sum: This study investigates how subsurface fluid injection affects the slip stability of gouge-filled faults using a spring-slider model coupled with rate-and-state friction, gouge dilatancy/compaction, and pore-pressure evolution. Through numerical ODE simulations and linear stability analysis under a quasi-steady-state approximation, the authors compare dry, fluid-saturated, and fluid-injection scenarios. Results show that fluid saturation without injection delays dynamic instability via dilatancy hardening, whereas rapid fluid injection advances instability and increases peak slip rate. Under rapid injection, onset timing becomes insensitive to the dilatancy coefficient, marking a transition from a dilatancy-influenced to an injection-dominated nucleation regime. The primary novelty is the derivation of a generalized critical stiffness expression and an injection-dilatancy competition number that simultaneously integrate effective normal stress magnitude, injection-driven pressurization rate, and dilatancy/compaction feedback, bridging classical stability criteria across varying hydraulic environments.
本研究建立了一个结合速率-状态摩擦定律、断层泥扩容/压实及孔隙压力演化的弹簧-滑块模型，结合常微分方程数值模拟与准稳态近似下的线性稳定性分析，对比了干燥、流体饱和及流体注入条件下的断层滑动演化。结果表明：无注入的流体饱和通过扩容硬化延迟了动态失稳，而快速流体注入则提前触发失稳并提高峰值滑移率，使失稳……

t: The authors couple a rate-and-state friction spring-slider model with Segall-Rice gouge porosity evolution and a lumped pore-pressure drainage/injection equation, solving the ODEs numerically and deriving linear stability via a quasi-steady-state approximation.
将速率-状态摩擦弹簧-滑块模型与孔隙度演化及注入方程耦合，结合数值求解与准稳态线性稳定性分析。

Synthetic numerical simulations explore dimensionless parameters constrained by laboratory and field data (e.g., Denver induced seismicity), varying normalized diffusivity (10^-3 to 10), injection rate (10^-4 to 0.2), and dilatancy coefficient (0.5 to 2).
基于实验室和丹佛诱发地震场地约束的无量纲参数，进行扩散率、注入率和扩容系数的数值模拟扫描。

First dynamic slip occurs at t = 67.12 (dry), delays to t = 112.91 (fluid-saturated without injection), and advances to t = 6.59 under rapid fluid injection (q = 0.1), with normalized peak slip rate reaching 9.04.
首次动态滑移时间在干燥、饱和无注入和快速注入下分别为67.12、112.91和6.59，注入下峰值滑移率最高达9.04。
The zero-dimensional lumped spring-slider model cannot capture spatially varying pore pressure, pressure-front migration, or rupture growth/arrest outside the locally pressurized fault patch.

Derives a unified critical stiffness criterion bridging Segall-Rice dilatancy stabilization and Alghannam-Juanes pressurization-rate destabilization, defining an injection-dilatancy competition number to map nucleation regime transitions.
推导出统一有效正应力、增压速率和扩容反馈的广义临界刚度判据，并提出注入-扩容竞争数。

Derived a generalized critical stiffness criterion that unifies effective normal stress magnitude, injection pressurization rate, and dilatancy feedback.
Introduced an injection-dilatancy competition number to quantify the transition from dilatancy-influenced to injection-dominated rupture nucleation.
建立了耦合断层泥扩容/压实、孔隙压力排泄和流体注入的速率-状态摩擦弹簧-滑块模型。
推导了统一有效正应力幅值、注入增压速率和扩容反馈的广义临界刚度判据。

me: Formulated a zero-dimensional lumped spring-slider ODE system combining Ruina slip law, Linker-Dieterich normal stress coupling, and Segall-Rice porosity evolution.
Solved coupled nonlinear dimensionless ODEs numerically using MATLAB's ode15s solver across dry, saturated, and injection parameter spaces.
Performed linear stability analysis using a quasi-steady-state approximation (QSSA) to separate slow injection pressurization from fast dilatancy perturbations.

Parametric sensitivity sweeps over normalized dilatancy coefficient (0.5 to 2), fluid injection rate (10^-4 to 0.2), and hydraulic diffusivity (10^-3 to 10).

针对归一化扩容系数（0.5至2）、流体注入速率（10^-4至0.2）和水力扩散系数（10^-3至10）的参数敏感性扫描实验。

Simulations are restricted to the net-dilatant gouge regime (epsilon > 0) and neglect fluid compressibility and compaction-dominated behaviors.
The QSSA linear stability approximation loses quantitative accuracy during early-time rapid injection and at high hydraulic diffusivity where slow/fast timescale separation weakens.

数值模拟仅限于净扩容断层泥机制（ε > 0），忽略了流体压缩性及压实主导的行为。

sum: This Nature News & Views article highlights a groundbreaking sea-floor monitoring experiment that successfully captured the creation of oceanic crust between two tectonic plates. Representing the first in situ measurement of sea-floor spreading, the study utilizes advanced undersea observatory instrumentation to record real-time geodynamical and tectonic processes at a mid-ocean ridge, providing unprecedented insights into how the ocean floor forms.
这篇发表在《Nature》的“新闻与观点”文章介绍了一项突破性的海底监测实验，该实验首次原位观测并记录了两大板块之间海洋地壳的诞生。该研究利用先进的海底观测站仪器，实时记录了洋中脊处的地质与构造活动，为理解海底扩张和洋壳形成机制提供了前所未有的直接观测证据。

捕获活动海底扩张和地壳形成的实时观测数据。
First direct in situ measurement and capture of oceanic crust being created between two tectonic plates.

Observations are localized to the specific undersea observatory site.

First time sea-floor spreading and crustal formation have been captured via direct in situ measurements.

sum: This paper presents a novel Tree-structured Bayesian Optimization (TBO) method integrated with Helmert Variance Component Estimation (HVCE) to jointly invert fault geometry and slip distribution from geodetic data (GNSS and InSAR). Traditional Monte Carlo-based Bayesian methods suffer from low computational efficiency and high sensitivity to initial parameters. The proposed TBO-HVCE framework overcomes these limitations, offering stable performance, reduced sensitivity to initial conditions, and lower misfits. Synthetic tests across various fault types and multi-fault scenarios demonstrate its robustness. The method is successfully applied to the 2021 Mw 6.4 Yangbi earthquake in Yunnan, China, accurately recovering fault kinematics and surface deformation.
本文提出了一种结合赫尔默特方差分量估计（HVCE）的树状结构贝叶斯优化（TBO）新方法，用于利用大地测量数据（GNSS和InSAR）联合反演断层几何和滑动分布。传统的蒙特卡洛贝叶斯方法计算效率低且对初始参数敏感。该研究提出的TBO-HVCE框架克服了这些局限性，具有更高的计算效率、更低的初始条件敏感……

t: A joint inversion framework combining Tree-structured Bayesian Optimization (TBO) with Helmert Variance Component Estimation (HVCE) to resolve non-linear fault geometry and linear slip distribution.
结合树状结构贝叶斯优化（TBO）与赫尔默特方差分量估计（HVCE）的联合反演框架，用于求解非线性断层几何与线性滑动分布。
Synthetic datasets representing various fault types and multi-fault scenarios, alongside real GNSS and InSAR observations of the 2021 Mw 6.4 Yangbi earthquake.
代表不同断层和多断层情景的合成数据集，以及2021年漾濞Mw 6.4级地震的真实GNSS和InSAR观测数据。

The proposed TBO-HVCE method achieves stable, reliable performance with significantly improved computational efficiency, lower sensitivity to initial conditions, and smaller misfits than conventional methods.
所提方法实现了稳定可靠的性能，相比传统方法显著提高了计算效率，降低了对初始条件的敏感性，并减小了拟合残差。

sum: This study presents high-resolution geochemical data and modeling of a 3.13–3.10 Ga volcanic succession in Australia's Pilbara Craton. The sequence contains tholeiitic, calc-alkaline, and boninitic lavas, indicating diverse mantle sources. Geochemical modeling shows that the mantle source required high water content, approaching modern mantle wedges. The authors propose that this hydrous melting was triggered by 'dripduction'—the localized, inclined foundering of hydrated lithosphere—rather than modern-style global plate tectonics.
本研究对澳大利亚皮尔巴拉克拉通31.3-31.0亿年前的火山岩层序进行了高分辨率地球化学数据分析与建模。该层序包含拉斑系列、钙碱性系列及玻安岩，表明存在多样化的地幔源区。地球化学模拟显示，产生这些熔体所需的地幔含水量极高，接近现代弧后地幔楔。研究表明，这种含水熔融是由“滴落构造”（即含水岩石圈的局部……

t: High-resolution geochemical analysis and thermodynamic modeling of mantle melting and depletion histories.

Geochemical measurements from a well-preserved 3.13-3.10 Ga volcanic succession in Australia's Pilbara Craton.

sum: Deep-learning phase pickers are increasingly used on borehole microseismic arrays, but whether exploiting cross-station moveout aids zero-shot generalization to new sites remains unclear. Using eight 3-component downhole arrays from the AMBER benchmark, this study performs a strict leave-one-site-out (LOSO) evaluation comparing an identical 2-D U-Net trained either across the full array or per trace. Results show no systematic benefit from moveout: median F1 scores are statistically tied (0.885 array vs. 0.878 per-trace). Instead, array advantage is confined to intermediate, in-distribution moveouts (25–35 ms), degrades at very small moveouts (6 ms), and suffers catastrophic P-wave detection collapse (F1 0.18 vs. 0.76) when a test site's moveout (70 ms) exceeds the training maximum (62 ms). A station-shuffle control proves non-transferable cross-station coupling drives this failure. For reliable unattended monitoring, the velocity-free per-trace picker is recommended as the safer default.
本研究利用AMBER基准库中的8个三分量井下微震台阵数据集，采用严格的留一站点交叉验证（LOSO）和无混杂消融实验，对比了完全相同的二维U-Net在全台阵（含台站间时差）与单道配置下的零样本泛化性能。结果表明，台阵时差并未带来系统性泛化收益，两者中位F1得分无显著差异（0.885对0.878）。台阵……

t: A 2-D U-Net (MoiraiPickerL3) acting on the (station, time) plane without striding the station axis, enabling an exact confound-free ablation between full-array (12-station) and per-trace (1-station) training under a zero-shot leave-one-site-out protocol.

Eight 3-component downhole microseismic arrays from the AMBER benchmark spanning geothermal, hydraulic-fracturing, and CO2-storage sites, standardized to 2000 Hz, 2048 samples, and up to 12 depth-ordered stations.

Array and per-trace pickers tie in median F1 (0.885 vs. 0.878), but at forge_19 (70 ms moveout vs. 62 ms training max) array P-picking collapses to F1 0.178 while per-trace achieves 0.755.

kc: Executed the first confound-free, zero-shot leave-one-site-out (LOSO) benchmark comparing array-level and per-trace deep-learning phase pickers across eight borehole microseismic arrays.

Demonstrated that cross-station moveout provides no systematic median F1 improvement (0.885 vs. 0.878) and causes catastrophic P-wave detection failure (F1 0.18) on out-of-distribution array geometries.
Designed a station-shuffle control experiment that separates ordered moveout from generic cross-station coupling, showing coupling drives the out-of-distribution collapse.
Formulated a practical, velocity-free deployment rule using a coordinate-free moveout descriptor to gate array models and trigger retraining.
在8个井下微震台阵上开展了首个无混杂因素、零样本留一站点（LOSO）基准测试，对比了台阵级与单道深度学习震相拾取器。
证明台站间时差不提供系统性的中位F1提升（0.885对0.878），且在分布外台阵几何下会导致灾难性的P波检测崩溃（F1为0.18）。

提出了一种基于无坐标时差描述符的无速度模型实用部署准则，用于控制台阵模型启用并触发重新训练。
me: 2-D U-Net architecture (MoiraiPickerL3, ~8M parameters) with GroupNorm + SiLU residual blocks and bottleneck self-attention acting on the (station, time) plane.
Confound-free ablation preserving the station axis without striding or pooling, allowing exact weight-sharing architecture between multi-station (S=12) and single-trace (S=1) inputs.
Class-weighted focal loss optimization with AdamW, cosine learning rate decay, and exponential moving average (EMA) parameter tracking.
Strict leave-one-site-out (LOSO) zero-shot evaluation with event-level bootstrap confidence intervals (300 resamples) and multi-seed stability checks.
Station-shuffle control permuting the station axis per sample to isolate ordered moveout from cross-station feature aggregation.
作用于（台站，时间）平面的二维U-Net架构（MoiraiPickerL3，约800万参数），包含GroupNorm+SiLU残差块和瓶颈自注意力层。
无混杂消融设计：在台站轴上进行卷积但不进行步幅下采样或池化，使多台站（S=12）与单道（S=1）输入共享完全相同的网络架构。
采用类别加权Focal Loss、AdamW优化器、余弦学习率衰减及指数移动平均（EMA）权重跟踪进行训练。
严格的留一站点（LOSO）零样本评估协议，结合事件级自助法置信区间（300次重采样）与多随机种子稳定性检验。
台站乱序对照实验：对每个样本独立打乱台站顺序，以分离有序时差与跨台站特征聚合的贡献。
de: Eight clean 3-component downhole microseismic sub-datasets from the AMBER benchmark (pnr-1, pnr-2, mseel_3h, mseel_5h, clearfield_mw4, clearfield_mw6, aneth, forge_19).
Waveforms standardized to 2000 Hz sampling rate with 2048-sample (1.024 s) windows across up to 12 depth-ordered borehole stations.
Spanning diverse induced-seismicity settings including hydraulic fracturing, enhanced geothermal systems (Utah FORGE), and geological CO2 storage (Aneth CCS) with median P moveouts from 6 to 70 ms.
来自AMBER基准数据库的8个高质量三分量井下微震子数据集（pnr-1、pnr-2、mseel_3h、mseel_5h、clearfield_mw4、clearfield_mw6、aneth、forge_19）。
波形统一重采样至2000 Hz，采用固定2048个采样点（1.024秒）分析时窗和最多12个按深度排序的井下台站。
涵盖水力压裂、增强型地热系统（Utah FORGE）和地质二氧化碳封存（Aneth CCS）等多种诱发地震场景，中位P波时差跨度为6至70毫秒。
li: The benchmark comprises only eight sites, making the non-monotonic relationship between array advantage and moveout suggestive rather than definitive.
The moveout descriptor is a one-dimensional proxy for geometry and does not explicitly incorporate coordinate-based aperture or source-array distance.
Direct comparison against fine-tuned external surface-trained pickers was left for future work.
基准测试仅包含8个站点，因此台阵优势与时差之间的非单调关系仅具指示性而非最终定论。
时差描述符仅是台阵几何的一维代理指标，未显式纳入基于坐标的孔径或震源-台阵距离。
尚未与经过微调的外部地表预训练拾取器进行直接对比。

tm.why: The paper designs and benchmarks deep-learning 2-D U-Net seismic phase pickers across array-level and per-trace configurations.
The core objective is automated P and S wave arrival-time picking and event detection on seismic waveforms.
The models are evaluated on downhole microseismic datasets from hydraulic fracturing, enhanced geothermal systems, and CO2 storage operations.

ev.notes: Full 21-page EarthArXiv preprint PDF including all text sections, equations, 3 tables, 7 main figures, and 4 supporting figures was analyzed.

sum: This study presents 3-m-resolution surface displacement and slip distributions for the 2023 Mw 7.8 Pazarcık and Mw 7.5 Elbistan, Türkiye, earthquakes using subpixel correlation of Planet Dove optical imagery. Focusing on a 30-km-long region spanning the Narlı-East Anatolian fault (EAF) intersection, the authors compare slip measurements from five datasets of varying resolutions (on-the-ground, WorldView, Planet Dove, Sentinel-2, and Sentinel-1). By integrating these surface observations with dynamic rupture simulations, they constrain the rupture evolution of the Pazarcık earthquake, which nucleated on the Narlı splay fault before propagating bilaterally onto the EAF. The work demonstrates how high-resolution surface deformation data from splay faults can resolve nonunique rupture models and improve our understanding of complex earthquake physics.
本研究利用Planet Dove光学影像的亚像素相关性，获取了2023年土耳其Mw 7.8 Pazarcık和Mw 7.5 Elbistan地震的3米分辨率地表形变及滑移分布。针对跨越Narlı与东安纳托利亚断裂（EAF）交汇处30公里的研究区，对比了野外、WorldView、Planet Dove……

t: Subpixel correlation of 3-m-resolution Planet Dove optical imagery combined with multi-resolution dataset comparison and integration with dynamic rupture simulations.
采用3米分辨率Planet Dove光学影像的亚像素相关性方法，并结合多分辨率数据集对比与动力学破裂模拟。
Optical and SAR datasets of varying resolutions (on-the-ground, WorldView, Planet Dove, Sentinel-2, and Sentinel-1) covering the 2023 Kahramanmaraş earthquake ruptures.
覆盖2023年土耳其地震破裂带的多分辨率光学与雷达数据集（包括野外实测、WorldView、Planet Dove、Se…
Constrained a consistent rupture evolution for the Mw 7.8 Pazarcık earthquake across the Narlı-EAF intersection by integrating multi-resolution surface slip with dynamic rupture models.
通过整合多分辨率地表滑移观测与动力学破裂模型，约束了Pazarcık地震跨越Narlı-EAF交汇处的破裂演化过程。
The analysis is limited by the nonuniqueness of rupture models and the varying spatial resolutions of the complementary geodetic datasets.
受限于破裂模型的多解性以及不同大地测量数据集空间分辨率的差异。
First comprehensive comparison of five multi-resolution surface slip datasets integrated with dynamic rupture simulations to resolve complex splay-to-main fault rupture propagation.
首次联合五种多分辨率地表滑移数据集与动力学模拟，系统解析了分支断层向主断层传播的复杂破裂过程。

Compared and integrated five multi-resolution geodetic and field datasets to evaluate complementary surface slip information.
Constrained the rupture evolution of the Mw 7.8 Pazarcık earthquake across the Narlı-EAF splay fault intersection by combining surface observations with dynamic rupture models.
利用Planet Dove影像生成了2023年卡赫拉曼马拉什地震序列全线3米分辨率的地表形变图。
对比并整合了五种不同分辨率的野外与大地测量数据集，评估了地表滑移信息的互补性。
结合地表观测与动力学破裂模型，约束了Mw 7.8 Pazarcık地震在Narlı-EAF分支断层交汇处的破裂演化过程。

Multi-resolution comparative analysis of surface slip distributions (on-the-ground, WorldView, Planet Dove, Sentinel-2, and Sentinel-1).
Integration of surface faulting observations with published dynamic rupture simulations.
高分辨率Planet Dove光学卫星影像的亚像素相关性分析。

On-the-ground field measurements, WorldView, Sentinel-2, and Sentinel-1 SAR/optical datasets over a 30-km-long study region spanning the Narlı-EAF intersection.

Integrating static surface slip with dynamic rupture models relies on simplified assumptions of fault geometry and friction.

tm.why: The paper integrates high-resolution surface slip distributions with dynamic rupture simulations to constrain the rupture process of the 2023 Kahramanmaraş earthquake sequence.
It investigates the role of splay faults, specifically the Narlı-EAF intersection, in controlling earthquake nucleation and rupture propagation.

sum: This Viewpoint paper re-evaluates the seismotectonic framework of the offshore Main Marmara Fault (MMF) along the North Anatolian Fault Zone near Istanbul. Traditionally modeled as a single continuous strike-slip fault, recent geological, geodetic, and microseismicity evidence indicates a broader distributed shear zone comprising strike-slip segments, pull-apart basins, and auxiliary faults with alternating locked and creeping patches. By drawing analogies with the San Andreas Fault and the Eastern California Shear Zone, and reviewing 3-D geomechanical and multicycle rupture models, the author argues that both single-fault and segmented models yield similar maximum magnitudes (Mw ~7.3–7.4). However, a distributed fault network introduces novel hazard challenges: potential rare supercycle multisegment ruptures, complex spatio-temporal ground-motion distributions from multiple rupture fronts, and breakdown of periodic recurrence intervals. Future risk mitigation requires dense submarine geodesy, high-resolution marine geophysics, and seafloor borehole seismic monitoring.
本观点文章重新评估了伊斯坦布尔附近北安纳托利亚断裂带海底主马尔马拉断层（MMF）的地震构造框架。综合地质、大地测量和微震数据表明，该区并非单一连续走滑断层，而是包含走滑段、拉分盆地及次级断层的宽广分布式剪切带，且闭锁与蠕滑区交替分布。通过类比圣安德烈斯断层与东加利福尼亚剪切带并结合数值模拟，作者指出……

t: The author synthesizes geological, geodetic, and seismological observations with geomechanical models and structural analogies to the San Andreas Fault and Eastern California Shear Zone to evaluate rupture scenarios in the Sea of Marmara.
综合地质、大地测量和地震学观测与力学模型，并类比东加利福尼亚剪切带以评估破裂情景。

Evidence includes a 2300-yr historical catalogue, marine bathymetry and seismic reflection surveys, geodetic slip rates, two decades of microseismicity, earthquake repeaters, and recent M > 5 migrating sequences.
综合了2300年历史地震目录、海洋地球物理测量、近二十年微震、重复地震及近期M>5序列。

Single continuous versus segmented fault models yield similar maximum magnitudes (Mmax ~ 7.4 vs ~ 7.3), but a broader shear zone implies complex ground motions from multiple rupture fronts and non-periodic strain release.
单一与分段模型最大震级相近（约7.4对7.3），但宽剪切带会导致多破裂前锋复杂地面运动。
Because the submarine fault zone lies tens of kilometers offshore, near-fault observations and high-resolution geodetic deformation measurements along fault subbranches remain limited.
因海底断层离岸数十公里，近断层观测及高分辨率海底大地测量形变数据仍然受限。

Reframes the Main Marmara Fault from a single planar fault to an Eastern California Shear Zone-like distributed fault network, highlighting multisegment cascading ruptures and complex ground-motion hazards.
将主马尔马拉断层重塑为分布式断层网络，强调多段级联破裂与复杂地面运动风险。

Draws structural and kinematic analogies between the Marmara fault system and the Eastern California Shear Zone / Walker Lane.
Outlines critical implications for Istanbul's seismic hazard, including complex ground motion from multiple rupture fronts, non-periodic strain release, and supercycle cascading ruptures.
综合地震学、大地测量和地质证据，表明主马尔马拉断层是一个复杂的分布式剪切带，而非单一平面断层。
在马尔马拉断层系统与东加利福尼亚剪切带/沃克巷之间建立了构造和运动学类比。
阐述了对伊斯坦布尔地震危害的关键影响，包括多破裂前锋引起的复杂地面运动、非周期性应变释放以及超周期级联破裂。

Comparative structural analogy with onshore transform fault systems (San Andreas Fault, Eastern California Shear Zone, Walker Lane).
Assessment of 3-D geomechanical and multicycle physics-based rupture modeling results.
对近海北安纳托利亚断裂带进行文献综合与地震构造框架评估。
与陆上转换断层系统（圣安德烈斯断层、东加利福尼亚剪切带、沃克巷）进行对比构造类比。
评估三维地质力学和多周期基于物理的破裂模拟结果。

Marine geophysical surveys, high-resolution bathymetry, and seismic reflection constraints.
Regional geodetic deformation rates (~20 mm/yr) and a 2300-yr historical earthquake catalog.

It examines fault-zone architecture, slip partitioning, seismic coupling, and alternating locked and creeping segments along the offshore North Anatolian Fault Zone.
It assesses the plausibility of single continuous ruptures versus cascading, multisegment ruptures across a distributed shear zone.

sum: This study utilizes high-resolution microseismic monitoring to investigate the progressive activation of a complex fault system during hydraulic fracturing operations. By analyzing high-precision microseismic locations and source parameters, the authors track the spatial-temporal evolution of seismicity and fluid migration. The results demonstrate how fluid injection progressively triggers slip on pre-existing complex fault networks, providing critical insights into the physical mechanisms of injection-induced earthquakes and fault reactivation.
本研究利用高分辨率微震监测技术，研究了水力压裂过程中复杂断裂系统的渐进激活过程。通过分析高精度微震位置和震源参数，作者追踪了地震活动性与流体运移的时空演化。结果表明，流体注入如何逐步触发预存复杂断层网络上的滑动，为注水诱发地震和断层活化的物理机制提供了关键见解。

t: High-resolution microseismic monitoring and event relocation to map the fine-scale geometry and progressive activation of a complex fault system during hydraulic fracturing.
采用高分辨率微震监测和事件重定位技术，绘制水力压裂过程中复杂断裂系统的精细几何结构和渐进激活过程。
Microseismic waveform data and injection parameters collected during hydraulic fracturing operations targeting a reservoir with a complex fault system.
在针对含有复杂断裂系统的储层进行水力压裂作业期间收集的微震波形数据和注入参数。
Detailed mapping of the progressive, step-by-step activation of pre-existing complex faults driven by fluid diffusion and stress transfer.
详细刻画了在流体扩散和应力传递驱动下，预存复杂断层逐步、分阶段激活的过程。
Analysis is constrained by the lack of direct downhole pore pressure measurements and localized in-situ stress state data.
分析受限于缺乏直接的井下孔隙压力测量和局地原位应力状态数据。
High-resolution characterization of the progressive, multi-stage activation of a complex, interconnected fault network rather than a single isolated fault plane.
高分辨率表征了复杂的、相互连接的断层网络（而非单一孤立断层面）的渐进式、多阶段激活过程。

Applied high-resolution microseismic monitoring to map fine-scale fault geometries and fluid pathways.
Provided observational constraints on the physical mechanisms driving injection-induced seismicity.
揭示了水力压裂过程中复杂断裂系统详细的时空渐进激活过程。
应用高分辨率微震监测技术绘制了精细尺度的断层几何结构和流体通道。

Spatial-temporal analysis of microseismicity and fluid diffusion modeling.
Characterization of fault plane orientations and source parameters.

Injection parameters including fluid volume, pressure, and injection rates.

It utilizes high-resolution microseismic monitoring to track the progressive activation of faults during injection.
It analyzes the progressive activation and mechanics of a complex fault system under fluid injection.

sum: Stacked cross-correlation functions (XCFs) of ambient seismic noise are widely used to approximate Green's functions. While valid for ballistic arrivals, theoretical justification for non-ballistic (scattered) arrivals has been lacking. This paper derives 2D analytical stationary-phase solutions for ambient noise XCFs across uncorrelated, correlated, point-scatterer, planar-reflector, and random-scattering scenarios, validated by synthetic wavefield simulations. The authors demonstrate that under continuous overlapping random noise, non-ballistic arrivals in stacked XCFs are heavily contaminated by source-induced cross-talk artifacts. Consequently, coda waves from random medium scattering cannot be distinguished from overlapping source cross-talks, and stable source correlations can mimic apparent velocity changes (e.g., dt/t ~ 1-2%). The key novelty is establishing the exact mathematical and physical conditions differentiating XCF non-ballistic phases from true Green's function coda, proving that interpreting late-lag XCF arrivals as medium changes requires ruling out source effects.
本文针对环境噪声互相关函数（XCF）中的非弹道（散射）波推导了二维解析稳相解，并结合点散射体、平面反射界面及随机介质的数值模拟进行验证。研究建立了区分叠加XCF非弹道波与真实格林函数尾波的数学与物理条件，量化了连续重叠噪声源引起的串扰伪影。结果表明，随机介质散射产生的尾波极其微弱，无法与重叠噪声源引……

t: The authors perform 2D analytical stationary-phase analysis on cross-correlations of random plane-wave noise fields, progressively relaxing assumptions from uncorrelated sources to time/angle correlated sources, point scatterers, planar reflectors, and random media.
对二维随机平面波噪声场互相关进行解析稳相分析，涵盖不相关源、时间/角度相关源、点散射体、平面反射及随机介质。

2D synthetic wavefield simulations are conducted using circular source distributions around two receivers in homogeneous, point-scatterer, planar-reflector, and random density (>100% variation) media, stacking up to 180,000 dominant periods.
在均匀、点散射、平面反射和强随机密度起伏（>100%）介质中进行二维合成波场模拟，最高叠加达180,000个主周期。

In random media, true coda waves have SNR < 1:1 even after 180,000 stacks due to overlapping source cross-talks. Furthermore, changing source correlation time in a static homogeneous medium induces false dt/t shifts of 1–2%.
随机介质真实尾波在叠加180,000次后信噪比仍低于1:1；静态均匀介质中震源相关时间变化可引起1%–2%的虚假dt/t…
The study relies entirely on 2D theoretical derivations and synthetic simulations assuming uniform source distributions and no intrinsic attenuation, without field data validation.
研究基于二维理论推导和无本征衰减的合成数据模拟，尚未在实际野外观测数据中验证。

First analytical stationary-phase framework quantifying non-ballistic scattered arrivals and cross-talk artifacts in ambient noise XCFs, disproving the general equivalency between late-lag XCFs and impulsive Green's function coda waves.
首次建立量化环境噪声XCF非弹道散射波与串扰伪影的稳相理论，证伪了XCF晚到波与脉冲格林函数尾波的普遍等价性。

kc: Derived 2D analytical stationary-phase solutions for non-ballistic arrivals in ambient noise cross-correlations under various source and scattering scenarios.
Demonstrated that stationary-phase zones for scattered waves (point scatterers and planar reflectors) differ markedly from those for ballistic direct waves.
Quantified the amplitudes of scattered waves versus source cross-talk artifacts, showing that random medium coda waves remain buried below SNR 1:1 even after 180,000 stacks.
Proved that changes in source correlation time in a homogeneous medium can produce apparent relative time shifts (dt/t of 1-2%) in late-time XCF arrivals.
推导了不同震源和散射情景下环境噪声互相关中非弹道波的二维解析稳相解。
证明了散射波（点散射体和平面反射界面）的稳相区与弹道直达波的稳相区存在显著差异。
量化了散射波与源串扰伪影的振幅关系，表明随机介质尾波即使在叠加180,000次后信噪比仍低于1:1。
证明了均匀介质中噪声源相关时间的变化会导致XCF晚到波产生1%-2%的虚假相对时间偏移（dt/t）。
me: 2D analytical stationary-phase analysis of frequency-domain cross-correlations for random plane-wave noise fields.
Theoretical formulation of cross-correlation phase and amplitude for time/angle correlated sources, single point scatterers, planar reflectors, and multiple scattering.
2D numerical wavefield simulations comparing true Green's functions with stacked XCFs for impulsive and continuous overlapping random sources.
针对随机平面波噪声场频率域互相关的二维解析稳相分析。
建立时间/角度相关源、单点散射体、平面反射界面及多次散射条件下的互相关相位与振幅理论公式。
开展二维数值波场模拟，对比脉冲源和连续重叠随机源下真实格林函数与叠加XCF的差异。
de: 2D synthetic wavefield simulations with a circular array of sources surrounding two receivers in a homogeneous medium containing a single point scatterer.
2D synthetic simulations with a single planar reflector outside the receiver pair support.
2D synthetic simulations in a strong random scattering medium (density variations >100%) stacked up to N = 180,000 times.
Synthetic experiment in a homogeneous medium with 8 realizations of time-correlated random noise sources to test apparent dt/t shifts.
含单点散射体的均匀介质中，围绕两个接收器的环形震源阵列二维合成波场模拟。
接收器对外部含单一平面反射界面的二维合成波场模拟。
强随机散射介质（密度起伏>100%）中的二维合成模拟，最大叠加次数达N = 180,000次。

sum: This paper presents a GPU-accelerated 3D finite-difference method to simulate dipole-source acoustic wave propagation in deviated boreholes within vertically transversely isotropic (VTI) formations. By employing a coordinate system rotation strategy, the method efficiently handles anisotropy with high computational performance. Simulations on a 2x2x6 m wellbore model (e.g., Pierre Shale) reveal distinct shear-wave velocity variations and splitting in the xoz and yoz planes as well deviation increases. Slowness-time-coherence analysis validates the simulated velocities against theoretical group velocities. The study demonstrates that well deviations exceeding 60 degrees introduce significant amplitude and arrival-time differences between fast and slow shear waves, enhancing the interpretation of acoustic logging in complex anisotropic reservoirs.
本文提出了一种利用GPU加速的三维有限差分方法，用于模拟垂直横向同性（VTI）地层斜井中双极子源的声波传播。该方法采用坐标系旋转策略高效处理各向异性，显著提升了计算效率。在2x2x6米井筒模型（如皮埃尔页岩）上的模拟表明，随着井斜角增加，xoz和yoz面内的剪切波速度呈现出不同的变化规律，揭示了快慢……

t: A 3D finite-difference method accelerated by GPU computing, utilizing a coordinate system rotation strategy to efficiently handle VTI anisotropy in deviated boreholes.
采用GPU加速的三维有限差分方法，结合坐标系旋转策略高效处理斜井中的VTI各向异性。
Synthetic waveforms simulated on a 2 x 2 x 6 m anisotropic wellbore model (e.g., Pierre Shale), supplemented by real acoustic logging data.

The study is limited to VTI and simple azimuthal anisotropy, requiring validation in more complex heterogeneous or fractured formations.

sum: This study characterizes the seismic source parameters of 735 earthquakes (1.65 <= ML <= 4.55) recorded between 2016 and 2024 across the Adriatic indenter in the European Southeastern Alps. Using the non-parametric Generalized Inversion Technique (GITpy) on S-wave Fourier amplitude spectra from 172 velocimetric and accelerometric stations, the authors isolate source spectra, path attenuation, and site responses. Fitting the Brune omega-square model yields seismic moments, corner frequencies, stress drops (median 0.44 MPa), radiated energy, and Savage-Wood seismic efficiency (median 0.278). The results reveal deviations from self-similar scaling, with stress drop and apparent stress increasing with earthquake size and focal depth. Spatially, high-efficiency events cluster in the northeastern Italian Alps and Sneznik Mt., whereas low-efficiency events characterize the Schio-Vicenza-Lessini and Tolmin-Idrija fault systems. This comprehensive regional dataset provides novel constraints on fault mechanical heterogeneity, dynamic fault strength, and ground motion modeling.
本研究采用非参数广义反演技术（GIT），联合172个测震与强震台站的S波傅里叶幅值谱，分离了欧洲东南阿尔卑斯亚得里亚楔入体区域2016–2024年间735次地震（1.65≤ML≤4.55）的震源、路径衰减与场地效应。基于Brune模型拟合获得了地震矩、拐角频率、应力降（中位数0.44 MPa）、辐射……

t: A two-step approach using non-parametric Generalized Inversion Technique (GITpy) to separate source, path, and site terms from S-wave Fourier amplitude spectra, followed by Brune omega-square model fitting.
采用两步法：先用非参数GIT（GITpy）分离震源、路径和场地项，再拟合Brune ω²震源模型。

1,191 high-quality earthquakes (735 converged for source parameters, 1.65 <= ML <= 4.55) recorded by 172 velocimetric and accelerometric stations across Northeastern Italy and surrounding areas during 2016-2024.
2016–2024年间172个速度与加速度台站记录的1191次高质量地震（735次收敛，1.65≤ML≤4.55）。

Brune stress drops range from 0.02 to 9.13 MPa (median 0.44 MPa), breaking self-similarity (epsilon = -0.63 +/- 0.14). Savage-Wood efficiency has a median of 0.278 and clusters spatially by tectonic domain.
应力降介于0.02–9.13 MPa（中位数0.44 MPa），偏离自相似性；地震效率中位数为0.278且具空间分异。
Estimates depend on the fixed Brune omega-square assumption (n = 2) and depth-independent path attenuation, leaving inherent trade-offs between spectral decay, depth, and stress drop scaling.
受限于固定ω²高频衰减假设与无深度依赖的路径衰减模型，存在固有参数折衷。
First regional-scale non-parametric GIT source characterization over the entire Adriatic indenter jointly utilizing all permanent and temporary accelerometric and velocimetric networks.
首次联合该区所有固定与流动强震及测震台网开展整个亚得里亚楔入体的非参数震源特征分析。

kc: Compiled and inverted an expanded dataset of 1,191 earthquakes recorded by 172 accelerometric and velocimetric stations across the Adriatic indenter, obtaining converged source parameters for 735 events.
Demonstrated apparent breaking of self-similarity in the region, with stress drop and apparent stress increasing with seismic moment and focal depth.

Mapped spatial variations in Savage-Wood seismic efficiency (median 0.278), identifying distinct fault mechanical regimes and potential high pore-pressure undershoot zones across seismotectonic domains.
整合并反演了亚得里亚楔入体区域172个加速度和速度台站记录的1191次地震，获得了735个事件的可靠震源参数数据集。
揭示了该区域震源偏离自相似标度律的特征，表现为应力降和视应力随地震矩和震源深度的增加而增大。
绘制了Savage-Wood地震效率（中位数0.278）的空间分布，识别出不同地震构造域的断层力学机制差异及潜在的高孔隙水压欠调区。
me: Non-parametric one-step Generalized Inversion Technique (GIT) implemented via GITpy to decompose log S-wave Fourier amplitude spectra into source, path attenuation, and site terms.
Reference site constraint using 12 flat-response stations with high-frequency decay (kappa = 0.02 s) and a reference hypocentral distance of r0 = 10 km.

Brune omega-square spectral fitting using depth-dependent S-wave velocity and density from a 1-D regional crustal model (MR20) to compute M0, fc, stress drop, radiated energy, and Savage-Wood efficiency.
采用GITpy实现的非参数一步广义反演技术（GIT），将对数S波傅里叶振幅谱分解为震源项、路径衰减项和场地响应项。
利用12个平坦响应参考台站施加高频衰减约束（κ = 0.02 s），并将参考震源距设定为 r0 = 10 km。
结合区域一维地壳模型（MR20）的深度相关S波速度和密度，拟合Brune ω²震源模型以计算地震矩、拐角频率、应力降、辐射能量及Savage-Wood效率。
de: Initial pool of 13,568 earthquakes (2016-2024) from the OGS bulletin within 120 km epicentral distance, relocated with NonLinLoc and filtered to 1,191 high-quality events (735 converged in spectral fitting).

Over 20,000 horizontal S-wave Fourier amplitude spectra per frequency (1.3-25 Hz) recorded across 172 permanent and temporary stations from 13 seismic networks in Italy, Slovenia, Austria, and Switzerland.
从OGS目录（2016–2024年）初选震中距120 km内的13,568次地震，经NonLinLoc重定位和质量筛选保留1191个高质量事件（其中735个谱拟合收敛）。
汇集意大利、斯洛文尼亚、奥地利和瑞士13个地震台网共172个固定和流动台站的记录，在1.3–25 Hz频段内每个频点包含超过20,000个水平向S波谱振幅值。

Source parameter estimates rely on the fixed Brune omega-square high-frequency spectral fall-off (n = 2), creating an inherent trade-off between stress drop scaling and spectral decay rate.
路径衰减模型未显式考虑震源深度依赖性，可能与震源项发生折衷并高估应力降随深度的增加趋势。
震源参数估计依赖于固定高频衰减斜率（n = 2）的Brune ω²模型假设，在应力降标度关系与谱衰减率之间存在固有折衷。

The study interprets spatial variations in Savage-Wood efficiency and stress drop to infer dynamic fault strength, overshoot/undershoot, and pore fluid pressurization across regional fault systems.
A non-parametric Generalized Inversion Technique is used to simultaneously separate source spectra, spectral path attenuation with distance, and site amplification.

sum: This study utilizes receiver function analysis to provide the first regional-scale estimate of subducted oceanic plate crustal thickness along the Perú-Chile Subduction Zone (10°S to 40°S) at depths up to ~100 km. The results show that the subducting Nazca plate crust varies in thickness from 6 to 22 km, with the thickest crust occurring near subducting aseismic ridges (e.g., the Nazca Ridge). Notably, flat-slab segments exhibit a broader zone of crustal thickening than predicted by offshore ridge geometry. Comparing these observations with numerical models suggests that while the combined effect of plate age and crustal thickness controls slab buoyancy and dip, a wide zone of crustal thickening (>400 km) is essential for supporting flat-slab subduction.
本研究利用接收函数分析，首次对秘鲁-智利俯冲带（南纬10°至40°）深达100公里的俯冲大洋板块地壳厚度进行了区域尺度估算。结果显示，俯冲的纳斯卡板块地壳厚度在6至22公里之间变化，最厚处位于俯冲脊（如纳斯卡海脊）附近。在平板俯冲段，地壳增厚区域比海脊向外延伸的范围更宽。与数值模拟对比表明，虽然板块……

t: Receiver function analysis is applied to seismic data along the Perú-Chile margin to image the subducted Nazca plate crustal thickness down to ~100 km depth.
利用接收函数分析方法处理秘鲁-智利边缘的地震数据，成像深达100公里的俯冲纳斯卡板块地壳厚度。
Seismic waveform data recorded between latitudes 10°S and 40°S along the Perú-Chile Subduction Zone, targeting depths up to ~100 km.
收集并分析了南纬10°至40°之间秘鲁-智利俯冲带的地震波形数据。

Reveals that the subducting Nazca plate crust varies in thickness from 6 to 22 km, with significant thickening near subducting ridges.

Comparison of observational results with geodynamic numerical model predictions of slab buoyancy.

Measurements of Nazca plate crustal thickness at depths up to ~100 km.

sum: This study investigates the deep circulation of meteoric water in the Himalayas and its relationship with regional tectonics and seismicity. By analyzing stable isotopes (δ18O and δD) and water chemistry of hot springs across three major tectonic boundaries, and integrating geothermometry-derived reservoir temperatures with earthquake hypocentral depths, the authors find that the maximum depth of meteoric water circulation is ~3–5 km. This is shallower than the regional earthquake hypocenters (5–25 km). The circulation is deeper in extensional settings or near additional heat sources, and shallower in compressional settings unless thrust faults are tectonically active. The study concludes that meteoric water circulation depths are strongly controlled by subsurface tectonic structures and fault activity, and generally do not reach earthquake hypocentral depths.
本研究探讨了喜马拉雅地区大气降水的深部循环及其与区域构造和地震活动的关系。通过分析跨越三个主要构造边界的温泉稳定同位素（δ18O和δD）和水化学特征，并结合地温计估算的储层温度与地震震源深度，研究发现大气降水循环的最大深度约为3-5千米，浅于该区域的地震震源深度（5-25千米）。在伸展背景或存在额外……

t: Analysis of stable isotopes (δ18O, δD) and water chemistry of hot springs combined with geothermometry to estimate reservoir temperatures and fluid circulation depths.
结合温泉稳定同位素（δ18O、δD）和水化学分析与地温计，估算热储温度和流体循环深度。

sum: This study investigates the geometry and kinematics of active faults in the Val d'Agri basin (Southern Italy) using a 2021–2023 machine-learning microseismic catalog (9,618 events). By combining waveform similarity-based clustering (Clusty/DBSCAN), double-difference relocation (hypoDD), and Bayesian full-waveform moment tensor inversion (Grond) down to M ≈ 2, the authors identify 10 distinct clusters (607 clustered events, 318 relocated) concentrated near the Pertusillo artificial reservoir. Relocated clusters illuminate planar, NW-SE striking, steeply (~60°) SW-dipping structures at 1.5–5 km depth within the Apulian carbonate platform, governed by normal faulting consistent with regional NE-SW extension. Analysis of a July 2023 sequence (Mw 3.4 mainshock) in the largest cluster (~3 km long) reveals bilateral edgeward migration consistent with hydraulic diffusivity D = 0.30 m²/s. Finally, finite-fault ground-motion simulations for a hypothetical complete segment rupture (Mw 4.7) yield PGVs of 0.09–0.14 m/s (MMI VI), demonstrating strong directivity and oblique-rake modulation.

sum: The relative roles of crustal versus mantle dynamics in sustaining the intracontinental Hangai Dome in central Mongolia remain debated. This study jointly inverts teleseismic P-wave receiver functions and ambient-noise Rayleigh wave dispersion (6–75 s), supplemented by H-κ and common conversion point (CCP) stacking across 52 stations, to image the crust and uppermost mantle. Results reveal a significantly thickened crust (50–53 km) and thinned lithosphere (65–70 km) beneath the dome. Pronounced lateral variations exist: the eastern dome exhibits a lower-crustal low-velocity zone (<3.5 km/s) and elevated Vp/Vs (1.75–1.80) attributed to fluids and volatiles facilitating rapid ascent of mantle melts, whereas the western lower crust remains stronger. Strong linear correlations between surface elevation, crustal thickness (r = 0.87), and Bouguer gravity anomalies (r = -0.94) demonstrate near-isostatic equilibrium, indicating that inherited Mesozoic crustal thickening primarily controls the uplift, with Cenozoic asthenospheric upwelling playing a secondary role.
针对蒙古中部杭爱穹隆陆内隆升的深部机制争议，本研究利用52个台站的远震接收函数与背景噪声瑞利波频散数据（6–75秒）开展联合反演，并结合H-κ和共转换点（CCP）叠加成像地壳及上地幔顶部结构。结果显示穹隆下方地壳显著增厚（50–53 km），岩石圈强烈减薄（65–70 km）。东西部结构差异显著：东……

t: Jointly inverts Rayleigh wave phase velocity dispersion (6–75 s) and ray-parameter-binned radial receiver functions using an iteratively damped least-squares algorithm, alongside H-κ and 3D-migrated CCP stacking.
采用迭代阻尼最小二乘法联合反演瑞利波相速度频散与接收函数，结合H-κ和三维时深转换CCP叠加。

Uses 6,997 radial receiver functions from 523 teleseismic events recorded at 52 stations along two profiles from the XL and YT arrays in central Mongolia, combined with 6–75 s ambient-noise Rayleigh wave dispersion.
使用蒙古中部XL和YT台阵52个台站记录的523个远震事件的6997条接收函数及6–75秒瑞利波频散。

Reveals thickened crust (50–53 km), thinned lithosphere (65–70 km), an eastern lower-crustal low-velocity zone (<3.5 km/s) with Vp/Vs of 1.75–1.80, and strong correlations of elevation with crustal thickness (r=0.87) and Bouguer gravity (r=-0.94).
揭示地壳增厚(50–53 km)、岩石圈减薄(65–70 km)、东部下地壳低速带，高程与地壳厚度(r=0.87)强相关…

Demonstrated strong linear correlations between elevation, crustal thickness (r = 0.87), and Bouguer gravity (r = -0.94), proving the dome is in near-isostatic equilibrium supported primarily by inherited thickened crust.

证实了地表高程与地壳厚度（r = 0.87）及布格重力异常（r = -0.94）具有强线性相关性，表明穹隆处于近均衡状态，主要由继承性增厚地壳支撑。

H-κ stacking (weights 0.7, 0.2, 0.1 for Ps, PpPs, PpSs/PsPs) and 3D velocity-migrated Common Conversion Point (CCP) stacking.
Iteratively damped least-squares joint inversion of ray-parameter-binned receiver functions and ambient-noise Rayleigh wave phase velocity dispersion curves (6–75 s).
Airy isostatic evaluation correlating crustal thickness, surface topography, and WGM2012 Bouguer gravity anomalies.

sum: This paper adapts Flow Matching, a generative deep learning method utilizing Continuous Normalizing Flows, to probabilistic geophysical inversion. Unlike traditional sampling methods hindered by the curse of dimensionality or deterministic inversions requiring accurate starting models and regularization, Guided Flow Matching learns to transform a standard Normal distribution into a posterior model distribution conditioned on observed seismic data via solving an ordinary differential equation. Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) is incorporated to steer trajectories toward high-likelihood models. The authors evaluate the approach on two synthetic cases: a 2D two-layer refraction traveltime model and 2D seismic Full-Waveform Inversion using the OpenFWI FlatFaultB dataset (54,000 models), combining a pretrained EfficientNet wavefield compressor with an attention U-Net. CFG (w=4) reduces mean traveltime error from 27.7e-5 s to 0.52e-5 s in the two-layer test and rapidly recovers complex faulted velocity models and posterior uncertainties within seconds.
本文首次将生成式AI中的流匹配（Flow Matching）技术引入地球物理概率反演。该方法利用连续归一化流，通过求解常微分方程，在观测数据引导下将正态分布转化为后验速度模型分布，并结合无分类器引导（CFG）提升似然度。实验采用双层折射走时模型和OpenFWI FlatFaultB全波形反演数据集（……

t: Guided Flow Matching trains a neural network (MLP or EfficientNet-encoded U-Net) to approximate a time-dependent conditional vector field, transforming Gaussian noise into posterior velocity models via solving an ODE with Classifier-Free Guidance.
利用引导流匹配训练神经网络逼近条件向量场，结合CFG通过求解ODE将高斯噪声转化为后验速度模型。
Evaluated on a 2D two-layer refraction traveltime model and the OpenFWI FlatFaultB dataset containing 54,000 faulted velocity models (64x64) with five 70-receiver surface shot gathers per model.
采用二维双层折射走时模型以及包含54,000个断层速度模型和五炮地震记录的OpenFWI数据集。

Classifier-Free Guidance (w=4) reduces mean traveltime error from 27.7e-5 s to 0.52e-5 s in the two-layer model and accurately reconstructs OpenFWI faulted velocity models in seconds with uncertainty localized at boundaries.
CFG(w=4)将双层模型走时误差从27.7e-5秒降至0.52e-5秒，并在数秒内重建复杂断层模型及边界不确定性。
The pretrained EfficientNet encoder requires fixed seismic acquisition geometries matching the training dataset, and predictions cannot extrapolate outside the prior training distribution.

First adaptation of generative AI Flow Matching and Classifier-Free Guidance to geophysical probabilistic inversion and 2D seismic Full-Waveform Inversion.
首次将生成式AI流匹配与无分类器引导引入地球物理概率反演及二维全波形反演。

Demonstrates that Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) significantly reduces data misfit by steering posterior samples toward higher likelihood regions.

Designs an EfficientNet-encoded U-Net architecture for 2D probabilistic seismic Full-Waveform Inversion on the OpenFWI FlatFaultB dataset, achieving rapid posterior sampling and uncertainty quantification.
将生成式AI中的流匹配（Flow Matching）与连续归一化流数学框架引入地球物理概率反演。
证明无分类器引导（CFG）能将后验采样推向高似然区域，从而显著降低数据拟合误差。
设计了结合EfficientNet编码器与U-Net的网络架构，在OpenFWI数据集上实现了快速的二维概率全波形反演与不确定性评估。
me: Guided Flow Matching with Gaussian Conditional Probability Paths and Continuous Normalizing Flows solved via ODEs.
Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) blending unguided and data-guided vector field predictions during ODE inference.
Deep neural network combining a fine-tuned pretrained EfficientNet wavefield compressor with an attention-based U-Net.
基于高斯条件概率路径与连续归一化流的引导流匹配方法，通过常微分方程（ODE）求解。

结合微调预训练EfficientNet波场压缩器与带注意力机制U-Net的深度神经网络。
de: Synthetic 2D two-layer velocity model conditioned on refracted wave traveltimes for a 50 m source-receiver offset.
OpenFWI FlatFaultB dataset comprising 54,000 2D synthetic velocity models (interpolated to 64x64) and 5-shot surface seismograms (90% training, 10% validation).
基于50米源检距折射波走时约束的二维双层合成速度模型实验。
OpenFWI FlatFaultB数据集，包含54,000个二维断层速度模型（插值至64x64）及对应的5炮地表地震记录（90%训练，10%验证）。

Regions with weak seismic signal (e.g., deeper structures without geometric spreading correction) rely heavily on prior extrapolation from the training distribution.
反演结果受限于训练数据集所涵盖的先验模型分布，无法采样分布外的有效模型。
EfficientNet波场编码器要求固定的观测系统几何结构，限制了在可变野外观测系统中的直接应用。
地震信号微弱区域（如未做几何扩散校正的深部构造）主要依赖训练分布的先验外推。

tm.why: The paper develops a probabilistic inversion framework using Flow Matching to sample posterior velocity model distributions and evaluate parameter uncertainty via standard deviations.
It adapts generative AI Flow Matching, Continuous Normalizing Flows, EfficientNet encoders, and U-Net architectures for geophysical velocity inversion.

sum: This study proposes an on-site comparison calibration system for broadband seismometers that incorporates temperature correction to mitigate sensitivity changes in the reference seismometer. The system was applied to calibrate operational STS-1 seismometers, determining midband sensitivity around 0.5 Hz with low uncertainties of 0.3%–0.5%. It also identified an unexpected 28 ms time delay and mapped the relative frequency response down to 0.02 Hz, demonstrating a robust approach for seismic network quality control.
本研究提出了一种结合温度校正的宽频带地震计在线比对标定系统，以消除参考地震计因温度变化导致的灵敏度漂移。该系统被应用于标定运行中的STS-1地震计，在0.5 Hz附近的频段内实现了0.3%–0.5%的低不确定度标定。此外，研究还发现了一个未知的28毫秒时延，并确定了低至0.02 Hz的相对频率响应，……

t: An on-site comparison calibration method that compares local vibration signals between a target and a reference seismometer, incorporating temperature monitoring to correct reference sensitivity drift.
一种在线比对标定方法，通过对比目标与参考地震计的本地振动信号，并引入温度监测来校正参考灵敏度漂移。
Local vibration signals recorded by operational STS-1 broadband seismometers and a co-located reference seismometer.
由运行中的STS-1宽频带地震计和同台址参考地震计记录的本地振动信号。
Determined midband sensitivity around 0.5 Hz with uncertainties of 0.3%–0.5%, and identified an unexpected 28 ms system delay.
确定了0.5 Hz附近的中频灵敏度，不确定度为0.3%–0.5%，并发现了一个未知的28毫秒系统延迟。
The exact cause of the identified 28 ms delay in either the seismometer or data logger remains unresolved.
地震计或数据采集器中存在的28毫秒延迟的具体原因尚未阐明。
Integration of real-time temperature correction into the on-site comparison calibration workflow to significantly improve reference sensitivity accuracy.
首次将实时温度校正集成到在线比对标定流程中，显著提高了参考灵敏度的准确性。

sum: This study identifies and analyzes four rare intermediate-depth reverse polarity earthquake families within a catalog of 3,153 repeating earthquake sequences in the North Chilean subduction zone (2006–2024). Focusing on the largest cluster of 38 events (including 5 reverse events), the authors use relative relocations and cluster analysis to constrain the active volume to a few hundred meters. The overlapping ruptures and weak upward migration over years suggest that these nearly reversed focal mechanisms are driven by transient processes, potentially linked to dehydration embrittlement and fluid pulses.
本研究在2006至2024年智利北部俯冲带的3153个重复地震序列目录中，识别并分析了四个罕见的中源反极性地震家族。通过对包含38个事件（含5个反向事件）的最大微震群进行相对重定位和聚类特征分析，研究人员将活动破裂体积限制在仅数百米范围内。破裂区的重叠以及多年来微弱的向上迁移特征表明，这些近乎相反的……

t: Relative event relocation and cluster property analysis of repeating earthquake sequences to identify spatial-temporal patterns and polarity flips.
利用重复地震序列的相对重定位和聚类特征分析，识别时空演化模式与波形极性反转。

sum: This study systematically analyzes 1,175 small-to-moderate aftershocks of the 2018 Mw 7.9 Gulf of Alaska outer-rise earthquake using data from the AACSE network. By applying a spectral decomposition approach to P waves and assuming a Brune source model, the authors estimate earthquake source spectra and stress drops. The results show that stress drop is independent of magnitude, supporting self-similar scaling. However, a strong depth dependence is observed, with median stress drops at depths >25 km being three times higher than those at <25 km. Lateral variations in stress drop are only present within the 12–25 km depth range. These findings suggest that bending-related stresses and depth-dependent mechanical properties govern stress-drop heterogeneity in outer-rise settings.
本研究利用AACSE台网数据，系统分析了2018年Mw 7.9阿拉斯加湾外隆起地震的1175个中小余震。通过对P波应用谱分解方法并采用Brune源模型，估算了地震震源谱和应力降。结果表明，应力降与震级无系统相关性，符合自相似标度关系。然而，应力降表现出明显的深度依赖性，深部（>25 km）的应力降中……

sum: This preprint proposes a conceptual and statistical framework for large earthquake (M>=7) prediction. Assuming gravity-driven vertical crustal material migration and applying generalized steady-state flow laws and Noether's theorem, the author links large earthquake frequency to crustal 'seismic resistivity' and energy states. Using USGS global/regional catalogs (1980–2024) and NEDC historical records for central mainland China (1879–2017), the study shows that cumulative M>=7 counts increase approximately linearly with time. Two prediction methods are constructed: (1) a Boltzmann sigmoid probability model based on pre-earthquake residuals from linear cumulative trends and inter-event intervals across nested spatial rings, and (2) a 'tau' rule combining long (quiescent) and short (active) intervals. Retrospective validation on 23 regional cases and 18 Ring-4 events shows time prediction accuracies reaching ~74–78% (±10 yr) for the residual probability method and 68.4% (±3 yr) for the tau rule, outperforming simple apparent recurrence period estimates.
本文基于重力驱动地壳物质下移的假说、稳态广义流定律及诺特定理，构建了大震（M≥7）发生频率与地壳“抗震阻率”及能量状态的关系。利用1980–2024年USGS全球及区域目录与1879–2017年中国大陆中部历史强震目录，发现大震累积数量随时间呈近似线性增长。据此提出了基于线性偏离残差的Boltzma……

t: Fits cumulative M>=7 earthquake counts linearly with time, models pre-earthquake residuals and inter-event intervals using Boltzmann sigmoid probability functions across nested spatial rings, and applies a quiescent/active interval 'tau' rule.
对M≥7累积地震数进行时间线性拟合，利用Boltzmann函数拟合震前残差与时间间隔概率，并提出长短间隔组合的“τ”规则…

Uses USGS global and regional M>=7 earthquake catalogs (1980–2024) and 19 historical M>=7 earthquakes (1879–2017) from the National Earthquake Data Center in central mainland China divided into nested rings.

Retrospective validation yields 78.3% (±10 yr) and 47.8% (±5 yr) accuracy using 50% energy probability vs. 56.5% and 26.1% for apparent periods; the 'tau' rule achieves 68.4% accuracy within ±3 years.

Model equations only address hypothetical gravity-driven vertical displacement, ignoring horizontal plate tectonics, and inner rings suffer from small sample sizes requiring artificially fixed fitting parameters.

利用四个嵌套环形区域及西南密集子区的概率随时间分布差分进行震中区域推断。

sum: This study investigates the rupture kinematics of the 2023 Kahramanmaraş, Türkiye earthquake doublet (Mw 7.8 and Mw 7.7) by integrating teleseismic backprojection imaging and joint finite-fault inversion. The authors reveal distinct rupture propagation patterns controlled by fault geometry. The first Mw 7.8 event originated on a splay fault and transitioned from subshear to transient supershear ruptures after passing through fault bends along the East Anatolian Fault (EAF). In contrast, the subsequent Mw 7.7 event initiated on a simpler fault strand and propagated bilaterally at a persistent supershear velocity. The findings highlight that geometric complexity is a key factor modulating large-scale earthquake rupture velocities.

Seismic waveform data from the 6 February 2023 Kahramanmaraş, Türkiye continental earthquake doublet (Mw 7.8 and Mw 7.7).

sum: This study discovers tidally modulated tremor at the Gofar transform fault along the East Pacific Rise. By analyzing tremor amplitudes, tidal phases, and temporal variations in the Vp/Vs ratio, the authors identify a valve-like sealing-drainage dynamic process. During periods of low Vp/Vs and sparse seismicity, hydrothermal sealing traps magmatic volatiles, boosting tidal sensitivity and sustaining tremor. Subsequent earthquake swarms and ruptures open high-permeability pathways, releasing fluids, silencing tremors, and triggering microseismicity before hydrothermal healing resets the cycle. This reveals that oceanic transform faults are highly permeable, tide-critical systems where energy release oscillates between tremor and rupture.
本研究在东太平洋隆起的Gofar海洋转换断层发现了受潮汐调制的地震震颤。通过分析震颤振幅、潮汐相位以及纵横波速度比（Vp/Vs）的随时间变化，研究人员提出了一种阀门式的“封存-排放”动态循环机制。在低Vp/Vs和稀疏地震活动期间，热液密封锁住了岩浆挥发分，增强了潮汐敏感性并维持了震颤；随后的群震和破……

t: Analysis of tidally modulated seismic tremor amplitudes combined with temporal monitoring of in-situ Vp/Vs ratios to track fluid pressure and fault zone sealing.
结合潮汐调制地震震颤振幅分析与原位Vp/Vs比值时变监测，追踪流体压力的变化。
Seismic waveform and earthquake catalog data from the Gofar transform fault along the East Pacific Rise, alongside ocean tide models.

Tremor amplitude correlates with semidiurnal tides during low Vp/Vs periods, but this correlation weakens after earthquake swarms accompanied by high Vp/Vs.

sum: This article presents the priorities and development plan for a next-generation Community Velocity Model (CVM) for the Cascadia Subduction Zone (CSZ), formulated by the CRESCENT working group and regional partners. The proposed model will span from the surface to ~100 km depth, covering offshore and onshore regions from Idaho to the tectonic transitions in California and Canada. Key priorities include implementing FAIR data principles, capturing along-strike and along-dip structural heterogeneity, resolving shallow offshore-onshore structures, and quantifying elastic property uncertainties. This model will serve as a critical foundation for numerical wave propagation, earthquake ground-motion simulations, and tsunami hazard assessments in the Pacific Northwest.

sum: Reconstructing latent geological process histories from static subsurface observations requires understanding temporal ordering and cross-cutting relationships. This paper introduces Geo-Strat-RL, a synthetic environment combining a procedural stratigraphic generator, a 2D acoustic finite-difference seismic renderer, and an executable verifier that scores chronological event sequences (deposition, tilting, faulting, erosion, intrusion). Using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with LoRA adapters, the author trains open vision-language models (Qwen2.5-VL-3B and Qwen3-VL-4B) via reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). On held-out test sets, RLVR substantially boosts geological reconstruction scores (e.g., Qwen3-VL-4B reward increases from 0.311 to 0.740), rivaling frontier closed models like GPT-5.5 (0.747). Notably, models trained exclusively on schematic stratigraphic diagrams transfer zero-shot to synthetic seismic amplitude sections (and vice versa), demonstrating that RLVR teaches reusable visual-temporal geological reasoning concepts across distinct observation modalities rather than mere surface-level formatting.

sum: This paper presents the DETECT seismological dataset, which consists of continuous recordings from 200 temporary stations (seismic network ZK) operating for approximately one year (August 2021 to August 2022) in the Southern Apennines, Italy. The experiment deployed 20 dense seismic arrays (each with a ~2 km aperture, containing broadband, short-period, and geophone sensors) directly above the fault segments of the destructive 1980 M 6.9 Irpinia earthquake. The resulting 5.2 TB dataset is fully compliant with FDSN standards and managed via SeisComP. It provides high-resolution observations to study microseismicity, fault-zone properties, and seismic hazard in one of Italy's most active tectonic regions.

sum: This study investigates how fluid pre-conditioning (FP)—an initial low-pressure injection phase prior to rapid pressurization—affects shear reactivation of a critically stressed saw-cut Rotondo granite fault confined at 20 MPa. In six triaxial reactivation experiments, the authors jointly use fiber-optic distributed strain sensing (DSS) and a 16-transducer piezoelectric array to monitor fault-parallel deformation, acoustic emissions, and ultrasonic P-wave velocity variations during fluid migration. Separate fault-flooding surveys reveal channelized fluid pathways with up to 10% P-wave velocity increases. Results show that FP promotes a relatively drained response, smoothing effective normal stress gradients and shear resistance, which leads to directional, coherent aseismic preslip and predictable transition to dynamic rupture without foreshocks. Conversely, non-pre-conditioned tests exhibit locally undrained responses with sharp effective-stress gradients, preserving asperity barriers, triggering foreshocks, and causing complex nucleation. The novelty lies in combining high-resolution DSS and ultrasonic imaging to link pre-injection permeability structure with rupture nucleation style.
本研究探讨了流体预处理（FP）对20 MPa围压下临界应力花岗岩锯切断层剪切再激活与成核行为的影响。通过六次三轴实验，结合光纤分布式应变传感（DSS）与16个压电换能器阵列，同步监测了断层平行应变、声发射及流体迁移引起的P波波速变化（最高增加10%）。结果表明，FP促进了断层尺度的排水响应，平滑了有……

t: Combined fiber-optic distributed strain sensing (DSS) and a 16-transducer piezoelectric array to monitor fault-parallel strain, acoustic emissions, and P-wave velocity variations during fluid-induced shear reactivation of a confined granite fault.
结合光纤分布式应变传感（DSS）与16换能器压电阵列，监测流体诱发断层再激活中的应变、声发射和P波波速。

Six triaxial fluid-injection reactivation tests (three with 10-minute fluid pre-conditioning, three without) and a 30-minute hydrostatic fault-flooding ultrasonic survey on a 35-degree saw-cut Rotondo granite sample extracted from the Bedretto Lab.
