sum: Rain-induced earthquake swarms are typically brief, yet the Palghar swarm in western India persisted for over two years. Using ~8,300 well-located earthquakes (ML -0.1 to 4.6, Mc 1.4, depth ≤ 10 km) recorded between January 2019 and November 2020, this study performs statistical analyses of spatio-temporal clustering, b-values, seismic moment release, and mainshock-aftershock sequences. The swarm splits into two steeply dipping N-S clusters (west and east) and distinct temporal phases. Post-monsoon phases in the west cluster show high b-values, linear cumulative seismic moment, symmetric rise-and-fall frequency, and localized shallow clustering, indicative of cataclastic deformation or aseismic collapse under hydraulic loading. Conversely, monsoon and pre-monsoon phases exhibit low b-values, power-law moment growth, and abrupt frequency drops characteristic of stick-slip motion. Across all phases, Omori-law decay and rupture-edge aftershock clustering confirm persistent stress triggering. This is the first report demonstrating multiple coexisting causal mechanisms sustaining a rain-induced swarm.
降雨诱发震群通常很短暂，但印度西部帕尔加尔震群持续了两年多。本研究利用2019年1月至2020年11月记录的约8300次精定位地震（震级-0.1至4.6，完备震级1.4，深度≤10 km），对b值、地震矩释放及主余震序列进行了统计分析。震群分为东西两个近垂直展布的丛集及多个时间阶段。季风后阶段表现为……

t: The authors analyze relocated seismicity using maximum likelihood b-values, spectral seismic moment scaling, and a 100-minute time-windowing algorithm to identify embedded mainshock-aftershock sequences and fit Omori decay and spatial distance scaling.
利用最大似然法计算b值、S波谱标定地震矩，并通过100分钟时间窗算法识别主余震序列及拟合大森定律。

Approximately 8,300 well-located earthquakes (ML -0.1 to 4.6, Mc = 1.4, depth ≤ 10 km, location uncertainties ≤ 1.5 km) recorded by a six-station broadband network in Palghar between January 2019 and November 2020, paired with NASA rainfall data.
2019年1月至2020年11月6台宽频带台网记录的约8300次精定位地震（深度≤10 km）及NASA降雨数据。

Post-monsoon phases exhibit high b-values, linear cumulative moment, and dense shallow clustering (ρN >> 65), indicating cataclasis; other phases show low b-values, power-law moment (∝ i^1.10–1.15), and stick-slip patterns, with persistent Omori decay (c=0.8) and rupture-edge clustering.
季风后呈高b值与线性累积矩（碎裂流变）；其他期呈低b值与幂律矩（粘滑）；全期余震遵循大森衰减并聚集于破裂边缘。

The seismic network became operational in January 2019, missing the swarm's initiation in November 2018, and near-vertical fault dips (~80–85°) make east vs. west dip orientations hard to distinguish.
台网于2019年1月运行，缺失2018年11月震群起始数据；断层近垂直导致倾向难以区分。

This study is the first to report the coexistence and interplay of multiple causal mechanisms—episodic rain-induced cataclasis/aseismic collapse and persistent coseismic stress triggering—sustaining a rain-induced earthquake swarm.
首次揭示降雨诱发震群中水文碎裂变形与同震应力触发多机制共存并维持震群长期活动的现象。

kc: Demonstrated for the first time that multiple causal mechanisms (hydrological cataclasis and mechanical stress triggering) coexist and sustain a long-duration rain-induced earthquake swarm.

Identified distinct seasonal phases in the Palghar swarm: post-monsoon phases characterized by high b-values, linear cumulative moment, and cataclastic/aseismic slip vs. monsoon/pre-monsoon phases showing stick-slip behavior.
Validated persistent mainshock-aftershock stress triggering throughout the swarm via Omori's law temporal decay and spatial clustering of aftershocks at mainshock rupture peripheries.
首次证实降雨诱发震群中存在水文碎裂变形与力学应力触发等多种致灾机制共存，并共同维持了震群的长期活动。
识别出帕尔加尔震群明显的季节性阶段特征：季风后阶段表现为高b值、线性累积地震矩和碎裂/无震滑动，而季风及季风前阶段表现为粘滑行为。
通过大森定律时间衰减及余震在主震破裂边缘的空间丛集特征，验证了整个震群演化过程中持续存在主余震应力触发。
me: Adopted high-precision earthquake locations using probabilistic NonLinLoc and relative double-difference HypoDD relocations from a 6-station broadband network.
Calibrated a linear log-seismic moment (M0) to local magnitude (ML) relationship via S-wave displacement spectral fitting of ~190 events.
Estimated completeness magnitude (Mc = 1.4) using GoF and EMR methods, and computed phase-wise b-values using Maximum Likelihood Estimation (MLE).
Applied a 100-minute time-windowing method (Hainzl & Fischer, 2002) to isolate embedded mainshock-aftershock sequences and fit Omori's law and spatial separation scaling.
采用6台宽频带台网数据，结合NonLinLoc概率定位和HypoDD双差相对定位获取高精度地震目录。
通过对约190个事件的S波位移谱拟合，标定了地方震级（ML）与对数地震矩（M0）的线性关系。
利用GoF和EMR方法评估完备震级（Mc = 1.4），并使用最大似然法（MLE）计算各阶段的b值。
应用100分钟时间窗方法（Hainzl & Fischer, 2002）提取震群内嵌的主余震序列，拟合大森定律及空间距离标度关系。
de: Catalog of ~8,300 well-located earthquakes (horizontal and vertical errors ≤ 1.5 km, average Δx ~0.25 km, Δz ~0.65 km) from January 2019 to November 2020 recorded by CSIR-NGRI.
Daily satellite-derived rainfall data from NASA GPM IMERG (2018–2020) and local rain gauge station observations.
CSIR-NGRI台网于2019年1月至2020年11月记录的约8300个精定位地震目录（水平和垂直误差≤1.5 km，平均Δx ~0.25 km，Δz ~0.65 km）。
NASA GPM IMERG（2018–2020年）卫星日降雨量数据及当地雨量站观测数据。
li: The local seismic network became operational in January 2019, missing the initial swarm onset in November 2018.
Near-vertical seismicity planes (~80–85° dip) and velocity/network uncertainties make it difficult to definitively resolve east- vs. west-dipping fault orientations.
Differences in water percolation efficiency between the west and east clusters remain unquantified and require further hydrogeological investigation.
当地地震台网于2019年1月才开始运行，未能记录到2018年11月震群最初的起始阶段。
近乎垂直的地震活动面（倾角约80–85°）以及速度模型和台网分布的不确定性，使得难以明确区分断层倾向是向东还是向西。
东西两个地震丛集之间雨水渗透效率的差异尚未定量化，需未来进一步开展水文地质调查。

tm.why: The paper investigates a long-duration earthquake swarm triggered by monsoonal rainfall and pore-pressure changes in western India.
The study analyzes the interplay of cataclastic deformation, aseismic collapse, stick-slip motion, and coseismic stress triggering along fault planes.
The analysis relies on a relocated high-precision catalog of ~8,300 local earthquakes and statistical evaluation of magnitude completeness, b-values, and Omori decay.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 40-page EarthArXiv preprint PDF including main text, figures (Figs. 1–6), and supplementary information (Figs. S1–S5).

sum: The origin of the lower seismic layer (LSL) in subduction-zone double seismic zones (DSZs) remains debated, particularly because many LSLs exhibit dry seismic signatures that challenge traditional dehydration embrittlement models. Combining global geophysical observations with 79 two-dimensional thermo-mechanical geodynamic simulations (using Underworld 2), this study investigates the genetic link between the LSL and the oceanic mid-lithospheric discontinuity (MLD). In the models, melt-derived granulites within the MLD undergo eclogitization during subduction, triggering grain-size reduction, diffusion creep, and profound rheological weakening. This intra-slab low-viscosity zone localizes strain within the MLD and transfers differential stress to the stronger overlying mantle section (~20–35 km below the slab top). The resulting stress amplification elevates the apparent friction coefficient (0.4–0.75) to levels sufficient for dry peridotite brittle failure. Subsequent grain growth progressively heals the MLD, naturally explaining the observed depth-dependent decay of LSL seismicity.
俯冲带双地震带中下层地震带（LSL）的成因极具争议，许多区域的干地幔地震学特征挑战了传统的脱水脆化模型。本研究结合全球地球物理观测与79个二维热-力学地球动力学数值模拟（基于Underworld 2），探讨了LSL与大洋岩石圈中部不连续面（MLD）的成因联系。模拟表明，MLD内熔体结晶形成的麻粒岩在……

t: 2-D thermo-mechanical finite-element particle-in-cell models (Underworld 2) with non-linear visco-plastic rheology and time-dependent diffusion creep to simulate eclogitization-induced weakening and grain-growth recovery in subducted oceanic MLDs.
采用Underworld 2建立二维热-力学模型，结合非线性粘塑性流变与时变扩散蠕变模拟俯冲MLD榴辉岩化弱化与恢复。

79 numerical subduction experiments varying MLD composition, slab age (40–70 Myr), minimum viscosity (10^18–10^22 Pa·s), and recovery timescale (5–30 Myr), compared against ISC earthquake catalogs and Japan Vp/Vs tomography.
开展79组改变板片年龄、粘度与时间尺度的数值实验，并结合ISC地震目录及日本Vp/Vs层析成像数据进行对比。

Eclogitization lowers MLD viscosity below 10^20 Pa·s, shifting the slab-parallel tensional band to 20–35 km beneath the slab top with peak stresses up to ~4.5 GPa and apparent friction reaching ~0.75.
MLD榴辉岩化使粘度降至10^20 Pa·s以下，在板片顶面下20–35 km产生峰值4.5 GPa的张应力带，视摩擦系…
The models do not directly simulate seismic rupture, use a simplified proxy for eclogite grain growth, and represent only one end-member mechanism among multiple processes governing LSLs globally.
模型未直接模拟地震动态破裂，晶粒演化采用简化代理参数，且仅代表解释全球LSL的端元机制之一。
First geodynamic demonstration that eclogitization of pre-existing melt-derived oceanic MLDs localizes strain and amplifies stress in the overlying dry mantle to generate the lower seismic layer.
首次从地球动力学角度证明先存大洋MLD榴辉岩化可在上覆干地幔中放大应力并产生双地震带下层地震。

kc: Identifies a systematic spatial correlation globally where the lower seismic layer (LSL) of double seismic zones is positioned immediately above the subducted oceanic mid-lithospheric discontinuity (MLD).

Demonstrates via 79 2-D thermo-mechanical subduction models that prograde eclogitization of melt-derived granulites in the MLD creates a transient low-viscosity zone that amplifies tensional stress and apparent friction (up to ~0.75) in the overlying mantle.

Provides a self-consistent mechanical pathway for intermediate-depth earthquake nucleation in dry peridotite, reconciling LSL seismicity with normal Vp/Vs observations and the depth-dependent decay of seismic activity.
发现了全球范围内双地震带下层地震带（LSL）系统性地位于俯冲大洋岩石圈中部不连续面（MLD）正上方的空间对应关系。
通过79个二维热-力学俯冲数值模拟证明，MLD中熔体源麻粒岩的进变质榴辉岩化会产生瞬态低粘度带，从而在紧邻的上覆地幔中放大张应力和视摩擦系数（高达约0.75）。
提出了干橄榄岩中源地震成核的力学机制，成功调和了LSL地震活动与正常Vp/Vs观测值以及地震活动随深度衰减的现象。
me: 2-D thermo-mechanical geodynamic numerical modeling using the finite-element particle-in-cell code Underworld 2.
Non-linear visco-plastic rheology incorporating diffusion creep, dislocation creep, and Peierls/plastic yielding.
Time-dependent diffusion-creep viscosity parameterization based on Coble creep cubic grain-size scaling to simulate syn-metamorphic weakening and post-eclogitization grain-growth recovery.
Thermodynamic phase equilibria modeling (Perple_X) to compare seismic Vp/Vs ratios of dry peridotite and antigorite against slab seismicity.
基于有限元网格粒子法程序Underworld 2的二维热-力学地球动力学数值模拟。
结合扩散蠕变、位错蠕变和塑性屈服的非线性粘塑性流变学本构关系。
基于Coble蠕变晶粒尺寸三次方关系的时变扩散蠕变粘度参数化，用以模拟同变质弱化及榴辉岩化后的晶粒生长恢复过程。
利用热力学相平衡计算程序（Perple_X）对比干橄榄岩与叶蛇纹石的地震波Vp/Vs比值及板内地震分布。
de: Suite of 79 numerical subduction experiments spanning three model groups (No MLD, Residual-melt MLD, Residual + Intrusive melt MLD), slab ages of 40–70 Myr, minimum eclogite viscosities (10^18–10^22 Pa·s), and recovery timescales (5–30 Myr).
Global compilation of observed oceanic MLD depths and LSL depths relative to the slab top across Pacific subduction zones.
Relocated earthquake catalogs from the International Seismological Centre (ISC) and 3-D seismic Vp/Vs tomography models beneath Northeast Japan.
79组数值俯冲实验，涵盖三类模型组（无MLD、残余熔体MLD、残余+侵入熔体MLD）、40–70 Myr板片年龄、10^18–10^22 Pa·s榴辉岩最小粘度以及5–30 Myr恢复时间尺度。
环太平洋俯冲带大洋MLD观测深度与LSL距板片顶部深度的全球汇编数据。
国际地震中心（ISC）地震目录及日本东北俯冲带三维地震波Vp/Vs层析成像数据。
li: The continuum thermo-mechanical models do not simulate dynamic seismic rupture or earthquake nucleation directly, relying instead on apparent friction coefficient thresholds.

Grain-size evolution during and after eclogitization is approximated using a simplified dimensionless time-dependent recovery factor rather than explicitly coupled microphysical grain-damage equations.
The proposed MLD-driven stress amplification acts as one end-member mechanism and cannot alone account for all regional variations of DSZs worldwide.
连续介质热-力学模型未直接模拟动态地震破裂或震源成核，而是依赖视摩擦系数阈值进行评估。
榴辉岩化期间及之后的晶粒尺寸演化采用了简化的无量纲时变恢复因子近似，未显式耦合微观晶粒损伤演化方程。
MLD驱动的应力放大机制仅作为一种端元机制，无法单独解释全球所有双地震带的区域差异。

tm.why: The paper uses 2D thermo-mechanical geodynamic numerical models to investigate how rheological layering associated with oceanic mid-lithospheric discontinuities controls stress localization in subducting slabs.
The study explains the physical mechanism of earthquake nucleation in the lower seismic layer of double seismic zones via differential stress amplification in dry mantle peridotite.

ev.notes: Full preprint PDF (59 pages including main text, 9 main figures, 7 supplementary figures, and 4 supplementary tables) was read and analyzed in detail.

sum: This Zenodo repository contains the complete dataset and Python code supporting the paper 'Low frequency icequakes generated during transient cavity drainage on a Greenlandic outlet glacier'. The resources include downsampled MSEED seismic waveforms, GNSS displacement data, matched-filter processing (MFP) localization catalogs for low-frequency events (1.5-21 Hz and 4-6 Hz), hydraulic potential maps, and correlated event families for both surface and deep icequake sources. These data enable the reproduction of the paper's figures and facilitate further research into subglacial hydrology and cryoseismology.
该Zenodo仓库包含了支持“格陵兰外流冰川瞬态空腔排水期间产生的低频冰震”论文的完整数据集和Python代码。资源包括降采样的MSEED地震波形、GNSS位移数据、低频事件（1.5-21 Hz和4-6 Hz）的匹配滤波处理（MFP）定位目录、水力势图以及地表和深部冰震源的关联事件族。这些数据可用于……

t: Matched-filter processing (MFP) and correlation analysis are used to locate and classify low-frequency icequakes into surface and deep families.
采用匹配滤波处理（MFP）和关联分析对低频冰震进行定位并分类为地表和深部族群。
Seismic waveforms downsampled to 200 Hz, GNSS data, ice thickness kriging maps, and hydraulic potential geotiffs from a Greenlandic glacier.
包含格陵兰冰川降采样至200 Hz的地震波形、GNSS数据、冰川厚度图及水力势数据。
The dataset provides localized event catalogs and correlated families that map the spatial-temporal evolution of icequakes during cavity drainage.
提供了定位事件目录和关联事件族，展示了空腔排水期间冰震的时空演化。
The seismic data is downsampled to 200 Hz and covers a short temporal window (September 10-12, 2024).
地震数据降采样至200 Hz，且时间跨度较短（2024年9月10日至12日）。
A comprehensive, open-access multi-disciplinary dataset linking seismic, geodetic, and hydraulic observations of transient subglacial drainage events.
提供了一个将地震、大地测量和水力学观测相结合的开源多学科冰川排水数据集。

kc: Provides downsampled multi-station seismic waveform data (MSEED) capturing transient subglacial drainage events.
Includes localized icequake catalogs categorized by frequency bands and source depths (surface vs. deep).
Shares Python scripts to fully reproduce the main figures of the associated scientific paper.
提供了捕获瞬态冰下排水事件的降采样多台站地震波形数据（MSEED）。
包含了按频段和震源深度（地表与深部）分类的定位冰震目录。
共享了用于完全重现相关科学论文主要插图的 Python 脚本。
me: Matched-filter processing (MFP) for spatial localization of low-frequency icequake events.
Correlation analysis to group icequakes into distinct surface and deep event families.
Hydraulic potential modeling to map subglacial water routing.
用于低频冰震事件空间定位的匹配滤波处理（MFP）方法。
将冰震分组为不同地表和深部事件族的关联分析。
用于绘制冰下水流路径的水力势建模。
de: Seismic waveform data from temporary seismic nodes downsampled to 200 Hz.
GNSS time-series data tracking ice surface displacement.
Kriged ice thickness maps and hydraulic potential geotiff files.
降采样至 200 Hz 的临时地震节点地震波形数据。
追踪冰面位移的 GNSS 时间序列数据。
克里金插值的冰川厚度图和水力势 geotiff 文件。
li: The seismic data is downsampled to 200 Hz, which may limit high-frequency micro-crack analysis.
The dataset is temporally restricted to a specific drainage window in September 2024.
地震数据被降采样至 200 Hz，这可能会限制高频微裂隙分析。
数据集在时间上局限于 2024 年 9 月的特定排水窗口。

tm.why: The dataset and code are designed to study low-frequency icequakes generated during transient cavity drainage on a Greenlandic outlet glacier.
The resources include matched-filter processing (MFP) localizations and catalogs of correlated surface and deep icequake families.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the detailed Zenodo repository abstract and file list, as no PDF was available.

sum: This study investigates a regionally extensive system of deep igneous intrusions (6–20 km depth, 100+ km lateral extent) within the Precambrian crystalline basement of the Baltic Basin, northern Poland, using high-resolution PolandSPAN® deep seismic reflection profiles. Because these depths are beyond borehole reach, the authors combined statistical wavelet extraction, vertical seismic resolution and tuning analysis, wedge modelling, and 2D full-wave seismic forward modelling to constrain intrusion properties. Testing granite-granodiorite, basalt, and dolerite scenarios against observed high-amplitude reflections showed that only dolerite (velocity ~6700 m/s, density ~2.87 g/cm³) reproduces the strong impedance contrast. Wedge modelling with a 29 Hz Ricker wavelet established a tuning thickness of ~57–58 m and indicated actual sill thicknesses of 60 to 200+ m, featuring saucer-shaped and step-wise geometries. Integrated with regional geological constraints, these intrusions are linked to the Mississippian (early Carboniferous) Lublin-Baltic Igneous Province.
本研究利用高分辨率PolandSPAN®深反射地震剖面，结合统计子波提取、调谐分析、楔形模型及二维全波地震正演模拟，研究了波兰北部波罗的海盆地前寒武纪结晶基底深处（6–20 km，横向延伸超100 km）的火成岩侵入体系统。通过对花岗闪长岩、玄武岩和辉绿岩三种岩性情景的正演对比，证实只有辉绿岩（速度……

t: The authors combine statistical wavelet tuning analysis, 1D/2D wedge modelling, and 2D zero-offset full-wave vertical-incidence seismic forward modelling to constrain the lithology, vertical resolution, and thickness of deep intra-basement igneous intrusions.
结合统计子波调谐分析、楔形模型与二维零偏全波正演模拟，约束深部侵入体的岩性与厚度。

Three high-resolution regional onshore seismic reflection profiles (PL-5400, PL-1200, PL-1100) from the PolandSPAN® survey in northern Poland, calibrated with deep boreholes Prabuty IG-1 and Pasłęk IG-1.
波兰北部PolandSPAN®调查的三条高分辨率深反射剖面及两口深钻井标定数据。

Dominant frequency at the intrusion depth is ~29 Hz, yielding a tuning thickness (λ/4) of 57–58 m. Only dolerite (Vp = 6700 m/s, density = 2.87 g/cm³) matches observed high amplitudes, indicating sill thicknesses of 60 to 200+ m.
主频约29 Hz，调谐厚度57–58 m；辉绿岩模型匹配强振幅，推断岩床厚60至200 m以上。
The intrusions lie far beyond borehole reach, Q attenuation is unknown, and compositional heterogeneity, internal layering, or host-rock variations cannot be excluded as factors affecting waveforms.
深度超钻井可及范围，缺乏Q衰减估计，且无法排除内部层理或围岩变化的影响。

First quantitative petrophysical and geometrical characterization of deep (6–20 km) crystalline basement sills in the Baltic Basin, linking them to the newly recognized Mississippian Lublin-Baltic Igneous Province.
首次定量刻画波罗的海盆地基底深部辉绿岩床，并将其归属为早石炭世卢布林-波罗的海火成岩省。

kc: Characterized an extensive (100+ km) deep crustal igneous intrusion system at 6–20 km depth in the Baltic Basin basement using PolandSPAN® seismic reflection data.
Demonstrated via 2D full-wave forward modelling that dolerite (Vp ~6700 m/s, density ~2.87 g/cm³) best explains the observed high-amplitude seismic reflections.
Quantified vertical seismic resolution and tuning thickness (~57–58 m at 29 Hz) using statistical wavelets and wedge modelling, constraining intrusion thicknesses to 60–200+ m.
Linked the deep intra-basement sills to the Mississippian (early Carboniferous) Lublin-Baltic Igneous Province based on lithological and spatial coherence with borehole data.
利用PolandSPAN®地震反射数据，刻画了波罗的海盆地基底6–20 km深处横向延伸超100 km的深部地壳火成岩侵入系统。
通过二维全波正演模拟证实，辉绿岩（纵波速度约6700 m/s，密度约2.87 g/cm³）最能解释观测到的强振幅地震反射特征。
结合统计子波与楔形模型量化了垂向地震分辨率和调谐厚度（29 Hz下约57–58 m），将侵入体厚度约束在60–200 m以上。
基于与浅部钻井揭示岩体的岩性和空间一致性，将这些深部基底岩床归属为早石炭世（密西西比世）卢布林-波罗的海火成岩省。
me: Statistical wavelet extraction and frequency-matching tuning analysis within target time windows on PreSTM seismic data.
2D zero-offset full-wave vertical-incidence seismic forward modelling testing three lithological scenarios (granite-granodiorite, basalt, dolerite).
Synthetic wedge modelling (0–200 m thickness, 29 Hz zero-phase Ricker wavelet) to evaluate waveform interference, tuning onset (λ/2), and tuning thickness (λ/4).
Structural and seismic attribute interpretation (amplitude amplification/dimming, polarity reversals, step-wise and saucer-shaped geometries) on PreSTM and PreSDM profiles.
在叠前时间偏移（PreSTM）地震数据的目标时间窗内进行统计子波提取与频率匹配调谐分析。
开展二维零偏全波垂直入射地震正演模拟，测试花岗闪长岩、玄武岩和辉绿岩三种岩性情景。
利用合成楔形模型（厚度0–200 m，29 Hz零相位雷克子波）评估波形干涉、调谐起始点（λ/2）和调谐厚度（λ/4）。
在PreSTM和PreSDM剖面上进行构造与地震属性解释（振幅放大/变暗、极性反转、阶梯状与碟状几何形态）。
de: Three deep regional onshore reflection profiles (PL-5400, PL-1200, PL-1100) from the PolandSPAN® survey (2–150 Hz sweep, 12 km offsets, 25 m station spacing, up to 28 s record).
Calibration well logs (sonic DT, gamma ray GR) and stratigraphic tops from deep boreholes Prabuty IG-1 and Pasłęk IG-1.
Literature-derived petrophysical properties and deep seismic refraction velocity gradients for the Precambrian basement.
来自PolandSPAN®陆上深反射区域调查的3条地震剖面（PL-5400、PL-1200、PL-1100，2–150 Hz扫描，12 km偏移距，25 m道距）。
深钻井Prabuty IG-1和Pasłęk IG-1的测井曲线（声波时差DT、自然伽马GR）及地层分层数据。
来自文献的岩石物理参数及前寒武纪基底的深地震折射速度梯度数据。
li: Deep intrusions lie at 6–20 km depth, far beyond direct borehole verification, making lithology, thickness, and age indirect estimates.
Lack of amplitude-preserved processing and reliable deep attenuation (Q) estimates restricts the study to relative amplitude comparisons rather than absolute calibration.
Compositional heterogeneity, internal layering, or host-rock variations cannot be excluded as alternative causes of lateral waveform changes.
深部侵入体位于6–20 km深处，远超钻井可及深度，因此岩性、厚度和年代均为间接推断。
缺乏保幅处理和可靠的深部衰减（Q值）估计，使研究局限于相对振幅对比而非绝对振幅标定。
无法排除侵入体成分非均质性、内部层理或围岩变化对横向波形变化的影响。

tm.why: The paper characterizes an extensive system of lower Carboniferous igneous intrusions at depths of 6–20 km within the crystalline basement of the Baltic Basin using deep seismic reflection profiles.
The authors apply 2D full-wave seismic forward modelling and wedge modelling to simulate wave propagation, interference, and tuning effects in complex geological models.
The research investigates deep crustal magmatic systems, specifically the geometry, thickness, and lithology of extensive doleritic sill intrusions.

ev.notes: Full 29-page PDF analysed, including all 17 figures, Table 1, methodology, tuning analysis, 2D full-wave forward modelling, and geological discussion.

sum: Detecting and modeling surface deformation from small-magnitude earthquakes (M < 5) using DInSAR is challenging due to low signal-to-noise ratios and atmospheric delays. This study investigates the 2023 ML 4.4 Umbertide earthquake in Central Italy by integrating Sentinel-1 DInSAR displacement maps from the EPOS platform, GNSS reference data, and 3D-relocated seismicity. Combining multiple line-of-sight interferograms yields up to 2 cm of vertical subsidence and 1.5 cm of eastward motion. The authors perform a linear Bayesian static slip inversion (using BEAT) constrained by focal mechanism nodal planes and the relocated mainshock hypocenter (3.5 km depth), explicitly accounting for spatially correlated noise. The results resolve a maximum slip of 7.3 cm (geodetic Mw 4.9) at 3–5 km depth on a low-angle NE-dipping splay of the Alto Tiberina Fault, matching the alignment of ~350 relocated aftershocks. This work demonstrates a cost-effective integrated approach to characterize unmapped active faults from small earthquakes.
利用DInSAR检测和模拟小震（M<5）地表形变易受大气延迟限制。本研究结合EPOS平台的Sentinel-1 DInSAR位移图、GNSS参考站数据与三维地震重定位，研究了2023年意大利中部Umbertide ML 4.4地震。多基线视线向形变合成揭示了最高2厘米的沉降和1.5厘米的向东位移。作……

t: Linear Bayesian static slip inversion (BEAT) of GPS-referenced Sentinel-1 LOS displacements on discretized rectangular fault planes constrained by 3D-relocated mainshock hypocenter and focal mechanism nodal planes, accounting for spatially correlated noise.
以3D重定位主震和震源机制节面为约束，利用BEAT对GPS校准的Sentinel-1数据进行考虑空间相关噪声的线性贝叶斯…
Four coseismic Sentinel-1 ascending and descending LOS displacement maps from EPOSAR, referenced to GPS station AT0400ITA, alongside ca. 350 seismic events relocated in a 3D velocity model.
以AT0400ITA GPS站为参考的四幅EPOSAR同震Sentinel-1升降轨LOS位移图，以及3D速度模型重定位…

Inversion favors the NE-dipping P2 splay fault with 7.3 cm maximum slip at 3–5 km depth (Mw 4.9, RMSE 0.28 cm), consistent with 2 cm vertical subsidence, 1.5 cm eastward motion, and aftershock alignment.
反演支持北东倾P2断层，3–5千米深处最大滑动7.3厘米（Mw 4.9，RMSE 0.28厘米），与2厘米沉降、1.5厘…
Centimetric displacements from small earthquakes limit unique slip resolution, and fixing a planar rectangular fault geometry in the inversion may introduce bias in slip estimates.
小震厘米级位移限制了滑动唯一分辨率，且反演中固定平面矩形断层几何可能引入滑动估计偏差。

Overcomes previous non-unique nonlinear inversions of the 2023 Umbertide event by combining GPS-referenced DInSAR, 3D seismic relocations, and Bayesian slip inversion to identify an unmapped ATF splay.
结合GPS校准DInSAR、3D地震重定位和贝叶斯反演，克服了前人非线性反演的多解性，识别出未编目的ATF分支断层。

kc: Demonstrates successful detection and finite-fault modeling of centimeter-scale coseismic deformation from a small-magnitude (ML 4.4) earthquake at ~3.5 km depth.
Identifies the causative source as an unmapped low-angle NE-dipping synthetic splay of the Alto Tiberina Fault (ATF) system.
Integrates multi-baseline DInSAR decomposition, GPS referencing, 3D non-linear earthquake relocation, and Bayesian slip inversion accounting for spatially correlated noise.
成功检测并完成了约3.5千米深处小震（ML 4.4）厘米级同震形变的有限断层反演建模。
确定发震断层为Alto Tiberina断层（ATF）系统中一条此前未编目的北东倾低角度同向分支断层。
集成了多基线DInSAR形变分解、GPS参考校准、三维非线性地震重定位以及考虑空间相关噪声的贝叶斯滑动反演。
me: Non-linear probabilistic earthquake relocation (NNLoc) using a local 3D P- and S-wave velocity model.

Over-determined least-squares combination of ascending and descending Sentinel-1 LOS maps across multiple temporal baselines to extract Vertical (Up) and East-West displacement components, referenced to a stable GNSS station.

Linear Bayesian static slip inversion using the Bayesian Earthquake Analysis Tool (BEAT) with PSGRN/PSCMP Green's functions (AK135 model), Laplacian smoothing prior, and full empirical noise variance-covariance matrices.
利用局部三维P波和S波速度模型进行非线性概率地震重定位（NNLoc）。
以稳定GNSS站为参考，通过超定最小二乘法联合多时间基线升降轨Sentinel-1视线向（LOS）图，提取垂直和东西向位移分量。
使用贝叶斯地震分析工具（BEAT）、基于AK135模型的PSGRN/PSCMP格林函数、拉普拉斯平滑先验及完整经验噪声协方差矩阵进行线性贝叶斯静态滑动反演。
de: Sentinel-1 ascending (track 117) and descending (track 95) DInSAR coseismic and postseismic LOS displacement maps from the EPOSAR service (12-day and 24-day temporal baselines).
Seismic phase picks and catalog locations for the ML 4.4 mainshock and ca. 350 aftershocks recorded between 4 and 31 March 2023 from INGV.
Time series from continuous GPS station AT0400ITA (TABOO Near Fault Observatory) located ~2 km west of Umbertide.
来自EPOSAR服务的Sentinel-1升轨（117轨道）和降轨（95轨道）12天与24天时间基线同震及震后LOS位移图。
INGV记录的2023年3月4日至31日期间ML 4.4主震及约350次余震的震相拾取与目录定位数据。
位于Umbertide以西约2千米的AT0400ITA连续GPS站（TABOO近断层观测站）时间序列数据。
li: Inverting centimetric geodetic displacements from small earthquakes inherently limits the ability to uniquely constrain detailed slip distributions.
Fault geometry is fixed as a planar rectangle during the linear inversion, which may bias slip estimates and only approximates the deeper part of a potentially listric fault.
DInSAR LOS observations have weak sensitivity to North-South motion, preventing full 3D displacement vector inversion.
反演小震引起的厘米级大地测量位移固有地限制了唯一约束精细滑动分布的能力。
线性反演中将断层几何固定为平面矩形，可能引入滑动估计偏差，且仅能近似潜在铲式断层的深部。
DInSAR视线向观测对南北向运动敏感度较弱，无法反演完整的三维位移矢量。

tm.why: The paper performs finite-fault static slip inversion to resolve the source geometry, kinematics, and slip distribution of the 2023 ML 4.4 Umbertide earthquake.
A linear Bayesian static slip inversion framework (BEAT) is used to estimate fault slip and its uncertainty while explicitly accounting for spatially correlated InSAR data noise.
The study relocates the mainshock and ca. 350 aftershocks using a non-linear location algorithm (NNLoc) and a local 3D velocity model to constrain the fault plane.

ev.notes: Full 14-page PDF analyzed, including abstract, main text, equations, Tables 1-2, and Figures 1-7.

sum: The authors present SDpy (stress drop in Python), an open-source, modular, and extensible Python package designed for robust earthquake stress-drop estimation. It supports spectral fitting and spectral ratio methods using P, S, and coda waves with single- or multi-window approaches. SDpy incorporates multiple theoretical source models (e.g., Brune and Boatwright) and accommodates diverse processing scenarios, including single- or multi-station data and empirical Green's functions (eGFs). The package's reliability is demonstrated through its application to a repeating earthquake sequence at the San Andreas Fault Observatory at Depth (SAFOD), yielding stress-drop estimates consistent with previous studies.
本文介绍了SDpy，一个用于稳健估计地震应力降的开源Python包。该工具基于谱拟合和谱比值法，支持利用P波、S波及尾波进行单窗口或多窗口分析。SDpy集成了Brune和Boatwright等多种理论震源模型，并能灵活处理单/三分量记录、单/多台站数据以及单/多个经验格林函数（eGF）等多种应用场景……

t: SDpy implements spectral fitting and spectral ratio methods using Brune and Boatwright source models to estimate earthquake stress drops from P, S, and coda waves.
SDpy实现了基于Brune和Boatwright震源模型的谱拟合与谱比值法，可处理P波、S波及尾波。
The package was tested and validated using a repeating earthquake sequence recorded at the San Andreas Fault Observatory at Depth (SAFOD).
该软件包使用圣安德烈斯断层深部观测站（SAFOD）记录的重复地震序列进行了测试和验证。
SDpy successfully reproduced stress-drop estimates for the SAFOD repeating sequence that are highly consistent with previous literature, proving its reliability.
SDpy成功重构了SAFOD重复地震序列的应力降，其结果与前人研究高度一致，证明了其可靠性。
The abstract does not explicitly detail limitations, but performance inherently relies on user-selected empirical Green's functions and signal-to-noise ratios.
摘要未详细说明局限性，但其性能本质上依赖于用户对经验格林函数的选择和信噪比。
SDpy provides a unified, modular, and highly flexible Python-based framework accommodating multiple wave types, windowing approaches, and station configurations.
SDpy提供了一个统一、模块化且高度灵活的Python框架，支持多种波形、窗口和台站配置。

kc: Developed SDpy, a modular and user-friendly open-source Python package for earthquake stress-drop estimation.
Integrated both spectral fitting and spectral ratio methods supporting P, S, and coda waves.
Provided flexibility for various processing scenarios, including single/multi-station data and empirical Green's functions (eGFs).
开发了SDpy，一个用于地震应力降估计的模块化、用户友好的开源Python包。
集成了支持P波、S波和尾波的谱拟合与谱比值方法。
为多种处理场景提供了灵活性，包括单/多台站数据和经验格林函数（eGF）。
me: Spectral fitting method using theoretical source models (Brune and Boatwright models).
Spectral ratio method utilizing empirical Green's functions (eGFs).
Single- and multi-window analysis of P, S, and coda waves.
使用理论震源模型（Brune和Boatwright模型）的谱拟合方法。
利用经验格林函数（eGF）的谱比值法。
对P波、S波和尾波进行单窗口和多窗口分析。
de: Applied the package to a repeating earthquake sequence targeted by the San Andreas Fault Observatory at Depth (SAFOD) to validate its performance.
将该软件包应用于圣安德烈斯断层深部观测站（SAFOD）的重复地震序列，以验证其性能。
li: The accuracy of stress-drop estimation remains dependent on the quality of input waveforms and the selection of appropriate empirical Green's functions.
应力降估计的准确性仍然取决于输入波形的质量以及合适经验格林函数的选择。

tm.why: The paper introduces a Python package specifically designed for estimating earthquake stress drop, which is a key parameter for characterizing earthquake source processes and rupture dynamics.
Stress drop is critical for understanding fault strength and fault mechanics, and the package is applied to SAFOD repeating earthquakes.

ev.notes: No PDF was available; analysis is based on the detailed abstract and metadata from OpenAlex and Crossref.

sum: Locating tectonic tremor typically requires multi-station arrays because tremor signals lack impulsive phase arrivals. This study introduces TremorViT, a deep learning framework combining a CNN feature extractor and a Vision Transformer (ViT) to directly estimate 3D relative source coordinates and a full 3D Gaussian covariance matrix (aleatoric uncertainty) from 1-minute, single-station three-component velocity waveforms. Trained and tested on Hi-net data from the Nankai subduction zone (2008–2016), TremorViT achieves a mean epicentral error of 4.75 km at the single-station level. Integrating independent station predictions via Mahalanobis distance validation, k-core graph clustering, and covariance intersection reduces the mean epicentral error to 2.50 km. Applied to continuous 2016 data, the framework localized 68,101 tremor windows (1,135.0 hours), an order of magnitude more than envelope-correlation catalogs, revealing fine-scale tremor migration and potential geodetically undetected slow slip events.
针对构造震颤缺乏脉冲震相、难以单台定位的难题，本文提出结合CNN与视觉Transformer的深度学习框架TremorViT，直接从单台三分量1分钟速度波形中估计三维相对源坐标及偶然不确定性（三维高斯协方差矩阵）。基于南海俯冲带Hi-net台网数据（2008–2016年）训练测试，单台平均震中误差达……

t: TremorViT tokenizes 1-minute 3-component waveforms using 1D convolutions and processes them through 15 Vision Transformer layers to predict 3D relative source coordinates and a Cholesky-parameterized covariance matrix trained via negative log-likelihood.
利用一维卷积将1分钟三分量波形分词，经15层视觉Transformer预测三维相对源坐标及Cholesky参数化的协方差…

Three-component velocity waveforms (100 Hz, 1-minute segments) from 129 NIED Hi-net stations in Nankai (2008–2016) paired with Mizuno and Ide (2019) catalog locations, comprising 641,718 training, 89,386 validation, and 56,744 test waveforms.
2008–2016年南海俯冲带129个Hi-net台站三分量波形及参考目录，含641,718训练、89,386验证和56…

Single-station localization achieved a mean epicentral error of 4.75 km (median 2.66 km) and depth error of 2.59 km; multi-station integration improved errors to 2.50 km and localized 68,101 events (1,135.0 hours) in 2016.
单台平均震中误差4.75公里，多台融合后降至2.50公里；2016年连续监测共定位68,101个震颤事件（累计1135.…
Performance drops significantly at unseen stations (mean epicentral error 35.07 km) due to learned path/site effects, and source depth remains weakly constrained due to lacking impulsive phases.
受路径与场地效应影响，未训练台站误差增至35.07公里；且缺乏脉冲震相导致深度约束较弱。

First direct estimation of 3D tectonic tremor locations and aleatoric uncertainties from single-station waveforms using a Vision Transformer, plus covariance intersection fusion for multi-station cataloging.
首次利用视觉Transformer从单台波形直接估计三维震颤位置与偶然不确定性，并结合协方差交叉实现多台融合。

kc: Developed TremorViT, a Vision Transformer model that predicts 3D tremor source coordinates and full covariance matrices (aleatoric uncertainty) from single-station 3-component waveforms.

Demonstrated that predicted aleatoric uncertainty ellipsoid volumes strongly correlate with localization error (ρ = 0.62) and effectively discriminate tremor from noise and regular earthquakes without explicit classification training (PR-AUC = 0.938).
Proposed a 6-step multi-station integration workflow using Mahalanobis distance, k-core graph clustering, and covariance intersection, reducing mean epicentral error from 4.75 km to 2.50 km.

Generated a high-resolution Nankai tremor catalog (Jan–Sep 2016) with 68,101 events (1,135.0 h duration), revealing detailed spatiotemporal patterns and potential geodetically undetected slow slip events.
开发了TremorViT视觉Transformer模型，直接从单台三分量波形预测三维震颤源坐标及完整协方差矩阵（偶然不确定性）。
证明预测的偶然不确定性椭球体积与定位误差显著相关（ρ = 0.62），且无需分类训练即可有效区分震颤与噪声及普通地震（PR-AUC = 0.938）。
提出包含马氏距离、k-核图聚类和协方差交叉的六步多台融合流程，将平均震中误差从4.75公里降低至2.50公里。
构建了2016年1-9月南海俯冲带高分辨率震颤目录（68,101个事件，累计1135.0小时），揭示了精细时空演化及大地测量未探测到的潜在慢滑移事件。
me: Pre-filtering continuous 1-minute 3-component spectrograms (2–8 Hz) using a CNN classifier (TremorDetector) with a probability threshold ≥ 0.9.
Tokenizing 60-s velocity waveforms (100 Hz) into overlapping 0.6-s patch tokens via 1D convolution and processing them through 15 Transformer encoder layers with conv-augmented feed-forward networks.
Training TremorViT with a negative log-likelihood (NLL) loss over a 3D Gaussian distribution, parameterizing the covariance matrix via Cholesky decomposition.

Fusing multi-station predictions via uncertainty pruning, pairwise Mahalanobis distance validation, k-core (k=2) graph clustering, covariance intersection, and 50-km radius multi-source discrimination.
使用CNN分类器（TremorDetector）对连续1分钟三分量时频谱（2–8 Hz）进行预筛选（震颤概率阈值 ≥ 0.9）。
通过一维卷积将60秒速度波形（100 Hz）分词为重叠的0.6秒块标记，并输入包含卷积增强前馈网络的15层Transformer编码器。
利用三维高斯分布的负对数似然（NLL）损失训练TremorViT，通过Cholesky分解参数化协方差矩阵以保证正定性。
通过不确定性剪枝、成对马氏距离验证、k-核（k=2）图聚类、协方差交叉融合及50公里半径多源判别实现多台预测融合。
de: Three-component velocity waveforms (100 Hz, 1-minute windows) from 129 NIED Hi-net stations in the Nankai subduction zone (Jan 2008 – Sep 2016).

Reference tremor catalog from Mizuno and Ide (2019) constructed via modified envelope correlation, split chronologically into training (2008–2014; 641,718 waveforms), validation (2015; 89,386), and testing (Jan–Sep 2016; 56,744).
Generalization and fine-tuning experiments on 31 stations excluded from primary training, plus attention rollout and waveform masking interpretability tests.
南海俯冲带129个NIED Hi-net台站的三分量速度波形（100 Hz采样，1分钟窗口，2008年1月至2016年9月）。
采用Mizuno和Ide (2019)改进包络互相关目录作为参考标签，按时间划分为训练集（2008–2014年，641,718条）、验证集（2015年，89,386条）和测试集（2016年1–9月，56,744条）。
在31个未参与主训练的台站上进行泛化与微调实验，并开展注意力展开（attention rollout）和波形掩码可解释性测试。
li: Weak source depth constraints (mean absolute depth error 2.59 km, weak correlation ρ = 0.18 with uncertainty) due to the lack of impulsive depth-sensitive phase arrivals.
Strong station and path dependency: mean epicentral error degrades to 35.07 km on unseen stations without station-specific fine-tuning.
Potential geometric ambiguity producing bifurcated dual-source candidates, and conservative event rejection in station-sparse regions like the Bungo and Kii Channels.
由于缺乏脉冲型深度敏感震相，震源深度约束较弱（平均绝对深度误差2.59公里，与不确定性相关性仅为ρ = 0.18）。
存在显著的台站和路径依赖性：在未训练台站上直接应用时平均震中误差增至35.07公里，需少量样本微调。
单台几何模糊性可能导致双源分叉解，且在丰后水道和纪伊水道等台站稀疏区因严格空间一致性过滤会漏检部分事件。

tm.why: The paper develops TremorViT, a vision transformer-based deep learning architecture to estimate 3D source locations and aleatoric uncertainties directly from seismic waveforms.
The study focuses on high-resolution localization of tectonic tremor and associated short-duration slow slip events (SSEs) in the Nankai subduction zone.
The workflow detects and locates 68,101 tremor events from continuous seismic data, creating an enhanced catalog an order of magnitude larger than existing network-based catalogs.

ev.notes: Full 52-page manuscript PDF (Scientific Reports Article in Press) was analyzed, including all sections, equations, and Figures 1–7.

sum: This study constrains the geometry, evolution, and seismic hazard of the poorly understood South Coastal Fault System in the South Gulf of Evia, Greece. The authors integrate field structural and geomorphic observations (uplifted marine terraces, wavecut notches, beachrock), 5-10 m DEM topographic swath profiles, river longitudinal profile knickpoint analyses, and European Ground Motion Service (EGMS) Sentinel-1 InSAR vertical deformation data, alongside re-evaluated offshore sparker reflection and OBS velocity models. They produce a new map of eight active normal faults resolving vertical motion from 10^5-10^6 years to the last 5 years. Reconstructed footwall relief and offshore basin depth (~1-2 km) indicate eastern fault slip rates of 2-3 mm/yr. Fault displacement profiles reveal two partially to fully linked fault groups (~20 km western, ~43 km eastern). A worst-case full-length rupture of the eastern array could generate a Mw 7.0 earthquake with epicentral PGA up to ~2.0 g.
本研究结合野外构造与地貌观测（海成阶地、浪蚀龛、海滩岩）、DEM地形条带剖面、河流纵剖面裂点分析、欧洲地面运动服务（EGMS）InSAR垂向形变数据及前人海底地震仪（OBS）速度模型，约束了希腊南埃维亚湾南岸断裂系统的几何形态、演化与地震危险性。研究绘制了8条活动正断层的新图件，解析了从百万年到近5……

t: Integrates field geomorphic/structural mapping (terraces, notches, fault planes) with DEM swath profiles, river knickpoint chi-analysis, and EGMS InSAR vertical ground motion data to constrain fault geometry, linkage, and seismic hazard.
整合野外地貌/构造测绘、DEM条带剖面、河流裂点分析及EGMS InSAR垂向形变数据，约束断层几何、连接与地震危险性。

Field observations from April 2025 (terraces, wavecut notches, beachrock, fault planes), 5 m NCMA and 10 m Copernicus DEMs, 2019-2023 Sentinel-1 EGMS InSAR vertical velocities, and published offshore sparker/OBS data.
2025年野外调查数据（阶地、浪蚀龛、断层面）、5米与10米DEM、2019-2023年InSAR形变数据及已发表OBS…
Mapped eight active normal faults forming two linked groups (~20 km west, ~43 km east) with eastern slip rates of 2-3 mm/yr, capable of hosting up to Mw 7.0 earthquakes with ~2.0 g epicentral PGA.
绘制8条活动正断层，分为西（约20 km）、东（约43 km）两组，东段滑动速率2-3 mm/yr，最大可发Mw 7.0…
Absolute dating constraints for geomorphic features and basin fill are unavailable, hanging wall throw ratios are borrowed from Corinth, and eastern InSAR signals are noisy or sparse.
缺乏地貌与盆地沉积绝对测年，上盘沉降比值借用自科林斯湾，且东段InSAR信号噪声较大。

Provides the first comprehensive fault map, throw/slip-rate estimates, and multi-timescale linkage and hazard assessment for the eight active normal faults along the South Coast of the South Gulf of Evia.
首次提供南埃维亚湾南岸8条活动正断层的完整分布图、滑动速率估算及多时间尺度断层连接与危险性评估。

kc: Produced an updated map and geometric characterization of eight active normal faults bounding the Southern margin of the South Gulf of Evia.
Resolved fault growth and vertical ground motion across timescales from 10^5-10^6 years (river knickpoints, terraces) to 6 kyr (notches) and 5 years (EGMS InSAR).

Identified two partially to fully linked fault groups (~20 km western array, ~43 km eastern array) with eastern slip rates of 2-3 mm/yr and a maximum credible earthquake of Mw 7.0 (epicentral PGA up to 2.0 g).
绘制了限定南埃维亚湾南缘的8条活动正断层的全新分布图并表征了其几何特征。
解析了跨越10^5-10^6年（河流裂点、阶地）、6千年（浪蚀龛）至5年（EGMS InSAR）的多时间尺度断层生长与垂向地表运动。
识别出两个部分至完全连接的断层组（西段约20 km，东段约43 km），东段滑动速率为2-3 mm/yr，最大可信地震达Mw 7.0（震中PGA高达2.0 g）。
me: Field structural and geomorphic mapping of fault planes, uplifted marine terraces, wavecut notches, platforms, and beachrock.
Quantitative DEM topographic analysis using along- and across-strike swath profiles to extract footwall relief and estimate minimum throw and displacement.
River longitudinal profile and chi-steepness (ksn) analysis using TopoToolbox and ChiProfiler to identify transient tectonic knickpoints.
Short-term vertical ground motion analysis using Sentinel-1 InSAR ORTHO data (2019-2023) from the European Ground Motion Service (EGMS).
Deterministic seismic hazard assessment using empirical fault length-magnitude scaling, Greek GMPEs for PGA, and PGA-to-MMI conversion.
对断层面、抬升海成阶地、浪蚀龛、波切平台和海滩岩进行野外构造与地貌测绘。
利用沿走向和垂直走向的DEM条带剖面进行定量地形分析，提取下盘地形起伏并估算最小断距和位移。
使用TopoToolbox和ChiProfiler进行河流纵剖面及陡度指数（ksn）分析，以识别瞬态构造裂点。
利用欧洲地面运动服务（EGMS）的Sentinel-1 InSAR正射数据（2019-2023年）进行短期垂向地表运动分析。
基于经验断层长度-震级标度律、希腊地面运动预测方程（GMPE）和PGA-MMI转换关系进行确定性地震危险性评估。
de: Field measurements of fault planes, marine terraces, wavecut notches, and beachrock collected in April 2025 using a laser range finder and clinometer.
10 m Copernicus DEM and 5 m Greek Military Map (NCMA) DEM for terrace mapping, swath profiling, and drainage network extraction.
European Ground Motion Service (EGMS) Sentinel-1 InSAR vertical deformation velocity data averaged from 2019 to 2023.
Previously published offshore sparker seismic reflection profiles and single-channel airgun/OBS P-wave velocity models.
2025年4月使用激光测距仪和测斜仪采集的断层面、海成阶地、浪蚀龛和海滩岩野外测量数据。
用于阶地测绘、条带剖面提取和水系网络提取的10米Copernicus DEM和5米希腊军用地图（NCMA）DEM。
2019至2023年平均的欧洲地面运动服务（EGMS）Sentinel-1 InSAR垂向形变速率数据。
前人发表的近海电火花地震反射剖面以及单道气枪/海底地震仪（OBS）P波速度模型。
li: Lack of absolute geochronological dating constraints for marine terraces, wavecut notches, and offshore sedimentary basin fill in the South Gulf of Evia.
Poor offshore constraints on hanging wall geometries require assuming footwall uplift to hanging wall subsidence ratios (1:2 to 1:3) from the neighboring Gulf of Corinth.
EGMS InSAR vertical deformation signals are noisy or sparse in the eastern study area and can be affected by non-tectonic groundwater extraction.
南埃维亚湾的海成阶地、浪蚀龛及近海沉积盆地充填物缺乏绝对年代学测年约束。
近海上盘几何形态约束不足，需借用邻近科林斯湾的下盘抬升与上盘沉降比值（1:2至1:3）进行估算。
研究区东部的EGMS InSAR垂向形变信号噪声较大或数据稀疏，且易受地下水开采等非构造因素干扰。

tm.why: The paper maps eight active normal faults, analyzes fault growth, displacement-length scaling, segment linkage, and relay ramp breaching over multiple timescales.
The study evaluates fault linkage scenarios to determine maximum credible earthquake magnitudes (up to Mw 7.0), Peak Ground Acceleration (PGA) via GMPEs, and Modified Mercalli Intensity (MMI).
The paper investigates tectonic extension, footwall uplift, and neotectonic rift basin evolution in the South Gulf of Evia, Greece.

ev.notes: Full 36-page PDF provided and analyzed, including all sections, equations, tables, and 19 figures.

sum: Conventional nonlinear finite-element analysis (FEA) of building responses under seismic loading is computationally prohibitive for real-time or portfolio-scale applications. This study introduces SeisGPT, a physics-informed foundation model for rapid, high-fidelity structural response prediction across diverse multistorey building typologies. SeisGPT integrates a simplified dynamic-response prior, a mass-stiffness-aware graph neural network encoder, and a Spectral Duhamel-Green (SDG) Mixer decoder that embeds modal Green's-function propagation with learnable rational spectral corrections. Trained on over 2 million nonlinear elastoplastic simulations from 270,000 generated code-compliant designs and 694 real buildings (>10 billion time steps), SeisGPT predicts unseen building displacement and acceleration histories with normalized errors below 5% and achieves up to a 60,000-fold speedup over CPU-based FEA. It also generalizes zero-shot to steel, masonry, and base-isolated structures, reproduces incremental dynamic analysis fragility curves, and reconstructs full-building responses from sparse sensors, outperforming FEA in 43-storey shake-table tests.
针对传统非线性有限元分析计算耗时的瓶颈，本文提出物理引导基础模型SeisGPT，用于多高层建筑地震响应的快速高保真预测。方法结合简化动力响应先验、质量-刚度感知图神经网络编码器及嵌入模态格林函数传播与有理谱修正的谱杜哈梅-格林（SDG）混合解码器。基于27万个自动生成结构模型和694栋真实建筑的超2……

t: SeisGPT combines a simplified dynamic-response prior and a mass-stiffness-aware graph neural network encoder with a Spectral Duhamel-Green Mixer decoder that propagates modal responses via Green's functions and learnable rational spectral corrections.
结合简化动力响应先验、质量-刚度感知图神经网络编码器与基于格林函数模态传播和有理谱修正的SDG混合解码器。

Pretrained on over 2 million OpenSees nonlinear elastoplastic simulations across 270,000 diffusion-generated code-compliant RC buildings and fine-tuned on 694 real-world buildings under 26,000 dynamic excitations, totaling >10 billion time steps.
基于27万个生成式合规RC建筑和694栋真实建筑在2.6万条激励下的205万次OpenSees非线性模拟（逾100亿步）…

On unseen real buildings, SeisGPT-Enhanced achieved acceleration and displacement FNMAEs of 0.0195 (R=0.9829) and 0.0639 (R=0.9423), while delivering 5,962x to 60,733x computational speedups over CPU-based nonlinear FEA.
真实建筑测试集加速度和位移FNMAE达0.0195和0.0639（R为0.9829和0.9423），速度较CPU有限元快…

Restricted to floor-defined code-compliant buildings prior to dynamic instability; ignores post-collapse debris kinematics, degrades at coarse sampling intervals, and lacks calibrated uncertainty quantification.
局限于失稳前合规层定义建筑，未建模倒塌碎屑运动，粗采样率下精度下降且缺乏不确定性量化。

Introduces the first generalizable physics-informed structural dynamics foundation model embedding spectral Duhamel-Green modal operators to achieve real-time nonlinear prediction across diverse building typologies and sparse-sensor settings.
提出首个嵌入谱杜哈梅-格林模态算子的物理引导结构动力基础模型，实现跨结构体系实时预测与稀疏重构。

kc: Developed SeisGPT, a physics-informed foundation model combining a mass-stiffness-aware GNN encoder and a Spectral Duhamel-Green (SDG) Mixer decoder for nonlinear structural dynamics.
Created a massive dataset of >2 million nonlinear time-history simulations across 270,000 AI-generated code-compliant buildings and 694 real-world buildings (>10 billion time steps).
Achieved <5% normalized prediction error on unseen buildings with 5,962x to 60,733x computational speedup over CPU-based nonlinear FEA.

Demonstrated zero-shot generalization to steel, masonry, and base-isolated buildings, rapid building-specific adaptation via LoRA (~20 s), and sparse-sensor full-building reconstruction validated by shake-table experiments.
开发了结合质量-刚度感知GNN编码器与谱杜哈梅-格林（SDG）混合解码器的物理引导结构动力基础模型SeisGPT。
构建了涵盖27万个AI生成合规结构与694栋真实建筑、超200万次非线性时程分析（逾100亿时间步）的大规模数据集。
在未知建筑上实现低于5%的归一化预测误差，推理速度较CPU非线性有限元提升5,962至60,733倍。
实现了对钢结构、砌体和隔震建筑的零样本泛化、基于LoRA的20秒单建筑微调，以及经振动台试验验证的稀疏传感器全楼响应重构。
me: Simplified Dynamic Response (SDR) module using reduced-order mass/stiffness matrices and Newmark-beta integration to generate linear coarse priors.
Physics-informed Graph Neural Network (PIGNN) encoding storey-level connectivity weighted by a mass-normalized structural operator.
Spectral Duhamel-Green (SDG) Mixer performing differentiable eigendecomposition, damped modal Green's-function phase-plane rotation, and bounded rational spectral correction.
Generative diffusion pipeline (ArchiFlux, StructFlux, BeamFlux) with physics-informed post-optimization to synthesize 270,000 code-compliant OpenSees 3D FE models.
Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) for few-shot building-specific personalization and learned gated feature fusion (SeisGPT-R) for sparse-sensor response reconstruction.
简化动力响应（SDR）模块：利用降阶质量/刚度矩阵与Newmark-β积分生成粗粒度线性响应先验。
物理引导图神经网络（PIGNN）：利用质量归一化结构算子加权编码楼层间连接与相互作用。
谱杜哈梅-格林（SDG）混合器：在潜空间执行可微特征分解、阻尼模态格林函数相平面旋转及有界有理谱非线性修正。
生成式扩散设计管线（ArchiFlux、StructFlux、BeamFlux）结合物理后优化，自动生成27万个符合规范的OpenSees三维有限元模型。
低秩自适应（LoRA）少样本单建筑微调，以及基于门控特征融合的稀疏传感器全楼响应重构（SeisGPT-R）。
de: 2,053,880 OpenSees nonlinear time-history analyses from 270,000 synthetic RC buildings (frame, frame-shear wall, shear wall) and 694 real-world buildings under 26,000 dynamic excitations.
Zero-shot cross-system evaluation on 2,000 steel structures (6,000 records), 33 masonry structures (73 records in Abaqus), and 4 base-isolated buildings (33 records in ETABS).
Shake-table experiment on a 1/10-scaled 43-storey RC frame-supported shear wall building under 7 ground motions using a single 11th-floor sensor for full reconstruction.
Incremental Dynamic Analysis (IDA) evaluation on 65 real buildings across 22 ground motions up to collapse instability across 4 FEMA Hazus damage limit states.
基于27万个合成钢筋混凝土建筑（框架、框剪、剪力墙）和694栋真实建筑在26,000条动荷载下的2,053,880次OpenSees非线性时程分析。
针对2,000个钢结构（6,000条记录）、33个Abaqus砌体结构（73次分析）和4栋ETABS隔震建筑（33次分析）的零样本跨结构体系评估。
1/10缩尺43层钢筋混凝土结构在7条地震动下的振动台试验，仅用11层单个位移传感器重构全楼响应。
65栋真实建筑在22条地震动下的增量动力分析（IDA）与四个FEMA Hazus损伤极限状态的地震易损性曲线验证。
li: Training data are confined to code-compliant, floor-defined multistorey buildings, under-representing highly irregular geometries, torsional irregularities, and soil-structure interaction.
Validated within well-posed nonlinear time-history analysis regimes up to instability onset; post-instability collapse progression, contact, and debris kinematics are not modeled.
Zero-shot predictive accuracy degrades at coarse temporal sampling intervals (e.g., dt >= 0.08 s) without explicit retraining.
The deterministic framework does not currently provide calibrated uncertainty quantification or probabilistic downstream risk metrics.
训练数据局限于符合规范的层定义多层建筑，对高度不规则几何、扭转不规则及土-结相互作用代表性不足。
仅在失稳前的常规非线性时程分析收敛域内验证，未涵盖失稳后倒塌演进、接触碰撞及碎屑运动学。
在未重新训练的情况下，粗时间采样率（如dt >= 0.08 s）会导致零样本预测精度下降。
当前模型为确定性框架，尚未提供经过校准的不确定性量化或下游概率风险指标。

tm.why: The paper develops a foundation model to rapidly predict nonlinear structural responses of multistorey buildings under seismic ground motions and perform incremental dynamic analysis for seismic fragility and post-earthquake damage assessment.

It introduces SeisGPT, a physics-informed deep learning foundation model combining graph neural networks and a Spectral Duhamel-Green Mixer trained on over 2 million seismic structural response simulations.

ev.notes: Full 18-page Nature Communications PDF used, including all 8 figures, 4 tables, equations, results, discussion, and methods.

sum: This study investigates tsunami generation from five MW 8–9 3-D dynamic rupture scenarios along the Hellenic Arc Subduction Zone. Using SeisSol (ADER-DG method) linked one-way to the nonlinear shallow-water solver GeoClaw, the authors examine how hypocentral location, rupture extent, and off-fault Drucker-Prager visco-plasticity govern seafloor uplift and tsunami propagation across the Mediterranean. Results demonstrate that shallow slip and off-fault plastic deformation control near-trench vertical uplift, with plasticity boosting tsunami amplitudes by over 50% to a maximum of 6.6 m along central and eastern Mediterranean coasts, while the northern Aegean and western Mediterranean remain shielded. Extending one margin-wide scenario into the first large-scale, fully-coupled 3-D elasto-acoustic earthquake-tsunami model for the Hellenic Arc reveals complex early-phase wave conversions, acoustic waves, oceanic Rayleigh waves, and dispersion not captured by static or linked models. These physics-based insights refine regional tsunami hazard assessment and early warning strategies.
本研究针对希腊弧俯冲带五个MW 8–9三维动态破裂情景开展海啸生成模拟。作者利用SeisSol（ADER-DG方法）与非线性浅水方程求解器GeoClaw进行单向耦合，探究震源位置、破裂范围及断层外Drucker-Prager粘塑性变形对海底隆起和地中海海啸传播的控制作用。结果表明，浅部滑移和断层外塑……

t: The authors use SeisSol (ADER-DG method) to simulate 3-D dynamic earthquake ruptures, linking static seafloor displacements one-way into the nonlinear shallow-water code GeoClaw, and also run a 3-D fully-coupled elasto-acoustic earthquake-tsunami model.
利用SeisSol模拟三维动态破裂，将静态海底位移单向输入GeoClaw浅水模型，并开展三维全耦合弹-声地震-海啸模拟。
Five 3-D dynamic rupture scenarios (HE, HM, HW, HEP, HEA) of MW 8–9 are modeled along the non-planar Hellenic Arc megathrust geometry using 15-arcsec GEBCO bathymetry across the Mediterranean.
基于希腊弧非平面巨型逆冲断层几何模型与15角秒GEBCO水深数据，构建了5个MW 8–9动态破裂情景。

Off-fault plastic yielding increases tsunami amplitudes by ~50%, producing maximum sea surface height anomalies up to 6.6 m near central and eastern Mediterranean coasts, while the fully-coupled model reveals early acoustic-tsunami wave conversions.
断层外塑性变形使海啸振幅增加约50%（最高达6.6米），全耦合模型揭示了早期声波与海啸波的复杂转换及频散效应。

The fully-coupled 3-D model neglects coastal inundation, requires smoothed bathymetry near coastlines, and is restricted to 300 seconds of simulation time due to high computational cost (~1 million CPU hours).
全耦合三维模型未考虑海岸淹没且简化了近岸水深，受计算成本（约100万CPU小时）限制仅模拟了300秒。

Presents the first large-scale, fully-coupled 3-D dynamic rupture and elasto-acoustic tsunami simulation for the Hellenic Arc megathrust, along with quantifying off-fault plasticity impacts on Mediterranean tsunami hazard.
首次实现了希腊弧俯冲带大规模三维全耦合地震-海啸模拟，并量化了断层外塑性变形对地中海海啸危险性的增强效应。

kc: Simulated five 3-D physics-based dynamic rupture scenarios (MW 8.05–8.96) along the Hellenic Arc megathrust and linked them to Mediterranean-scale nonlinear shallow-water tsunami simulations.

Demonstrated that off-fault visco-plastic deformation reduces shallow fault slip but enhances vertical seafloor uplift away from the trench, increasing maximum tsunami amplitudes by over 50% (reaching 6.6 m).

Presented the first large-scale, fully-coupled 3-D dynamic rupture and elasto-acoustic tsunami simulation for the Hellenic Arc, capturing seismic-to-acoustic wave conversions, oceanic Rayleigh waves, and dispersive tsunami initiation.
模拟了希腊弧巨型逆冲断层上的5个三维物理动态破裂情景（MW 8.05–8.96），并将其与地中海尺度的非线性浅水海啸模拟相耦合。
证明断层外粘塑性变形虽减小浅部断层滑移，但增强了远离海沟的海底垂直隆起，使最大海啸振幅增加50%以上（高达6.6米）。
提出了首个针对希腊弧的大规模三维全耦合动态破裂与弹-声波海啸模拟，捕捉了地震波与海洋声波的转换、大洋瑞利波及频散海啸生成过程。
me: 3-D dynamic earthquake rupture and seismic wave propagation modeling using the ADER-DG method in SeisSol with linear slip-weakening friction and Drucker-Prager off-fault visco-plasticity.

One-way linked tsunami propagation modeling over 8 hours using the 2-D depth-averaged nonlinear shallow-water equations with adaptive mesh refinement in GeoClaw, incorporating the Tanioka horizontal displacement filter.

Fully-coupled 3-D elasto-acoustic earthquake-tsunami modeling in SeisSol combining an elastic solid Earth with a compressible acoustic water layer and a linearized gravity-restoring free-surface boundary condition.
利用SeisSol中的ADER-DG方法结合线性滑移弱化摩擦准则与Drucker-Prager断层外粘塑性本构关系，开展三维动态地震破裂与地震波传播模拟。
采用含Tanioka水平位移滤波器的GeoClaw自适应网格加密二维非线性浅水方程，进行8小时单向耦合海啸传播模拟。
在SeisSol中将弹性固体地球与可压缩声学水层及线性重力恢复自由表面边界条件相结合，开展全耦合三维弹-声地震-海啸模拟。
de: 3-D non-planar Hellenic Arc slab interface geometry based on Scala et al. (2020) and Basili et al. (2021), embedded in a 1-D layered velocity structure (Haslinger et al., 1999) with GEBCO 15-arcsec bathymetry.

Five dynamic rupture scenarios: three margin-wide elastic models with eastern (HE), middle (HM), and western (HW) hypocenters; one margin-wide model with off-fault plasticity (HEP); and one single-asperity MW ~8 model (HEA).

Synthetic time series evaluation at 11 virtual tide-gauge stations across the Mediterranean and detailed 300-s wavefield analysis on a 35.8-million-element unstructured tetrahedral mesh (~1 million CPU hours on SuperMUC-NG).
基于Scala等(2020)和Basili等(2021)构建的三维非平面希腊弧俯冲板片几何模型，嵌入一维层状速度结构(Haslinger等, 1999)与GEBCO 15角秒水深地形数据。
五个动态破裂情景：具有东(HE)、中(HM)、西(HW)震源的三个全边缘弹性模型，一个包含断层外塑性的全边缘模型(HEP)，以及一个单凹凸体MW ~8模型(HEA)。
地中海11个虚拟验潮站的合成时间序列评估，以及在3580万单元非结构化四面体网格上开展的300秒全耦合波场分析（在SuperMUC-NG上耗时约100万CPU小时）。
li: GeoClaw shallow-water simulations neglect wave dispersion and coastal inundation, while the 3-D fully-coupled SeisSol simulation uses simplified coastline bathymetry (adjusting |z| < 200 m to ±200 m) and runs for only 300 s due to high computational cost.
Dynamic rupture initial stress and friction parameterizations remain simplified and do not include splay faults branching off the megathrust.
GeoClaw浅水模拟忽略了波频散和海岸淹没，而三维全耦合SeisSol模拟受限于高昂计算成本，采用了简化的海岸线水深地形（将|z| < 200 m调整为±200 m）且仅模拟了300秒。
动态破裂的初始应力和摩擦参数化仍较为简化，未包含从主逆冲断层分叉出的次级逆冲断层（splay faults）。

tm.why: The paper simulates 3-D dynamic earthquake rupture scenarios (MW 8–9) along the Hellenic Arc megathrust including off-fault visco-plastic deformation.
The study performs large-scale 3-D ADER-DG numerical simulations using SeisSol on SuperMUC-NG, solving coupled elasto-acoustic wave propagation and gravity boundary conditions.
The dynamic rupture models directly inform physics-based tsunami hazard assessment and coastal wave arrival metrics across the eastern Mediterranean.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the provided preprint PDF text (pages 1–6 and 22–30) and the published GJI abstract metadata.

sum: This study investigates interseismic locking on the Kamchatka megathrust prior to the 2025 Mw 8.84 earthquake using a novel data-driven probabilistic framework. Combining horizontal GNSS velocities with a boundary element model (BEM) on a Slab2.0 triangular mesh and a Metropolis-Hastings sampling algorithm, the authors estimate fault locking probabilities without prescribing asperity locations a priori. The posterior ensemble identifies a principal locked cluster whose accumulated moment deficit over the ~73 years since the 1952 Mw 9.0 earthquake (median Mw 8.71–8.80) matches the 2025 coseismic moment release. Hierarchical clustering reveals smaller, high-probability subclusters coinciding with the 1952 and 2025 hypocenters, while foreshocks cluster along locked margins. Comparing 1952 and 2025 coseismic slip models shows both ruptured the same deep persistent asperity, terminating near a positive trench-parallel gravity anomaly, but differed strongly in near-trench shallow slip, explaining the contrasting tsunami severities.

t: Couples a triangular boundary element model (tribem) accounting for stress shadows with a Metropolis-Hastings sampling algorithm (10^6 chains of 10^4 iterations) to estimate fault element locking probabilities from GNSS velocities, followed by hierarchical clustering.
将考虑应力阴影的三角形边界元模型与Metropolis-Hastings采样及层次聚类结合，由GNSS反演闭锁概率。

Horizontal interseismic GNSS velocities (CGPS and 2001–2003 SGPS) from Bürgmann et al. (2005) on a 1,638-element Slab2.0 mesh (80 mm/yr convergence), compared against 1952/2025 tsunami and USGS coseismic slip models and marine gravity anomalies.
使用堪察加震间水平GNSS速度、Slab2.0断层网格、1952/2025海啸与USGS同震滑动模型及重力异常。

Identifies a 618-element principal locked cluster accumulating ~5.8 m slip deficit since 1952, yielding a probabilistic median Mw 8.708 (scaled Mw 8.80, ~90% of 2025 M0 = 2.26 × 10^22 N·m) and subclusters matching 1952/2025 hypocenters.

Offshore and shallow near-trench coupling are poorly resolved without seafloor geodesy, edge artifacts appear downdip (~80 km), and steady slip deficit (~5.8 m) underpredicts local 2025 peak slip (20–30 m).

Introduces an objective, fully data-driven BEM Metropolis-Hastings approach that infers probabilistic megathrust locking and persistent multi-cycle sub-asperities without prescribing asperity geometries a priori.

Demonstrated that the 73-year slip deficit accumulated on the principal Kamchatka locked cluster accounts for the seismic moment of the 2025 Mw 8.84 earthquake.
Identified internal subclusters via hierarchical clustering that align with the rupture initiation zones of both the 1952 and 2025 megathrust earthquakes.
Showed that persistent deep asperities and structural gravity boundaries govern multi-cycle rupture extent, while variable shallow slip drives tsunami hazard uncertainty.

me: Boundary Element Modeling (BEM) using the tribem code on a 1,638-element triangular mesh derived from Slab2.0, incorporating mechanical stress shadowing.
Modified Metropolis-Hastings Markov Chain Monte Carlo sampling (1,000,000 independent chains of 10,000 iterations each) to select binary locked/creeping element states.
Hierarchical clustering (k=5 via elbow method) of the posterior locking ensemble and forward GNSS misfit (WRSS) testing of subclusters.
Comparison of locking probabilities with finite-fault/tsunami coseismic slip models (1952 and 2025) and locally/regionally detrended trench-parallel gravity anomalies (TPGA).

采用改进的Metropolis-Hastings算法（100万条独立链，每条迭代1万次）对断层单元的闭锁/蠕滑二元状态进行概率采样。
对后验闭锁模型集合进行层次聚类（肘部法则确定k=5），并通过正演GNSS加权残差平方和（WRSS）检验次级簇的力学意义。
将闭锁概率与1952和2025年同震滑动模型（海啸及有限断层反演）以及去趋势平行海沟重力异常（TPGA）进行对比。

Kamchatka megathrust 3D fault geometry from the Slab2.0 model with plate convergence set at 80 mm/yr (azimuth 307°).
Coseismic slip models for the 1952 Mw 9.0 and 2025 Mw 8.84 events derived from tide-gauge, DART buoy tsunami waveforms, and USGS V5 finite-fault inversions.
Satellite-altimetry derived marine gravity data processed into locally and regionally detrended trench-parallel gravity anomalies (TPGA).
Bürgmann等（2005）汇编的堪察加半岛震间水平GNSS速度场数据（包含连续站CGPS与2001–2003年流动站SGPS，北美参考框架）。
基于Slab2.0模型的堪察加俯冲带三维断层几何模型，板块汇聚速率设为80 mm/yr（方位角307°）。
由验潮站、DART浮标海啸波形和USGS V5有限断层反演获得的1952年Mw 9.0和2025年Mw 8.84地震同震滑动模型。
由卫星测高海洋重力数据处理得到的局部和区域去趋势平行海沟重力异常（TPGA）。
li: Poor spatial resolution for offshore and shallow near-trench coupling due to land-only GNSS station coverage, necessitating future seafloor geodesy.
Edge effects and weak downdip geodetic sensitivity produce non-physical deep (~80 km) and northern locking artifacts near model boundaries.

Local 2025 coseismic slip (20–30 m) exceeds the ~5.8 m slip deficit accumulated since 1952 under steady 80 mm/yr convergence, leaving unmodeled postseismic reloading or incomplete 1952 strain release.
由于仅使用陆地GNSS台站数据，对近海和近海沟浅部耦合的分辨率较低，未来需依赖海底大地测量。
模型边界效应及深部大地测量敏感度不足导致在深部（约80 km）和北部出现非物理的反演假象。

tm.why: The study focuses on interseismic megathrust locking, stress shadowing, and strain accumulation across multiple seismic cycles along the Kamchatka subduction zone.
The paper links persistent locked asperities to coseismic slip distributions, rupture initiation, and moment release of the 1952 Mw 9.0 and 2025 Mw 8.8 Kamchatka earthquakes.
The authors introduce a data-driven probabilistic framework using a Metropolis-Hastings sampling algorithm to estimate posterior locking probability distributions without prior asperity assumptions.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 9-page Geophysical Research Letters PDF (Periollat & Funning, 2026), including all text sections, equations/statistics, and Figures 1–3.

sum: This study investigates the spatial and temporal evolution of permanent coastal uplift along 300 km of the central Chilean forearc, within the 2015 Mw 8.3 Illapel earthquake rupture zone. Combining 12-m TanDEM-X topographic mapping of four Pleistocene marine terrace levels, stratigraphic analysis, eight new post-IR IRSL luminescence ages, geodetic comparisons, and Okada elastic dislocation modeling, the authors constrain deformation rates across glacial cycles. They find modest uplift rates of 0.1–0.3 m/ka during MIS 9 and MIS 5e, interrupted by a transient pulse of rapid uplift (0.5–0.9 m/ka) during MIS 7 lasting ~200 ka. Terrace uplift rates do not correlate with decadal interseismic GPS velocities, megathrust locking, or 2015 coseismic slip, and upper-plate normal faults contribute less than 10% of total uplift. The novelty lies in demonstrating that transient coastal uplift is decoupled from the seismic cycle and instead driven by deep subduction channel dynamics, specifically modest seamount chain subduction or...
本研究结合12米TanDEM-X地形测绘、地层分析、8个新的钾长石红外后释光（post-IR IRSL）测年数据、GPS大地测量对比及Okada弹性位错模拟，研究了智利中部2015年Mw 8.3伊亚佩尔地震破裂带300公里海岸的永久隆升演化。结果显示，MIS 9和MIS 5e期间隆升速率较低（0.1……

t: Shoreline angles were mapped from 12-m TanDEM-X DEMs using TerraceM, dated via K-feldspar post-IR IRSL luminescence, and modeled with Okada elastic dislocations to separate upper-plate normal faulting from background uplift.
利用TanDEM-X和TerraceM提取古海岸线角度，结合钾长石释光测年与Okada位错模拟分离断层与背景隆升。

Topographic swath profiles from 12-m TanDEM-X DEMs across 300 km of coast, eight new post-IR IRSL sediment samples, 20 published ages, decadal GPS velocities, interseismic locking, and 2015 Illapel coseismic slip.
300公里海岸12米TanDEM-X地形、8个新释光样品、20个已发表年龄及GPS与同震滑动数据。
Incremental uplift rates were 0.1–0.3 m/ka during MIS 5e and 0.2–0.3 m/ka during MIS 9, but accelerated to 0.5–0.9 m/ka during MIS 7, with background uplift contributing >90% of total deformation.
MIS 5e和MIS 9隆升速率为0.1–0.3 m/ka，MIS 7加速至0.5–0.9 m/ka，背景隆升占比超90…
Whether the MIS 7 transient uplift pulse was driven solely by modest seamount chain subduction or combined with transient underplating of crustal nappes remains speculative.
MIS 7瞬态隆升究竟仅由海山链俯冲驱动还是结合了推覆体底垫作用仍具推测性。

Demonstrates that permanent forearc uplift and transient MIS 7 acceleration are decoupled from the Illapel megathrust cycle and upper-plate faulting, pointing instead to modest seamount subduction or underplating.
证明前弧永久隆升与巨型逆冲地震周期及浅表断层脱钩，揭示了海山俯冲或底垫驱动机制。

kc: Mapped four Pleistocene marine terrace levels (MIS 5e, MIS 7, MIS 9, and ~1 Myr rasa) along 300 km of the central Chilean coast using 12-m TanDEM-X DEMs and TerraceM.
Provided eight new post-IR IRSL luminescence ages on coarse-grained K-feldspar to constrain last interglacial (MIS 5) marine and continental terrace deposits.
Identified a ~200-ka transient pulse of accelerated coastal uplift (0.5–0.9 m/ka) during MIS 7, three times faster than MIS 9 and MIS 5e background rates (0.1–0.3 m/ka).

Demonstrated via elastic dislocation modeling and geodetic comparisons that permanent coastal uplift is decoupled from the Illapel megathrust seismic cycle and dominated (>90%) by deep background sources rather than upper-plate normal faulting.
利用12米TanDEM-X数字高程模型和TerraceM软件，测绘了智利中部300公里海岸线上的四级更新世海成阶地（MIS 5e、MIS 7、MIS 9和约1 Myr的夷平面）。
提供了8个新的粗粒钾长石post-IR IRSL释光测年数据，约束了末次间冰期（MIS 5）海相和陆相阶地沉积物的年代。
识别出MIS 7期间持续约20万年的瞬态海岸隆升加速事件（0.5–0.9 m/ka），其速率是MIS 9和MIS 5e背景速率（0.1–0.3 m/ka）的三倍以上。
通过弹性位错模拟和大地测量数据对比，证明永久性海岸隆升与伊亚佩尔巨型逆冲地震周期脱钩，且主要由深部背景源主导（>90%），而非上盘正断层活动。
me: High-resolution topographic swath profiling and shoreline-angle extraction using 12-m TanDEM-X DEMs and TerraceM software.
Post-infrared infrared stimulated luminescence (post-IR IRSL at 225°C) dating of K-feldspar grains from marine and alluvial terrace deposits.
Incremental and non-incremental tectonic uplift-rate calculations across multiple chronological hypotheses and sea-level curves.
Okada elastic dislocation modeling in TerraceM to separate upper-plate normal fault slip contributions from regional background uplift.
Spatial correlation analysis comparing long-term terrace uplift rates against decadal vertical GPS velocities, interseismic megathrust locking, and 2015 Illapel coseismic slip.
利用12米TanDEM-X数字高程模型和TerraceM软件进行高分辨率地形条带剖面分析和古海岸线角度提取。
对海相和冲积阶地沉积物中的钾长石颗粒进行225°C红外后激发红外释光（post-IR IRSL）测年。
在多种年代学假设和海平面变化曲线下计算增量和非增量构造隆升速率。
在TerraceM中使用Okada弹性位错模型，将上盘正断层滑动贡献与区域背景隆升分离。
将长期阶地隆升速率与十年尺度的垂直GPS速度、震间巨型逆冲断层闭锁度以及2015年伊亚佩尔地震同震滑动进行空间相关性分析。
de: 12-m resolution TanDEM-X Digital Elevation Model covering ~300 km of the central Chilean coastline (30°S–32.5°S).
Eight new post-IR IRSL sediment samples (TON1, TON4, TAL1, TAL2, VIL2, VIL3, PIC1, MOL3) and 20 compiled published U/Th, ESR, AAR, and 10Be ages.
Published decadal vertical GPS velocities and interseismic megathrust locking models for pre-2010 Maule and 2010–2015 pre-Illapel periods.
Coseismic slip distribution model of the 2015 Mw 8.3 Illapel earthquake and active continental fault geometries from the 1:25,000 Chile fault database.
覆盖智利中部约300公里海岸线（30°S–32.5°S）的12米分辨率TanDEM-X数字高程模型。
8个新的post-IR IRSL沉积物样品（TON1、TON4、TAL1、TAL2、VIL2、VIL3、PIC1、MOL3）以及汇编的20个已发表U/Th、ESR、AAR和10Be年龄数据。
2010年毛莱地震前和2010–2015年伊亚佩尔地震前两个震间期的十年尺度垂直GPS速度和震间巨型逆冲断层闭锁模型。
2015年Mw 8.3伊亚佩尔地震同震滑动分布模型以及来自1:25,000智利断层数据库的活动大陆断层几何参数。
li: Older marine terrace chronologies (MIS 7, MIS 9, and rasa) rely on sparse published U/Th and 10Be ages subject to post-mortem uranium exchange, erosion uncertainties, and surface reoccupation.
Whether the MIS 7 transient uplift pulse was driven solely by modest seamount chain subduction or combined with crustal nappe underplating remains speculative without direct subsurface imaging.
较老海成阶地（MIS 7、MIS 9和夷平面）的年代学依赖于稀疏的已发表U/Th和10Be年龄，受限于死后铀交换、侵蚀不确定性和地表重复占据的影响。
由于缺乏直接的地下成像约束，MIS 7瞬态隆升究竟完全由小型海山链俯冲驱动，还是与地壳推覆体底垫作用共同驱动，仍具有推测性。

tm.why: The paper investigates long-term and transient forearc deformation, coastal uplift, and subduction zone dynamics (seamount subduction and underplating) in central Chile.

The study models slip rates on upper-plate normal faults using elastic dislocation models and compares millennial terrace uplift with interseismic locking and coseismic slip of the 2015 Mw 8.3 Illapel megathrust earthquake.

sum: Following the January 7, 2025 MS 6.8 Dingri earthquake in southern Xizang, understanding the seismogenic structure required systematic investigation of the Dingmu Co fault-bounded basin. This study integrates 1:50,000 geological mapping, optically stimulated luminescence (OSL) dating of fault breccia carbonized zones, and pre-earthquake audio-frequency magnetotelluric (AMT) and soil-radon profiles acquired in 2022. The results show that lacustrine strata contain abundant seismically induced soft-sediment deformation structures. The basin is shaped by an east-west-trending half-graben in the north (linked to the Lhagoi Kangri Detachment System) and north-south strike-slip normal faults in the east. AMT and radon surveys reveal at least seven concealed normal faults and heightened pre-seismic fault activity west of the main boundary fault. OSL ages constrain three major tectonic episodes since the Late Pleistocene (~53.4, ~37.1–32.2, and ~9.2 ka BP). Furthermore, intense coseismic deformation in 2025 concentrated at intersections of multi-trending fault systems.

t: The authors combined 1:50,000 field structural mapping, OSL dating of fault carbonized zones, and an 8-km pre-earthquake AMT and soil-radon transect across the southern Dingmu Co basin.
结合1:50,000野外构造填图、断层碳化带OSL测年及8 km长震前AMT与土壤氡气联合剖面测量。
Three OSL samples from boundary fault breccia zones, an 8-km AMT profile (100-m spacing), and soil-radon measurements (10-m spacing) acquired in 2022 prior to the 2025 earthquake.
3个边界断层角砾岩OSL样品，以及2022年震前采集的8 km长AMT（点距100m）和土壤氡气数据。
OSL dating yielded ages of 53.4±7.3 ka in the northern half-graben and 37.1±4.1 to 32.2±3.4 ka along the eastern fault; AMT and radon revealed at least seven concealed normal faults.
测定北缘半地堑活动年龄53.4±7.3 ka，东边界断层37.1–32.2 ka；识别出至少7条隐伏正断层。
Limited outcrop exposure prevents direct surface observation of buried faults, whose orientations rely on a single geophysical profile without drilling constraints.
盆地内露头有限，隐伏断层产状仅靠单条物探剖面约束，缺乏钻探验证。

First reconstruction of multi-phase Late Pleistocene tectonic history of the Dingmu Co basin integrating pre-seismic AMT/radon data and linking multi-trend fault intersections to 2025 Dingri coseismic deformation.
首次结合震前物探与测年重建丁木错晚更新世三期活动历史，揭示多向断层交汇控制2025年定日地震强变形。

kc: Documented extensive seismically induced soft-sediment deformation structures in Quaternary lacustrine deposits of the Dingmu Co basin.
Identified at least seven concealed normal faults and pre-earthquake soil-radon anomalies across the southern Dingmu Co basin using 2022 AMT and radon transects.
Established three major Late Quaternary tectonic activity phases (~53.4 ka, ~37.1–32.2 ka, and ~9.2 ka BP) using OSL dating of fault carbonized zones and existing paleoseismic data.

Proposed a two-fault-set genetic model combining the N-S Dingmu Co strike-slip normal fault and E-W Lhagoi Kangri Detachment System, showing that 2025 MS 6.8 coseismic deformation focused at fault intersections.
记录了丁木错盆地第四纪湖相沉积中广泛发育的地震成因软沉积物变形构造。
利用2022年震前AMT和土壤氡气剖面，在丁木错盆地南部识别出至少7条隐伏正断层及震前断层活动异常。
通过断层碳化带OSL测年结合前人古地震资料，确立了晚更新世以来（~53.4、~37.1–32.2和~9.2 ka BP）三期主要构造活动。
提出了受南北向走滑正断层与东西向拆离断层共同控制的盆地成因模型，并指出2025年定日6.8级地震强烈变形集中于多向断层交汇区。
me: 1:50,000-scale regional geological mapping and field structural analysis of boundary faults and soft-sediment deformation structures.
Optically stimulated luminescence (OSL) dating of quartz and potassium feldspar from carbonized fault breccia zones.
8-km-long audio-frequency magnetotelluric (AMT) 2D resistivity imaging (100-m station spacing) coupled with soil-radon gas concentration profiling (10-m spacing).
1:50,000区域地质填图及边界断层与软沉积物变形构造的野外构造解析。
断层角砾岩碳化带石英和钾长石颗粒的光释光（OSL）测年。
8 km长音频大地电磁（AMT）二维电阻率成像（点距100 m）与同剖面土壤氡气浓度测量（点距10 m）。
de: Field outcrops of Quaternary lacustrine sediments, northern margin E-W half-graben, and eastern margin N-S Dingmu Co normal-strike-slip fault zone.
Three OSL dating samples (LA-01, LA-02 from the eastern boundary fault; LA-03 from the northern half-graben).
Pre-earthquake (2022) 8-km AMT profile and concurrent RAD-7 soil-radon transect across the southern Dingmu Co basin.
第四纪湖相沉积、北缘东西向半地堑及东缘南北向丁木错正-走滑断层带的野外露头观测数据。
3个断层带OSL测年样品（东边界断层LA-01、LA-02；北部半地堑LA-03）。
2022年震前横跨丁木错盆地南部的8 km长AMT剖面及同步RAD-7土壤氡气测量数据。
li: Limited outcrop exposure within the basin leaves buried active faults without direct surface geological constraints.
Orientations of concealed faults are constrained by only a single 2D geophysical profile without Quaternary drilling verification.
盆地内部露头有限，隐伏活动断层缺乏直接的地表地质资料约束。
隐伏断层的产状目前仅受控于单条地球物理剖面，缺乏第四纪钻探验证。

tm.why: The paper investigates the sedimentary framework, structural architecture, and Late Quaternary tectonic evolution of the Dingmu Co fault-bounded basin within the Southern Xizang Rift System.
The study analyzes active boundary fault kinematics, concealed graben-horst structures, and paleoseismic activity history using field surveys, OSL dating, AMT, and soil-radon profiles.
The authors link multi-directional fault intersections to the intense coseismic surface deformation zones of the 2025 MS 6.8 Dingri earthquake to inform disaster risk assessment.

ev.notes: Full 15-page PDF analyzed, including text, Table 1, and Figures 1–10.

sum: To align Kazakhstan's building codes with Eurocode 8, this study develops probabilistic Detailed Seismic Zoning (DSZ) maps for the Turkestan region using the OpenQuake Engine. A unified earthquake catalog (1900–2023) was compiled for the region and a 300 km buffer zone, analyzed for completeness, and used to parameterize 35 crustal and 2 deep subduction area sources alongside finite active fault models. Epistemic uncertainties were handled via logic trees combining two active fault databases (EAFDB and regional data) and 12 ground motion models (GMMs) validated against Kazakhstani strong-motion records (PGA >= 30 cm/s2). For rock sites (VS30 >= 800 m/s), predicted PGAs range from 0.020–0.370 g and 0.052–0.720 g for 10% and 2% probabilities of exceedance in 50 years, peaking in the southeastern Ugam active fault zone. Incorporating hybrid area-linear sources significantly improves spatial hazard resolution over the 2017 general zoning maps.

sum: This study presents an extended Differential Effective Medium (DEM) theory to overcome the limitation of standard DEM, which assumes ideal ellipsoidal pores. By introducing a perturbation tensor, the new framework accounts for irregular and complex pore geometries typical of carbonate rocks. For isotropic composites, this tensor simplifies to two scalar coefficients representing pore shape complexity, which are quantified using a convexity-based metric. Numerical simulations on synthetic rocks demonstrate that these coefficients increase with decreasing convexity, indicating higher compliance. The model is validated using well-log and micro-computed tomography (μCT) data from carbonate reservoirs in the Mumbai Offshore Basin, India. The extended DEM significantly improves shear-wave velocity predictions compared to standard DEM, offering a practical tool for rock-physics modeling in heterogeneous carbonate systems.
本研究提出了一种扩展的双重有效介质（DEM）理论，以解决传统DEM仅适用于理想椭球形孔隙的局限性。通过引入扰动张量，该新框架能够表征碳酸盐岩中典型的不规则和复杂孔隙几何。对于各向同性介质，该张量简化为两个标量系数，其物理意义通过基于凸度的孔隙形状数值模拟得到了验证。在印度孟买近海盆地碳酸盐岩储层的测……

sum: This study investigates upper-crustal seismic anisotropy in the southeastern Korean Peninsula using 4,611 reliable shear-wave splitting (SWS) measurements from local earthquakes recorded by the Gyeongju Hi-density Broadband Seismic Network. Spatial averaging shows a dominant NE–SW fast-polarization direction, with local rotations near the Yangsan and Ulsan fault systems. Delay-time tomography reveals high anisotropy near the 2016 Gyeongju earthquake sequence (Naenam fault) and east of the Ulsan fault. The results demonstrate that upper-crustal anisotropy is not driven by a single mechanism but rather by a combination of fault-related deformation, inherited Miocene basin structures, and local stress fields. This provides a crucial baseline for intraplate crustal deformation.
本研究利用庆州高密度宽频带地震台网记录的局部地震，通过4611个剪切波分裂（SWS）测量，研究了朝鲜半岛东南部上地壳的地震各向异性。空间平均显示出主导的东北-西南（NE-SW）快波方向，但在梁山和蔚山断裂带附近存在局部旋转。延迟时间断层成像显示，在2016年庆州地震序列（奈南断裂）附近和蔚山断裂以东……

sum: This study presents integrated 2D seismic and density models along the OBS2020-3 profile in the Southwest Subbasin (SWSB) of the South China Sea using seismic refraction, reflection, and gravity data. The results reveal intra-crustal reflectors at ~11.5 km depth beneath the northwestern margin, interpreted as the brittle-ductile transition. In the oceanic basin, thin magmatic crust overlying serpentinized mantle indicates reduced magmatic supply. A systematic southwestward decrease in crustal thickness suggests diminishing melt supply toward the southwestern termination. The ridge axis (Longmen Seamount) exhibits low-velocity anomalies and crustal thickening, attributed to enhanced porosity and serpentinization from extensive faulting during the final tectonic spreading stage.
本研究利用地震折射、多道反射和重力数据，构建了穿过南海西南次海盆的OBS2020-3剖面二维地震与密度模型。结果显示，西北大陆边缘约11.5 km深处存在内反射界面，代表韧脆性过渡带。洋盆内覆盖在蛇纹岩化地幔之上的薄洋壳表明岩浆供应不足。沿脊轴向西南方向地壳厚度系统性减薄，反映熔体供应逐渐减少。脊轴……

sum: This study investigates the causal factors of elevated seismicity in the Fort Worth basin since 2008 by testing the roles of wastewater disposal (SWD) and hydraulic fracturing (HF). Using an updated unified earthquake catalog (Mc = 2.0) and well injection datasets, the authors apply a generalized Seismogenic Index model combined with Theis radial pore-pressure diffusion and statistical reshuffling tests to hindcast gridded seismicity rates against a tectonic-only null hypothesis. They discover a previously undocumented seismic cluster near the Oklahoma border induced by HF. For high large-scale diffusivity (D = 2.0 m2/s), SWD is statistically linked to the far-field Irving-Dallas and Lake Lewisville sequences, whereas no significant SWD link is found for the Venus, Azle-Reno, or Cleburne sequences due to temporally inconsistent fault responses. The findings demonstrate that the basin experiences isolated fault reactivation rather than cascading seismicity, supporting targeted, well-by-well mitigation strategies.
本研究探讨了2008年以来沃斯堡盆地地震活动升高的成因，评估了废水回注（SWD）和水力压裂（HF）的作用。作者整合了最新区域地震目录（Mc=2.0）与注水数据，结合广义地震成因指数模型、Theis孔隙压力扩散方程及重排统计检验，回溯了网格化地震发生率并与纯构造加载零假设对比。研究首次发现俄克拉荷马州……

Unified earthquake catalog (Mc = 2.0) merging TexNet, NTXES, and ComCat from October 2008, paired with monthly SWD volumes (through December 2021) and daily HF stimulation records (through September 2022).
