模型假设网格内地震响应随时间一致，难以捕捉短暂孤立震群，且结果对难以客观约束的扩散率D高度敏感。

First probabilistic attribution of both HF and SWD across the Fort Worth basin, revealing an undocumented HF-induced cluster and statistical support for far-field SWD triggering in Irving-Dallas and Lake Lewisville.
首次对沃斯堡盆地HF和SWD开展概率归因，发现未报道的HF诱发地震簇，并证实了Irving-Dallas等远场SWD触发…

kc: Applies a physics-based probabilistic framework for the first time to systematically test both HF and SWD as causal triggers in the Fort Worth basin.
Identifies a previously undocumented HF-induced earthquake sequence near the Texas-Oklahoma border.
Demonstrates a statistical link between far-field SWD pore-pressure diffusion (at D = 2.0 m2/s) and the enigmatic Irving-Dallas and Lake Lewisville sequences.
Concludes that the Fort Worth basin is dominated by isolated sequences on a small subset of faults rather than widespread cascading reactivation.
首次应用基于物理的概率框架系统检验了沃斯堡盆地水力压裂（HF）和废水回注（SWD）的诱发地震成因。
识别出德克萨斯-俄克拉荷马边界附近一个此前未报道的由水力压裂诱发的地震序列。
证实了高扩散率（D = 2.0 m²/s）下远场SWD孔隙压力扩散与Irving-Dallas和Lake Lewisville地震序列的统计关联。
阐明沃斯堡盆地受控于少数断层上的孤立地震序列，而非全盆地尺度的广泛级联断层活化。
me: Catalog homogenization and nearest-neighbor declustering using an adaptable random forest model to isolate mainshocks above Mc 2.0.
Generalized Seismogenic Index model incorporating background tectonic rates, stressing-rate dependent time lags, and Theis transient radial diffusion of SWD volumes.
Statistical hypothesis testing via likelihood ratios and 200 synthetic injection-reshuffling simulations per grid block to compute p-values.
Hydraulic Fracturing Radar (HFR) spatio-temporal screening metric using 5 km and 3-day buffers adjusted for stimulation duration.
整合区域地震目录并利用自适应随机森林最近邻去丛集算法提取Mc 2.0以上的主震。
采用广义地震成因指数模型，结合背景构造地震率、应力率相关的时间滞后以及SWD体积的Theis瞬态径向扩散。
通过似然比及每个网格200次合成注水数据重排模拟进行统计假设检验，计算p值。
使用水力压裂雷达（HFR）时空筛选指标（5公里和3天缓冲窗口，并按压裂持续时间校正）进行交叉验证。
de: Unified earthquake catalog for the Central and Eastern United States (2000–2023) combining TexNet, NTXES, SMU, USArray, and ComCat, analyzed from October 2008 with Mc = 2.0.
Regional wastewater disposal monthly volume records from the B3 database through December 2021.
Hydraulic fracturing daily stimulation volumes and durations from FracFocus and IHS Markit databases through September 2022.
Sensitivity experiments testing large-scale hydraulic diffusivity values of D = 0.3, 1.0, and 2.0 m2/s and non-declustered catalogs.
整合TexNet、NTXES、SMU、USArray和ComCat建立2000–2023年美国中东部统一地震目录，主要分析2008年10月后Mc=2.0的数据。
来自B3数据库的截至2021年12月的区域废水回注（SWD）月度注入量数据。
来自FracFocus和IHS Markit数据库的截至2022年9月的水力压裂（HF）日注入量与持续时间数据。
针对大尺度水力扩散系数（D = 0.3、1.0和2.0 m²/s）及非去丛集目录的敏感性实验。
li: The probabilistic framework assumes a temporally consistent seismic response within each spatial grid block, which fails for short-lived, isolated swarms.
Strong sensitivity of SWD causal links to the assumed large-scale hydraulic diffusivity parameter D, which is difficult to constrain objectively.
Spatio-temporal variations in earthquake catalog completeness and epicentral uncertainties due to sparse monitoring prior to 2017.
概率框架假设每个空间网格内的地震响应随时间保持一致，这不适用于短暂、孤立的震群序列。
SWD因果关联结论对假设的大尺度水力扩散系数D高度敏感，而该参数在地质上难以客观约束。
2017年前区域台网稀疏导致地震目录完备性及震中定位不确定性存在显著的时空差异。

tm.why: The study investigates the causal links between wastewater disposal (SWD), hydraulic fracturing (HF), and seismicity in the Fort Worth basin.
The authors compile a unified regional earthquake catalog for the Central and Eastern United States and apply nearest-neighbor declustering.
The paper employs physics-based statistical earthquake recurrence models to hindcast seismicity rates and evaluate fault reactivation potential for hazard mitigation.

ev.notes: Full 10-page PDF provided and analyzed, including abstract, main sections §1–§5, data availability, and all four main figures.

sum: This study investigates co-seismic damage and shear fault formation in intact Westerly granite under passive confinement (14–18 MPa) at high strain rates (100–1,000 s⁻¹) using a split-Hopkinson pressure bar coupled with ultra-high-speed synchrotron X-ray phase-contrast imaging (440 ns resolution) and digital image correlation. Postmortem 3D X-ray microtomography complements the in situ 2D radiographs. The authors show that under confinement, dynamic compression produces localized shear faults and rock granulation (gouge) rather than homogeneous pulverization. Faulting initiates via P-wave-driven volumetric dilation (longitudinal tensile fractures), followed less than 5 µs later by S-wave-driven shear localization that links fractures into a staircase pattern during the stress drop. Remarkably, gouge forms dynamically with less than 300 µm of slip—smaller than the grain size. This demonstrates that dynamic rupture propagation itself granulates and weakens the fault rock before frictional slip weakening mechanisms take over.
本研究结合分离式霍普金森压杆与超高速同步辐射X射线相衬成像（440纳秒分辨率）及数字图像相关技术，研究了被动围压（14-18 MPa）和高应变率（100-1,000 s⁻¹）下Westerly花岗岩的同震损伤与剪切成核。结合震后三维显微CT，发现在围压下动态压缩会产生局部剪切破坏和断层泥，而非均匀粉……

t: Split-Hopkinson pressure bar dynamic compression of passively confined granite coupled with 440 ns synchrotron X-ray phase-contrast radiography, Bayesian 2D digital image correlation, and postmortem 3D microtomography.
结合被动围压SHPB动态压缩、440纳秒同步辐射X射线成像、二维贝叶斯DIC与震后三维显微CT。

Cylindrical Westerly granite specimens (10 mm height, 5 mm diameter, 0.7–1 mm grain size) enclosed in aluminum jackets providing 14–18 MPa lateral confinement, loaded at strain rates of 100–1,000 s⁻¹.
铝套围压（14–18 MPa）下的Westerly花岗岩圆柱体（高10毫米、直径5毫米），以100–1,000 s⁻¹应…

Volumetric dilation precedes shear localization by less than 5 µs during the stress drop; shear faulting dissipates 11.3–14.4 MJ/m³ (fracture energy 10⁴–10⁵ J/m²) and produces gouge within 300 µm of slip.
应力降阶段体积膨胀先于剪切局部化不到5微秒；耗散能11.3–14.4 MJ/m³，小于300微米滑动即产生断层泥。
High-speed X-ray imaging captures 2D projections rather than time-resolved 3D tomography, and requires fault planes to orient sub-parallel to the X-ray beam for clear strain localization imaging.
原位高速成像仅为二维投影而非实时三维CT，且需断层面近平行于X射线束。
First sub-microsecond in situ internal X-ray imaging of confined rock under dynamic loading, proving gouge forms dynamically from the rupture wave before significant frictional slip.
首次实现受围压岩石动态破裂的亚微秒级内部原位成像，证实断层泥在显著摩擦滑动前已动态生成。

kc: Achieved in situ sub-microsecond (440 ns) synchrotron X-ray imaging of dynamic shear faulting in confined granite at strain rates of 100–1,000 s⁻¹.
Demonstrated that volumetric dilatant damage precedes shear strain localization by less than 5 µs, consistent with P- and S-wave arrival delays.
Showed that fault gouge forms dynamically during the stress-drop phase with total fault slip (<300 µm) smaller than the rock grain size (0.7–1 mm).
实现了100–1,000 s⁻¹高应变率下受围压花岗岩动态剪切破裂的原位亚微秒级（440纳秒）同步辐射X射线成像。
证明体积扩容损伤先于剪切应变局部化不到5微秒发生，与样本内P波和S波的到时差一致。
表明断层泥在应力降阶段动态形成，所需断层总滑动量（<300微米）小于岩石矿物粒径（0.7–1毫米）。
me: Split-Hopkinson pressure bar (SHPB) dynamic compression under passive confinement (14–18 MPa) using a pre-heated aluminum jacket.
In situ ultra-high-speed synchrotron X-ray phase-contrast radiography at 440 ns temporal resolution using two interlaced Shimadzu HPVX2 cameras.
Modified 2D digital image correlation (DIC) using an Energy Maximization Bayesian correlator and postmortem 3D X-ray microtomography (2.2 µm voxel).
利用预热铝套提供被动围压（14–18 MPa），开展分离式霍普金森压杆（SHPB）动态压缩实验。
使用两台交错拍摄的超高速相机开展440纳秒时间分辨率的原位同步辐射X射线相衬放射成像。
采用基于能量最大化贝叶斯相关器的改进二维数字图像相关（DIC）分析，以及震后三维X射线显微断层扫描（2.2微米体素）。
de: Cylindrical Westerly granite specimens (10 mm length, 5 mm diameter, 0.7–1 mm grain size) impacted at 11–13 m/s on ESRF beamline ID19.
Postmortem 3D phase-contrast microtomography scans conducted on ESRF beamline BM18.
在ESRF ID19线站对圆柱形Westerly花岗岩样本（长10毫米，直径5毫米，粒径0.7–1毫米）进行11–13 m/s的高速撞击实验。
在ESRF BM18线站对实验后样品进行三维相衬显微CT扫描。
li: In situ high-speed imaging is limited to 2D radiographic projections, yielding volumetric average strain fields in the projection plane rather than time-resolved 3D slices.
Clear DIC tracking of fault development requires the fault plane to form favorably oriented (sub-parallel) to the X-ray beam.
原位高速成像仅限于二维X射线投影，DIC得到的是投影平面内的体积平均应变场而非时间分辨的三维切片。
利用DIC清晰追踪断层演化要求生成的断层面恰好与X射线束方向近乎平行。

tm.why: The study investigates the micro-mechanics of shear fault formation, localization, and gouge generation in confined granite under high dynamic strain rates.
It examines co-seismic rock damage, fracture energy, and dynamic fault weakening occurring in the process zone of a propagating earthquake rupture.

ev.notes: Full 11-page PDF of the GRL paper was provided and analyzed, including all 4 main figures, equations, experimental parameters, and section text.

sum: GeoFIRING-Net is an end-to-end deep-learning framework that transfers eight recent speech and computer-vision advances into a shared backbone for three-component (3C) seismic traces. It integrates filtered feature recycling (FIRING-Net), dual local/non-local attention (CASE-Net), multi-scale adversarial fine-tuning (Vsegan), progressive reinforcement learning (Vq-insight), deep watermarking (Omniguard), static-to-dynamic multi-channel transfer (LVE-S2D), visual in-context few-shot adaptation (VICL), and weak-to-strong supervision (WTS). The authors also introduce two new benchmarks: GeoTamper (20k windows with splicing, cropping, and resampling attacks) and GeoQA-5K (5,000 expert-rated traces). Evaluated on STEAD and INSTANCE at 0 dB input SNR, GeoFIRING-Net achieves 12.37 dB and 12.05 dB output SNR (outperforming FIRING-Net by 1.33 dB and 1.27 dB), 90.7% tamper localization accuracy, and 0.815 SRCC on quality assessment, with a 14 ms inference latency per 10-s window.
本文提出统一深度学习框架GeoFIRING-Net，将语音与视觉领域的八项前沿技术（滤波特征回收、局部/非局部注意力、对抗微调、渐进强化学习、深度水印、静态到动态迁移、上下文少样本适配及弱到强泛化）迁移至三分量地震波形处理中，联合完成波形去噪增强、篡改定位和质量评估。研究构建了GeoTamper和G……

t: A 6-stage shared filtered-recycling encoder with STFT spectral gating and local/non-local attention branches into three heads for enhancement, watermark-based tamper localization, and RL-based quality assessment, aided by in-context adaptation and weak-to-strong supervision.
六阶段滤波特征回收编码器结合局部/非局部注意力与三个任务头，融合上下文适配与弱到强监督实现联合训练。

Evaluated on STEAD (1.1M 3C windows), INSTANCE (50k earthquake, 130k noise windows), and two new benchmarks: GeoTamper (20k windows with splice, crop, resample attacks) and GeoQA-5K (5,000 expert-scored traces).
采用STEAD、INSTANCE数据集，并新建含三类篡改攻击的GeoTamper与专家打分的GeoQA-5K基准。
At 0 dB input SNR, achieves 12.37 dB SNR on STEAD (+1.33 dB over FIRING-Net) and 12.05 dB on INSTANCE (+1.27 dB), 90.7% accuracy (0.881 F1) on GeoTamper, and 0.815 SRCC on GeoQA-5K.
0 dB输入下STEAD和INSTANCE输出信噪比达12.37和12.05 dB，篡改定位准确率90.7%，质量评估S…

Stronger watermark embedding (mu = 0.5) degrades enhancement SNR by 0.31 dB, and cross-domain evaluation on non-seismic geoscientific records (volcanic tremor, geomagnetic, gravity) is left to future work.
过强水印会降低去噪信噪比0.31 dB，且尚未在火山颤动、地磁与重力数据上验证。

First unified end-to-end seismic framework jointly solving waveform enhancement, watermark-aided tamper localization, and RL-based quality assessment alongside two new benchmarks (GeoTamper and GeoQA-5K).
首个联合实现地震波形增强、篡改定位与质量评估的端到端框架，并推出两个新基准数据集。

kc: Proposes GeoFIRING-Net, an end-to-end multi-task backbone transferring eight speech/vision techniques to 3C seismic waveforms for joint enhancement, tamper localization, and quality assessment.
Introduces two standardized seismic benchmarks: GeoTamper (20k windows with splicing, cropping, and resampling attacks) and GeoQA-5K (5,000 traces rated 1–5 by senior seismologists).
Demonstrates state-of-the-art performance across STEAD, INSTANCE, GeoTamper, and GeoQA-5K (+1.33 dB SNR over best baseline, 90.7% tamper accuracy, 0.815 SRCC) with 14 ms inference latency.
提出GeoFIRING-Net端到端多任务框架，将八项语音与视觉前沿技术迁移至三分量地震波形，联合实现波形增强、篡改定位与质量评估。
构建并发布了两个标准化地震基准数据集：GeoTamper（含拼接、裁剪和重采样攻击的2万个时间窗）和GeoQA-5K（由资深地震学家按1-5分标注的5000条波形）。
在STEAD、INSTANCE、GeoTamper和GeoQA-5K上取得最优性能（信噪比提升高达1.33 dB，篡改定位准确率90.7%，质量评估SRCC达0.815），单10秒窗推理仅需14毫秒。
me: Six-stage filtered feature recycling encoder combining 1-D depthwise convolution, STFT learnable spectral filtering, gated feature recycling, and dual local/non-local attention.
Three task-specific heads trained with multi-scale waveform adversarial loss, Omniguard-style spread-spectrum watermark embedding/recovery, and progressive REINFORCE token decoding.
Cross-channel static-to-dynamic transfer, visual in-context cross-attention adapter (up to 8 station exemplars), and KL-divergence weak-to-strong supervision from heuristic pseudo-labels.
六阶段滤波特征回收编码器，结合一维深度卷积、STFT可学习频谱滤波、门控特征回收单元以及双分支局部/非局部注意力机制。
三个任务专用预测头，联合多尺度波形判别器对抗损失、扩频深度水印嵌入与恢复损失，以及渐进式REINFORCE强化学习质量评分解码。
跨通道静态到动态权重迁移、基于目标台站少样本示例的上下文交叉注意力适配器，以及利用启发式伪标签的弱到强KL散度监督。
de: STEAD (1.1M 3C waveform windows at 100 Hz) and INSTANCE (50k earthquake and 130k noise windows) evaluated at -5, 0, 5, and 10 dB input SNR.
GeoTamper benchmark (~20k STEAD-derived windows injected with splicing, cropping, and irregular resampling attacks; split 14k/3k/3k).
GeoQA-5K benchmark (5,000 traces scored 1–5 by three senior seismologists, kappa = 0.78) plus a paired preference study with 12 volunteer seismologists.
在STEAD（110万个100 Hz三分量波形窗）和INSTANCE（5万个地震窗与13万个噪声窗）上进行-5、0、5和10 dB输入信噪比下的增强与跨数据集泛化实验。
GeoTamper基准测试（基于STEAD生成的约2万个含拼接、置零裁剪和不规则重采样攻击的波形窗，按14k/3k/3k划分）。
GeoQA-5K基准测试（由3名资深地震学家进行1-5分标注的5000条波形，一致性kappa=0.78）以及由12名地震学志愿者参与的成对偏好评估。
li: High watermark strength (e.g., mu = 0.5) becomes perceptible in enhanced waveforms and degrades output SNR by 0.31 dB, requiring careful hyperparameter balancing.
Evaluated solely on 10-s earthquake waveform windows; applicability to volcanic tremor, geomagnetic, and gravity continuous records remains unverified future work.
较高的水印嵌入强度（如mu=0.5）会在增强波形中产生可察觉失真并导致输出信噪比下降0.31 dB，需仔细权衡超参数。
目前仅在10秒地震波形窗口上进行了验证，对火山颤动、地磁和重力连续时间序列的适用性仍有待未来工作检验。

tm.why: The paper proposes GeoFIRING-Net, a unified deep-learning framework for three-component seismic waveform enhancement, tamper localization, and quality assessment.

The framework processes raw three-component earthquake waveforms from STEAD and INSTANCE to suppress noise, verify integrity, and assess quality as a prerequisite for reliable event detection and location.

ev.notes: Full 16-page preprint PDF (including 6 figures and 5 tables) was read and analyzed.

sum: The water storage capacity of the lower mantle remains poorly constrained due to experimental difficulties in analyzing unquenchable davemaoite (CaSiO3-perovskite). Using a Kawai-type multi-anvil press with synchrotron X-ray diffraction up to 30 GPa and 2100 K, the authors performed simultaneous in-situ lattice-volume comparisons of dry and hydrous davemaoite, constructed a new dry thermal equation of state (up to 43 GPa), and conducted SIMS analyses on recovered amorphous samples. Contrary to previous diamond-anvil cell studies reporting 2–3% volume reductions and 0.5–1 wt% H2O, hydration caused negligible volume reduction (~0.02% on average), constraining water incorporation to <0.08 wt% (~0.03 wt% by SIMS). Furthermore, no tetragonal distortion was observed at mantle temperatures. This novelty reveals that peridotitic mantle davemaoite is nearly dry, implying that deep lower-mantle water storage and mid-lower mantle seismic scatterers are primarily controlled by hydrous aluminous silica phases in subducted basaltic crust.
针对下地幔毛钙硅石（CaSiO3钙钛矿）储水能力不明的问题，本研究利用川井型多面砧压机结合同步辐射X射线衍射，在高达30 GPa和2100 K条件下开展了干、湿样品的原位晶胞体积同步对比，建立了干毛钙硅石热状态方程，并对回收样品进行了二次离子质谱（SIMS）分析。结果表明，水化仅引起微弱体积减小（平……

t: Used a Kawai-type multi-anvil press with synchrotron X-ray diffraction to simultaneously compare dry and hydrous davemaoite lattice volumes, constructed a dry thermal equation of state, and measured recovered water content via SIMS.
利用川井型多面砧压机与同步辐射XRD同步对比干湿毛钙硅石体积，建立干态热状态方程，并用SIMS测水。
In-situ synchrotron XRD measurements on dry and hydrous CaSiO3 (3 and 13 wt% H2O) up to 30 GPa and 2100 K, 124 dry P-V-T points up to 42.9 GPa, and SIMS analysis on sample M4014.
高达30 GPa和2100 K的干湿样品原位XRD数据、124个干态P-V-T数据点及回收样品SIMS数据。

Simultaneous dry-wet measurements showed an average volume decrease of 0.02(2)% at 20–28 GPa and 1200–2100 K, indicating 0.04–0.08 wt% H2O, while SIMS on recovered amorphous davemaoite yielded 0.0292±0.0012 wt% H2O and XRD showed cubic symmetry.
20-28 GPa和1200-2100 K下平均体积仅减小0.02%，对应含水量<0.08 wt%，SIMS测得0.02…

Residual deviatoric stress varies across different multi-anvil cell assemblies, causing systematic errors that make detecting small volume differences using an external equation of state difficult without simultaneous multi-chamber measurements.
不同组装的残余偏应力差异会引入系统误差，难以仅靠外部状态方程精确检测微小体积差。

First simultaneous multi-anvil in-situ volume comparison of dry and hydrous davemaoite, overturning previous claims of weight-percent water solubility and tetragonal distortion at lower-mantle temperatures.
首次实现干湿毛钙硅石同腔原位体积对比，推翻了前人认为其含水量达wt%级且呈四方相的结论。

kc: Demonstrated via simultaneous multi-sample chamber synchrotron XRD up to 28 GPa and 2100 K that volume differences between dry and hydrous davemaoite are negligible (~0.02%), constraining water content to <0.08 wt%.
Confirmed trace water incorporation (~0.03 wt% H2O) in recovered amorphized davemaoite synthesized at 25 GPa and 1573 K using secondary ion mass spectrometry (SIMS).
Constructed a new thermal equation of state (3BM-MDG-EOS) for dry cubic davemaoite using 124 P-V-T data points up to 42.9 GPa and 1473 K.

Showed that davemaoite remains cubic without tetragonal peak splitting under hydrous lower-mantle conditions, ruling out its tetragonal-cubic transition as the main cause of mid-lower mantle seismic scatterers.
通过高达28 GPa和2100 K的多样品腔同步辐射XRD原位直接对比，证明干、湿毛钙硅石体积差异极小（约0.02%），限定其含水量低于0.08 wt%。
利用二次离子质谱（SIMS）对25 GPa、1573 K下合成并卸压非晶化的毛钙硅石进行测试，证实其仅含微量水（约0.03 wt% H2O）。
基于高达42.9 GPa和1473 K的124个P-V-T数据点，建立了干立方相毛钙硅石的新热状态方程（3BM-MDG-EOS）。
证明含水条件下毛钙硅石在地幔温度下保持立方相而无四方相劈裂，排除了其四方-立方相变作为中下地幔地震散射体主要成因的可能性。
me: Simultaneous in-situ energy-dispersive synchrotron X-ray diffraction (XRD) volume comparison of dry and hydrous davemaoite using a multi-sample chamber in a Kawai-type multi-anvil press (KMA).
Construction of a third-order Birch-Murnaghan and Mie-Grüneisen-Debye thermal equation of state (3BM-MDG-EOS) for dry davemaoite with bootstrap uncertainty estimation.
Secondary ion mass spectrometry (SIMS) with hydrogen ion imaging on recovered amorphous davemaoite and FE-SEM/EDS textural characterization.

sum: This study investigates the seismogenesis of the 2021 Mw 7.1 and 2022 Mw 7.3 Fukushima-Oki intraslab earthquakes in northeastern Japan by integrating Vp/Vs consistency-constrained double-difference seismic tomography with 2-D thermo-mechanical numerical modeling (I2VIS). Using 9,512 local events recorded by 122 onshore and 45 offshore Hi-net stations, the tomography reveals a distinct high-Vp, high-Vs, and low-Vp/Vs (1.65–1.75) anomaly in the oceanic mantle beneath the relocated hypocenters (64.5 km and 62.2 km depth), indicating a dehydrated mantle and fluid release at the transition zone. Concurrently, numerical simulations tailored to northeastern Japan show that slab segmentation causes significant deviatoric stress accumulation within subducted outer-rise bending fault networks at 60–80 km depths. The novelty lies in demonstrating that fluid-driven weakening from slab dehydration and tectonic stress buildup from slab segmentation act synergistically to reactivate pre-existing outer-rise faults.

Mainshocks relocated to 64.5 and 62.2 km depths within velocity transition zones above a dehydrated mantle anomaly (Vp/Vs 1.65–1.75), matching modeled slab-segmentation stress buildup at 60–80 km depth.

Demonstrated via 2-D thermo-mechanical modeling that slab segmentation drives deviatoric stress buildup at 60–80 km depth within internal outer-rise bending faults.

提出了流体孔隙压力升高与板片分段构造应力放大协同作用的板内大地震孕震新模式。

Checkerboard resolution tests (CRT), restoring resolution tests (RRT), and bootstrap resampling (100 trials) for relocation uncertainty quantification.
2-D thermo-mechanical finite-difference modeling with marker-in-cell technique (I2VIS code) incorporating visco-plastic rheologies and phase transitions.

2-D numerical subduction experiments tailored to NE Japan with a 32-km felsic continental overriding crust and a 100-Myr subducting oceanic plate.
Pressure-Temperature (P-T) phase diagram analysis comparing modeled thermal structures with hydrous mineral dehydration boundaries (chrysotile, antigorite, brucite).

sum: This study investigates rare reverse-polarity earthquakes (anti-repeaters) at intermediate depths (>100 km) in the North Chilean subduction zone using a 2006–2024 catalog of 3153 repeating earthquake sequences recorded by the IPOC network. By searching for waveform cross-correlation coefficients cc <= -0.95 across P and S wave windows, the authors identify four reverse-polarity families: three doublets and one exceptional 38-event sequence (cID120) at 133 km depth containing five reverse events. Relative relocation using cross-correlation-refined S-P differential times collapses the 38-event sequence into a ~600 m volume with partial source overlap (radii 40–230 m) and reveals a 100–200 m upward migration after 2015. Agglomerative clustering shows reverse events do not form a separate subcluster, and three occur shortly (~26 days) after prograde events before ceasing entirely after 2017. These high-resolution spatiotemporal patterns rule out delayed eclogitization and instead point to transient fluid pulses and dehydration embrittlement within inherited fault heterogeneity.

sum: Traditional Vening Meinesz-Moritz (VMM) methods require transforming satellite gravity gradients into gravity disturbances before inverting for Moho depth, smoothing out high-frequency signals. This paper proposes an alternative method that constructs a direct functional relationship between GOCE vertical gravity gradients and Moho topography using gridded tesseroids and iterative least-squares adjustment. Applied to GOCE level-2 data (2009–2012) over the Tibetan Plateau, the method reduces fitting residual standard deviation from 0.3229 E to 0.0641 E and improves agreement with seismic receiver function checkpoints compared to VMM and CRUST1.0. The higher-resolution Moho model reveals: (1) prevailing Moho fold wavelengths of ~578 km E–W and 515–708 km N–S; (2) two possible lower crustal flow channels in southeastern Tibet; and (3) an ~5 km Moho subsidence in the central Tarim Basin.
传统VMM方法需先将重力梯度转换为重力扰动再反演莫霍面，导致高频信号丢失。本文提出利用网格化球体单元（tesseroids）直接建立GOCE垂直重力梯度与莫霍面深度的函数关系，并通过最小二乘迭代求解。将该法应用于青藏高原2009-2012年GOCE卫星数据，反演残差标准差从0.3229 E降至0.0……

Vertical GOCE gravity gradients (EGG_TRF_2) from November 2009 to August 2012 are continued to 262.4 km altitude, gridded at 10' x 10', and stripped of topographic, sediment, and crystalline crust effects using Earth2014 and CRUST1.0.

sum: Standard Epidemic-Type Aftershock Sequence (ETAS) models assume isotropic, circular spatial distributions for aftershocks, neglecting fault geometry and suppressing estimated productivity parameters for elongated sequences. This study introduces a fully automated, data-driven anisotropic ETAS model for Europe by integrating dynamic ellipse estimation directly into the Expectation–Maximization (EM) inversion procedure. Using Principal Component Analysis (PCA) weighted by pairwise triggering probabilities, an individual spatial ellipse is estimated for each triggering event without requiring external fault maps. Trained on the ESHM20 catalog (1980–2014) and evaluated pseudo-prospectively on the EMSC and EMEC catalogs (2015–2022), the elliptical model yields higher, less-biased productivity parameters and achieves a statistically significant information gain per event (IGPE of 0.042 in out-of-sample testing) over the isotropic baseline. To enable near-real-time operational forecasting when early aftershocks are sparse, the authors introduce a step-wise constraint on ellipse aspect ratios and a dynamic sequence-specific productivity updating strategy.
标准ETAS模型假设余震呈各向同性圆形分布，忽略了断层几何形态并低估了狭长序列的生产率参数。本研究将基于触发概率加权的主成分分析（PCA）动态椭圆估计集成到期望最大化（EM）反演中，提出了一种全自动数据驱动的各向异性ETAS模型。利用欧洲ESHM20目录（1980–2014）训练，并在EMSC和EM……

在EM反演中通过触发概率加权的余震坐标主成分分析动态估计面积归一化椭圆核，替代各向同性距离。
Uses the harmonized ESHM20 European catalog (1980–2014, Mc down to 3.5) for model training, and post-2014 EMSC and EMEC catalogs (2015–2022) for pseudo-prospective validation and testing.

sum: This paper presents SS-UNETR, a semi-supervised pre-trained foundation model based on a 3D Swin Transformer backbone for 3D geological feature analysis in seismic volumes. To overcome the high demand for labeled data and limited generalization of traditional deep learning, the authors propose a dual-stage training workflow. In the first stage, the encoder is pre-trained on 75,651 unlabeled field seismic images using three self-supervised proxy tasks: image inpainting, rotation prediction, and contrastive learning. In the second stage, the model is fine-tuned on 2,860 synthetic seismic images annotated with geological features like faults, channels, and caves. Experimental results show that SS-UNETR outperforms conventional deep learning and general seismic foundation models, especially in few-shot scenarios, demonstrating strong generalization and multi-task segmentation capabilities for complex geological structures.
本文提出基于3D Swin Transformer的半监督预训练大模型SS-UNETR。通过7.5万张无标签实际地震图像进行自监督预训练，并用2860张合成图像微调，实现了断层、河道和溶洞等多特征的同时分割。实验表明，该模型在少样本任务中显著优于传统模型，有效降低了人工标注成本并提升了泛化性。

sum: This dataset presents relocated and augmented earthquake catalogs for the 1999 İzmit–Düzce earthquake sequence along the Karadere–Düzce branch of the North Anatolian Fault, Türkiye. Using waveform cross-correlation and double-difference relocation, the authors refined hypocentral locations and origin times. Local magnitudes (ML) were recalculated using simulated Wood–Anderson displacement seismograms. The dataset features two catalogs: a primary relocated catalog containing 13,435 earthquakes and an augmented catalog containing 16,440 events detected using the temporary YJ network. This dataset is highly valuable for studying fault zone processes, post-seismic deformation, and earthquake triggering mechanisms.

sum: This study investigates the spatiotemporal variation of magmatism across the ultraslow-spreading Gakkel Ridge in the Arctic Ocean over the past 35 Ma. By applying forward magnetic modeling to 60 aeromagnetic profiles from Project Magnet (3°W to 50°E), the authors classify the sediment-blanketed oceanic basement into magmatic (basalt, gabbro, serpentinite) and amagmatic (serpentinite with sparse gabbro intrusions) domains. Results reveal that amagmatic lithosphere unexpectedly dominates 68% of the Eurasian Basin, with magmatic seafloor accounting for only 32%. Comparing conjugate ridge flanks reveals cyclical melt supply: a short (~2 Myr) burst of robust symmetric magmatism, followed by ~4 Myr of intermediate asymmetric magmatism, and ~5 Myr of starved amagmatic spreading. The authors propose that a thick, strong lithosphere acts as a barrier causing melt to pond until bursting, modulated by a heterogeneous marble-cake mantle.
本研究利用60条航磁剖面的正演建模，揭示了北冰洋超慢速扩张加克尔海脊过去35 Ma的岩浆活动时空演化。通过克服厚层沉积物掩盖，研究区分了岩浆型与非岩浆型海底。结果显示非岩浆岩石圈意外占据了欧亚盆地约68%的面积，岩浆型海底仅占32%。共轭翼部对比揭示了周期性熔体供应序列：约2 Myr的强烈对称岩浆爆……

sum: The UPFLOW project deployed 50 ocean bottom seismometers (OBSs) across a 1,000 × 2,000 km2 area in the Azores-Madeira-Canary Islands region from June 2021 to August 2022, recovering 49 stations with 91.2% overall data completeness. Utilizing three frame designs (LOBSTER, NAMMU, and prototype DUNE) mostly equipped with Trillium Compact broadband sensors and hydrophones, the array targets upward mantle flow. Data processing included non-linear ambient-noise clock drift corrections, horizontal orientation estimation via teleseismic P-wave and Rayleigh-wave polarisations, and cascade tilt and compliance noise removal. Results demonstrate lower long-period vertical noise compared to prior OBS experiments, while securing head buoys with custom tarps significantly suppressed 3–8 Hz strumming noise. Notably, the array achieved the first clear OBS observations of low-frequency normal modes (down to ~1.8 mHz after tilt/compliance corrections) using 120 s Trillium Compact sensors, alongside rich recordings of earthquakes and baleen whale calls.
UPFLOW项目于2021至2022年在亚速尔-马德拉-加那利群岛海域布设了50台海底地震仪（OBS），成功回收49台，整体数据完整率达91.2%。研究采用了三种框架（含新型DUNE原型机）及Trillium Compact宽频带传感器与水听器，评估了仪器状态（SOH），结合远震P波和瑞利波极化确定……

t: Horizontal orientations were determined via teleseismic P-wave covariance eigenvalue analysis and Rayleigh-wave Hilbert-transform correlation. Low-frequency (<0.1 Hz) vertical noise was reduced by sequentially removing tilt and hydrophone-derived compliance transfer functions in 15-minute windows.
结合远震P波特征值与瑞利波互相关确定水平方位角，利用四分量传递函数级联去除低频倾斜与顺应性噪声。

The UPFLOW array deployed 50 free-fall broadband OBSs (recovering 49) across a 1,000 × 2,000 km2 region around the Azores-Madeira-Canary Islands at 1,440–5,457 m water depths from June 2021 to August 2022.
2021年6月至2022年8月在亚速尔-马德拉-加那利海域布设50台宽频带OBS，回收49台。

Overall data completeness reached 91.21% (95.5% excluding faulty/lost stations). Wrapping LOBSTER head buoys reduced 3–8 Hz strumming noise, and tilt/compliance corrections enabled clear vertical normal-mode observations down to ~1.8 mHz following Mw > 8 earthquakes.
整体数据完整率91.21%；捆绑浮球降低了3-8 Hz噪声；校正后清晰观测到低至1.8 mHz的地球自由振荡。
One station was lost, five had unusable seismic data, horizontal components remained noisy above 20 s period, and substantial non-linear clock drift averaged 8.64 s in absolute skew.
1台丢失、5台数据不可用，长周期水平分量噪声较高，且存在平均8.64秒的非线性钟差。

Presents the largest Atlantic OBS array to date, demonstrating the first clear OBS low-frequency normal modes recorded on 120 s Trillium Compact sensors and effective tarp-based buoy strumming suppression.
迄今最大规模大西洋OBS阵列，首次用Trillium Compact清晰观测低频自由振荡并验证浮球捆绑降噪。

kc: Successfully deployed 50 and recovered 49 OBS stations in the Atlantic Ocean with 91.2% overall data completeness (95.5% excluding lost/faulty stations).
Demonstrated that securing floating head buoys with custom tarpaulins on LOBSTER frames substantially reduces current-induced strumming noise between 3 and 8 Hz.
Reported the first clear OBS observations of low-frequency Earth free oscillations (down to ~1.8 mHz) using 120 s corner-period Trillium Compact sensors, enhanced by tilt and compliance corrections.
Established a comprehensive quality control and FAIR archiving workflow (including State-of-Health diagnostics, P/Rayleigh orientation, and non-linear clock drift corrections) hosted on EIDA.
在大西洋成功布设50台并回收49台海底地震仪（OBS），整体数据完整率达91.2%（剔除故障和丢失台站后达95.5%）。
证实利用定制篷布固定LOBSTER框架的漂浮头浮球可显著降低3至8 Hz频段由洋流引起的颤振噪声。
首次报道了利用120秒角周期的Trillium Compact传感器在海底清晰观测到低至约1.8 mHz的地球自由振荡，且经倾斜和顺应性校正后信噪比显著提升。
建立了一套包含仪器健康状态（SOH）诊断、P波与瑞利波水平定向及非线性钟差校正的完整质量控制与FAIR数据归档流程，数据托管于EIDA。
me: State-of-Health (SOH) auxiliary data analysis (battery voltage, temperature, mass position, static sensor acceleration) to diagnose hardware and seabed stability issues.

Horizontal component orientation estimation combining eigenvalue analysis of teleseismic P-wave (8–30 s) covariance matrices and grid-search correlation of Rayleigh wave (8–20 s) elliptical particle motion.
Sequential cascade removal of seafloor tilt and compliance noise (<0.1 Hz) using 15-minute windows of four-component (3C seismometer + hydrophone) spectral transfer functions in ISP.
Probabilistic Power Spectral Density (PPSD) and full-deployment spectrogram analysis to benchmark noise against NHNM/NLNM and CTBTO acoustic models.
利用仪器健康状态（SOH）辅助数据（电池电压、温度、质量块位置、静态传感器加速度）诊断硬件故障与海床稳定性问题。
结合远震P波（8-30秒）协方差矩阵特征值分析与瑞利波（8-20秒）椭圆质点运动网格搜索互相关，估算水平分量方位角。
在ISP软件中利用四分量数据（三分量地震计加一分量水听器）以15分钟时间窗计算传递函数，级联去除低频（<0.1 Hz）海床倾斜与顺应性噪声。
通过概率功率谱密度（PPSD）和全周期时频谱分析，将台站噪声水平与陆地NHNM/NLNM模型及CTBTO水声模型进行对比评估。
de: 50 free-fall OBSs (LOBSTER, NAMMU, and prototype DUNE frames) deployed at 1,440–5,457 m depths across a 1,000 × 2,000 km2 area (~110–160 km spacing) from June 2021 to August 2022.
Waveform recordings of 149 cataloged local, regional, and teleseismic earthquakes, including the Mw 8.3 South Sandwich Islands and Mw 8.2 Alaska earthquakes for normal mode spectra.
Continuous hydrophone and 3-component broadband seismic recordings capturing winter microseisms, fin and blue whale vocalisations (16–28 Hz), and current-induced frame resonances.
2021年6月至2022年8月在1,000 × 2,000平方公里海域（水深1,440-5,457米，台间距约110-160公里）布设的50台自由落体式OBS（含LOBSTER、NAMMU和DUNE原型机）。
149个目录中的地方震、区域震和远震波形记录，包括用于提取地球自由振荡谱的Mw 8.3南桑威奇群岛地震和Mw 8.2阿拉斯加地震。
连续的水听器和三分量宽频带地震记录，捕获了冬季微震、长须鲸与蓝鲸叫声（16-28 Hz）以及洋流引起的仪器部件共振信号。
li: One prototype DUNE station (UP14) was lost during recovery, and five recovered stations (UP07, UP10, UP19, UP23, UP24) yielded unusable seismometer data due to firmware bugs, pin corrosion, seabed tilting, or levelling failures.

Substantial non-linear clock drift occurred on 6D6 dataloggers (average absolute skew 8.64 s, with >24 h drift on two firmware-bugged IDL stations), requiring complex ambient-noise cross-correlation corrections.

Horizontal components remain substantially noisier than the NHNM at long periods (T > 20 s), preventing clear normal mode observations on horizontal channels and limiting some P-wave orientation estimates.
1台DUNE原型机（UP14）未能回收，另有5台回收台站（UP07、UP10、UP19、UP23、UP24）因固件漏洞、插针腐蚀、海床倾斜或调平故障导致地震计数据不可用。
6D6数采器存在显著的非线性钟差（平均绝对钟差8.64秒，两台受固件故障影响的IDL台站漂移超过24小时），依赖复杂的背景噪声互相关校正。
水平分量在长周期（T > 20秒）频段噪声仍显著高于NHNM高噪声模型，无法在水平分量上清晰观测自由振荡，并限制了部分台站的P波极化定向。

tm.why: The paper presents the deployment, instrument performance, noise characterization, horizontal orientation, and tilt/compliance corrections of a 50-station Ocean Bottom Seismometer (OBS) array.
The overarching goal of the UPFLOW OBS experiment is to investigate upward mantle flow, plumes, and deep Earth structures beneath the Azores-Madeira-Canary Islands region.

The paper highlights non-earthquake environmental and biological signals in OBS data, including seasonal microseisms, fin and blue whale vocalisations, and ocean current-induced instrument resonances.

ev.notes: Full 21-page PDF report from Seismica (including abstract, 8 sections, 12 figures, and 2 tables) was read and analyzed.

sum: Ridge-transform intersections (RTIs) exhibit substantial bathymetric variability (~1 km) even at comparable spreading rates and age offsets, challenging classical thermal and spreading-rate models. This study combines shipborne multibeam bathymetry from 101 global RTIs across 65 oceanic transform faults with 3-D thermo-tectono-magmatic numerical simulations (using LaMEM). By varying spreading rates, age offsets, and crustal thicknesses, the authors demonstrate that the fraction of plate separation accommodated by dike injection (M) directly controls RTI depth. At small age offsets (<5 Myr), a thin brittle lithosphere (2-4 km) allows M to vary widely (0.3-1.1) in response to magma supply, generating up to 3 km of depth scatter and explaining asymmetric RTI depths on the same transform. Conversely, thicker lithosphere (8-10 km) at larger age offsets restricts M (0.2-0.6), yielding deeper, more uniform RTIs. Thus, RTI morphology records the local balance between magmatic accretion and tectonic extension.
本研究结合全球65条转换断层上101个洋中脊-转换断层交汇区（RTI）的船载多波束水深数据与三维热-构造-岩浆数值模拟（LaMEM），探究了RTI水深显著变化（相同扩张速率和年龄偏置下可达约1 km）的成因。结果表明，岩脉侵入所调节的板块分离比例（M值）比扩张速率和年龄偏置更直接地控制RTI水深。在……

t: The authors use the 3-D visco-elasto-plastic finite-difference particle-in-cell code LaMEM to simulate plate separation, lithospheric deformation, and self-generated tectono-volcanic dike injection (M) in a ridge-transform-ridge system.
采用三维粘-弹-塑性有限差分程序LaMEM，模拟洋脊-转换断层系统中板块分离、岩石圈变形及自发岩脉侵入（M）。

Shipborne multibeam bathymetric data from 101 RTIs across 65 ridge-transform-ridge systems (full spreading rates of 1.4–17.1 cm/yr) compiled from JAMSTEC and the Global Multi-Resolution Topography (GMRT) synthesis.
汇编了JAMSTEC和GMRT数据库中65个洋脊-转换断层系统上101个RTI的船载多波束水深数据。

Observed RTI bathymetry exhibits up to ~2.5 km scatter at age offsets <5 Myr or spreading rates <8 cm/yr; numerical models show RTI depth scales directly with magmatic fraction M (varying from 0.2 to 1.05).
年龄偏置<5 Myr时RTI水深离散度达2.5 km；模拟表明RTI水深直接受岩浆侵入比例M（0.2–1.05）控制。

The model cannot simulate lateral melt migration or along-axis dike propagation, simplifies M using off-axis 1-D stress rather than 3-D transform stress, and restricts hydrothermal cooling to <6 km depth.
无法模拟顺轴熔体运移和岩脉扩展，忽略了三维复杂应力对M的影响，且将热液冷却限制在6 km以浅。

Extends coupled tectono-magmatic partitioning (effective M) to 3-D ridge-transform intersections, reconciling both age-offset deepening and spreading-rate-independent bathymetric scatter and asymmetry.
将耦合构造-岩浆分配机制（有效M值）引入三维RTI模型，统一解释了水深随年龄加深及同断层水深不对称性。

kc: Quantified bathymetric variability across 101 global ridge-transform intersections (RTIs) spanning ultraslow to fast spreading rates (1.4–17.1 cm/yr).
Performed 3-D thermo-tectono-magmatic simulations with self-generated effective dike injection fraction (M) emerging from tectono-volcanic cycles.
Demonstrated that M exerts a more direct control on RTI depth than spreading rate or transform age offset alone.
Explained the high scatter and asymmetry of RTI depths at small age offsets (<5 Myr) via thin brittle lithosphere sensitivity to adjacent ridge magma supply.
量化了全球101个跨越超慢速至快速扩张脊（1.4–17.1 cm/yr）的洋中脊-转换断层交汇区（RTI）的水深变化。
开展了三维热-构造-岩浆数值模拟，其中有效岩脉侵入比例（M）由构造-火山周期自发产生。
证明了M值比单纯的扩张速率或转换断层年龄偏置对RTI水深具有更直接的控制作用。
通过薄脆性岩石圈对相邻洋脊岩浆供应的敏感性，解释了小年龄偏置（<5 Myr）下RTI水深的高离散度与不对称性。
me: 3-D visco-elasto-plastic thermo-mechanical numerical modeling using the finite-difference particle-in-cell code LaMEM.
Analytical formulation of effective magmatic accretion fraction (M) coupled with axial brittle lithospheric thickness, magma flux, and tectonic stress thresholds.
Topographic and slope gradient analysis of global shipborne multibeam bathymetry to consistently extract mean depths of RTIs and segment centers.
使用有限差分网格粒子法程序LaMEM进行三维粘-弹-塑性热力学数值模拟。
将有效岩浆增生比例（M）的解析公式与轴部脆性岩石圈厚度、岩浆通量及构造应力阈值相耦合。
对全球船载多波束水深数据进行地形和坡度梯度分析，以一致地提取RTI和洋脊段中心的平均水深。
de: Shipborne multibeam bathymetric data from 101 RTIs at 65 oceanic transform faults from JAMSTEC and GMRT databases.
Systematic 3-D geodynamic simulation suite varying full spreading rates (1.5–15 cm/yr), transform lengths (30–200 km), and RTI crustal thicknesses (2–6 km).
来自JAMSTEC和GMRT数据库的65条大洋转换断层上101个RTI的船载多波束水深数据。
系统的三维地球动力学模拟实验，改变了全扩张速率（1.5–15 cm/yr）、转换断层长度（30–200 km）和RTI地壳厚度（2–6 km）。
li: The model implements dike injection by widening a vertical column and cannot simulate lateral melt migration or along-axis dike propagation.
The formulation of M relies on 1-D off-axis stress states, neglecting 3-D heterogeneous transform shear and oblique extension stresses at RTIs.
Hydrothermal cooling is simplified via an enhanced thermal conductivity factor (Nu=8) restricted to depths <6 km and temperatures <600°C.
模型通过加宽垂直柱体来实现岩脉侵入，无法模拟侧向熔体运移或顺轴岩脉扩展。
M值的计算公式基于一维离轴应力状态，忽略了RTI处三维非均匀转换剪切和斜向伸展应力。
热液冷却通过限制在深度<6 km和温度<600°C内的增强热导率因子（Nu=8）进行了简化。

tm.why: The paper investigates the origin of bathymetric variability at mid-ocean ridge-transform intersections using 3D thermo-tectono-magmatic geodynamic simulations and global shipborne bathymetric data.

ev.notes: Full 11-page PDF analyzed, including abstract, main text (§1–§5), equations (1–8), and all 10 figures.

sum: Fourier Neural Operators (FNO) are effective surrogates for wave propagation due to their global receptive fields, but frequency truncation causes spectral bias, smoothing out high-frequency interference fringes in underwater acoustic transmission loss (TL) fields. This paper proposes a Spectral-Spatial Residual Learning (S2RL) framework to reconcile global consistency with local detail. Derived from an operator-theoretic subspace decomposition, S2RL operates in two sequential stages: Stage I uses an FNO (Vanilla or physics-encoded Hankel-FNO) as a Global Propagator to capture low-frequency wave trends, while Stage II employs a spatial U-Net as a Local Refiner to reconstruct high-frequency residuals within the water column using a bathymetry mask. Tested on 200 Hz RAM-simulated TL fields using South China Sea environmental data (FVCOM and ETOPO1), S2RL reduces RMSE from 2.93 to 1.56 dB for Vanilla FNO and 1.95 to 1.54 dB for Hankel-FNO, while retaining ~8–10 ms inference speeds.
针对傅里叶神经算子（FNO）在预测水声传播损失（TL）时因频率截断产生频谱偏差、平滑高频干涉条纹的问题，本文提出谱-空残差学习（S2RL）框架。该方法将预测分解为由粗到精的两阶段：第一阶段利用FNO（标准FNO或融合先验的Hankel-FNO）作为全局传播器捕获低频趋势；第二阶段使用空间域U-Net……

t: A cascaded two-stage Spectral-Spatial Residual Learning (S2RL) framework where Stage I uses an FNO Global Propagator for coarse low-frequency prediction and Stage II uses a spatial U-Net Local Refiner to recover high-frequency interference residuals.
提出两阶段S2RL框架：第一阶段用频谱FNO预测全局低频趋势，第二阶段用空间U-Net恢复高频干涉残差。

3,456 underwater transmission loss samples (2,765 training, 691 testing) simulated at 200 Hz via the RAM solver over 10 km range and 1.5 km depth using South China Sea FVCOM sound speeds and ETOPO1 bathymetry.
基于南海FVCOM温盐和ETOPO1地形，用RAM在200 Hz模拟3456个10km×1.5km传播损失样本。
S2RL reduces RMSE from 2.93 dB to 1.56 dB for Vanilla FNO and from 1.95 dB to 1.54 dB for Hankel-FNO, while running in 8.37–10.42 ms compared to 333.32 ms for the RAM solver.
将标准FNO和Hankel-FNO的RMSE分别降至1.56 dB和1.54 dB，推理仅需8.37–10.42 ms。
The cascaded S2RL stage adds a ~5 ms inference latency overhead over single-stage FNO, and experiments are evaluated at a single fixed frequency of 200 Hz.
级联阶段增加了约5 ms推理开销，且实验仅在200 Hz单一固定频率模拟数据上验证。

Motivated by an operator-theoretic low-pass interpretation of FNO, S2RL explicitly decouples low-frequency global wave propagation from high-frequency spatial interference residuals using a cascaded FNO-UNet architecture.
从算子低通滤波视角出发，显式解耦低频全局波传播与高频空间干涉残差，结合FNO与U-Net优势。

kc: Formulated an operator-theoretic decomposition of underwater acoustic fields into low-frequency global propagation and high-frequency spatial interference residuals.
Designed the cascaded S2RL architecture combining a spectral FNO Global Propagator with a spatial U-Net Local Refiner trained sequentially with a seabed binary mask.
Demonstrated substantial RMSE reductions (down to ~1.54 dB) and full spatial-frequency spectrum recovery on South China Sea simulations with millisecond-level runtime.
从算子理论视角将水声场显式分解为低频全局传播与高频空间干涉残差。
设计了级联S2RL架构，将频谱域FNO全局传播器与空间域U-Net局部细化器结合，并采用海底二进制掩码进行分阶段训练。
在南海模拟数据集上显著降低了预测RMSE（低至1.54 dB），恢复了全谱段能量，同时保持毫秒级推理速度。
me: Stage I Global Propagator using Vanilla FNO or physics-encoded Hankel-FNO (incorporating zeroth-order Hankel function far-field asymptotics and bathymetry embedding).
Stage II Local Refiner using a multi-scale spatial U-Net with skip connections to predict high-frequency residual maps from frozen Stage I outputs.
Two-phase sequential L2 loss optimization constrained to the ocean water column via a binary sediment mask.
第一阶段全局传播器：采用标准FNO或物理编码的Hankel-FNO（融合零阶汉克尔函数远场渐近行为与海底地形嵌入）。
第二阶段局部细化器：使用带跳跃连接的多尺度空间U-Net，从冻结的第一阶段输出中学习高频残差图。
两阶段顺序优化策略：通过二进制沉积层掩码将L2损失约束在水体区域内。
de: 3,456 synthetic transmission loss fields (2,765 train, 691 test) simulated by the RAM solver at f = 200 Hz over a 10 km range and 1.5 km depth.
3D ocean environmental inputs from the South China Sea, combining FVCOM temperature/salinity fields and ETOPO1 bathymetry.
Evaluated via water-column RMSE, runtime comparisons, and radially averaged 2D Power Spectral Density (PSD) over the 5–10 km range window.
使用RAM求解器在200 Hz频率下模拟的3456个传播损失场样本（2765个训练，691个测试），覆盖10公里距离和1.5公里深度。
采用南海三维海洋环境数据，结合FVCOM温盐场与ETOPO1海底地形数据。
通过水体RMSE、推理耗时对比以及5–10公里距离窗口内的径向平均二维功率谱密度（PSD）进行评估。
li: Experiments are limited to synthetic simulations at a single fixed acoustic frequency of 200 Hz and fixed 2D domain size (10 km range by 1.5 km depth).
The two-stage cascaded architecture roughly doubles the neural inference latency compared to single-stage FNO (adding ~5 ms overhead).
实验仅限于单一固定频率（200 Hz）和固定二维区域（10公里距离×1.5公里深度）的数值模拟数据。
与单阶段FNO相比，两阶段级联架构增加了约5毫秒的计算开销，推理时间约翻倍。

tm.why: The paper develops a two-stage Fourier Neural Operator and U-Net deep learning surrogate to solve the Helmholtz wave propagation equation in ocean acoustics.
The method acts as a fast neural surrogate for solving the 2D range-dependent acoustic Helmholtz wave equation, accelerating computation by two orders of magnitude over traditional numerical solvers.

ev.notes: Full 5-page PDF analyzed, including equations, methodology, Table I, and Figures 1-3.

sum: This study investigates the post-collisional evolution of the southern Variscan belt using 2D numerical modeling of a convergent-divergent tectonic system, focusing on the Valpelline Series in the western Alps. By integrating U-Pb zircon geochronology and pressure-temperature (P-T) estimates, the authors compare observed metamorphic trajectories with model predictions. The results show that the transition from convergence to extension reactivated inherited structures and formed shallow sedimentary basins. Crucially, the best-fit models require a rapid shift from convergence to forced extension at plate margins near the Permo-Carboniferous boundary, rather than a prolonged gravitational collapse. This demonstrates that early Permian basin formation and deep-crustal exhumation were primarily driven by plate-boundary forces, providing new insights into post-collisional geodynamics.
本研究利用二维数值模拟，结合西阿尔卑斯Valpelline系列的锆石年代学和温压数据，探讨了南瓦里斯坎带碰撞后演化。模拟表明，板块边缘在二叠-石炭纪之交从收敛向强迫伸展的快速转变，与观测到的P-T-t轨迹最吻合。这证明早二叠世盆地形成和深部地壳折返主要受板块边界力控制，而非长期的重力垮塌。

t: 2D numerical modeling of a convergent-divergent tectonic system to simulate post-collisional crustal evolution.
利用收敛-离散构造系统的二维数值模拟，模拟碰撞后的地壳演化。
U-Pb zircon geochronology and pressure-temperature estimates from the Valpelline Series in the western Alps.
来自西阿尔卑斯山Valpelline系列的U-Pb锆石年代学和压力-温度估算数据。
Models with rapid transition from convergence to forced extension at plate margins best fit the observed P-T-t paths.
板块边缘从收敛到强迫伸展快速转变的模型最符合观测到的P-T-t轨迹。
The 2D model simplification may not capture 3D oblique or rotational tectonic complexities.
二维模型简化可能无法捕捉三维倾斜或旋转构造的复杂性。
Demonstrates that early Permian basin formation and deep-crustal exhumation were driven by plate-boundary forces rather than gravitational collapse.
表明早二叠世盆地形成和深部地壳折返主要受板块边界力控制。

kc: Demonstrated that plate-boundary forces, rather than gravitational collapse, controlled early Permian exhumation and basin formation in the southern Variscan belt.
Successfully matched observed P-T-t paths from the Valpelline Series with 2D convergent-divergent numerical models.
Showed that the transition to extension involved reactivation of inherited structures and their migration across plates.
证实了板块边界力而非重力垮塌控制了南瓦里斯坎带早二叠世的折返和盆地形成。
成功将Valpelline系列的观测P-T-t轨迹与二维收敛-离散数值模型相匹配。
表明向伸展的转变涉及继承构造的重活化及其跨板块迁移。
me: 2D numerical geodynamic modeling of convergent-divergent tectonic systems.
Integration of petrological pressure-temperature (P-T) estimates and U-Pb zircon geochronology.
收敛-离散构造系统的二维地球动力学数值模拟。
整合岩石学压力-温度（P-T）估算与U-Pb锆石年代学。
de: Pressure-temperature-time (P-T-t) data compiled from the Valpelline Series, western Alps.
Synthetic P-T-t paths generated from 2D numerical geodynamic simulations.
收集自西阿尔卑斯Valpelline系列的压力-温度-时间（P-T-t）数据。
通过二维地球动力学数值模拟生成的合成P-T-t轨迹。
li: The 2D model geometry cannot account for 3D oblique convergence or rotational tectonics.
Simplifications in rock rheology and thermodynamic databases may affect precise P-T path matching.
二维模型几何结构无法考虑三维倾斜收敛或旋转构造。
岩石流变学和热力学数据库的简化可能会影响精确的P-T轨迹匹配。

tm.why: The paper uses 2D numerical geodynamic modeling to investigate the post-collisional crustal exhumation and lithospheric evolution of the southern Variscan belt.

ev.notes: No PDF was available. The analysis is based on the detailed abstract and metadata from OpenAlex and Crossref.

sum: While magmatically accreted oceanic crust is well known to exhibit increasing seismic velocity with age due to crack closure, the evolution of tectonically accreted lithosphere (exhumed mantle peridotites) remains poorly constrained despite forming ~1/6 of the global seafloor. Using a 150-km P-wave traveltime tomography profile from an ocean-bottom seismometer survey across the ultraslow-spreading Southwest Indian Ridge (64°30′E), the authors reconstruct discontinuous seafloor ages across flip-flop detachment faults from 0 to 6 Ma. They find a ~13% overall velocity increase in the top 6 km—about 62% greater than in magmatic crust—peaking at 1.5–4.5 km depth (~16%). In the top 1.5–2.5 km, progressive serpentinization lowers velocity, partially counteracting crack closure. Empirical velocity-porosity-hydration relations indicate a bulk water content of 8.1 wt.% in the upper 6 km, nearly triple that of magmatic crust, implying enhanced arc magmatism and intraslab seismicity when such lithosphere subducts.
本研究利用横跨超慢速扩张西南印度洋脊（64°30′E）的150公里海底地震仪（OBS）初至波走时层析成像剖面，首次约束了由出露地幔橄榄岩组成的构造增生海洋最上部岩石圈的演化。作者结合跷跷板式拆离断层重建了0至6 Ma的不连续海底年龄，提取一维速度-深度剖面进行线性回归并估算含水量。结果显示，顶部6公……

t: The authors reconstruct discontinuous lithospheric ages across flip-flop detachment faults, extract 1D P-wave velocity profiles from 0.5 to 5.5 km depth for linear regression against age, and apply empirical velocity-porosity equations to estimate bulk hydration.
通过跷跷板式拆离断层重建不连续年龄，提取0.5–5.5 km一维P波速度对年龄进行线性回归，并利用经验公式估算总含水量。

A 150-km-long active-source ocean-bottom seismometer (OBS) first-arrival traveltime P-wave velocity tomographic profile (SMOO33) across the ultraslow-spreading Southwest Indian Ridge at 64°30′E, supplemented by IODP Site U1601C porosity data.
横跨西南印度洋脊（64°30′E）的150公里长海底地震仪（OBS）初至波走时层析成像剖面（SMOO33）及IODP孔隙…

From 0 to 6 Ma, P-wave velocity increases by 16.34% at 1.5–4.5 km depth and ~10% at 0.5–1.5 and 4.5–5.5 km (~13% overall, 62% above magmatic crust), with an average bulk water content of 8.1 wt.% in the top 6 km.
0–6 Ma间，1.5–4.5 km深度波速增加16.34%，整体增加~13%（比岩浆地壳高62%），顶部6 km平均含…

Drilling constraints on depth-dependent serpentinization, porosity, and crack aspect ratio in tectonically accreted lithosphere are scarce, making porosity uncertainty the primary error source in shallow water estimates.
缺乏深钻导致蛇纹石化程度和孔隙度随深度的变化约束不足，浅部含水量估算误差主要源于孔隙度。

Provides the first quantitative constraints on the seismic evolution and bulk hydration of tectonically accreted oceanic topmost lithosphere with age, contrasting it with magmatically accreted oceanic crust.
首次定量约束了构造增生海洋最上部岩石圈随年龄的地震演化与水化程度，并与岩浆地壳进行了对比。

kc: Provides the first quantitative constraints on the seismic velocity evolution (0–6 Ma) of tectonically accreted topmost oceanic lithosphere at the Southwest Indian Ridge.

Demonstrates that overall velocity increase in the top 6 km of tectonically accreted lithosphere (~13%) is ~62% higher than in magmatically accreted crust (~8%), with maximum increase (~16%) occurring at 1.5–4.5 km depth.
Identifies age-progressive serpentinization in the top 1.5–2.5 km as a velocity-reducing process that partially counteracts crack closure and pore infilling.
Estimates that the top 6 km of tectonically accreted lithosphere holds ~8.1 wt.% bulk water, up to three times more than equivalent magmatic crust (2.9 wt.%).
首次对西南印度洋脊构造增生最上部海洋岩石圈的地震波速随年龄演化（0–6 Ma）提供了定量约束。
证明构造增生岩石圈顶部6公里的整体波速增长（~13%）比岩浆增生地壳（~8%）高约62%，且最大增幅（~16%）出现在1.5–4.5公里深度。
指出顶部1.5–2.5公里随年龄推进的蛇纹石化作用会降低波速，从而部分抵消裂隙闭合和孔隙充填带来的波速增加。
估算构造增生岩石圈顶部6公里的加权平均总含水量约为8.1 wt.%，高达同等岩浆地壳（2.9 wt.%）的三倍。
me: Graphical reconstruction of discontinuous lithospheric ages (0–6 Ma) across alternating flip-flop detachment fault emergences and breakaways assuming a 14 mm/yr spreading rate.
Extraction of 1D P-wave velocity–depth profiles from a 2D first-arrival traveltime tomographic model (0.5–5.5 km below seafloor) and linear regression against distance and age.
Bulk and structural water content estimation using empirical velocity–serpentinization–porosity relationships combined with a depth-dependent porosity model.
假设14 mm/yr的恒定扩张速率，根据交替极性的“跷跷板”式拆离断层出露点和决裂点，图解重建0–6 Ma的不连续岩石圈年龄。
从二维初至波走时层析成像模型中提取海底以下0.5–5.5公里的一维P波速度-深度剖面，并对距离和年龄进行线性回归分析。
结合随深度变化的孔隙度模型，利用经验波速-蛇纹石化-孔隙度关系式估算岩石圈的总含水量（含孔隙水和结构水）。
de: 2D P-wave velocity tomographic model from active-source ocean-bottom seismometer (OBS) profile SMOO33 (150 km long) acquired during the SISMOSMOOTH 2014 cruise at the Southwest Indian Ridge (64°30′E).
Porosity constraints from IODP Site U1601C serpentinized peridotite cores (7.0% ± 3.7% initial porosity) and a global crustal porosity–depth gradient model.
2014年SISMOSMOOTH航次在西南印度洋脊（64°30′E）采集的150公里长主动源海底地震仪（OBS）剖面SMOO33的二维P波走时层析成像速度模型。
来自IODP U1601C站位蛇纹石化橄榄岩岩芯的孔隙度约束（初始孔隙度7.0% ± 3.7%）以及全球地壳孔隙度-深度梯度模型。
li: Depth-dependent variations in serpentinization degree, porosity, and crack aspect ratio within tectonically accreted lithosphere remain poorly constrained due to limited deep drilling.
Seafloor ages rely on a constant spreading rate assumption and fault geometry interpretation rather than magnetic anomalies, yielding up to ±7.25% age uncertainty at 6 Ma.
The top 500 m below the seafloor is excluded from velocity analysis due to larger tomographic velocity uncertainty (SD > ~0.1 km/s).
由于缺乏深海钻探样本，构造增生岩石圈内部蛇纹石化程度、孔隙度和裂隙纵横比随深度的变化仍缺乏直接约束。
海底年龄依赖恒定扩张速率假设和断层几何解释而非磁异常条带，在6 Ma处存在高达±7.25%的年龄不确定性。
由于浅表层析成像速度不确定性较大（标准差 > ~0.1 km/s），海底以下顶部500米被排除在速度分析之外。

tm.why: The paper investigates the evolution, serpentinization, and hydration of tectonically accreted topmost oceanic lithospheric mantle at the ultraslow-spreading Southwest Indian Ridge.
The study relies on a 2D first-arrival traveltime P-wave velocity tomographic model along a 150-km OBS profile to extract velocity-age relationships.
The velocity constraints are derived from an active-source ocean bottom seismometer (OBS) survey across the Southwest Indian Ridge.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 17-page published PDF (Geochemistry, Geophysics, Geosystems, 2026), including all text sections, equations, Figures 1–5, and Tables 1–2.

sum: This study evaluates how spatial smoothing regularization affects Bayesian finite-fault slip inversions by comparing an unregularized (BUR) approach that directly samples distributed slip parameters with a hybrid regularized (BR) approach that samples smoothing hyperparameters. Synthetic tests varying data noise, resolution ratio, and slip complexity show that BUR preserves local amplitudes and spatial roughness at shallow depths when data constraints are strong, whereas BR underestimates roughness and over-narrows posterior uncertainty. Applied to joint InSAR and near-field GNSS observations of the 2019 Mw 7.1 Ridgecrest earthquake sequence and 3-month early afterslip, integrating near-fault data, a 1D layered elastic structure, and prediction covariance is essential for matching field surface slip measurements. The preferred BUR model concentrates 48.6 ± 10.9% of seismic moment at 6.7–10 km depth (implying locally ~70 MPa static stress drop) and reveals only ~30% coseismic-afterslip moment overlap (vs. 60% in BR), clarifying distinct fault slip modes.
本研究对比了直接采样分布式滑动参数的贝叶斯无正则化（BUR）方法与采样平滑超参数的贝叶斯正则化（BR）方法。合成测试表明，在数据约束良好时，BUR能保留浅部滑动粗糙度与局部峰值，而BR则低估粗糙度并人为缩小不确定性。将两种方法应用于2019年Mw 7.1 Ridgecrest地震序列及震后3个月早期……

t: Compares Bayesian unregularized (BUR) inversion directly sampling subfault slip via CATMIP against Bayesian regularized (BR) inversion sampling a Laplacian smoothing hyperparameter α² and solving bound-constrained least-squares, using depth-dependent uniform priors.
对比直接采样滑动参数的无正则化（BUR）与采样拉普拉斯平滑超参数的正则化（BR）反演。

Uses four synthetic test suites and 2019 Ridgecrest geodetic data: five coseismic InSAR tracks (COSMO-SkyMed and Sentinel-1) plus 17 near-field GNSS stations, and two 3-month postseismic Sentinel-1 tracks plus 23 GNSS stations.
采用四组合成测试及Ridgecrest同震（5轨InSAR+17个GNSS）与震后早期数据集。

BUR concentrates 48.6 ± 10.9% of Ridgecrest seismic moment at 6.7–10 km depth (peak slip ~9 m, local stress drop ~70 MPa) and yields ~30% coseismic-afterslip moment overlap at 10%-peak threshold, versus 60% in BR.
BUR在6.7-10km集中48.6%地震矩（峰值~9m），同震与余滑10%阈值矩重叠仅30%（BR为60%）。

InSAR temporal resolution (6–12 days) conflates earliest afterslip with coseismic slip, postseismic models ignore poro-/visco-elasticity at Coso, and BUR requires higher computational cost and careful deep prior design.
InSAR时间分辨率混入早期余滑，震后未计粘/孔隙弹性，且BUR计算成本较高。

Quantifies how Laplacian smoothing distorts Bayesian slip posteriors and log-evidence, demonstrating that unregularized inversion with layered elastic uncertainties resolves true slip roughness and coseismic-afterslip separation.
量化平滑约束对贝叶斯后验与信息增益的扭曲，证实无正则化能恢复滑动粗糙度与跨模式分离。

kc: Systematically compares Bayesian unregularized (BUR) and Laplacian-regularized (BR) finite-fault slip inversions using synthetic benchmarks and information-theoretic metrics (log-evidence, KL divergence, RMS roughness).

Demonstrates that combining near-fault geodetic data, a layered elastic crustal structure, and shear-modulus prediction covariance (Cp) is crucial to resolve shallow slip gradients and match field surface offsets at Ridgecrest.

Quantifies the spatial separation of seismic and aseismic slip at Ridgecrest, showing that BUR reduces artificial coseismic-afterslip moment overlap from ~60% (in BR) to ~30% at the 10%-peak-slip threshold.
通过合成基准测试和信息论指标（对数证据、KL散度、均方根粗糙度），系统对比了贝叶斯无正则化（BUR）和拉普拉斯正则化（BR）有限断层滑动反演。
证明了结合近断层大地测量数据、分层弹性地壳结构及剪切模量预测协方差（Cp）对于分辨Ridgecrest浅部滑动梯度并匹配野外地表位错至关重要。
量化了Ridgecrest同震与非地震滑动的空间分离，表明在10%峰值滑动阈值下，BUR将人为平滑导致的同震-余滑矩重叠从BR的约60%降低至约30%。
me: Bayesian unregularized (BUR) inversion directly sampling strike-slip and dip-slip parameters on discretized subfault patches using the CATMIP parallel tempering MCMC algorithm.
Hybrid Bayesian regularized (BR) inversion sampling the Laplacian smoothing hyperparameter α² via CATMIP and solving bound-constrained least-squares for subfault slip.

Depth-dependent uniform priors (positive-uniform above ~13.3 km, zero-mean uniform at greater depths) combined with observational (Cd) and 1D layered elastic shear-modulus perturbation (Cp) covariance matrices.
采用CATMIP并行回火MCMC算法直接对离散子断层走滑和倾滑参数进行采样的贝叶斯无正则化（BUR）反演。
通过CATMIP采样拉普拉斯平滑超参数α²并求解有界约束最小二乘子断层滑动的混合贝叶斯正则化（BR）反演。
结合深度依赖均匀先验（浅部正均匀分布，深部零均值均匀分布）与观测误差协方差（Cd）及一维分层弹性剪切模量扰动协方差（Cp）。
de: Four suites of synthetic tests evaluating data accuracy (σd from 0.5 to 5 cm), data-to-model resolution ratio (η = Lo/Lf), slip pattern complexity (random, single/multi-asperity, Gaussian), and nonplanar Ridgecrest geometry.

Coseismic geodetic dataset for the 2019 Ridgecrest sequence: five downsampled InSAR tracks (3 COSMO-SkyMed X-band masked within 0.5 km, 2 Sentinel-1 C-band retaining near-fault pixels) and 17 near-field GNSS stations.

Early postseismic dataset (first 0.25 years): 2 Sentinel-1 interferograms (ascending/descending) and 23 near-field GNSS stations, plus validation against >650 field surface offset measurements, optical correlation data, and 7 published slip models.
四组合成实验，评估数据精度（σd从0.5至5 cm）、数据与模型分辨率比（η = Lo/Lf）、滑动模式复杂度（随机、单/多凹凸体、高斯型）及非平面Ridgecrest断层几何的影响。
2019年Ridgecrest序列同震大地测量数据集：5个降采样InSAR轨道（3个0.5 km内掩膜的COSMO-SkyMed X波段，2个保留近断层像元的Sentinel-1 C波段）及17个近场GNSS台站。
早期震后数据集（震后前0.25年）：2个Sentinel-1升降轨干涉图和23个近场GNSS台站，并结合超过650个野外地表位错测量、光学相关性数据及7个已发表滑动模型进行对比验证。
li: InSAR temporal resolution (6–12 days) conflates pre-event signals and earliest postseismic afterslip with coseismic slip.
BUR exhibits higher computational cost due to sampling high-dimensional parameter spaces and can produce minor prior-inherited spurious slip at poorly constrained intermediate depths.
Postseismic modeling neglects Cp, dip-slip components, and poroelastic/viscoelastic relaxation, leaving larger residuals (~1 cm) near the fault and at the Coso volcanic field.
InSAR的时间分辨率（6–12天）将震前信号和极早期震后余滑与同震滑动混杂在一起。
BUR因直接采样高维参数空间而计算成本较高，且在约束较弱的中等深度可能产生受先验影响的轻微虚假滑动。
震后反演忽略了模型预测误差Cp、倾滑分量以及孔隙弹性/粘弹性松弛效应，在近断层区域和Coso火山区留下了较大的残差（约1 cm）。

tm.why: The paper systematically formulates and compares unregularized (BUR) and regularized (BR) Bayesian fault slip inversion frameworks using CATMIP MCMC sampling, log-evidence, and KL divergence.
It investigates the spatial heterogeneity and limited overlap between coseismic slip and 3-month early postseismic afterslip to constrain fault rheology and velocity-weakening/strengthening behavior.
It infers finite-fault coseismic slip distributions, shallow slip deficits, and static stress drops for the 2019 Mw 6.4 and Mw 7.1 Ridgecrest earthquake sequence.

ev.notes: Full 25-page PDF from JGR: Solid Earth (2026) analyzed, including all equations, 2 tables, and 13 figures.

sum: This study uses 4D buoyancy-driven analogue subduction experiments monitored via stereoscopic Particle Image Velocimetry (sPIV) to investigate how overriding plate thickness, subducting plate thickness, far-field boundary conditions, and subduction interface rheology control forearc topography and strain. The results show that forearc valley formation and deepening occur primarily during progressive slab steepening due to a positive downdip suction force gradient along the interface. Thinner overriding plates and stronger interface rheologies yield narrower, more curved forearc valleys with greater trench-normal shortening, while laterally fixed plates enhance hinge suction forces that reduce local valley deflection and shortening. Across all tested parameters, a strong positive spatio-temporal correlation (R2 = 0.88) exists between local surface curvature and shortening, confirming that forearc strain arises directly from flexural bending of the lithosphere. These findings explain forearc deformation and basin sediment variations in the Chile, Alaska, and Cascadia subduction zones.
本研究利用4D浮力驱动俯冲物理模拟实验并结合立体粒子图像测速（sPIV）技术，系统探究了上覆板片厚度、俯冲板片厚度、远场边界条件和界面流变学对弧前地形与应变的控制作用。结果表明，弧前盆地的形成和加深主要发生在板片渐进变陡阶段，受控于界面顺倾吸力梯度。较薄的上覆板片和较强的界面耦合会产生更窄、曲率更大……

t: Time-evolving 3D buoyancy-driven analogue models of two-layered subduction in a Perspex tank using silicone plates over glucose syrup, monitored with stereoscopic Particle Image Velocimetry (sPIV) to measure surface topography and strain.
利用硅胶板和葡萄糖浆开展三维时变浮力驱动俯冲物理模拟，结合sPIV测量弧前地形和应变。

Nine laboratory experiments systematically varying overriding plate thickness (75–125 km scaled), subducting plate thickness (50–100 km scaled), far-field boundary conditions (free or fixed), and interface lubricant rheology (90–10 vs 80–20 paraffin-petrolatum).
九组实验室物理模型，系统改变上覆与俯冲板片厚度、远场边界条件及界面润滑剂流变配比。

Thinner overriding plates and stronger interfaces produce narrower, more curved forearc valleys with greater shortening (up to -20.3%), yielding a parameter-independent correlation (R2 = 0.880) between surface curvature and finite shortening strain.
薄上覆板片与强界面产生更窄更弯的弧前谷和更大缩短（达-20.3%），曲率与缩短高度相关（R2=0.88）。

Unwanted experimental variations in ambient lab temperature (affecting upper mantle syrup viscosity) and initial slab dip angle, plus simplified homogeneous isoviscous Newtonian plate rheologies and a closed 660-km bottom boundary.
存在实验室温度和初始板片倾角波动，且采用了简化的均匀等黏度牛顿流变学和封闭底边界。

First 4D buoyancy-driven analogue parametric study quantitatively evaluating how plate thicknesses, far-field boundary conditions, and interface rheology jointly control both forearc topography and flexural bending strain.
首次通过4D浮力驱动物理模拟定量评估多种俯冲参数对弧前地形及挠曲应变的联合控制。

kc: Performed parametric 4D buoyancy-driven analogue subduction modeling evaluating overriding/subducting plate thicknesses, far-field boundaries, and interface rheology.
Demonstrated a parameter-independent spatio-temporal correlation (R2 = 0.88) between forearc surface curvature and trench-normal shortening strain.
Linked experimental forearc subsidence and strain mechanics to natural observations in the Chile, Alaska, and Cascadia subduction zones, constraining interface downdip depths to 50–70 km.
开展了参数化的4D浮力驱动俯冲物理模拟，系统评估了上覆/俯冲板片厚度、远场边界条件和界面流变学的影响。
证实了弧前地表曲率与垂直海沟缩短应变之间存在独立于实验参数的强时空正相关性（R2 = 0.88）。
将弧前沉降与应变机制应用于智利、阿拉斯加和卡斯卡迪亚俯冲带，并将板片界面下端深度约束在50–70 km。
me: 3D time-evolving buoyancy-driven laboratory analogue modeling using silicone-iron powder plates over glucose syrup upper mantle.
Lubricant mixtures of paraffin oil and petrolatum applied to simulate variable weak subduction interface rheologies.
Non-intrusive stereoscopic Particle Image Velocimetry (sPIV) to track passive tracers and extract 4D surface topography and strain.
采用硅胶混合铁粉模拟岩石圈板块、葡萄糖浆模拟上地幔，开展三维时变浮力驱动实验室物理模拟。
使用石蜡油和凡士林混合物作为润滑层，模拟不同强度的弱俯冲界面流变学性质。
应用非侵入式立体粒子图像测速（sPIV）技术追踪被动示踪粒子，提取四维地表地形和有限应变演化。
de: Nine scaled laboratory subduction experiments varying plate thicknesses, trailing edge boundary conditions, and lubricant mixtures.
Topographic, basement depth, and slab geometry (Slab2) profiles from the Northern/Central Chile, Alaska, and Cascadia subduction zones.
九组按比例缩放的实验室俯冲模拟实验，系统改变板片厚度、尾端边界条件和界面润滑剂配比。
北/中智利、阿拉斯加和卡斯卡迪亚俯冲带的地形剖面、基底沉积物厚度及Slab2板片几何形态数据。
li: Limited experimental control over initial slab dip angle and lab temperature fluctuations affecting syrup viscosity.
Implementation of homogeneous isoviscous Newtonian rheologies rather than complex visco-elasto-plastic layered rheologies.
Closed bottom tank boundary at scaled 660 km depth prevents lower-mantle penetration and whole-mantle convection.
实验难以精确控制初始板片倾角及影响糖浆黏度的实验室温度波动。

sum: This study conducts a shallow-seismic survey to investigate the structural disturbances beneath the ~2 km gap in the southern rim of the Yilan impact crater in northeastern China. S-wave and P-wave velocity models are constructed by individually inverting surface-wave dispersion curves and first-arrival travel times. K-means clustering is then applied to these multi-parameter models to achieve lithological zonation of the shallow subsurface. The results reveal that the fractured bedrock of the remnant southern crater wall is buried beneath more than 10 m of loose sediments, indicating significant erosion and subsequent burial. This integrated approach demonstrates the effectiveness of combining multiple seismic methods with statistical clustering for delineating buried crater structures.

sum: This study investigates deep carbon cycling efficiency in end-member cold (Tonga) and hot (Colombia) subduction zones by integrating open-system thermo-petrological modeling (HEPs_vol, PGCtherm2D, Perple_X, and Deep Earth Water solubility models) with compiled volcanic CO2 degassing observations and arc rock geochemistry. Using site-specific slab geometries and eight-layer lithological compositions constrained by drilling and geophysical data, the authors simultaneously evaluate metamorphic decarbonation, carbonate dissolution, and partial melting. Results reveal two contrasting regimes: hot Colombia undergoes efficient "focused" decarbonation (>15% efficiency, 1.57 Tg Myr−1 m−1) between 75 and 115 km depth, dominated by metamorphic breakdown (~80%) and supplemented by sediment melting. Conversely, cold Tonga exhibits sluggish "diffuse" decarbonation (~1% efficiency, 0.51 Tg Myr−1 m−1) spanning 75–310 km depth, controlled primarily by fluid-mediated carbonate dissolution (~65%). This site-specific synthesis reconciles modeled slab fluxes with observed arc emissions and illuminates global west-versus-east Pacific degassing asymmetries.

sum: This paper presents a novel 4D geometric analysis of seismic source clouds (spatiotemporal seismicity patterns) preceding large earthquakes. By analyzing these multidimensional clouds, the author identifies 'universal V-transition pathways' and establishes empirical scaling relationships. This geometric approach aims to characterize the precursory evolution of seismicity in space and time, offering new insights into earthquake nucleation, precursory processes, and potential forecasting methodologies based on multidimensional catalog analysis.

sum: This study evaluates the regional-scale applicability of the single-station microtremor horizontal-to-vertical spectral ratio (mHVSR) technique in the Guadalquivir River sedimentary basin, Spain. Using one week of continuous data from 50 permanent and temporary stations, the authors map soil resonance frequencies. They identify a decreasing frequency trend toward the southeast, though shallow chaotic olistostromic structures act as resonators that obscure the deep Paleozoic basement. By integrating borehole and geophysical survey data, they establish an empirical frequency-depth relationship and a shear-wave velocity model for the sedimentary infill. The model reveals a southeastward dip increasing toward the Subbetic thrust belt, with sediment thickness exceeding 3500 m. This work demonstrates that mHVSR is a reliable tool for regional-scale basin characterization and seismic hazard assessment.

将传统上用于局地尺度的mHVSR技术提升至区域尺度盆地表征，并结合钻孔数据进行深部基底成像。

kc: Demonstrated the feasibility of using the mHVSR technique at a regional scale rather than just local site-response scales.
Mapped the regional soil resonance frequencies across the Guadalquivir Basin, Spain.
Derived an empirical relationship between resonance frequency and basement depth, and a shear-wave velocity model for the sedimentary infill.
证明了在区域尺度而非仅在局地场地响应尺度上应用mHVSR技术的可行性。
绘制了西班牙瓜达尔基维尔盆地的区域土壤共振频率图。
推导了共振频率与基底深度之间的经验关系，并建立了沉积填充物的剪切波速度模型。
me: Single-station microtremor horizontal-to-vertical spectral ratio (mHVSR) analysis.
Empirical regression fitting to relate resonance frequency to basement depth.
Shear-wave velocity modeling of the sedimentary infill.
单台微动水平与垂直向谱比（mHVSR）分析。
用于关联共振频率与基底深度的经验回归拟合。
沉积填充物的剪切波速度建模。
de: Continuous seismic noise data from 50 permanent and temporary accelerograph and broadband stations recorded over one week.
Borehole data and interpreted geophysical surveys for calibration and validation.
来自50个永久和临时强震仪及宽频带台站、记录时间超过一周的连续地震背景噪声数据。
用于校准和验证的钻孔数据及解译的地球物理勘探资料。

复杂且混乱的浅部结构（滑塌体楔）充当了浅层共振器，阻碍了在某些区域清晰识别深部古生代基底。

sum: BackTrackBB is a software tool designed for the detection and space-time location of seismic sources. It leverages multi-scale, frequency-selective statistical coherence of wavefields recorded by dense seismic networks and local arrays. This specific WorkflowHub entry describes a pre-configured experiment using a synthetic dataset to test the workflow's performance on the Marenostrum V supercomputer. The workflow consists of signal processing, space-time imaging, and detection/location steps. Running the 1300-task workflow (including 864 computationally intensive btb_block tasks) takes approximately 11 minutes using 108 nodes. The workflow demonstrates the feasibility of automated, high-throughput seismic source monitoring using high-performance computing.
BackTrackBB是一款用于地震源检测和时空定位的软件工具。它利用密集台阵波场的统计相干性进行分析。该工作流在Marenostrum V超级计算机上使用合成数据集进行了测试。工作流包含信号处理、时空成像和检测定位。在108个节点上运行1300个任务约需11分钟，展示了利用高性能计算进行自动化地震……

t: Multi-scale, frequency-selective statistical coherence of wavefields recorded by dense seismic networks, processed via a three-step workflow: signal processing, space-time imaging, and detection/location.
利用密集地震台网记录的波场多尺度、频率选择性统计相干性，通过三步工作流进行处理。
A synthetic continuous seismic dataset simulating 2 days (24 hours per day) of wavefield recordings, used to test the workflow's computational performance.
模拟2天（每天24小时）波场记录的合成连续地震数据集，用于测试工作流的计算性能。
The 1300-task workflow runs in ~11 minutes on 108 nodes of Marenostrum V, though CPU usage averages 34.39% due to transition overheads.
在Marenostrum V的108个节点上，1300个任务的工作流在约11分钟内运行完毕。
Moderate CPU utilization (34.39%) caused by significant idle time during transitions between workflow iterations.
由于工作流迭代之间的过渡时间较长，导致CPU平均利用率较低（34.39%）。
Integration of the BackTrackBB array detection algorithm into a highly parallelized, reproducible HPC workflow on Marenostrum V.
将BackTrackBB台阵检测算法整合到Marenostrum V上高度并行化、可重复的HPC工作流中。

kc: Presents a pre-configured, high-performance computing workflow for the BackTrackBB seismic source detection and location software.
Demonstrates successful execution and scaling on the Marenostrum V supercomputer using synthetic datasets.
Provides open-access workflow configurations and performance profiling for reproducible computational seismology.
为BackTrackBB地震源检测与定位软件提供了一个预配置的高性能计算工作流。
展示了在Marenostrum V超级计算机上使用合成数据集的成功运行与扩展。
提供了开源的工作流配置和性能分析，促进可重复性计算地震学。

Three-step workflow: signal processing, space-time imaging, and detection/location.
