sum: Nonstationary Epidemic Type Aftershock Sequence (ETAS) models allow background seismicity rate and triggering productivity to vary over time to infer post-seismic processes, but suffer from parameter trade-offs and identifiability issues. This study introduces a diagnostic framework combining empirical-Bayes penalized nonstationary ETAS inversion (using ABIC for smoothing selection) with an independent, model-agnostic Isolation Forest anomaly detector applied to 13 multivariate catalog features (temporal, magnitude, depth, spatial). Applied to the 2025 Mw 7.1 Dingri, Tibet earthquake sequence, the nonstationary ETAS model infers peak background-rate variations 8–10 days post-mainshock. However, the Isolation Forest detects no coherent multivariate catalog anomaly during this interval. Semi-synthetic catalog experiments and feature-ablation tests confirm the detector is sufficiently sensitive to recover true temporal-rate transients when present. This demonstrates that improved statistical fit alone does not guarantee physical nonstationarity, establishing model-agnostic anomaly detection as an essential validation tool.
非平稳流行病型余震序列（ETAS）模型常用于从地震目录推断瞬态震后过程，但存在参数权衡与可识别性问题。本文提出一种诊断框架，将基于经验贝叶斯和ABIC准则的惩罚非平稳ETAS反演与模型无关的孤立森林（Isolation Forest）无监督异常检测相结合，直接分析时间、震级、深度和空间等13维目录特……

t: Pairs empirical-Bayes penalized nonstationary ETAS modeling (using cubic splines and ABIC smoothing selection) with an independent Isolation Forest anomaly detector applied to 13 MAD-normalized temporal, magnitude, depth, and spatial catalog features in 0.5-day bins.
将基于三次样条与ABIC平滑选择的经验贝叶斯非平稳ETAS模型，与作用于13维目录特征的孤立森林无监督异常检测相结合。

Analyzes the 2025 Mw 7.1 Dingri earthquake aftershock catalog in southern Tibet (Yao et al., 2025) above a conservative completeness threshold Mc = 2.5, alongside five semi-synthetic catalogs with injected temporal-rate perturbations.
分析2025年西藏定日Mw 7.1地震余震目录（Mc>=2.5），并构造5个注入时间速率扰动的半合成目录进行验证。

Stationary ETAS yields mu = 9.639 events/day, K = 0.0495, p = 1.42 (AIC = -9074.4). Nonstationary ETAS (ABIC = -9115.4) infers mu(t) variations at 8–10 days, but Isolation Forest finds no coherent catalog anomaly.
非平稳ETAS（ABIC=-9115.4）推断主震后8-10天存在显著背景率波动，但孤立森林在该时段未发现一致的多变量目…

The empirical application is limited to the Dingri sequence, and temporal ETAS alone cannot resolve subtle post-seismic stress forcing against statistical uncertainty and internal parameter trade-offs.
实证应用仅限于定日地震序列，且纯时间ETAS难以在统计不确定性和参数权衡下分辨微弱震后应力强迫。

First systematic cross-validation framework pairing parametric nonstationary ETAS inference with unsupervised multivariate anomaly detection and semi-synthetic sensitivity tests to separate physical regime shifts from statistical parameter trade-offs.
首次系统提出将参数化非平稳ETAS反演与模型无关的多变量无监督异常检测及半合成灵敏度测试相结合的交叉验证框架。

kc: Developed a diagnostic framework pairing empirical-Bayes nonstationary ETAS modeling with unsupervised Isolation Forest anomaly detection on 13 catalog features.
Applied the framework to the 2025 Mw 7.1 Dingri earthquake aftershock sequence in southern Tibet, finding that inferred ETAS parameter variations at 8–10 days lack corresponding catalog anomalies.
Validated detector sensitivity using semi-synthetic catalogs with injected Poisson rate perturbations and feature-ablation analyses across temporal, magnitude, depth, and spatial subsets.
Demonstrated that favorable information criteria (AIC/ABIC) are necessary but insufficient to prove physical post-seismic regime transitions without independent model-agnostic confirmation.
开发了结合经验贝叶斯非平稳ETAS建模与基于13维目录特征的孤立森林无监督异常检测的诊断框架。
将该框架应用于2025年藏南定日Mw 7.1地震余震序列，发现主震后8–10天推断的ETAS参数变化缺乏对应的目录特征异常。
利用注入泊松速率扰动的半合成地震目录及跨时间、震级、深度和空间子集的特征消融分析，验证了检测器的灵敏度。
证明了良好的信息准则（AIC/ABIC）仅是推断物理震后状态转变的必要非充分条件，必须结合独立的模型无关验证。
me: Time-dependent completeness magnitude Mc(t) estimation using the coefficient of variation (CV) stabilization method in 250-event sliding windows.
Stationary temporal ETAS maximum-likelihood estimation and time-rescaling residual analysis.
Empirical-Bayes nonstationary ETAS modeling using cubic splines on six knots with roughness penalties selected via the Akaike Bayesian Information Criterion (ABIC).
Unsupervised anomaly detection using Isolation Forest (500 trees) on 13 MAD-standardized temporal, magnitude, depth, and spatial features in 0.5-day bins.
Sensitivity calibration via semi-synthetic catalogs with amplified temporal occurrence rates and feature-ablation experiments.
在250个事件的滑动窗口中利用变异系数（CV）稳定法估计随时间变化的完备震级Mc(t)。
平稳时间ETAS模型的最大似然估计与时间重标度残差分析。
基于六节点三次样条和粗糙度惩罚的经验贝叶斯非平稳ETAS建模，通过赤池贝叶斯信息准则（ABIC）选择平滑超参数。
在0.5天时间窗内对经MAD标准化的13个时间、震级、深度和空间特征应用孤立森林（500棵树）进行无监督异常检测。
通过放大时间发生率的半合成目录和特征消融实验进行灵敏度标定。
de: Aftershock catalog of the 7 January 2025 Mw 7.1 Dingri earthquake in southern Tibet from Yao et al. (2025), filtered above constant conservative threshold Mc = 2.5.
Additional nonstationary ETAS inversion keeping triggering productivity fixed and allowing only the background rate to vary.
Five semi-synthetic catalogs (Sim1–Sim5) injecting Poisson events in the 8–10 day post-mainshock window with amplification factors a = 0.5 to 2.5.
Feature-ablation tests running Isolation Forest separately on temporal, magnitude, depth, and spatial feature groups.
来自Yao et al. (2025)的2025年1月7日藏南定日Mw 7.1地震余震目录，截取保守完备震级阈值Mc = 2.5以上的事件。
固定触发生产率、仅允许背景地震发生率随时间变化的附加非平稳ETAS反演实验。
在主震后8–10天窗口内按放大因子a = 0.5至2.5注入泊松事件的五个半合成地震目录（Sim1–Sim5）。
分别在时间、震级、深度和空间特征子集上独立运行孤立森林的特征消融测试。
li: Application is currently restricted to a single case study (the 2025 Dingri sequence); systematic evaluation across multiple sequences and tectonic settings is still needed.
Purely temporal ETAS formulation neglects spatial triggering kernels and may lack resolution to separate low-amplitude physical forcing from internal statistical trade-offs.
Full posterior covariance of the nonstationary spline coefficients was not propagated jointly with the catalog diagnostics.
目前的应用仅限于单一案例研究（2025年定日地震序列），仍需跨多个序列和构造背景进行系统评估。
纯时间ETAS公式忽略了空间触发核，可能缺乏足够的分辨率将低幅物理强迫与内部统计权衡区分开。
非平稳样条系数的完整后验协方差尚未与目录诊断工具进行联合传播分析。

tm.why: The paper develops an unsupervised machine learning diagnostic test using the Isolation Forest algorithm to evaluate whether inferred nonstationary ETAS parameter transients correspond to genuine changes in earthquake catalog properties.

The study performs statistical modeling of aftershock clustering and multivariate anomaly detection on earthquake catalog features (rates, magnitudes, depths, and spatial coordinates) from the 2025 Mw 7.1 Dingri sequence.
Nonstationary ETAS models are specifically evaluated as tools for inferring transient post-seismic fault mechanics processes such as afterslip, viscoelastic relaxation, and pore-fluid diffusion.

ev.notes: Full 12-page PDF text and all 6 figures from Earth and Planetary Science Letters (2026) were analyzed in detail.

sum: Statistical earthquake forecast models evaluated via log-likelihood (LL) scores of the full earthquake count distribution P(n) suffer from bias due to fat tails and out-of-range observations. This study introduces a tail-aware evaluation framework combining adaptive Gaussian kernel density estimation with three tail-handling strategies (power-law extrapolation, fixed minimum probability, and exclusion). Using the AoyuX platform, a 25-year (2000–2023) monthly pseudoprospective experiment in the China Seismic Experimental Site (CSES) compares homogeneous (ETASμ) and spatially heterogeneous (ETASμ(x,y)) ETAS variants across six spatial resolutions and five magnitude thresholds using 100,000 simulations per window. Empirical count distributions follow power laws with exponent a ≈ 1.02 ± 0.23, constraining the productivity exponent α = 0.83 ± 0.19. Power-law extrapolation proves theoretically justified and empirically robust, whereas alternative strategies introduce post-mainshock biases. Cumulative information gain demonstrates that ETASμ(x,y) outperforms ETASμ in data-rich configurations and active M ≥ 5 regions.
本研究针对地震预测模型评估中的厚尾与超范围观测偏差，提出了结合自适应高斯核密度估计与幂律外推等三种尾部处理策略的评估框架。依托AoyuX平台，利用中国地震科学实验场（CSES）1970–2023年地震目录及每窗口10万次模拟，开展了2000–2023年逐月准前瞻性实验，对比了均匀与空间非均匀背景率的……

t: Estimates cell-wise earthquake count distributions P(n) from 100,000 ETAS simulations using adaptive Gaussian kernel density estimation, handling out-of-range counts via power-law extrapolation of the upper 30% tail, fixed minimum probability, or exclusion.
利用自适应高斯核密度估计从10万次ETAS模拟中估计网格地震数分布P(n)，并通过幂律外推等三种策略处理超范围计数。

CENC catalog of M ≥ 3.0 earthquakes in the China Seismic Experimental Site (1970–1984 auxiliary, 1985–2023 primary), evaluated over 288 monthly windows (2000–2023) across six spatial resolutions and five magnitude thresholds.
采用CSES区域1970–2023年M≥3.0地震目录，在6种空间分辨率和5个震级阈值下开展2000–2023年共288…

Empirical cell count distributions follow P(n) ~ n^{-(1+a)} with a ≈ 1.02 ± 0.23, yielding productivity exponent α = 0.83 ± 0.19. Spatially heterogeneous ETASμ(x,y) outperforms ETASμ in data-rich settings and M ≥ 5 regions.
网格计数服从a≈1.02±0.23的幂律分布，导出生产率指数α=0.83±0.19；ETASμ(x,y)在数据丰富配置及…

Purely ETAS-based models assume stationary background seismicity and lack long-term tectonic loading, while short-term aftershock incompleteness and sparse-count noise degrade parameter stability and model ranking.
纯ETAS模型缺乏长期构造加载物理机制，且强震后短期目录不完备及稀疏计数噪声会影响参数稳定性。

Introduces the AoyuX forecasting platform and systematically quantifies how fat-tail out-of-range probability treatments impact comparative earthquake model ranking, establishing power-law extrapolation as unbiased.
推出AoyuX预测测试平台，系统量化了厚尾超范围概率处理对模型排序的影响，确立了幂律外推的无偏性。

kc: Developed a fat-tail-aware evaluation framework using adaptive Gaussian KDE and power-law tail extrapolation to handle out-of-range earthquake counts without bias.
Implemented the AoyuX online platform and conducted a 25-year (2000–2023) monthly pseudoprospective forecasting experiment in the China Seismic Experimental Site (CSES).
Demonstrated that ETAS with spatially heterogeneous background rates outperforms homogeneous ETAS in data-rich settings and regions with M ≥ 5 earthquakes.
Inferred an independent constraint on the ETAS productivity exponent (α = 0.83 ± 0.19) from empirical power-law scaling of cell-wise earthquake counts (a ≈ 1.02 ± 0.23).
开发了结合自适应高斯核密度估计与幂律尾部外推的厚尾感知评估框架，无偏处理超范围地震计数。
构建了AoyuX在线平台，并在中国地震科学实验场（CSES）开展了25年（2000–2023年）逐月准前瞻性预测实验。
证实了空间非均匀背景率ETAS模型在数据丰富配置及发生M≥5地震活跃区的预测性能优于均匀背景模型。
基于网格地震计数的经验幂律标度率（a ≈ 1.02 ± 0.23），独立约束了ETAS生产率指数（α = 0.83 ± 0.19）。
me: Epidemic-Type Aftershock Sequence (ETAS) modeling comparing constant background rate (ETASμ) and non-parametric spatially variable background rate (ETASμ(x,y)) calibrated via extended Expectation-Maximization.
Adaptive Gaussian kernel density estimation (KDE) with locally varying bandwidths to smooth simulated earthquake count distributions P(n) across 100,000 synthetic catalogs per window.
Comparative tail-treatment evaluation for out-of-range observations using upper 30% power-law extrapolation, fixed minimum probability (1/Nsim^2), and exclusion.
Signal-to-noise diagnostic using the coefficient of variation (CV) of per-window log-likelihood differences to evaluate stability of cumulative information gain (CIG).
采用传染型余震序列（ETAS）模型，通过扩展EM算法校准并对比常数背景率（ETASμ）与非参数空间可变背景率（ETASμ(x,y)）。
利用局部可变带宽的自适应高斯核密度估计（KDE），对每时间窗10万个合成目录的模拟地震计数分布P(n)进行平滑。
针对超范围观测对比三种尾部处理策略：前30%尾部数据幂律外推、固定最小概率（1/Nsim^2）以及直接剔除。
利用单窗口对数似然差的变异系数（CV）作为信噪比诊断工具，评估累积信息增益（CIG）的稳定性。
de: Earthquake catalog with M ≥ 3.0 in the China Seismic Experimental Site (CSES) from 1970 to 2023 provided by CENC (1970–1984 auxiliary, 1985–2023 primary).
288 monthly non-overlapping pseudoprospective forecast windows from January 2000 to December 2023, each generating 100,000 synthetic ETAS catalogs.
Multi-scale evaluation across six geodesic triangular spatial resolutions (195 km² to ~780,000 km²) and five magnitude thresholds (Mt = 3.0 to 5.0).
中国地震台网中心（CENC）提供的1970–2023年中国地震科学实验场（CSES）M≥3.0地震目录（1970–1984年为辅助目录，1985–2023年为主目录）。
2000年1月至2023年12月共288个不重叠的月度准前瞻性预测窗口，每个窗口生成10万个合成ETAS地震目录。
跨越6种测地线三角形空间分辨率（195 km²至约780,000 km²）和5个震级阈值（Mt = 3.0至5.0）的多尺度评估。
li: Purely ETAS-based models assume stationary background seismicity and lack long-term tectonic loading or fault-specific recurrence physics.
Short-term aftershock incompleteness immediately following large earthquakes (e.g., 2008 Wenchuan) can transiently bias ETAS productivity and background parameter estimation.
In sparse-count configurations (high magnitude thresholds or fine spatial grids), stochastic sampling fluctuations dominate cumulative information gain.
纯ETAS模型假设背景地震活动在时空上平稳，未显式包含长期构造加载或断层特定的复发物理机制。
大地震（如2008年汶川地震）后紧接的短期余震目录不完备性会导致ETAS生产率和背景率参数估计产生瞬态偏差。
在稀疏计数配置（高震级阈值或精细空间网格）下，随机抽样波动主导了累积信息增益，掩盖了真实模型差异。

tm.why: The paper evaluates synthetic and observed earthquake catalogs in the China Seismic Experimental Site using statistical ETAS models.
It develops a 25-year pseudoprospective earthquake forecasting experiment and an operational platform (AoyuX) for time-dependent seismic hazard assessment.

ev.notes: Full 61-page manuscript PDF (including all text, equations, 8 figures, and 3 tables) was used as primary evidence.

sum: This paper reports on the first long-term deployment of Güralp Aquarius broadband ocean-bottom seismometers (OBS) by the Canadian National Facility for Seismological Investigations on the Laurentian Fan seismic zone. Deploying 12 OBS at ~4.5 km depth, the study recovered eight instruments with three months of high-quality data. The authors addressed the lack of GPS synchronization using ambient-noise cross-correlation to correct clock drift. They determined sensor orientations and tilt angles using teleseismic P-wave particle motion and noise-based transfer functions. Applying machine-learning phase pickers, they detected 17 local-to-regional earthquakes (up to ML 2.2). Additionally, they identified fin and blue whale vocalizations, demonstrating a hybrid double-difference method to track a blue whale over 58 km. This study highlights the capability of the new OBS facility for both tectonic and marine bioacoustic research.
本文介绍加拿大在劳伦森扇首次长期部署新型OBS的成果。在4.5千米水深获取3个月数据，利用背景噪声互相关校正了时钟漂移并确定仪器方位。通过机器学习检测到17次局部地震（最大震级2.2）。此外，还识别出蓝鲸和长须鲸鸣叫，并利用双差法实现了58千米的蓝鲸追踪。该研究展示了新型OBS在构造与海洋生物声学中……

t: Ambient-noise cross-correlation for clock drift, particle-motion analysis for orientation, noise-based transfer functions for tilt, and machine-learning phase picking for earthquake detection.
利用背景噪声互相关校正时钟，粒子运动确定方位，传递函数估计倾角，机器学习检测地震。
Three months of continuous seismic data from eight recovered Güralp Aquarius broadband OBS deployed at ~4.5 km depth in the Laurentian Fan seismic zone.
在劳伦森扇地震带约4.5千米水深部署并回收的8台OBS获取的为期3个月的连续地震数据。
Corrected a 1.14 s clock drift, determined sensor orientations, detected 17 local-to-regional earthquakes (ML up to 2.2), and tracked a blue whale over 58 km.
校正了1.14秒时钟漂移，检测到17次局部地震（最大2.2级），并追踪了58千米蓝鲸路径。
Limited data duration (three months), incomplete instrument recovery (8 of 12), and reliance on post-processing for clock synchronization.
数据时长有限（3个月），仪器回收不完全（12台仅回收8台），且时钟同步依赖后期处理。
First long-term deployment of Güralp Aquarius OBS, demonstrating dual-use capability for both microearthquake detection and high-resolution marine mammal tracking.
首次长期部署新型OBS，展示了微震检测与海洋哺乳动物追踪的双重能力。

kc: First long-term test and successful recovery of the new Güralp Aquarius broadband OBS by the Canadian National Facility for Seismological Investigations.
Successful correction of clock drift and determination of sensor orientations/tilts using ambient noise and teleseismic data.
Detection of 15 new local-to-regional earthquakes using machine learning-based phase picking.
Demonstration of marine bioacoustic tracking of a blue whale over 58 km using a hybrid double-difference method.
首次对加拿大国家地震研究设施的新型Güralp Aquarius宽频带OBS进行了长期测试与成功回收。
利用背景噪声和远震数据成功校正了时钟漂移并确定了传感器的方位角与倾角。
利用基于机器学习的相位拾取技术检测到15个新的局部至区域地震。
利用混合双差定位法成功实现了对一只蓝鲸58千米路径的海洋生物声学追踪。
me: Ambient-noise cross-correlation for clock drift assessment and correction.
Particle-motion analysis of teleseismic P waves for horizontal component orientation.
Noise-based transfer-function technique for tilt angle estimation.
Machine learning-based phase picking and automated association for earthquake detection.
Double-spectrogram method and hybrid double-pair double-difference method with cross-correlation delay times for whale tracking.
用于时钟漂移评估与校正的背景噪声互相关方法。
用于确定水平分量方位的远震P波粒子运动分析。
用于估计倾角的基于噪声的传递函数技术。
用于地震检测的基于机器学习的相位拾取和自动关联。
用于鲸鱼追踪的双谱图方法以及结合互相关延迟时间的混合双对双差法。
de: Deployment of 12 Güralp Aquarius broadband OBS in the lower Laurentian Fan seismic zone (~4.5 km water depth) from November 2021 to August 2022.
Three months of high-quality continuous seismic data recovered from 8 instruments.
Four teleseismic earthquakes (Mw >= 6.8) used for orientation calibration.
A 24-hour acoustic dataset of blue and fin whale vocalizations (15-25 Hz).
2021年11月至2022年8月在劳伦森扇深海地震带（约4.5千米水深）部署的12台Güralp Aquarius宽频带OBS。
从成功回收的8台仪器中获取的为期3个月的高质量连续地震数据。
用于方位角校准的4个远震地震（Mw >= 6.8）数据。
包含蓝鲸和长须鲸鸣叫（15-25 Hz）的24小时声学数据集。
li: Lack of GPS clock synchronization required post-processing correction using ambient noise.
Only 8 out of 12 deployed OBS were recovered, and only three months of data were suitable for analysis.
Small number of teleseismic events (four) available for orientation estimation.
由于缺乏GPS时钟同步，需要使用背景噪声进行后期处理校正。
部署的12台OBS中仅回收了8台，且仅有3个月的数据适用于分析。
可用于方位角估计的远震事件数量较少（仅4个）。

tm.why: The paper evaluates the first long-term deployment, recovery, and data processing (clock drift, orientation) of Güralp Aquarius broadband ocean-bottom seismometers.
The study applies machine learning-based phase picking and association to detect and locate 17 local-to-regional earthquakes.
The authors perform bioacoustic tracking of fin and blue whales using the OBS array, which falls under environmental seismology.

ev.notes: Analysis is based on the detailed abstract and public metadata since no PDF was available.

sum: This study investigates deep crustal responses to tectonic extension and magmatism in the Datong Basin (northern Shanxi Rift) using a dense array of 586 seismic nodes (~5 km spacing). The authors apply 3D passive-source reverse time migration (PS-RTM) with multichannel singular spectrum analysis (MSSA) to teleseismic P-wave receiver functions from 17 events. The resulting image reveals a segmented Moho interface that uplifts to 38–39 km beneath the basin, compared to a ~40.5 km regional average and 42–44 km beneath surrounding mountains. Statistical analysis shows intraplate seismicity strongly correlates with steep Moho depth gradients (>=0.15, ~8.5 deg dip) near southwestern boundary faults, indicating simple-shear coupling between upper-crustal brittle faulting and lower-crustal ductile thinning. Conversely, enhanced Moho conversion amplitudes in the northeastern volcanic area coincide with lower-crustal low-Vs anomalies and surface basalts, pointing to active magmatic underplating and thermal weakening.
本研究利用586个密集节点台站（间距约5 km）记录的17个远震事件，结合多道奇异谱分析（MSSA）与三维被动源逆时偏移（PS-RTM）方法，对大同盆地P波接收函数进行成像。结果显示盆地下方莫霍面呈分段式隆起（38–39 km），浅于区域平均值（约40.5 km）。统计分析表明，板内地震主要簇集在盆……

t: Applies 3D passive-source reverse time migration (PS-RTM) with a normalized cross-correlation imaging condition to MSSA-regularized teleseismic P-wave receiver functions using two separate acoustic solvers.
对MSSA插值去噪后的远震P波接收函数，采用双声波求解器与归一化互相关成像条件进行三维被动源逆时偏移。
Uses teleseismic waveforms from 17 earthquakes (ML > 5.5, epicentral distance 30–90 degrees) recorded between June and November 2023 by a 586-node array (5 km spacing) across the Datong Basin.
使用大同盆地586个密集节点台阵（间距5 km）在2023年6-11月记录的17个远震波形数据。

Reveals segmented Moho uplift to 38–39 km (regional average ~40.5 km), seismicity clustering where lateral Moho gradients exceed 0.15 (~8.5 deg dip) within 6 km of faults, and strong conversion amplitudes beneath northeastern volcanoes.
发现盆地莫霍面分段隆起至38–39 km，地震簇集于断层附近梯度≥0.15处，东北部火山区转换振幅显著增强。
Cumulative Moho depth uncertainties reach up to ~2.5 km when combining bootstrap resampling (<1 km), 1-D velocity model assumptions, surface elevation, and lateral crustal velocity heterogeneities.
综合速度模型、高程和地壳横向非均匀性等因素，莫霍面深度的累积不确定性最高可达约2.5 km。

First high-resolution 3D wave-equation Moho imaging of the Datong Basin linking steep Moho gradients to fault-controlled seismicity in the southwest and enhanced conversion amplitudes to magmatic underplating in the northeast.
首次获得大同盆地高分辨率三维莫霍面波动方程图像，揭示了西南断层简单剪切减薄与东北岩浆底侵的分段演化机制。

kc: High-resolution 3D Moho topography and conversion amplitude imaging beneath the Datong Basin using dense-array PS-RTM.
Quantitative statistical demonstration that intraplate seismicity clusters along steep Moho depth gradients (>=0.15) near basin-bounding faults.
Identification of spatially segmented rift evolution: fault-driven simple-shear crustal thinning in the southwest versus magmatic underplating in the northeast.
利用密集台阵被动源逆时偏移（PS-RTM）获得了大同盆地高分辨率三维莫霍面形态及转换振幅图像。
通过定量统计证明板内地震优先簇集在盆地边界断层附近的莫霍面深度陡梯度带（≥0.15）。
识别出裂谷演化的空间分段特征：西南部受控于断层相关的简单剪切地壳减薄，东北部则受控于岩浆底侵作用。
me: Iterative time-domain deconvolution to extract teleseismic radial P-wave receiver functions (cutoff ~1.0 Hz).
Multichannel singular spectrum analysis (MSSA) for array wavefield interpolation and denoising.
3D passive-source reverse time migration (PS-RTM) using two separate acoustic solvers for P and Ps wavefields and a normalized cross-correlation imaging condition.
Normalized histogram ratio analysis (Hauksson, 2011) correlating Moho depth and lateral gradients with fault distances and earthquake catalog locations.
采用时间域迭代反褶积提取远震径向P波接收函数（截止频率约1.0 Hz）。
利用多道奇异谱分析（MSSA）进行密集台阵波场插值与去噪。
使用两个独立的声波求解器分别反向传播P波和Ps波场，结合归一化互相关成像条件实现三维被动源逆时偏移（PS-RTM）。
采用归一化直方图比值法定量分析莫霍面深度及横向梯度与断层距离、地震目录空间分布的相关性。
de: Continuous waveforms from a 586-node dense seismic array (~5 km spacing) across the Datong Basin deployed from June to November 2023.
Teleseismic waveforms from 17 high-quality earthquakes (ML > 5.5, epicentral distance 30 to 90 degrees).
Regional earthquake catalog (1970–2025, ML >= 1.0 and ML >= 3.0) from CENC and prior S-wave velocity, magnetotelluric, and Curie depth models.
2023年6月至11月在大同盆地布设的586个密集地震节点台阵（台站间距约5 km）连续波形数据。
17个高质量远震事件波形数据（ML > 5.5，震中距30°–90°）。
中国地震台网中心（CENC）1970–2025年区域地震目录，以及前人S波速度模型、大地电磁和居里深度数据。
li: Acoustic wavefield back-propagation assumes a constant Vp/Vs ratio of 1.85 and empirical density rather than full elastic anisotropic wave propagation.
Cumulative Moho depth uncertainty reaches up to ~2.5 km due to velocity model smoothing, surface elevation, and lateral crustal heterogeneities.
Short deployment duration (6 months) limits the total number of usable teleseismic events to 17.
声波反向传播假设恒定的Vp/Vs比值（1.85）和经验密度关系，未采用完全弹性各向异性波场传播。
受速度模型平滑、地表高程及地壳横向非均匀性影响，莫霍面深度的累积不确定性可达约2.5 km。
密集台阵观测期较短（6个月），限制了可用高质量远震事件的数量（仅17个）。

tm.why: Applies 3D passive-source reverse time migration to teleseismic P-wave receiver functions to image Moho depth and conversion amplitude variations.
Investigates crustal thinning, simple-shear rifting mechanics, and magmatic underplating beneath the intracontinental Datong Basin.

ev.notes: Full 11-page PDF of the Geophysical Research Letters article was analyzed, including all 4 figures, methodology equations, and discussion sections.

sum: The paper develops a simple quasi-static elastic model to investigate the physical mechanisms of slow earthquakes. By incorporating fault elements that are either slipping or locked (with healing-dependent static strength), the model successfully reproduces both the migration patterns of elastic/frictional models and the statistical properties of Brownian models. The simulated events exhibit characteristic recurrence intervals (~1 year), propagation speeds (~10 km/day), and high-frequency decay ($f^{-1}$) consistent with observations. The authors approximate the simulated moment rate functions using a linear birth-death process, providing analytical estimates of equilibrium moment rate and spectral properties. This model successfully bridges the gap between elastic/frictional and Brownian representations of slow slip.
本文开发了一个简单的准静态弹性模型来研究慢地震的物理机制。该模型通过引入具有愈合相关静态强度的滑动或锁定断层单元，成功重现了弹性/摩擦模型的迁移模式以及布朗模型的统计特性。模拟事件具有约1年的复发周期、约10公里/天的传播速度以及符合观测的高频衰减（$f^{-1}$）。作者利用线性生死过程近似模拟的……

t: A simple quasi-static elastic model with discrete fault elements that are either slipping or locked, featuring history-dependent static strength.
一种具有离散断层单元的简单准静态弹性模型，单元呈滑动或具有历史相关静态强度的锁定状态。
Synthetic simulations of slow slip events generated by varying static strength, slip speed, and grid spacing.
通过改变静态强度、滑动速度和网格间距生成的慢滑移事件数值模拟数据。
Simulated events reproduce ~1-year recurrence, ~10 km/day propagation, $f^{-1}$ high-frequency decay, and are analytically approximated via a linear birth-death process.
模拟事件重现了约1年复发、约10公里/天传播及高频衰减，并可通过线性生死过程进行解析近似。
The assumption of a fixed slip speed averages over variable slip velocities, underestimating the observed ratio of squared moment acceleration to moment rate.
固定滑动速度的假设平均了多变的滑动速度，低估了观测到的矩加速度平方与矩率之比。
Bridges the gap between elastic/frictional and Brownian models of slow slip, providing both migration patterns and statistical properties in one framework.
桥接了慢滑移的弹性/摩擦模型与布朗模型，在统一框架下同时提供迁移模式和统计特性。

kc: Developed a simple discrete quasi-static elastic model that bridges elastic/frictional and Brownian models of slow slip.
Reproduced key observational characteristics of slow slip, including migration patterns, recurrence intervals, and high-frequency spectral decay.
Derived analytical estimates for equilibrium moment rate and spectral properties using a linear birth-death process approximation.
开发了一个简单的离散准静态弹性模型，桥接了慢滑移的弹性/摩擦模型与布朗模型。
重现了慢滑移的关键观测特征，包括迁移模式、复发周期和高频谱衰减。
利用线性生死过程近似，推导出了平衡矩率和频谱特征的解析估计。
me: Quasi-static elastic modeling with discrete fault elements (slipping or locked with history-dependent static strength).
Linear birth-death process approximation to model simulated moment rate functions.
Fracture mechanics analytical scaling to estimate propagation speeds and frequencies.
具有离散断层单元（滑动或具有历史相关静态强度的锁定状态）的准静态弹性建模。
利用线性生死过程近似来模拟矩率函数。
利用断裂力学解析标度来估计传播速度和频率。
de: Numerical simulations of slow slip events with varying static strength, slip speed, and grid spacing.
Comparison of simulated moment rate functions and amplitude spectra against Brownian walk models and observations.
对具有不同静态强度、滑动速度和网格间距的慢滑移事件进行数值模拟。
将模拟的矩率函数和振幅谱与布朗游走模型及实际观测进行对比。
li: The model assumes a fixed slip speed, which averages over more variable slip velocities and underestimates the observed ratio of squared moment acceleration to moment rate.
模型假设了固定的滑动速度，这平均了多变的实际滑动速度，低估了观测到的矩加速度平方与矩率之比。

tm.why: The paper develops a physical model to reproduce the migration patterns and statistical properties of slow slip earthquakes.
The model simulates rupture propagation, moment rate functions, and high-frequency spectral decay of slow slip events.

ev.notes: Analysis is based on the detailed abstract and metadata from ESS Open Archive, as the full PDF text was not available.

sum: Slowly sheared granular faults typically accumulate energy and dilate before failing via energy-releasing, compacting avalanches. Using a 2D cylindrical granular fault of ~4,000 photoelastic disks, the authors simultaneously measured driving and resisting torques, layer thickness (dilatancy), acoustic emissions, and grain-scale photoelastic force networks over 100-hour runs. They discovered all four combinations of energy release or storage with contraction or dilation. Counterintuitively, a distinct class of 'negative avalanches' (mode Q4) both dilates the granular layer and increases the elastic energy stored at the resisting boundary. Image and force-chain analyses show that while conventional relaxing events localize slip within the shear band, energy-storing avalanches extend into the jammed region, reorganizing force chains without net force release and producing enhanced acoustic emissions. This demonstrates that avalanches can redistribute stress into more heavily loaded states, offering new insights into fault mechanics and post-event instability.
本研究构建了包含约4000个光弹圆盘的二维颗粒断层实验系统，在100小时的慢速剪切中同步测量了驱动与阻抗扭矩、断层厚度、声发射及颗粒尺度光弹力链网络。研究发现了能量释放或储存与体积收缩或膨胀的全部四种组合模式。最核心的创新发现是存在反直觉的“负雪崩”（Q4模式），它们在引起断层膨胀的同时增加了阻抗边……

t: The authors simultaneously measure driving and resisting forces, vertical displacement at 10 kHz, acoustic emissions across six piezoelectric sensors at 100 kHz, and 24-camera photoelastic images every 4 s, converting all mechanical and acoustic observables into energies.
以10 kHz同步记录驱动与阻抗扭矩及层厚，100 kHz记录6通道声发射，每4秒采集24相机光弹图像并转化为能量。

A monolayer granular fault of ~4,000 3D-printed bidisperse photoelastic disks (4 mm thick) confined between concentric cylinders under a 20 kg load, sheared at 48 mm/h over 100-hour runs capturing ~10^5 mechanical avalanches.
约4000个双分散3D打印光弹圆盘在20 kg载荷下以48 mm/h慢速剪切100小时，捕获约10^5次雪崩。

Avalanches divide into four modes (Q1–Q4); Q4 events dilate the layer while increasing stored mechanical energy, exhibiting 2x smaller shear-band displacements, force rearrangements extending into the jammed region, and higher acoustic energy at small torque changes.
发现四种雪崩模式；Q4模式同时膨胀并增加储能，剪切带位移小一半，力网重组延伸至卡阻区且声能更高。

Quantitative event frequencies and scaling laws may depend on confinement geometry, loading protocol, and detection thresholds, and require testing across independent realizations before extrapolating to natural faults.
事件频率和标度律可能受几何约束、加载协议和检测阈值影响，推广至天然断层前需独立验证。

First experimental demonstration that granular fault avalanches are not purely relaxing or dissipative, but can simultaneously dilate the fault and increase stored elastic energy via force-network reorganization beyond the shear band.
首次实验证明断层雪崩并非纯耗散松弛过程，可通过剪切带外的力链重组同时引起断层膨胀和弹性储能增加。

kc: Simultaneous 100-hour monitoring of boundary torques, dilatancy, acoustic emissions, and photoelastic force networks across ~10^5 mechanical avalanches in a laboratory granular fault.
Identification of four coupled avalanche modes, including counterintuitive 'negative avalanches' (Q4) that both dilate the fault and increase stored mechanical energy.
Demonstration that energy-storing avalanches reorganize force networks into the jammed region beyond the shear band and depart from standard acoustic-mechanical energy scaling.
在实验室颗粒断层中对约10^5次机械雪崩进行了长达100小时的边界扭矩、剪胀、声发射和光弹力网同步监测。
识别出四种耦合雪崩模式，包括反直觉的“负雪崩”（Q4），其同时引起断层膨胀和机械储能增加。
证明储能型雪崩将力链网络重组延伸至剪切带外的卡阻区，并偏离常规的声学-机械能量标度律。
me: Synchronized multi-modal acquisition of driving/resisting torques and layer dilation (10 kHz), 6-sensor acoustic emissions (100 kHz), and 24-camera panoramic photoelastic imaging (0.5 Hz).
Classification of avalanches into four quadrants (Q1-Q4) based on the joint signs of resisting elastic energy change (ΔE_grains) and vertical potential energy change (ΔE_h).
Grain-scale kinematic tracking via Hough transform and pattern matching, combined with in-situ calibrated photoelastic contact force network reconstruction.
同步多模态采集驱动/阻抗扭矩与层厚膨胀（10 kHz）、6传感器声发射（100 kHz）以及24相机全景光弹图像（0.5 Hz）。
根据阻抗弹性能力变化（ΔE_grains）和垂直势能变化（ΔE_h）的联合符号将雪崩分为四个象限（Q1-Q4）。
结合霍夫变换与模式匹配的颗粒尺度运动追踪，以及原位标定的光弹接触力网络重构。
de: Quasi-static shear experiments on a monolayer of ~4,000 bidisperse 3D-printed photoelastic disks confined between concentric cylinders under a 20 kg dead load and sheared at 48 mm/h.
Open-access catalog of ~4×10^5 acoustic bursts, 10^5 mechanical avalanches, and 2×10^4 discrete displacement events (LabQuakes150 dataset on OSF).
在20 kg恒定载荷和48 mm/h剪切速率下，对同心圆柱间约4000个双分散3D打印光弹圆盘单层进行准静态剪切实验。
包含约4×10^5次声发射爆发、10^5次机械雪崩和2×10^4次离散位移事件的开源目录（OSF上的LabQuakes150数据集）。
li: Quantitative event frequencies and scaling relations may depend on confinement geometry, loading protocol, and detection thresholds, requiring validation across independent realizations.
No systematic precursor signature was found to distinguish between avalanche classes prior to failure when signal fluctuations are considered.
定量的事件频率和标度关系可能依赖于约束几何、加载协议和检测阈值，需在独立实验中验证。
考虑信号波动时，未发现可在破裂前区分不同雪崩类别的系统性前兆特征。

tm.why: The paper investigates granular fault mechanics in the laboratory, showing how avalanches can dilate the fault and increase stored elastic energy via force-chain reorganization.
It examines the energy budget, acoustic emission scaling, and structural slip localization of laboratory earthquake analogs during stick-slip instabilities.

ev.notes: Full 29-page PDF including main text (pp. 1-16) and Supplementary Materials (pp. 17-29) was read and analyzed.

sum: How submerged oceanic or cratonic domains become stable subaerial continental interiors remains debated. Focusing on the late Paleozoic Tarim Basin in Central Asia, this study demonstrates a surface-process-mediated pathway for ocean-to-continent transformation without requiring major horizontal shortening or mantle plumes. Using 2D thermomechanical subduction simulations (Underworld2) to drive landscape-evolution simulations (Badlands), along with a two-way coupled verification test, the authors show that subduction generates uplift in surrounding orogenic belts while depressing the central block. Strong topographic gradients drive intense erosion and riverine sediment transport, filling the 4-km-deep paleo-Tarim Sea within ~13 Myr. Based on active-source seismic constraints on Devonian–Carboniferous carbonate thicknesses (~1000 m), this enclosed, high-sedimentation basin sequestered ~1.75 × 10^15 kg of CO2 (~220 ppmv gross drawdown), amplifying late Paleozoic global cooling. This highlights deep-Earth, surface erosion, and carbon-cycle coupling during continent assembly.
针对被困海洋或克拉通块体如何转化为稳定陆内盆地的问题，本文提出了一种由地表过程介导的洋陆转换新机制。研究结合二维热力学俯冲数值模拟（Underworld2）与地表景观演化模拟（Badlands），并结合塔里木盆地泥盆-石炭系碳酸盐岩地震剖面厚度数据开展分析。结果表明，俯冲作用使周缘造山带隆升而中央块……

t: A two-step numerical modeling framework uses 2D thermomechanical subduction simulations (Underworld2) to generate tectonic uplift rates that drive 3D landscape-evolution simulations of erosion and basin sedimentation (Badlands), validated by a two-way coupled experiment.
采用两步数值模拟：利用二维热力学俯冲模拟生成的隆升率驱动三维景观演化与沉积模拟，并通过双向耦合实验验证。

Carbon sequestration is calculated using Devonian–Permian sedimentary sequences in the 5.3 × 10^5 km^2 Tarim Basin, with Devonian–Carboniferous carbonate thicknesses (~1000 m) constrained by active-source seismic profiles and stratigraphic records.
利用主动源地震剖面和地层记录约束的塔里木盆地泥盆-石炭系碳酸盐岩厚度（约1000米）计算碳封存量。

Erosion from uplifted surrounding mountains fills the 4-km-deep paleo-Tarim Sea to above sea level in ~13 Myr (at 2.8 × 10^11 kg yr^-1), and Devonian–Carboniferous carbonates sequester ~1.75 × 10^15 kg CO2 (~220 ppmv drawdown).
周缘山脉侵蚀在约13 Myr内填满4 km深的古塔里木海，泥盆-石炭系碳酸盐岩封存约1.75×10^15 kg CO2（…

Simulations neglect orographic precipitation asymmetry, and the ~220 ppmv carbon burial estimate (spanning 113–522 ppmv) represents gross burial without subtracting oxidative weathering or metamorphic degassing CO2 fluxes.
忽略了地形降水非对称性，且~220 ppmv仅为总埋藏估算，未扣除氧化风化和变质脱气释放的CO2。

Demonstrates an alternative surface-process-mediated pathway for ocean-to-continent conversion where peripheral subduction uplift and erosion stabilize trapped basins and drive durable intracontinental carbon sequestration.
提出由俯冲周缘隆升与地表侵蚀沉积介导的被困盆地洋陆转换及陆内持久碳封存新机制。

kc: Identifies a surface-process-mediated pathway for ocean-to-continent conversion in trapped basins (such as the late Paleozoic Tarim Basin) without requiring large horizontal shortening or plume activity.

Combines 2D thermomechanical subduction models (Underworld2) and 3D landscape evolution models (Badlands) in both sequential and two-way coupled frameworks to quantify basin shoaling timescales (~13 Myr).

Quantifies late Paleozoic carbon sequestration in the Devonian–Carboniferous Tarim carbonate sequences at ~1.75 × 10^15 kg CO2 (~220 ppmv drawdown), linking intracontinental basin infill to global cooling.
提出了无需大规模水平缩短或地幔柱活动的、由地表侵蚀沉积过程介导的被困盆地（如晚古生代塔里木盆地）洋陆转换新途径。
结合二维热力学俯冲模型（Underworld2）和三维景观演化模型（Badlands）进行单向和双向耦合模拟，量化了盆地变浅成陆的时间尺度（约13 Myr）。
量化了塔里木泥盆-石炭系碳酸盐岩序列的碳封存量（约1.75×10^15 kg CO2，合~220 ppmv大气浓度下降），将陆内盆地沉积填充与全球变冷相联系。
me: 2D finite-element marker-in-cell thermomechanical subduction modeling using Underworld2 with visco-plastic rheology.
3D surface-process and landscape evolution modeling (fluvial incision, hillslope creep, marine diffusion) using Badlands driven by geodynamic uplift rates.
Two-way coupled geodynamic–surface-process testing exchanging free-surface displacements and eroded/deposited mass loads every 10 kyr.
Geological mass-balance calculation of mineralized CO2 storage from carbonate rock volume, density, mineral fraction, and mineralization efficiency.
使用Underworld2程序和粘塑性流变学开展二维有限元质点网格法（marker-in-cell）热力学俯冲数值模拟。
利用地球动力学隆升速率驱动Badlands三维地表过程与景观演化模拟（包含河流下切、坡面蠕变和海洋扩散）。
开展每10 kyr交换自由表面位移与侵蚀/沉积质量载荷的地球动力学-地表过程双向耦合检验实验。
基于碳酸盐岩体积、密度、矿物比例及矿化效率的矿化CO2封存量地质质量平衡计算。
de: Paleogeographic reconstructions and Paleodigital Elevation Models (PaleoDEMS) of the Tarim block and Eurasia during the Paleozoic.
Stratigraphic records and active-source seismic profile thickness constraints (~1000 m average for Devonian–Carboniferous layers across 5.3 × 10^5 km^2 in the Tarim Basin).
Numerical sensitivity experiments varying lithospheric thermal age (100–300 Myr), erodibility coefficient (10^-8 to 10^-6 yr^-1), precipitation rate, initial basin geometry, and elastic thickness.
古生代塔里木块体及欧亚大陆的古地理重建与古数字高程模型（PaleoDEMS）数据。
塔里木盆地地层记录与主动源地震剖面沉积物厚度约束（5.3×10^5 km^2面积内泥盆-石炭系平均厚度约1000 m）。
改变岩石圈热年龄（100–300 Myr）、可蚀性系数（10^-8至10^-6 yr^-1）、降水率、初始盆地几何形态和有效弹性厚度的数值敏感性实验。
li: The surface-process simulations assume spatially uniform, time-constant rainfall and neglect asymmetric orographic precipitation gradients.

The carbon burial calculation (~220 ppmv gross drawdown, 113–522 ppmv plausible range) only estimates the burial flux and does not quantitatively model opposing CO2 release from oxidative weathering of petrogenic carbon or metamorphic degassing.
Main quantitative results rely on idealized one-way sequential forcing rather than fully 3D two-way thermomechanical-landscape coupling.
地表过程模拟假设降雨在空间上均匀且随时间恒定，忽略了非对称地形降水梯度的影响。
碳埋藏计算（粗略下降约220 ppmv，合理范围113–522 ppmv）仅估算了总埋藏通量，未定量模拟岩石有机碳氧化风化或变质脱气释放的反向CO2通量。
主要定量结果依赖于理想化的单向顺序驱动方案，而非完全三维的双向热力学-地表过程耦合。

tm.why: The paper uses 2D thermomechanical geodynamic modeling of subduction and lithospheric evolution coupled with landscape surface-process modeling to investigate the ocean-to-continent transformation of the Tarim block.

ev.notes: Full 11-page article PDF analyzed in detail, including main text, 4 figures, equations, and Methods section.

sum: Vertical migration of CO2 in layered sandstone reservoirs is governed by thin shale barriers with uncertain properties. This paper presents a Bayesian inversion framework combining a fast graph-based invasion-percolation (IP) simulator with Approximate Bayesian Computation and Sequential Monte Carlo (ABC-SMC) to infer effective shale threshold pressures and post-breakthrough mobility from time-lapse seismic plume outlines. Unlike conventional quasi-static IP models, the proposed simulator incorporates finite-rate vertical transfer across breached barriers and uses precomputed structural trap graphs, achieving a 40x speedup in the quasi-static limit. Applied to 2010 and 2023 seismic observations from the Sleipner storage site, the finite-rate model reproduces the vertical distribution and temporal evolution of CO2 across nine sand units, whereas a quasi-static model fails. Synthetic experiments on a four-layer reservoir further demonstrate that parameter recovery and forecast certainty strongly depend on capturing barrier breakthrough events and accurately specifying seismic detection thresholds.
层状砂岩储层中CO2的垂向运移受控于性质未知的薄泥岩隔层。本文提出一种贝叶斯反演框架，将快速图侵入逾渗（IP）模拟器与近似贝叶斯计算及序贯蒙特卡洛（ABC-SMC）结合，利用时移地震羽流轮廓推断有效泥岩突破压力和突破后流度。不同于传统准静态IP模型，该模拟器引入了隔层有限速率垂向传输并预计算圈闭图，……

t: Spill-point analysis reduces reservoir surfaces to reusable trap graphs, while finite-rate vertical transfer across shales is inferred from binary seismic plume outlines via ABC-SMC using area fractions and spatial moments.
利用溢出点分析将储层简化为圈闭图，结合有限速率传输与ABC-SMC，从二值地震羽流轮廓中反演隔层参数。
Evaluated on Sleipner seismic monitoring data from 2010 and 2023 across nine sand units (65x119 grid), plus a synthetic four-layer Gaussian random field reservoir.
使用Sleipner场地2010和2023年9个砂层的地震监测数据（65×119网格），以及4层高斯随机场合成储层模型。

The graph-based kernel achieves a 40x quasi-static speedup (7.09 ms vs 288 ms) and 64.2 ms finite-rate runtime, accurately reproducing Sleipner's 2010–2023 vertical plume evolution where quasi-static models fail.
图内核在准静态下提速40倍（7.09 ms），有限速率耗时64.2 ms，成功重现了准静态模型无法拟合的Sleipner…

The simulator neglects imbibition, residual trapping, and localized feeders, while uncertain shale topography and misspecified seismic detection thresholds introduce lateral mismatches and parameter bias.
未考虑吸液、残余圈闭和局部优势通道；泥岩地形误差与地震检测阈值设定偏差会导致侧向错位和参数偏差。
Combines a fast graph-based multilayer invasion-percolation simulator featuring finite-rate barrier transfer with likelihood-free ABC-SMC inversion of time-lapse seismic plume outlines.
将含有限速率隔层传输的快速图多层侵入逾渗模拟器与时移地震羽流轮廓的无似然ABC-SMC反演相结合。

kc: Developed an efficient graph-based multilayer invasion-percolation (IP) simulator incorporating finite-rate vertical migration across shale barriers, achieving a 40x speedup over cell-by-cell implementation in the quasi-static limit.

Formulated a likelihood-free Bayesian inversion workflow using ABC-SMC and low-dimensional plume-outline summary statistics to estimate barrier threshold pressures and mobility from time-lapse seismic data.

Demonstrated on real Sleipner data (2010 and 2023) and synthetic models that finite-rate transfer is essential to reproduce multilayer temporal CO2 redistribution and that monitoring value is event-dependent.
开发了结合泥岩隔层有限速率垂向运移的高效图多层侵入逾渗（IP）模拟器，在准静态极限下比逐网格实现快约40倍。
构建了基于ABC-SMC和低维羽流轮廓统计量的无似然贝叶斯反演流程，从时移地震数据中估计隔层突破压力和流度。
在Sleipner真实数据（2010与2023年）和合成模型上证明了有限速率传输对重现多层CO2时间演化的必要性，且监测价值依赖于所捕获的突破事件。
me: Spill-point analysis to reduce 3D reservoir shale topographies into reusable directed graphs of structural traps and lateral spill paths.
Finite-rate Darcy-like vertical transfer law across breached shale barriers driven by buoyancy pressure exceeding capillary threshold pressure.
Approximate Bayesian Computation with Sequential Monte Carlo (ABC-SMC) using footprint area fractions and spatial first moments as summary statistics.
利用溢出点分析将三维储层泥岩起伏简化为可复用的构造圈闭和侧向溢出路径有向图。
建立由超过毛细管阈值压力的浮力驱动的、穿过破裂泥岩隔层的有限速率达西型垂向传输定律。
采用以羽流面积分数和空间一阶矩为汇总统计量的近似贝叶斯计算与序贯蒙特卡洛（ABC-SMC）进行无似然推断。
de: Real-world application to the Sleipner CO2 storage site using 9 shale surfaces and seismic plume outlines from 2010 (Sleipner 2019 Benchmark Model) and 2023 (derived from FWI).

Synthetic 4-layer Gaussian random field (GRF) reservoir experiments testing parameter recovery, 50-year forecasting, monitoring duration (10 vs 16 years), quasi-static vs finite-rate model misspecification, and seismic detection thresholds (0, 3, 8 m).
在Sleipner CO2封存场地的实际应用，使用9个泥岩界面以及2010年（Sleipner 2019基准模型）和2023年（源自全波形反演）的地震羽流轮廓。
合成4层高斯随机场（GRF）储层实验，测试参数恢复、50年预测、监测时长（10年与16年）、准静态与有限速率模型设定误差以及地震检测阈值（0、3、8米）敏感性。
li: The IP simulator only models drainage (neglecting imbibition, residual trapping, brine pressure, and back-pressure) and assumes spatially uniform effective barrier properties without localized feeder chimneys.

Errors in seismic-derived shale topography cause lateral mismatches between simulated traps and observed plume outlines, and misspecifying the minimum detectable column height biases parameter estimates.
IP模拟器仅模拟排驱过程（忽略吸液、残余圈闭、盐水压力和背压），且假设隔层有效属性空间均匀，未包含局部优势运移通道。
地震反演的泥岩地形误差导致模拟圈闭与观测羽流轮廓存在侧向错位，且最小可检测柱高的设定误差会导致参数估计偏差。

tm.why: The paper develops an Approximate Bayesian Computation with Sequential Monte Carlo (ABC-SMC) framework to infer barrier parameters and quantify forecast uncertainty.
The core focus is a likelihood-free inverse problem estimating effective migration parameters from time-lapse seismic plume outlines.

ev.notes: Full 24-page arXiv preprint PDF analyzed, including main text, equations, Sleipner case study, synthetic experiments, and Appendices A and B.

sum: This study develops an analytical geometric framework to estimate Earth figure change (EFC) parameters from global GNSS vertical velocity fields, focusing on the degree-2 zonal spherical harmonic coefficient (F20) representing solid Earth flattening change. The method decomposes F20 into weighted global averages of polar and equatorial radial deformation rates, mitigating aliasing errors common in truncated least-squares inversions. Synthetic tests with four Glacial Isostatic Adjustment (GIA) models quantify gridding biases caused by uneven and evolving ITRF station distributions. Applied to 886 ITRF2014/ITRF2020 GNSS stations from 1997 to 2015, the framework reveals an acceleration in polar uplift (rising from ~0.5 to ~1.0 mm/yr) and concurrent equatorial subsidence, yielding an F20 acceleration of ~0.4 mm/yr/decade. Mapping non-GIA vertical displacements to J2 rates via an elastic PREM loading framework shows an accelerating positive J2 rate (~9 × 10^-12 yr^-2), demonstrating physical consistency between geometric crustal deformation and gravimetric oblateness trends.
本研究建立了一个解析几何框架，利用全球GNSS垂直速度场估计地球形状变化（EFC）参数，重点关注表征固体地球扁率变化的二阶带谐系数（F20）。该方法将F20分解为极地和赤道径向形变率的加权全球平均值，减轻了截断最小二乘反演中的混叠误差。基于四个冰川均衡调整（GIA）模型的合成测试量化了由不均匀且演化……

t: The degree-2 zonal coefficient (F20) of Earth figure change is estimated stepwise from the difference between co-latitude weighted polar and equatorial global averages of gridded GNSS vertical velocities.
通过对网格化GNSS垂直速度进行余纬加权的极地和赤道全球平均，分步估计地球形状变化的二阶带谐系数（F20）。
Global vertical velocities from 886 quality-filtered GNSS stations (mostly ITRF2014 plus 8 polar ITRF2020 sites, with 43 multi-velocity sites) spanning 1997–2015, alongside 4 GIA velocity models.
1997—2015年间886个经质量筛选的GNSS台站（主要为ITRF2014及8个ITRF2020极地站）垂直速度，以…

Polar uplift increased from ~0.5 to ~1.0 mm/yr over 1997–2015 with comparable equatorial subsidence, yielding an F20 acceleration of ~0.4 mm/yr/decade and an elastic J2 acceleration of 9 × 10^-12 yr^-2.
1997—2015年间极地隆升从~0.5增至~1.0 mm/yr，伴随相当的赤道沉降，F20加速度约0.4 mm/yr/…
Assuming a purely elastic Earth response for non-GIA deformation and uncertainties in GIA model viscosity structures likely bias the inferred elastic J2 rates toward larger values.
对非GIA形变假设纯弹性地球响应以及GIA模型粘度结构的不确定性，可能导致推导的J2变化率偏大。

Develops an analytical decomposition of F20 into polar and equatorial radial deformation rates, avoiding multi-harmonic least-squares aliasing and explicitly quantifying time-varying network gridding biases.
将F20解析分解为极地和赤道径向形变率，避免了多谐波最小二乘混叠，并明确量化了时变台网网格化偏差。

kc: Formulated a closed-form stepwise estimator linking polar and equatorial radial deformation rates directly to the degree-2 zonal coefficient of solid Earth figure change.
Quantified spatial sampling and interpolation biases across evolving GNSS network geometries using synthetic vertical land motion fields from four GIA models.
Detected an accelerating reduction in solid Earth flattening (~0.4 mm/yr/decade) over 1997–2015 from ITRF2014/ITRF2020 GNSS vertical velocities, driven by contemporary polar ice mass loss.
Demonstrated physical compatibility between decreasing solid Earth geometric flattening and increasing geoid oblateness (J2) using an elastic surface loading conversion.
建立了闭式分步估计器，将极地和赤道径向形变率直接与固体地球形状变化的二阶带谐系数联系起来。
利用四个GIA模型的合成垂直地表运动场，量化了随时间演化的GNSS台网几何结构中的空间采样和插值偏差。
基于1997—2015年ITRF2014/2020 GNSS垂直速度，检测到由当代极地冰质量损失驱动的固体地球扁率加速减小（约0.4 mm/yr/decade）。
利用弹性表面负荷转换，证明了固体地球几何扁率减小与大地水准面扁率（J2）增加之间的物理相容性。
me: Spherical harmonic decomposition of the global vertical velocity field into polar and equatorial scale rate parameters via fractional integral estimators.

Triangulation-based spatial interpolation (nearest-neighbor, linear, natural-neighbor, cubic) of scattered station velocities onto a 1° × 1° global grid with zero-mean mass conservation normalization.
Synthetic error propagation using four GIA models (JPL2019, ICE-6G_C, ICE-7G_NA, LM17.3) sampled at yearly active ITRF station configurations.
Elastic Earth loading mapping using PREM degree-2 load Love numbers to translate non-GIA vertical deformation rates into incremental J2 gravity rates.
通过分数积分估计器将全球垂直速度场球谐分解为极地和赤道尺度速率参数。
基于三角剖分的空间插值（最近邻、线性、自然邻、三次插值），将离散台站速度插值到1°×1°全球网格并进行零均值归一化。
利用四个GIA模型（JPL2019、ICE-6G_C、ICE-7G_NA、LM17.3）在每年活跃ITRF台站配置下进行合成误差传播分析。
利用PREM二阶负荷勒夫数进行弹性地球负荷映射，将非GIA垂直形变率转化为增量J2重力变化率。
de: Vertical velocities from 886 GNSS stations primarily from ITRF2014, supplemented by 8 polar stations from ITRF2020 (Alaska, Greenland, western Antarctica) over 1997–2015.
Subset of 43 GNSS stations with segmented piece-wise linear vertical velocities capturing nonlinear accelerating deformation.
Global 1° × 1° vertical land motion grids from four GIA models: JPL2019, ICE-6G_C (VM5a), ICE-7G_NA (VM7), and LM17.3 (VM5a).
1997—2015年间主要来自ITRF2014的886个GNSS台站垂直速度数据，并补充了8个ITRF2020极地台站（阿拉斯加、格陵兰、西南极洲）。
包含43个具有分段线性垂直速度估计的GNSS台站子集，用于捕捉非线性加速形变。
来自四个GIA模型的全球1°×1°垂直地表运动网格：JPL2019、ICE-6G_C (VM5a)、ICE-7G_NA (VM7) 和 LM17.3 (VM5a)。
li: Heterogeneous and time-varying spatial distribution of global GNSS stations introduces systematic positive biases (up to ~0.4 mm/yr) and artificial temporal drifts (~0.2 mm/yr/decade) during gridding.

The mapping of non-GIA vertical displacements to J2 rates assumes a purely elastic Earth response, neglecting contemporary viscoelastic mantle relaxation and uncertainties in GIA model viscosity structures.
The spherical harmonic formulation assumes stations lie on a constant-radius reference sphere, neglecting station elevation variations (though the induced bias is <0.01 mm/yr).
全球GNSS台站不均匀且随时间变化的空间分布会在网格化过程中引入系统性正偏差（高达~0.4 mm/yr）和人为时间漂移（~0.2 mm/yr/decade）。
将非GIA垂直位移映射为J2变化率时假设了纯弹性地球响应，忽略了当代粘弹性地幔松弛以及GIA模型粘度结构的不确定性。
球谐公式假设台站位于恒定半径参考球面上，忽略了台站高程变化（尽管由此引起的偏差小于0.01 mm/yr）。

tm.why: The paper investigates long-wavelength radial deformation of the solid Earth and its figure change driven by glacial isostatic adjustment and contemporary surface mass redistribution.

ev.notes: Full 23-page PDF analyzed, including mathematical derivations, synthetic GIA tests, ITRF2014/2020 GNSS inversion results, and all 8 figures and 6 tables.

sum: This study investigates crustal anisotropy and deformation mechanisms in the southern South China Block (SCB) using receiver-function Pms splitting. Analyzing teleseismic waveforms from 250 broadband seismic stations (including 162 HAVESArray portable stations), the authors obtain reliable anisotropy parameters at 216 stations. The results reveal an overall WNW-ESE fast axis orientation (FAO) with significant regional variations. In the eastern Cathaysian block, NW-SE FAOs reflect tectonic extension from Paleo-Pacific subduction. In the Leizhou peninsula, a transition in FAO suggests horizontal flow from the Hainan mantle plume. The western Cathaysian block shows conjugate NW-SE and NE-SW FAOs linked to faulting and Indian plate subduction, while Hainan Island exhibits E-W FAOs aligned with major local faults. This work provides high-resolution constraints on crustal deformation in a complex tectonic junction.
本研究利用接收函数Pms分裂方法，分析了华南南部250个台站的远震波形，获得216个台站的壳内各向异性特征。结果显示，该区整体快轴方向为WNW-ESE，但区域差异显著：华夏东部受古太平洋俯冲伸展影响呈NW-SE向；雷州半岛记录了海南地幔柱水平流动；华夏西部受共轭断裂及印度俯冲影响呈双向特征；海南岛则……

t: The study applies the receiver-function method based on Pms splitting to teleseismic waveforms to measure crustal anisotropy parameters.
该研究利用基于Pms分裂的接收函数方法分析远震波形，以测量地壳各向异性参数。
Teleseismic waveforms recorded at 250 broadband seismic stations, including 162 HAVESArray portable stations and 88 provincial permanent stations in the southern South China Block.
记录于华南板块南部250个宽频带台站（含162个流动台和88个固定台）的远震波形数据。

Reliable anisotropy results at 216 stations reveal an overall WNW-ESE fast axis orientation, with distinct regional variations reflecting Paleo-Pacific subduction, Hainan plume flow, and local faulting.
216个台站的可靠结果显示整体快轴方向为WNW-ESE，其区域差异反映了古太平洋俯冲、海南地幔柱及局部断裂的影响。
The Pms splitting method provides a vertically integrated measurement of crustal anisotropy, potentially masking depth-dependent variations within the crust.
Pms分裂方法提供的是地壳各向异性的垂直积分测量，可能掩盖了壳内随深度变化的特征。
Utilizes a dense temporary array (HAVESArray) to provide unprecedented spatial resolution of crustal anisotropy and deformation mechanisms across the southern South China Block.
利用高密度流动台网（HAVESArray）提供了华南板块南部前所未有的高空间分辨率壳内各向异性与变形机制约束。

kc: Provides a high-density crustal anisotropy map of the southern South China Block using 250 broadband stations.
Identifies distinct crustal deformation domains influenced by the Paleo-Pacific subduction, Indian subduction, and Hainan mantle plume.
Links fast axis orientations to both tectonic fault strikes and deep mantle plume flow.
利用250个宽频带台站提供了华南板块南部高密度的壳内各向异性图景。
识别出受古太平洋俯冲、印度俯冲及海南地幔柱影响的不同地壳变形分区。
将快轴方向与区域构造断裂走向及深部地幔柱流动建立了联系。
me: Receiver-function analysis of teleseismic waveforms.
Pms splitting measurement to determine crustal anisotropy parameters (fast-axis orientation and splitting delay time).
远震波形的接收函数分析。
基于Pms分裂测量确定壳内各向异性参数（快轴方向和分裂延迟时间）。
de: Teleseismic waveform data recorded at 250 broadband seismic stations in the southern South China Block.
Includes 162 HAVESArray portable stations and 88 provincial permanent stations, yielding reliable results at 216 stations.
华南板块南部250个宽频带地震台站记录的远震波形数据。
包括162个HAVESArray流动台站和88个省级固定台站，在216个台站获得了可靠结果。
li: Pms splitting represents an integrated effect of crustal anisotropy, which may lack vertical resolution within the crust.
Station coverage might still be sparse in certain complex fault zones or offshore areas.
Pms分裂代表壳内各向异性的积分效应，可能缺乏地壳内部的垂直分辨率。
在某些复杂断裂带或近海区域的台站覆盖可能仍显不足。

tm.why: The paper directly investigates crustal anisotropy using receiver-function Pms splitting.
The core methodology is the receiver-function method based on Pms splitting.
The study interprets crustal deformation mechanisms and tectonic evolution of the South China Block.

ev.notes: No PDF was available. The analysis is based on the detailed abstract and public metadata.

sum: This study presents the first 3D shear-wave velocity (Vs) model of the crust and upper mantle (down to 50 km) beneath Tenerife Island derived from teleseismic P-to-S receiver functions. Using >785 teleseismic events recorded across 20 broadband stations (2017–2024), the authors compute 12,147 receiver functions via multiple-taper correlation and invert them with a Bayesian transdimensional reversible-jump McMC algorithm. The interpolated 3D Vs model is combined with petrological constraints in MAGEMin to estimate melt mass fractions via Gibbs-energy minimization. Results delineate a ~10 km thick high-Vs (4.5–5.5 km/s) oceanic crust overlying a heterogeneous magmatic underplating layer hosting four low-velocity zones (M1–M4, Vs down to 1.6 km/s) between 10 and 30 km depth. Melt fractions reach 50–79 wt%, with M1 containing up to 218 km³ of >50 wt% melt. Local seismicity clusters above these anomalies, indicating volatile release into the shallower hydrothermal system.
本研究利用20个宽频带台站记录的785余次远震事件（2017–2024），通过多锥度相关法计算了12,147条P-S接收函数，并结合跨维贝叶斯反演构建了特内里费岛地下50 km深度的首个三维横波速度（Vs）模型。结合岩石学数据与MAGEMin热力学模拟估算了熔体质量分数。结果显示约10 km厚的高速……

t: Multiple-taper correlation deconvolves teleseismic P-to-S receiver functions, which are inverted for 1D Vs profiles via Bayesian transdimensional rj-McMC, interpolated in 3D via IDW, and coupled with MAGEMin Gibbs-energy minimization for melt fraction.
采用多锥度相关提取远震接收函数，经跨维贝叶斯反演与三维IDW插值，结合MAGEMin热力学模拟计算熔体分数。
More than 785 teleseismic events (Mw >= 5.5, 30°–90° distance) recorded by 20 broadband stations on Tenerife (2017–2024), producing 12,147 radial receiver functions filtered at 0.2–0.5 Hz.
特内里费岛20个宽频带台站（2017–2024）记录的785余次远震（Mw≥5.5），在0.2–0.5 Hz频段生成12…
Revealed a ~10 km thick high-Vs (4.5–5.5 km/s) oceanic crust over an underplating zone containing four LVZs (M1–M4, Vs down to 1.6 km/s) at 10–30 km depth with melt fractions reaching 50–79 wt%.
揭示约10 km厚高速洋壳覆盖于岩浆底侵带之上，10–30 km处存在四个低速体（Vs低至1.6 km/s），熔体分数达…
The 0.2–0.5 Hz bandpass filter lowers shallow crustal vertical resolution, while 3D lateral resolution is governed by station distribution and spacing.
0.2–0.5 Hz滤波降低了浅地壳垂向分辨率，三维横向分辨率受限于台站分布间距。
First 3D crustal and upper-mantle Vs model (to 50 km) beneath Tenerife using transdimensional RF inversion integrated with thermodynamic melt fraction modeling.
首次结合跨维接收函数反演与热力学模拟构建特内里费岛50 km深度的三维Vs与熔体分布模型。

kc: Constructed the first 3D Vs model of the crust and upper mantle down to 50 km beneath Tenerife using Bayesian transdimensional receiver function inversion.
Identified a shallow (~10 km) oceanic Moho marked by a velocity decrease into a heterogeneous magmatic underplating zone with four primary low-velocity anomalies (M1–M4).
Quantified local melt fractions up to 79 wt% (and volumes up to 218 km³ with >50 wt% melt in M1) by coupling Vs models with MAGEMin thermodynamic modeling.
Linked deep magma accumulation and degassing at the crust-underplating interface to post-2016 volcano-tectonic/hybrid seismic swarms and surface degassing.
利用跨维贝叶斯接收函数反演，构建了特内里费岛地下50 km深度范围内的首个三维横波速度（Vs）模型。
识别出约10 km深的浅部洋壳莫霍面，其下方为速度降低的非均质岩浆底侵带及四个主要低速异常体（M1–M4）。
将Vs模型与MAGEMin热力学模拟结合，量化出局部熔体质量分数最高达79 wt%（M1中熔体>50 wt%的体积达218 km³）。
将洋壳-底侵界面的深部岩浆聚集与脱气过程同2016年以来的火山地震群及地表脱气增强联系起来。
me: Multiple-taper correlation (MTC) deconvolution in the frequency domain (0.2–0.5 Hz bandpass) with median filtering and back-azimuthal stacking.
Bayesian transdimensional reversible-jump Markov Chain Monte Carlo (rj-McMC) 1D Vs profile inversion exploring 10^6 models per station.
3D Inverse-Distance-Weighting (IDW, power of 2) interpolation onto a 50 x 50 x 50 grid (~1 km spacing).
Thermodynamic Gibbs-energy minimization using MAGEMin across a 3-layer petrological model (oceanic crust, cumulate pyroxenite underplating, peridotitic mantle) to estimate melt mass fractions.
采用0.2–0.5 Hz带通滤波的频域多锥度相关（MTC）反褶积技术，结合中值滤波与反方位角叠加提取接收函数。
应用跨维贝叶斯可逆跳转马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（rj-McMC）算法进行一维Vs剖面反演，每个台站搜索10^6个模型。
利用反距离加权法（IDW，幂次为2）将一维剖面插值到间距约1 km的50×50×50三维网格。
基于三层岩石学模型（洋壳、辉石岩底侵层、橄榄岩上地幔），利用MAGEMin进行吉布斯自由能最小化热力学模拟以估算熔体质量分数。
de: Teleseismic waveforms from >785 events (Mw >= 5.5, epicentral distance 30°–90°) recorded between October 2017 and January 2024.
20 broadband seismic stations on Tenerife (19 from INVOLCAN network C7, 1 MACI station from IGN), yielding 12,147 radial receiver functions.
Synthetic resolution tests under realistic noise conditions confirming ~1 km average vertical resolution.
Comparison with local earthquake catalog hypocenters and bulk geochemical compositions from Tenerife/Canary Islands petrological literature.
2017年10月至2024年1月期间记录的785余次远震事件波形（震级Mw≥5.5，震中距30°–90°）。
特内里费岛上的20个宽频带地震台站（19个属INVOLCAN C7台网，1个属IGN的MACI台站），共生成12,147条径向接收函数。
在真实噪声条件下开展合成分辨率测试，证实平均垂向分辨率约为1 km。
结合当地地震目录震源分布以及加那利群岛岩石学文献中的全岩地球化学成分进行对比分析。
li: The 0.2–0.5 Hz bandpass filter reduces vertical resolution in the shallow crust.
Lateral resolution of the 3D IDW-interpolated model is strictly limited by station spacing and network geometry.
1D RF inversion assumes isotropic, horizontally layered media, ignoring 3D scattering and dipping interface effects.

Very high estimated melt fractions (up to 79 wt%) depend on assumed bulk compositions, lithostatic pressure gradients, and attribute all Vs reduction to temperature/melt rather than volatiles or compositional heterogeneity.
0.2–0.5 Hz带通滤波降低了浅部地壳的垂向分辨率。
三维IDW插值模型的横向分辨率受限于台站间距与台网几何分布。
一维接收函数反演假设介质为各向同性水平层状，忽略了三维散射和倾斜界面效应。
高达79 wt%的熔体分数估算依赖于假设的岩石成分和静岩压力梯度，且未完全剥离挥发分和成分非均质性对波速降低的贡献。

tm.why: The study computes 12,147 teleseismic P-to-S receiver functions using multiple-taper correlation and inverts them for 1D and 3D shear-wave velocity profiles and Moho depth.
The study images the magmatic plumbing system, melt fractions, and mafic underplating beneath Tenerife volcano and relates them to volcanic unrest and degassing.
A Bayesian transdimensional reversible-jump Markov Chain Monte Carlo (rj-McMC) inversion is applied to derive posterior Vs distributions at each station.

ev.notes: Full 16-page PDF article ('Article in Press' in Scientific Reports) examined, including abstract, introduction, results and discussion, conclusions, methods, and Figures 1-3.

sum: Probabilistic tsunami hazard analysis (PTHA) requires massive simulation ensembles from earthquake rupture forecasts (ERFs). This study evaluates eight linear and nonlinear dimensionality reduction methods—including PCA, LSA, kernel PCA, autoencoders, MDS, Isomap, UMAP, and t-SNE—on synthetic tsunami data generated by a greedy-sequential ERF and linear long-wave Green's functions along the Nankai subduction zone. Performance is assessed via external (Adjusted Rand Index, mutual information) and internal (silhouette) clustering metrics on peak nearshore tsunami amplitude (PNTA) profiles and coastal time series (marigrams). Manifold learning techniques (specifically t-SNE and UMAP) achieve the highest clustering scores for PNTA profiles and yield higher silhouette scores in reduced space than in the unreduced ambient space. Furthermore, isolated filamentary structures extracted in the reduced domain can be mapped back to concentrated fault cell participation zones, offering a novel waveform-based hazard disaggregation tool.
概率海啸危险性分析（PTHA）需要海量数值模拟。本研究利用南海海槽贪婪序列地震破裂预测（ERF）和线性长波格林函数生成合成海啸数据，评估了PCA、自编码器及流形学习（UMAP、t-SNE等）共八种线性与非线性降维方法。基于近岸最大海啸振幅（PNTA）剖面和验潮站时间序列，采用外部（调整兰德指数、互信……

t: Eight linear, autoencoder, and manifold learning dimensionality reduction methods are evaluated on synthetic tsunami profiles and marigrams using external (AR, NMI, AMI) and internal (silhouette) clustering metrics.
利用外部（AR、NMI、AMI）和内部（轮廓系数）聚类指标，在合成海啸数据上评估八种线性、自编码器和流形学习降维方法。
97 greedy-sequential ERF runs of 5,200 synthetic earthquakes each along the Nankai megathrust, parsed into 60 m isobath PNTA profiles and marigrams at six nearshore stations.
南海海槽97次ERF模拟（每次5200个合成地震），提取60米等深线PNTA剖面和6个近岸台站的时间序列。

Manifold learning methods (t-SNE and UMAP) achieved the highest external and internal clustering scores for PNTA profiles, reducing negative intra-cluster silhouette scores from 17% in ambient space to 4%.
流形学习（t-SNE和UMAP）在PNTA剖面上得分最高，将原始空间17%的负轮廓系数比例降低至4%。
Evaluation is restricted to cluster-structure preservation on a single subduction zone, and marigram external metrics suffer from uncertain ground-truth clustering in the ambient domain.
评估仅限于单一俯冲带的聚类结构保持，且时间序列在原始空间的基准真值聚类存在不确定性。
Demonstrates that reduced-domain manifold features (filaments) of tsunami amplitudes and marigrams can be mapped back to specific fault rupture zones for hazard disaggregation.
将降维空间提取的流形纤维状特征反向映射回特定断层破裂区，实现新型海啸危险性解耦。

kc: Benchmarks eight linear, neural network, and manifold learning dimensionality reduction methods on synthetic PTHA tsunami datasets.
Demonstrates that nonlinear manifold learning (UMAP, t-SNE) achieves superior clustering scores over linear methods like PCA, improving cluster separation compared to ambient space.
Introduces a novel hazard disaggregation workflow by mapping low-dimensional manifold filaments back to specific earthquake rupture zones and magnitude ranges on the causative fault.
在合成概率海啸危险性分析（PTHA）数据集上系统评估了八种线性、神经网络和流形学习降维方法。
证明非线性流形学习（UMAP、t-SNE）的聚类得分优于PCA等线性方法，且比原始高维空间具有更好的聚类分离度。
提出了一种新型危险性解耦流程，将低维流形中的纤维状特征映射回发震断层上的特定破裂区域和震级范围。
me: Greedy-sequential earthquake rupture forecast (ERF) drawing from a Gutenberg-Richter distribution coupled with linear long-wave tsunami Green's functions.
Dimensionality reduction using decomposition (PCA, LSA, kPCA), neural networks (autoencoders), and manifold learning (MDS, Isomap, UMAP, t-SNE).
Clustering evaluation using k-means and agglomerative clustering scored by Adjusted Rand Index (AR), Normalized/Adjusted Mutual Information (NMI/AMI), and silhouette scores.
结合古登堡-里克特分布的贪婪序列地震破裂预测（ERF）与线性长波海啸格林函数模拟。
应用矩阵分解（PCA、LSA、kPCA）、神经网络（自编码器）和流形学习（MDS、Isomap、UMAP、t-SNE）进行数据降维。
采用k-means和层次聚类，并通过调整兰德指数（AR）、归一化/调整互信息（NMI/AMI）和轮廓系数评估聚类性能。
de: 97 ERF model runs along the Nankai megathrust, each containing 5,200 synthetic earthquakes simulated on a 510 x 1,140 grid (30 arc-sec ETOPO22 bathymetry) for 36,000 time steps.
Peak nearshore tsunami amplitude (PNTA) profiles sampled along the 60 m isobath (5.7 x 10^7 total data points) and nearshore marigrams at six tide gauge locations (2.8 x 10^7 total data points).
南海海槽巨型逆冲断层的97次ERF模型运行，每次包含5,200个合成地震，在510×1,140网格（30角秒ETOPO22水深）上模拟36,000个时间步。
沿60米等深线采样的近岸最大海啸振幅（PNTA）剖面（共5.7×10^7个数据点）以及6个验潮站位置的近岸海啸时间序列（共2.8×10^7个数据点）。
li: Evaluation is limited to cluster-structure preservation rather than end-to-end downstream probabilistic inundation mapping or real-time forecasting.
Lack of an established optimal clustering methodology for tsunami marigrams in the ambient domain introduces ground-truth instability for external metrics.
Tested only on a single subduction zone fault without complex multi-fault networks or non-seismic tsunami sources.
评估范围仅限于聚类结构保持能力，未直接测试下游端到端的概率淹没制图或实时预警性能。
原始高维空间中缺乏公认的最优海啸时间序列聚类方法，导致外部评估指标的基准真值存在不稳定性。
仅在单一俯冲带断层上进行了测试，未包含复杂多断层网络或非地震海啸源。

tm.why: Evaluates unsupervised dimensionality reduction and clustering algorithms (PCA, LSA, kPCA, MDS, Isomap, UMAP, t-SNE, autoencoders) on synthetic earthquake-generated tsunami simulation datasets.
Applies dimensionality reduction to earthquake rupture forecasts and tsunami simulations to improve probabilistic tsunami hazard analysis (PTHA) and hazard disaggregation.
Uses greedy-sequential earthquake rupture forecasts along the Nankai megathrust and maps extracted tsunami wavefield features back to specific fault rupture zones.

ev.notes: Full 23-page PDF read and analyzed, including all 17 figures, 1 table, equations, and methodology/results sections.

sum: Giant sequoias require up to ~2 m3 of water per day during dry summers, yet their subsurface water stores remain poorly characterized. This study combines 2D elastic full-waveform inversion (using a localized traveltime misfit and SPECFEM2D) with geostatistical rock physics modeling (via ensemble smoother multiple data assimilation) along three active-source seismic profiles in Yosemite's Mariposa Grove. The resulting Vp, Vs, porosity, and saturation models reveal abundant shallow (<2 m) water near drainages, whereas on ridges and hillslopes, plant-accessible moisture is primarily stored deeper (>2 m) as rock moisture within saprolite and weathered bedrock. Integrating water volumes across rooting scenarios indicates that while drainage sequoias only need shallow roots, ridge and hillslope sequoias must root deeper than 2–6 m to access the ~200 m3 needed to survive a 100-day dry season, demonstrating a previously unrecognized reliance on deep critical zone rock moisture.
巨杉在干旱夏季每天需水约2立方米，但其地下储水分布尚不明确。本研究在优胜美地国家公园采集了三条主动源地震剖面，结合基于SPECFEM2D的二维弹性全波形反演（局部走时层析成像）与地质统计岩石物理反演（集成平滑多数据同化），获取了高分辨率纵横波速度、孔隙度及饱和度模型，量化了地下含水量。结果表明，排水……

t: 2D elastic full-waveform inversion matching phase in overlapping Gaussian windows via SPECFEM2D and adjoint methods, followed by ES-MDA geostatistical rock physics inversion of Vp and Vs for porosity and saturation.
利用SPECFEM2D进行基于重叠高斯窗相位匹配的二维弹性全波形反演，再通过ES-MDA开展岩石物理反演获取孔隙度与饱和…

Three hammer-source seismic profiles recorded on autonomous Stryde accelerometer nodes across ridge, hillslope, and drainage transects in Yosemite's Mariposa Grove, combined with airborne and handheld lidar point clouds.
在优胜美地Mariposa林区山脊、山坡和排水沟采集的三条大锤震源Stryde节点地震剖面，结合机载和手持激光雷达点云。
Weathered bedrock (~500 m/s Vs) depth varies from 1 to 10 m. Drainage sequoias access >200 m3 of water within 2 m depth, whereas ridge and hillslope sequoias must root >2–6 m deep.
风化基岩（Vs约500 m/s）深1–10米；排水沟巨杉在2米内可获取>200立方米水，而山脊和山坡巨杉需扎根超过2–6…
Results lack direct borehole verification and ignore 3D variability, root density limits, water potential, and plant competition, yielding only upper-bound extractable water estimates.
缺乏钻孔验证，且未考虑三维非均质性、根系密度、水势和植物竞争，仅给出可提取水量的上限估计。
First application of elastic FWI and rock physics modeling to map subsurface water in a giant sequoia grove, revealing their reliance on deep (>2 m) weathered bedrock moisture.
首次将弹性全波形反演与岩石物理建模用于量化巨杉林地下储水，揭示其对2米以下深部基岩水分的依赖。

kc: High-resolution 2D Vp and Vs models of the critical zone beneath giant sequoias using elastic full-waveform inversion.
Quantification of subsurface volumetric water content by coupling FWI velocities with geostatistical rock physics inversion.
Demonstration that ridge and hillslope giant sequoias must root deeper than 2 m into weathered bedrock to meet summer water demands.
利用弹性全波形反演构建了巨杉下方关键带的高分辨率二维Vp和Vs速度模型。
将全波形反演速度与地质统计岩石物理反演相结合，量化了地下体积含水量分布。
证实山脊和山坡上的巨杉必须扎根至2米以下的风化基岩中才能满足夏季需水。
me: First-arrival ray-based traveltime tomography (pyGIMLi) to build initial Vp and scaled Vs velocity models.

2D elastic full-waveform inversion in SPECFEM2D using overlapping Gaussian windows to minimize cross-correlation time lags via the adjoint-state method across multiscale frequency bands (5–20 Hz to 5–65 Hz).
Geostatistical rock physics inversion combining an empirical biexponential velocity-porosity relation, Gassmann's equation, and Ensemble Smoother with Multiple Data Assimilation (ES-MDA).
利用初至波射线走时层析成像（pyGIMLi）构建初始Vp和按比例缩放的Vs速度模型。
基于SPECFEM2D的二维弹性全波形反演，采用重叠高斯窗通过伴随状态法在多尺度频带（5–20 Hz至5–65 Hz）内最小化互相关时移。
结合经验双指数速度-孔隙度关系、Gassmann方程和集成平滑多数据同化算法（ES-MDA）的地质统计岩石物理反演。
de: Three linear active-source seismic refraction profiles (Ridge, Hillslope, Drainage) in Mariposa Grove, Yosemite National Park, recorded with Stryde accelerometer nodes and a sledgehammer source.
Airborne and handheld lidar point clouds to map tree canopy height and topography.
Cylindrical integration of 2D water content models across rooting depths (0–20 m) and lateral radii (0–80 m).
在优胜美地国家公园Mariposa林区使用Stryde加速度计节点和大锤震源采集的三条线性主动源地震折射剖面（山脊、山坡、排水沟）。
用于绘制树冠高度和地形的机载与手持激光雷达点云数据。
在不同扎根深度（0–20米）和侧向半径（0–80米）情景下对二维含水量模型进行柱体体积积分。
li: Lack of direct corroborating subsurface measurements (such as deep borehole logs or co-located soil moisture profiles at survey time) to ground-truth deep water estimates.
Water volume calculations extrapolate 2D transects into 3D cylinders and ignore limited root density, low water potential, and plant competition, providing only an upper-bound estimate.
Rock physics empirical parameters were calibrated on Sherman granite rather than the local metarhyodacite bedrock.
缺乏钻孔测井或同期同址土壤水分测量等直接地下观测数据来验证深层水分估算。
水量计算将二维剖面外推为三维柱体，未考虑根系密度限制、低水势和植物竞争，仅提供上限估计。
岩石物理经验参数标定自Sherman花岗岩，而非当地的变流纹英安岩基岩。

The study employs a geostatistical rock physics inversion using probability field simulation and ensemble smoother with multiple data assimilation (ES-MDA) to estimate porosity and saturation.

sum: This study investigates the Marlborough Ultramafic Suite in the New England Orogen, Australia, using petrological and geochemical data to reconstruct the evolution of a once-consumed oceanic domain. The suite consists of harzburgite, serpentinite, and high-grade serpentinite, with major and rare earth element signatures resembling residual abyssal peridotites. Early lizardite serpentinization indicates seafloor fluid-rock interaction, while high bulk alkali/U ratios and prograde antigorite, talc, and magnesian olivine (Fo95) record subduction-related metamorphism. The authors propose that Paleo-Pacific oceanic lithosphere was subducted beneath eastern Gondwana, detached and mixed within the subduction channel, and subsequently exhumed and accreted. This work provides key constraints on the multi-stage evolution and recycling of subducted oceanic mantle.
本研究利用岩石地球化学数据分析了澳大利亚Marlborough超基性岩套。该岩套元素特征类似深海残留橄榄岩，其早期蜥蛇纹石化指示洋底流体作用，而顺变变质矿物（富镁橄榄石Fo95）记录了俯冲变质。结果表明该岩套在俯冲通道中脱离、混合并折返吸积，重建了古太平洋板块俯冲地幔的多阶段演化历史。

t: Petrological and geochemical analysis of bulk-rock major and rare earth elements, alongside mineral chemistry of serpentinized peridotites.
对超基性岩套样品进行全岩主微量元素及矿物化学分析。
Rock samples (harzburgite, serpentinite, high-grade serpentinite) collected from the Marlborough Ultramafic Suite in eastern Australia.
采集自澳大利亚东部Marlborough超基性岩套的岩石样品。
Identification of early seafloor lizardite serpentinization followed by subduction-related prograde metamorphism forming antigorite, talc, and highly magnesian olivine (Fo95).
识别出早期洋底蛇纹石化及随后的俯冲顺变变质作用（形成Fo95橄榄石）。
Potential preservation bias and overprinting of geochemical signatures during multi-stage metamorphism and exhumation.
样品仅来自地表出露，可能存在保存偏差及后期变质叠加。
First detailed reconstruction of the multi-stage subduction and exhumation history of the Marlborough Ultramafic Suite as a relic of the Paleo-Pacific Ocean.
首次重建了该超基性岩套从深海橄榄岩到俯冲折返的多阶段演化。

kc: Provides the first comprehensive petrological and geochemical characterization of the Marlborough Ultramafic Suite, the largest ultramafic massif in eastern Australia.
Identifies a multi-stage evolutionary history transitioning from mid-ocean ridge abyssal peridotite to subduction-zone prograde metamorphism.
Constrains the tectonic reconstruction of the eastern Gondwanan margin and the fate of the Paleo-Pacific oceanic lithosphere.

为东冈瓦纳边缘的构造重建及古太平洋大洋岩石圈的归宿提供了关键约束。

Bulk-rock major and rare earth element (REE) geochemical systematics.

sum: Between 2000 and 2010, anomalous seismicity and ground deformation occurred in the Qarun oil field, ~50 km west of the tectonically active 1992 Mw 5.8 Dahshour earthquake source near Cairo, Egypt. To discriminate between anthropogenic and tectonic origins, this study integrates Persistent Scatterer Interferometry (PSI) from 38 Envisat SAR scenes (2004–2010), earthquake catalog statistics (b-values), and full moment tensor decomposition. Results show that Qarun seismicity is shallow (2–5 km), exhibits a high b-value (1.1), and lags peak oil extraction by ~1 year. Full moment tensors in Qarun reveal dominant non-double-couple (ISO+CLVD averaging 62.4%) components, alongside localized surface uplift (~5 mm/a) flanked by mild subsidence (-1 to -2 mm/a). Conversely, Dahshour earthquakes are deeper (8–28 km), follow mapped faults, and have a low tectonic b-value (0.67). This multi-disciplinary approach successfully distinguishes reservoir-induced seismicity from adjacent natural tectonic hazards in Egypt's Western Desert.
2000至2010年间，埃及开罗西南Qarun油田（距1992年Dahshour Mw5.8震源区约50公里）出现异常地震活动与地表形变。本研究结合2004-2010年38景Envisat永久散射体合成孔径雷达干涉测量（PSI）、地震目录b值统计及全矩张量分解，区分人为诱发与自然构造地震。结果表明：……

t: Combines Envisat Persistent Scatterer Interferometry (StaMPS), Gutenberg-Richter b-value statistics on declustered catalogs, and full-waveform moment tensor decomposition into ISO, CLVD, and DC components.
结合Envisat永久散射体干涉测量（StaMPS）、去丛集地震目录b值统计及全波形矩张量分解（ISO、CLVD、DC）…
Uses 38 Envisat descending SAR scenes (2004–2010), a compiled catalog of 1,240 earthquakes (Mw 0.1–5.8) from DLSN and ENSN, and full waveforms for M ≥ 3.0 Qarun events.
使用38景Envisat降轨SAR影像（2004–2010）、1240个地震目录（Mw 0.1–5.8）及Qarun地区…
Qarun exhibits shallow seismicity (2–5 km), b-value of 1.1±0.02, 62.4% average non-DC (ISO+CLVD) mechanisms, ~5 mm/a central surface uplift, and a 1-year lag after peak oil production.
Qarun地震较浅（2–5 km），b值1.1，非双力偶成分平均占62.4%，中心隆升约5 mm/a，震频峰值滞后采油峰…

Lack of ascending Envisat SAR scenes prevented horizontal velocity resolution, while limited regional seismic network coverage and restricted access to oilfield operational data hindered detailed mechanical modeling.
缺乏升轨SAR数据无法解析水平形变，且区域台网密度有限及油田作业数据受限。

First integrated InSAR and full moment tensor study demonstrating that Qarun oil field seismicity is anthropogenically triggered and distinct from the adjacent tectonic Dahshour earthquake source zone.
首次综合InSAR与全矩张量反演，证实Qarun油田地震为人为诱发，并与邻近Dahshour构造震源区分开。

kc: Discriminated shallow induced seismicity in the Qarun oil field (2–5 km, b-value 1.1) from deeper tectonic seismicity in the adjacent Dahshour source zone (8–28 km, b-value 0.67).
Detected localized ground uplift (~5 mm/a) and flanking subsidence (-1 to -2 mm/a) in the Qarun oil field using Envisat PSI time-series analysis (2004–2010).
Demonstrated high non-double-couple (ISO+CLVD averaging 62.4%) moment tensor components for Qarun earthquakes (M ≥ 3.0), confirming fluid-driven fracturing and pore-pressure perturbations.
Identified an ~1-year temporal lag between peak hydrocarbon production (2004–2006) and peak seismicity (2007–2008), explained by slow pore-pressure diffusion and poroelastic stress transfer.
区分了Qarun油田浅源诱发地震（2–5 km，b值1.1）与邻近Dahshour震源区深源构造地震（8–28 km，b值0.67）。
利用Envisat PSI时序分析（2004–2010）探测到Qarun油田中心约5 mm/a的局部地表隆升及两侧-1至-2 mm/a的沉降。
揭示了Qarun地区M≥3.0地震具有显著的非双力偶矩张量成分（ISO+CLVD平均达62.4%），证实了流体驱动破裂与孔隙压力扰动机制。
发现油田地震活动峰值（2007–2008）滞后于油气开采峰值（2004–2006）约1年，归因于低渗透层内缓慢的孔隙压力扩散与孔隙弹性应力传递。
me: Persistent Scatterer Interferometry (PSI) using ROI_PAC, DORIS, StaMPS, and TRAIN tropospheric correction on 38 Envisat descending scenes.
Earthquake catalog compilation, magnitude unification to Mw, Gardner-Knopoff declustering, and least-squares Gutenberg-Richter b-value estimation.
Full waveform moment tensor inversion and decomposition into isotropic (ISO), compensated linear vector dipole (CLVD), and double-couple (DC) components using 1-D velocity models.
Statistical F-ratio testing to evaluate the significance of deviatoric+isotropic models against pure double-couple models.
基于ROI_PAC、DORIS、StaMPS及TRAIN对流层校正算法，对38景Envisat降轨数据进行永久散射体干涉测量（PSI）。
地震目录整编、矩震级（Mw）统一转换、Gardner-Knopoff去丛集处理，以及最小二乘Gutenberg-Richter b值拟合。
基于一维速度模型的全波形矩张量反演，并将其分解为各向同性（ISO）、补偿线性矢量偶极（CLVD）和双力偶（DC）分量。
采用F检验统计评估偏量+各向同性模型相对于纯双力偶模型的显著性改善。

Compiled historical and instrumental earthquake catalog (1,240 events, Mw 0.1–5.8, depths 2–30 km) from Ambraseys et al. (1994), Dahshour Local Seismic Network (DLSN), and Egyptian National Seismological Network (ENSN).
Full broadband waveforms from ENSN for 7 earthquakes with local magnitudes ≥ 3.0 in the Qarun region (2011–2020).
Annual hydrocarbon production rates and seismicity time-series from the Qarun oil field (1997–2014).

整合历史资料、Dahshour地方台网（DLSN）和埃及国家地震台网（ENSN）的1,240个地震目录（Mw 0.1–5.8，深度2–30 km）。
ENSN记录的Qarun地区7个ML≥3.0地震（2011–2020年）的全波形数据。

sum: This study develops empirical ground-motion models for the effective amplitude spectra (EAS) and group delay time (derived from Fourier phase spectra, FPS) in the Chilean subduction zone. Utilizing a comprehensive dataset of interface and inslab earthquake recordings (M 4.6 to 7), the authors employ Bayesian regression to characterize how spectral amplitudes depend on magnitude, distance, source type, and site conditions. The resulting models capture systematic phase variations and wave propagation characteristics, offering a spectrum-based alternative to traditional ground-motion models. This enables realistic time-history simulations for seismic hazard assessment and earthquake-resistant design in Chile.
本研究针对智利俯冲带开发了有效振幅谱（EAS）和群延迟时间（源自傅里叶相位谱FPS）的经验地面运动模型。利用包含M 4.6至7级板间及板内地震记录的综合数据集，作者采用贝叶斯回归量化了光谱振幅对震级、震中距离、震源类型和场地条件的依赖性。该模型捕捉了与群延迟相关的系统相位变化，为传统地面运动预测模型……

智利俯冲带地震（M 4.6至7）的强震动记录综合数据集，区分板间和板内事件。
Empirical models that successfully predict spectral amplitudes and phase variations, enabling realistic time-history simulations for Chile.

Model applicability is constrained to the magnitude range of M 4.6 to 7 and the specific tectonic setting of Chile.

Simultaneous empirical modeling of both amplitude (EAS) and phase (group delay) spectra specifically tailored for Chilean subduction zone earthquakes.

sum: This study presents a novel geochronological age constraint for Guishandao, an active volcanic island located off northeastern Taiwan at the southern tip of the Okinawa Trough. By refining the eruptive history of Guishandao, the authors discuss its implications for the back-arc basin opening of the Okinawa Trough, regional tectonic evolution, geothermal energy potential, and volcanic hazard assessment. The new age data helps resolve previous chronological discrepancies, providing a more reliable framework for evaluating future volcanic risks and geothermal exploration in this tectonically active region.
本研究为台湾东北部冲绳海槽南端的活性火山岛龟山岛提供了全新的地质年代学约束。通过精确限定其喷发历史，作者探讨了其对冲绳海槽张裂、区域构造演化、地热潜力及火山灾害评估的意义。这一新数据解决了以往年代学争议，为评估该活跃区的未来火山风险和地热开发提供了更可靠的时间框架。

对火山岩进行地质年代学测定，以约束龟山岛的喷发历史。
Volcanic rock samples collected from Guishandao island, northeastern Taiwan, for isotopic dating.
