sum: This study evaluates the capability of Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) networks for back-projection imaging of moderate earthquakes. Using synthetic tests and observations of a Mw 4.9 earthquake in the Eastern California Shear Zone, the authors demonstrate that the high spatial density of DAS arrays can resolve fine-scale, sub-kilometer cascading rupture features. They propose a novel two-step inversion procedure that integrates dense DAS observations with regional broadband seismic station data. This integration significantly enhances the spatiotemporal resolution of earthquake source imaging, offering a powerful tool to better understand rupture dynamics and seismic hazards using existing fiber-optic infrastructure.
本研究系统评估了分布式声学传感（DAS）网络在地震回溯成像中的分辨率。通过合成测试以及对加州东部剪切带Mw 4.9级地震的分析，作者证明了DAS的高密度空间采样能够解析亚公里级的精细级联破裂特征。研究提出了一种结合DAS观测与区域宽频带台网数据的两步反演方法。该方法显著提升了震源成像的时空分辨率，为……

sum: The mantle transition zone (MTZ) hosts substantial water and dense mid-ocean ridge basalt (MORB), yet their combined impact on dynamic stability remains unclear. Using 2D thermo-mechanical simulations in Underworld2 integrated with Perple_X phase equilibria, the authors evaluate how varying pyrolite water content (0.4–2.0 wt%) and MORB fraction (10–40 wt%) control MTZ buoyancy, viscosity, and stability. They identify four stability regimes governed primarily by the MORB-to-water ratio (R): long-lived stability requires R ≈ 18–45, whereas higher ratios induce slow lower-boundary foundering and lower ratios trigger upper-boundary upwelling and dehydration that can form mid-lithospheric discontinuities. Combining this dynamic threshold with published global seismic estimates of MTZ MORB and water distributions, the authors define a laterally heterogeneous effective hydration potential (~0.64–1.0 wt% globally). They conclude that most of the present-day MTZ experiences slow lower-boundary dehydration, sustaining the deep water cycle and preserving long-term cratonic stability.
地幔转换带（MTZ）富含水和致密洋中脊玄武岩（MORB），但二者如何共同调节其物理稳定性尚不清楚。本文利用Underworld2构建二维热-力学地球动力学模型并结合Perple_X相平衡计算，量化了含水量（0.4–2.0 wt%）和MORB比例（10–40 wt%）对MTZ密度、黏度及演化稳定性的影……

t: 2D thermo-mechanical geodynamic simulations in Underworld2 solving mass, momentum, and heat conservation with Perple_X phase transitions and hydroweakening rheology across varying MTZ water and MORB fractions.
利用Underworld2构建二维热-力学模型，结合Perple_X相平衡与水弱化流变律模拟含水MTZ演化。
60 numerical simulations spanning 0.4–2.0 wt% water and 10–40 wt% MORB, integrated with global observational maps of MTZ MORB fraction and water content.
60组不同水与MORB含量的数值模拟实验，并结合全球MTZ玄武岩比例与含水量观测图件。

Long-lived MTZ stability requires a MORB-to-water ratio R ≈ 18–45 (optimal ~27–30), constraining present average global MTZ hydration potential to ~0.64–1.0 wt% (~1.9–2.9 ocean masses) with widespread lower-boundary slow dehydration.
MTZ长期稳定需R在18–45之间，限制现今全球平均水合潜力为0.64–1.0 wt%且以底部缓慢脱水为主。
Excludes active subducted slabs, thermal plumes, and variable Fe-content melt stagnation near 410 km, modeling only purely composition-driven end-member dynamics.
仅考虑纯组分浮力驱动，未包含滞留俯冲板片、次级地幔柱扰动及富铁熔体在410 km处的滞留效应。
Defines an effective MTZ hydration potential combining dynamical buoyancy stability with mineralogical storage capacity, demonstrating that dense MORB fraction regulates deep water retention.

Demonstrated that long-term dynamical stability of the hydrous MTZ requires an intermediate MORB-to-water ratio (R ≈ 18–45, peaking at ~27–30).
Formulated the 'effective MTZ hydration potential' combining intrinsic mineralogical storage capacity and gravitational stability constraints.
Mapped global present-day MTZ hydration potential and stability regimes, showing predominance of slow lower-boundary dehydration (Type L) and links to mid-lithospheric discontinuity (MLD) formation.
识别出由MORB与水比例（R）控制的含水地幔转换带四种动力学稳定模式（S、L、U和D型）。

Thermodynamic phase equilibria and density parameterization calculated via Perple_X and experimental mineral physics.

sum: This study investigates the orientation of maximum horizontal ground-motion intensity in strike-slip earthquakes using both theoretical modeling and observational data. By analyzing theoretical displacements above a shear dislocation in an isotropic, homogeneous medium, the authors show that while maximum intensity generally aligns with the epicentral transverse orientation, it systematically shifts to the radial orientation in cones near the principal stress axes. This pattern is qualitatively confirmed using recorded waveforms, including filtered velocities, high-rate GNSS displacements, and oscillator responses from strong-motion and simulated accelerations. The findings challenge the assumption of a uniform transverse orientation across all azimuths and suggest that incorporating the angle from the fault strike as a predictor variable can significantly improve estimates of maximum intensity orientation for future seismic hazard analyses.
本文结合理论模拟与观测数据，研究了走滑地震中最大水平地面运动强度的方向。通过分析各向同性均匀介质中剪切断层上方的理论位移，作者发现最大强度方向在大多数方位角下接近震中切向，但在主应力轴附近的锥形区域内会系统性地转向径向。利用滤波速度、高频GNSS位移以及强震动和数值模拟加速度的振子响应等观测记录，定……

Theoretical displacements in an isotropic medium and recorded strike-slip earthquake waveforms (velocities, high-rate GNSS, strong-motion accelerations) at stations without site effects.

Maximum horizontal intensity orientation systematically shifts from epicentral transverse to radial in cones near the principal stress axes.
最大水平地面运动强度方向在主应力轴附近的锥形区域内，系统性地从震中切向转为径向。

sum: Traditional earthquake early warning systems often saturate for large megathrust earthquakes, leading to underestimated tsunami forecasts. This study presents the first fully automated, pseudo-real-time implementation of a Prompt Elastogravity Signal (PEGS)-based rapid source characterization module on the Alaska seismic network. The pipeline combines SeedLink streaming, quality control, STA/LTA P-wave picking with post-P zero-padding, and a fine-tuned Graph Neural Network (PEGSGraph). Evaluated over a 13-month continuous playback (2020–2021), 42 moderate regional events, and 37 teleseismic events, the system enforces a multiparametric alert criterion (stable Mw ≥ 7.8 for 25 s, ≥ 100 triggered stations, and regional localization) to achieve a strict zero false-alarm rate. It accurately resolved the magnitude and focal mechanism of the 2018 Mw 7.9 Kodiak, 2020 Mw 7.8 Shumagin, and 2021 Mw 8.2 Chignik earthquakes within 90–120 s, demonstrating high resilience to picking errors (±2 s) while highlighting sensitivity limits tied to post-USArray station density.
传统地震预警在处理巨型逆冲地震时易发生震级饱和。本研究首次在阿拉斯加地震台网实现了基于瞬时弹性重力信号（PEGS）的全自动准实时震源快速表征模块。该流程结合实时数据流质量控制、STA/LTA拾取、P波后置零掩码以及微调的图神经网络（PEGSGraph）。通过对13个月连续数据回放、42个区域中强震和……

t: Continuous broadband waveforms undergo quality control, STA/LTA P-wave triggering, post-P zero-padding, and 2–30 mHz filtering before feeding a transfer-learned Graph Neural Network (PEGSGraph) every 5 s to estimate magnitude, location, and focal mechanism.
连续波形经质控、STA/LTA触发、P波后置零和2–30 mHz滤波后，每5秒输入微调后的PEGSGraph估算震源参数…

Fine-tuned on 512,000 synthetic earthquakes embedded in 2022–2025 empirical noise from 156 Alaska stations, and tested on a 13-month continuous playback (2020–2021), 42 moderate regional events, and 37 major teleseismic events.
利用51.2万个合成地震叠加实测噪声微调模型，并在13个月连续数据、42个区域震和37个远震上测试。

Applying a multiparametric alert criterion (stable Mw ≥ 7.8 for 25 s, ≥ 100 stations, regional location) yielded a zero false-alarm rate and accurately resolved three Mw ≥ 7.8 regional earthquakes within 90–120 s.
结合多参数警报准则实现零误报，并在震后90–120秒内准确收敛得到3次Mw≥7.8区域大震的震级和震源机制。
Reduced post-USArray station density limits sensitivity to Mw ≥ 7.8, missing the tsunami-generating 2020 Mw 7.6 Sand Point earthquake under the current sparser network.

First fully automated pseudo-real-time operational implementation of a PEGS-based deep-learning source characterization pipeline on the Alaska seismic network, handling live telemetry artifacts and automatic phase picks.
首次在阿拉斯加台网实现基于PEGS与深度学习的全自动准实时震源快速表征流水线。

kc: Developed the first fully automated pseudo-real-time PEGS-based earthquake source characterization pipeline on the Alaska seismic network.
Adapted the PEGSGraph Graph Neural Network to the sparser post-USArray Alaska network (2022–2025) using transfer learning and 512,000 synthetic earthquakes embedded in empirical noise.

Defined a multiparametric alert criterion requiring temporal stability (Mw ≥ 7.8 for ≥ 25 s), network consensus (≥ 100 stations), and regional localization, achieving a zero false-alarm rate over 13 months.
Accurately tracked magnitude and focal mechanism for three Mw ≥ 7.8 Alaska earthquakes within 90–120 s and demonstrated robustness to ±2 s automated P-wave picking errors.
在阿拉斯加地震台网开发了首个基于瞬时弹性重力信号（PEGS）的全自动准实时震源参数快速表征流水线。
利用迁移学习及叠加实测噪声的51.2万个合成地震事件，将PEGSGraph图神经网络适配至USArray撤出后较稀疏的当代阿拉斯加台网（2022–2025年）。
建立了结合时间稳定性（连续25秒Mw≥7.8）、台网共识（≥100个台站）和区域定位的多参数警报准则，在13个月连续回放测试中实现零误报。
在震后90–120秒内准确测定了3次Mw≥7.8阿拉斯加大震的震级与震源机制，并验证了对±2秒自动P波拾取误差的鲁棒性。
me: Continuous SeedLink data ingestion with multi-stage quality control (latency and gap checks) on 150+ broadband vertical (BHZ) channels.
Event-driven STA/LTA P-wave triggering (0.7–2.0 Hz bandpass, threshold 25.0) initiating inference when ≥ 30 stations trigger, with post-P waveform zero-padding to isolate pre-P PEGS.
Standardized 300 s waveform preprocessing (instrument response removal to acceleration, linear detrending, 2.0–30.0 mHz bandpass filtering, 1 Hz decimation) updated every 5 s.
Transfer learning fine-tuning of PEGSGraph using QSSP synthetic PEGS Green's functions in AK135 convolved with stochastic STFs and added to 2022–2025 empirical noise.
基于SeedLink协议连续获取150多个宽频带垂直分量（BHZ）波形，并进行延迟和数据间断等多级质量控制。

对300秒时间窗波形进行标准化预处理（去仪器响应转换为加速度、去线性趋势、2.0–30.0 mHz带通滤波、1 Hz降采样），每5秒更新一次震源估计。
利用AK135模型下QSSP计算的合成PEGS格林函数与随机震源时间函数褶积，叠加2022–2025年实测噪声生成训练集，对PEGSGraph进行迁移学习微调。

13-month continuous offline playback simulation (1 July 2020 to 1 August 2021) covering the 2020 Mw 7.8 Shumagin, 2020 Mw 7.6 Sand Point, and 2021 Mw 8.2 Chignik earthquakes.
Targeted evaluation on the 2018 Mw 7.9 Kodiak earthquake, 42 moderate regional earthquakes (5.5 ≤ Mw < 7.8, 2022–2025), and 37 teleseismic earthquakes (Mw ≥ 7.0, 2022–2025).
Sensitivity experiments injecting uniform random P-wave picking errors U(-2, 2) s and U(-4, 4) s, plus comparative tests between complete historical (USArray era) and reduced modern station networks.
使用51.2万个合成地震（Mw 5.5–9.5）叠加156个阿拉斯加低噪声宽频带台站（小时标准差<1 nm/s²）2022–2025年的实测背景噪声进行模型微调。
开展13个月（2020年7月1日至2021年8月1日）连续离线回放模拟，涵盖2020年Shumagin Mw 7.8、Sand Point Mw 7.6和2021年Chignik Mw 8.2地震。
针对2018年Kodiak Mw 7.9地震、42个区域中强震（5.5 ≤ Mw < 7.8，2022–2025年）以及37个全球远震（Mw ≥ 7.0，2022–2025年）进行专项测试。
开展注入U(-2, 2)秒和U(-4, 4)秒均匀随机P波拾取误差的敏感性实验，以及历史密集台网（USArray时期）与当前稀疏台网的对比测试。
li: High operational sensitivity threshold (Mw ≥ 7.8) under the sparser post-2021 Alaska network, causing the tsunami-generating 2020 Mw 7.6 Sand Point earthquake to fall below the alert threshold.
Severe P-wave picking errors (±4 s) degrade magnitude estimation stability for borderline events near the sensitivity limit (e.g., Mw 7.8 Shumagin).

The module only characterizes the earthquake source and requires integration with downstream tsunami propagation modeling, sea-level observations, and W-phase/GNSS systems for complete tsunami warning.
在2021年后较稀疏的阿拉斯加台网下，系统的有效检测下限较高（Mw ≥ 7.8），导致引发海啸的2020年Sand Point Mw 7.6地震未能触发警报。
在极端P波拾取误差（±4秒）条件下，处于灵敏度极限边缘的事件（如Mw 7.8 Shumagin地震）的震级估计稳定性显著下降。
该模块仅提供震源快速表征，无法独立构成完整的海啸预警系统，需与下游海啸传播数值模拟、海平面直接观测及W震相/GNSS方法结合使用。

The module performs rapid real-time source characterization, estimating moment magnitude, hypocentral location, and focal mechanism of large megathrust earthquakes.
The system is explicitly designed and evaluated as an operational rapid source-characterization module to support tsunami early warning in Alaska.

sum: This paper introduces SW1D, an open-source Python package refactored from the legacy code of Gomberg and Masters (1988) for forward modelling of Rayleigh and Love waves in 1-D isotropic, layered elastic media. SW1D solves the stress-displacement eigenvalue problem via the propagator-matrix technique, incorporating Woodhouse's minor vector propagation and mode-counting algorithms, anelastic attenuation (Q), and Earth-flattening transformations. It outputs phase/group velocity dispersion curves, eigenfunctions, and frequency-domain displacement spectra or synthetic seismograms for point moment-tensor sources. The authors rigorously validate SW1D against theoretical energy equipartition and Herrera's orthogonality flux relations in PREM, benchmark it against Computer Programs in Seismology (CPS v3.30) with virtually indistinguishable results, and reproduce classic source-excitation spectra from Tsai and Aki (1971). Its key novelty lies in seamless integration within a Python ecosystem for niche applications: coupling with SWRT to model multimode conversion across vertical discontinuities and with FW-ANSI2D for multi-component ambient noise cross-correlation forward modelling.
本文介绍了开源Python软件包SW1D，用于一维各向同性层状弹性介质中瑞利波和勒夫波的正演计算。该方法基于Gomberg和Masters(1988)的传播矩阵算法求解面波本征值问题，结合了非弹性衰减、地球扁平化变换及点源矩张量激发函数。作者利用PREM模型验证了能量积分与能流正交理论关系，并与经典……

t: SW1D solves the 1-D surface wave eigenvalue problem using the propagator-matrix method of Gomberg and Masters (1988) with Woodhouse's minor vector propagation and mode counting, then computes frequency-domain displacement spectra for moment-tensor point sources.
基于Gomberg和Masters(1988)传播矩阵法与Woodhouse算法求解一维面波本征值及点源激发谱。

Benchmarks use the PREM model down to 2853 km, GCMT parameters for the 2013 Mw 7.0 Colombia earthquake, the Gutenberg continental model for Tsai and Aki (1971) sources, and synthetic 2-D discontinuity/noise models.
采用PREM模型、2013年哥伦比亚Mw7.0地震参数、Gutenberg大陆模型及合成间断面与噪声模型。

SW1D satisfies theoretical energy and flux equalities across modes, produces dispersion curves, eigenfunctions, and 3-component synthetic waveforms visually indistinguishable from CPS v3.30, and reveals larger anisotropic-source biases on C_ZZ than C_RR/C_ZR.
满足理论能量与能流恒等式，频散与合成波形同CPS完全一致，并揭示非均匀噪声源下C_ZZ偏差大于C_RR/C_ZR。
High-order modes at long periods show minor discrepancies in energy integral checks due to model truncation at 2853 km, and accuracy requires sufficiently fine depth sampling (≤5 km).
长周期高阶模因2853km深度截断存在微小积分偏差，且模型深度采样需足够精细（≤5 km）。

Provides a pure Python implementation of the Gomberg and Masters (1988) locked-mode/propagator algorithm that seamlessly integrates with Python packages like SWRT and FW-ANSI2D for hybrid wave propagation problems.
提供可无缝集成至SWRT和FW-ANSI2D等Python生态工具的纯Python一维面波求解器。

kc: Develops and releases SW1D, an open-source Python translation of Gomberg and Masters (1988) for 1-D Rayleigh and Love wave eigenvalues, dispersion, and moment-tensor synthetic seismograms.
Validates numerical solutions using theoretical kinetic-elastic energy equipartition and Herrera's norm energy flux relations up to the 10th higher mode in PREM.
Benchmarks dispersion curves, eigenfunctions, and 3-component synthetic waveforms against CPS v3.30 and reproduces classic earthquake/explosion spectra from Tsai and Aki (1971).
Demonstrates ecosystem integration with SWRT for Love wave mode conversion across vertical discontinuities and FW-ANSI2D for multi-component ambient noise cross-correlation modelling.
开发并开源了SW1D Python软件包，实现一维瑞利波和勒夫波本征值、频散曲线及矩张量点源理论地震图计算。
利用PREM模型中基阶至十阶高阶模的动能-弹性势能均分及Herrera范数能流关系对数值解进行了严格的理论验证。
将频散曲线、本征函数和三分量合成波形与CPS v3.30进行基准测试，并重现了Tsai和Aki(1971)的地震与核爆振幅谱。
展示了与SWRT（垂直间断面勒夫波模态转换）及FW-ANSI2D（多分量背景噪声互相关正演）的Python生态集成应用。
me: Propagator-matrix method with Woodhouse (1980, 1981) minor vector propagation and mode counting for solving the 1-D surface wave stress-displacement eigenvalue problem.
Incorporation of causal anelastic attenuation via logarithmic velocity dispersion and energy-weighted modal Q decay, plus Biswas-Knopoff Earth-flattening transformation.
Frequency-domain surface wave excitation calculation for double-couple or general moment tensor sources following Mendiguren (1977) and Saito (1967).
Coupling 1-D Green's function solutions with semi-analytical mode-matching (SWRT) and 2-D elastic ambient noise interferometry forward modelling (FW-ANSI2D).
采用结合Woodhouse次要向量传播和模态计数算法的传播矩阵法，求解一维面波应力-位移本征值问题。
引入对数速度频散和能量加权模态Q值衰减以考虑非弹性衰减，并采用Biswas-Knopoff地球扁平化变换。
基于Mendiguren(1977)和Saito(1967)公式计算双力偶或矩张量点源的频率域面波激发谱。
将一维格林函数解与半解析模态匹配代码(SWRT)及二维弹性背景噪声互相关正演代码(FW-ANSI2D)耦合。
de: Theoretical energy integral and energy flux checks on PREM down to the core-mantle boundary (2853 km) at periods of 10, 50, and 100 s.
Benchmark comparisons against CPS v3.30 in PREM for dispersion curves (>10 s), eigenfunctions, and synthetic waveforms of the 2013 Mw 7.0 Colombia earthquake (500–5000 km).
Reproduction of Tsai and Aki (1971) Love and Rayleigh amplitude spectra in the Gutenberg continental Earth model for strike-slip, dip-slip, and explosion sources across depths.
Numerical experiments on Love wave mode conversion across vertical discontinuities ('model L' and 'model F') and 4-component Rayleigh wave ambient noise cross-correlations (C_ZZ, C_RR, C_ZR, C_RZ).
在PREM模型（至核幔边界2853 km）中对10、50和100秒周期的理论能量积分和能流关系进行数值检验。
在PREM模型中与CPS v3.30对比频散曲线（>10 s）、本征函数，以及2013年哥伦比亚Mw 7.0地震（震中距500-5000 km）的合成波形。
采用Gutenberg大陆地球模型重现Tsai和Aki(1971)不同深度走滑、倾滑地震及地下核爆的勒夫波与瑞利波振幅谱。
开展跨越垂直不连续面（模型L和F）的勒夫波模态转换数值实验，以及四分量瑞利波背景噪声互相关（C_ZZ, C_RR, C_ZR, C_RZ）正演实验。
li: Limited to 1-D isotropic, laterally homogeneous layered media bounded by a lower half-space.
Earth-flattening transformation is an approximation, and theoretical energy integral checks degrade if depth sampling is too coarse (>5 km) or truncated before deep higher-mode eigenfunctions decay.
仅限于底层为半空间的一维各向同性、横向均匀层状介质。
地球扁平化变换属于近似，且当深度采样过粗（>5 km）或深部高阶模本征函数未完全衰减被截断时，能量积分验证会出现微小偏差。

tm.why: Presents SW1D, an open-source Python software package for forward computation of Rayleigh and Love wave dispersion curves, eigenfunctions, and synthetic seismograms in 1-D layered elastic media.
Demonstrates integrating SW1D with FW-ANSI2D for multi-component elastic forward modelling of ambient noise cross-correlations under arbitrary spatial source distributions.
Includes anelastic attenuation via physical dispersion and amplitude decay, and couples SW1D with SWRT to study surface wave mode conversion across lateral vertical discontinuities.

ev.notes: Full 28-page PDF (including Appendices A and B and all 13 figures) was analyzed and used for all extractions and source anchors.

sum: Sumatra has produced multiple great megathrust earthquakes (Mw > 8.0), whereas neighboring Java-Lesser Sunda experiences smaller ruptures. To explain this contrast, this study integrates 30 years of marine geophysical constraints, 2D finite-element kinematic-thermal modeling across eight transects, and laboratory friction data on serpentine polymorphs. In warmer northern Sumatra (younger slab, deeper ~25 km mantle wedge corner), the megathrust develops a narrow (<30 km) velocity-strengthening lizardite-rich 'soft barrier' immediately downdip of the mantle wedge corner, followed by seismogenic antigorite-rich patches at 30–50 km depth, yielding a 180–220 km wide seismogenic zone capable of Mw > 8.5 events. Conversely, colder Java-Lesser Sunda (older slab, shallower 15–20 km mantle wedge corner) forms a wide (80–120 km) lizardite-rich 'hard barrier' that impedes downdip rupture, confining the seismogenic zone (<100 km) to shallow crustal depths. Sensitivity tests identify incoming-plate age and mantle wedge corner depth as first-order controls.
本研究结合30年海洋地球物理观测、8条剖面的二维有限元运动学-热模拟及蛇纹石多晶型实验室摩擦数据，探讨了巽他弧巨型逆冲地震的沿走向差异。结果表明，温暖的苏门答腊（年轻板片、约25 km深的地幔楔角）在地幔楔角下方仅发育窄（<30 km）的速度强化蜥纹石“软障碍”，更深处（30–50 km）过渡为不稳……

t: 2D steady-state finite-element kinematic-thermal modeling in COMSOL Multiphysics combined with petrologic phase-transition criteria and laboratory frictional constraints to map seismogenic zones and lizardite/antigorite regimes along megathrust transects.
利用COMSOL进行二维稳态有限元运动学-热模拟，结合蛇纹石相变与摩擦实验约束划分发震带与软/硬障碍区。

Tectonic and marine geophysical constraints compiled across eight arc-perpendicular transects along the Sunda Arc (Sumatra, Java, Lesser Sunda), plus global comparisons with Mariana, Kermadec, Chile, and Japan Trench.
汇编巽他弧8条垂直岛弧剖面的30年海洋地球物理与构造约束数据，并与马里亚纳、智利和日本等俯冲带对比。

Sumatra profiles show wide seismogenic zones (180–220 km) with narrow (<30 km) lizardite soft barriers supporting Mw > 8.5 earthquakes, whereas Java/Lesser Sunda show narrower (<100 km) crustal zones and wide (80–120 km) lizardite hard barriers.
苏门答腊发育180–220 km宽发震带和<30 km窄蜥纹石软障碍（支持Mw>8.5），爪哇发育<100 km窄发震带…
The 2D models cannot resolve along-strike rupture length or 3D heterogeneity in structure, petrology, friction, and stress, and deep fault composition requires proxy wet-quartz flow laws.
二维模型无法约束沿走向破裂长度及三维非均匀性，且深部断层成分缺乏直接约束需采用湿石英代理流变律。

Extends the mantle-wedge serpentine soft-barrier hypothesis to a previously unrecognized cold hard-barrier end-member (Java, Mariana), reconciling along-strike megathrust behavior across the Sunda Arc.
将地幔楔蛇纹石软障碍假说拓展至寒冷的“硬障碍”端元（爪哇、马里亚纳），统一解释了巽他弧巨震活动差异。

kc: Constructed 2D kinematic-thermal finite-element models along eight transects across the Sunda Arc constrained by 30 years of marine geophysical observations.

Distinguished two contrasting mantle-wedge configurations: a warm Sumatra-type 'soft barrier' (narrow lizardite zone followed by seismogenic antigorite) and a cold Java-type 'hard barrier' (wide lizardite zone inhibiting deep rupture).

Demonstrated via earthquake scaling with depth-dependent upper-plate rigidity that Sumatra's 180–220 km seismogenic width supports Mw > 8.5 events, while Java's 80–100 km width limits events to Mw 7.6–8.1.

Performed systematic sensitivity tests showing incoming-plate age and mantle wedge corner (MWC) depth are first-order controls on seismogenic-zone width, modulated by dip, friction, convergence rate, and obliquity.
Extended the temperature-dependent serpentine framework to global subduction margins including Mariana, Kermadec, south-central Chile, and Japan Trench.
基于30年海洋地球物理观测约束，建立了横跨巽他弧8条剖面的二维运动学-热有限元模型。
区分了两种截然不同的地幔楔构造模式：温暖的苏门答腊型“软障碍”（窄蜥纹石带后接发震叶蛇纹石）和寒冷的爪哇型“硬障碍”（阻碍深部破裂的宽蜥纹石带）。
利用随深度变化的上盘刚度进行地震标度分析，证明苏门答腊180–220 km的发震带宽度支持Mw > 8.5巨震，而爪哇80–100 km的宽度将地震限制在Mw 7.6–8.1。
通过系统敏感性测试表明俯冲板片年龄和地幔楔角（MWC）深度是控制发震带宽度的首要因素，并受倾角、摩擦、汇聚速率和斜交角度调节。
将温度依赖型蛇纹石相变框架推广至马里亚纳、克马德克、智利中南部和日本海沟等全球俯冲边缘。
me: 2D steady-state finite-element kinematic-thermal modeling implemented in COMSOL Multiphysics incorporating heat conduction, advection, radiogenic heating, and megathrust frictional/viscous shear heating.
Petrologic-frictional stability classification combining modeled megathrust P-T paths with laboratory friction constraints on quartz/carbonate sediments and lizardite-to-antigorite phase transitions.
Earthquake moment-magnitude scaling analysis incorporating empirical P-wave velocity-derived depth-dependent upper-plate rigidity.
Single-parameter perturbation sensitivity analysis evaluating the effects of slab age, dip, Moho depth, friction coefficient, convergence rate, and obliquity.
基于COMSOL Multiphysics的二维稳态有限元运动学-热模拟，包含热传导、热平流、生热率以及断层摩擦/粘滞剪切生热。
结合断层P-T轨迹、石英/碳酸盐沉积物实验室摩擦约束及蜥纹石-叶蛇纹石相变条件的岩石学-摩擦稳定性分类方法。
融合由纵波速度经验转换所得的随深度变化上盘刚度的地震矩震级标度分析。
评估板片年龄、倾角、莫霍面深度、摩擦系数、汇聚速率和斜交角度影响的单参数扰动敏感性分析。
de: 30-year synthesis of marine geophysical observations along eight Sunda Arc transects (bathymetry, slab geometry, active-source seismic MWC depths, sediment thickness/petrology, and seafloor heat-flow probe measurements).
Laboratory frictional and rheological parameters for quartzo-feldspathic rocks, carbonates, olivine creep, wet-quartz viscous flow, and serpentine polymorphs (lizardite, chrysotile, antigorite).
Historical and modern earthquake catalogs (GCMT, ISC-EHB), coseismic slip distributions, and geodetic interseismic locking depths along Sumatra, Java, Mariana, Kermadec, Chile, and Japan.
巽他弧8条剖面30年海洋地球物理观测综合数据（水深地形、板片几何、主动源地震地幔楔角深度、沉积物厚度/岩石学及海底热流探针测量）。
长英质岩石、碳酸盐岩、橄榄石蠕变、湿石英粘滞流动及蛇纹石多晶型（蜥纹石、纤蛇纹石、叶蛇纹石）的实验室摩擦与流变参数。
苏门答腊、爪哇、马里亚纳、克马德克、智利和日本俯冲带的历史与现代地震目录（GCMT、ISC-EHB）、同震滑动分布及大地测量震间闭锁深度。
li: The 2D steady-state thermal models cannot resolve along-strike length (L) or 3D heterogeneity in fault structure, petrology, frictional properties, and stress distribution.

Exact spatial distributions of sediments, crustal rocks, and mantle materials within the deep megathrust fault zone are poorly constrained and require simplified proxy rheologies (wet-quartz flow law).
Insufficient seafloor heat flow measurements in several transects require assuming effective basal friction coefficients (0.03–0.05) based on sediment thickness and seamount subduction.
二维稳态热模型无法解析发震带的沿走向长度（L）或断层结构、岩石学、摩擦性质及应力分布的三维非均匀性。
深部大逆冲断层带内沉积物、地壳岩石和地幔物质的精确空间分布缺乏约束，需要采用简化的代理流变律（湿石英流动律）。
部分剖面缺乏足够的海底热流测量数据，需根据沉积物厚度和海山俯冲情况假设有效基底摩擦系数（0.03–0.05）。

tm.why: The paper links laboratory friction data and temperature-dependent serpentine phase transitions (lizardite vs. antigorite) to megathrust frictional stability, aseismic creep, and stick-slip behavior.

The study constructs 2D kinematic-thermal finite-element models of subduction zones across the Sunda Arc to evaluate how slab age, mantle wedge corner depth, and convergence parameters control forearc thermal structure.
The authors evaluate how soft and hard lizardite-rich barriers control downdip rupture propagation, seismogenic zone width, and earthquake magnitude scaling.

ev.notes: Full 14-page PDF analyzed, including abstract, main text (§1–§5), Table 1, and Figures 1–9.

sum: This study evaluates the safety of early-strength mineral-based cementitious reinforcement materials for high-pile wharfs in port engineering using a multi-scale numerical framework and laboratory testing. Dynamic triaxial tests on solidified ISO standard sand characterize shear modulus and damping ratio across varying curing agent dosages (1–8%) and confining pressures (0.1–0.4 MPa). An OpenSees finite element model couples material (PressureIndependMultiYield), component (pile-soil interface), and system scales, validated against centrifuge shaking table benchmarks. A Back-Propagation (BP) neural network surrogate model and Monte-Carlo simulation quantify probabilistic failure. Results show an 8% curing agent yields an initial dynamic shear modulus exceeding 800 MPa. Reinforcing the retaining wall base is optimal, reducing surface residual displacement by 33.3% and pile bending moment by 34.4%. While a 3 m depth maximizes deterministic displacement reduction (50%), a 2 m reinforcement depth offers superior probabilistic risk control across earthquake intensities, reducing severe damage probability to 1.1% at 0.5g.
本研究针对港口工程高桩码头抗震加固材料安全性，结合室内动三轴试验与OpenSees多尺度数值模拟，探究早强矿物基胶凝材料固化土的动力特性。研究构建了涵盖材料、构件与系统尺度的流固耦合有限元模型，并利用离心机试验数据验证；进而结合BP神经网络代理模型与蒙特卡洛方法计算结构失效概率。结果表明：8%固化剂……

t: Constructs a multi-scale OpenSees finite element model (material, component, and system scales) calibrated by dynamic triaxial tests, and combines a BP neural network surrogate with Monte-Carlo simulation to compute structural failure probabilities.
结合动三轴试验构建OpenSees三尺度有限元模型，并利用BP神经网络代理模型与蒙特卡洛方法计算结构失效概率。

Uses 16 dynamic triaxial test conditions (varying curing agent dosage 1–8%, confining pressure 0.1–0.4 MPa, and curing time 7–14 days) on ISO standard sand, alongside centrifuge shaking table benchmark data.
包含ISO标准砂的16组动三轴试验数据（不同掺量、围压与龄期）以及Kobe和El-Centro波激励下的离心机试验基准数…

At 8% curing dosage, initial dynamic shear modulus exceeds 800 MPa. Reinforcing the retaining wall foot reduces surface displacement to 0.24 m, and a 2 m reinforcement depth keeps severe failure probability at 1.1% under 0.5g.
8%掺量下初始动剪切模量超800 MPa；加固挡土墙脚使地表位移降至0.24 m；0.5 g下2 m加固深度严重破坏概率…
Omits complex clay/organic soil layers, simplifies the wharf deck as a rigid body, and neglects long-term wet-dry cycle durability degradation of the curing agent.
未考虑含黏土或有机质的复杂土层，简化假设码头面板为刚体，且忽略了长期干湿循环对固化剂耐久性的影响。
Integrates dynamic triaxial tests and centrifuge benchmarks into a three-scale OpenSees model coupled with a BP neural network and Monte-Carlo probabilistic safety evaluation for port wharfs.
融合动三轴与离心机数据建立材料-构件-系统多尺度模型，并结合神经网络与蒙特卡洛模拟实现高桩码头概率安全评估。

kc: Characterized dynamic shear modulus and damping ratio of sand solidified with an early-strength mineral-based cementitious agent across dosages (1–8%) and confining pressures (0.1–0.4 MPa).
Developed a multi-scale OpenSees finite element framework linking constitutive soil behavior, zero-length pile-soil interfaces, and 2D fluid-solid coupled system response.
Trained a BP neural network surrogate model (R² = 0.9661) integrated with Monte-Carlo simulation to evaluate structural failure probabilities under parameter uncertainty.
Identified the retaining wall foot and a 2 m grouting depth as optimal for balancing displacement control and probabilistic seismic risk across 0.2g and 0.5g excitations.
通过动三轴试验表征了不同固化剂掺量（1–8%）和围压（0.1–0.4 MPa）下早强矿物基胶凝固化土的动剪切模量与阻尼比演化规律。
建立了连接固化土本构、桩-土接触界面零长度单元及二维流固耦合系统的OpenSees多尺度有限元框架。
训练了高精度BP神经网络代理模型（测试集R²=0.9661）并结合蒙特卡洛模拟，量化了参数不确定性下的结构失效概率。
确定挡土墙脚与2 m注浆深度为最优方案，在0.2 g与0.5 g地震下实现了变形控制与失效概率风险的最佳平衡。
me: Stress-controlled cyclic dynamic triaxial testing (3 Hz, 30–240 kPa) on saturated solidified standard sand samples.
Multi-scale finite element modeling in OpenSees using PressureIndependMultiYield soil elements, Giuffré-Menegotto-Pinto steel fibers, and Biot porous medium quadUP elements.
Levenberg-Marquardt least-squares parameter calibration of constitutive hysteresis loops accounting for open-loop plastic strain energy.
Three-layer BP neural network surrogate modeling coupled with 10,000-sample Monte-Carlo probabilistic reliability analysis.
对饱和固化标准砂试样进行应力控制式正弦循环动三轴试验（频率3 Hz，动应力幅值30–240 kPa）。
基于OpenSees构建多尺度有限元模型，采用PressureIndependMultiYield本构、Giuffré-Menegotto-Pinto钢纤维模型及Biot多孔介质quadUP流固耦合单元。
考虑非闭合滞回环塑性应变能，采用Levenberg-Marquardt最小二乘法标定本构模型参数。
构建三层BP神经网络代理模型，并结合10,000次采样的蒙特卡洛方法进行结构抗震可靠性概率分析。
de: 16 sets of dynamic triaxial test conditions (4 dosages × 4 confining pressures × 2 curing times, with 3 parallel samples each) on ISO standard sand.
Benchmark dynamic centrifuge shaking table test data (An et al.) under Kobe and El-Centro ground motions for system-scale validation.
320 finite element simulation data pairs divided into training (70%), validation (15%), and testing (15%) sets for BP neural network training.
基于ISO标准砂的16组动三轴试验工况（4种掺量×4种围压×2种龄期，每组3个平行试样）。
用于系统尺度模型验证的Kobe波和El-Centro波激励下高桩码头离心机振动台基准试验数据。
由有限元模型生成的320组参数-响应数据对（按70%、15%、15%划分为训练集、验证集与测试集）。
li: Laboratory experiments used uniform ISO standard sand and did not account for complex natural soil strata containing clay or organic matter.
The numerical model assumes a rigid wharf deck ideally fixed to the pile foundation, simplifying structural synergistic deformation effects.
Long-term durability degradation of the curing agent under marine wet-dry cycles was not considered.
室内试验采用均质ISO标准砂，未考虑实际场地含黏土或有机质的复杂土层。
数值模型假设码头面板为刚体并与桩基理想固结，简化了结构的协同变形效应。
未考虑长期干湿循环作用对固化剂耐久性能退化的影响。

tm.why: Evaluates the seismic response, liquefaction mitigation, and structural failure probability of high-pile wharfs under strong earthquake ground motions (0.2g to 0.5g).

Employs a Back-Propagation (BP) neural network surrogate model combined with Monte-Carlo simulation to predict surface residual displacements and probabilistic structural failure under seismic excitation.

ev.notes: Full text PDF (26 pages) including abstract, methodology, equations, 14 figures, and 7 tables was analyzed.

sum: This paper extends the variational two-point Eigenray method in heterogeneous anisotropic elastic media to finite frequencies using trajectory mechanics, where a frequency-dependent potential couples phase and amplitude. The core novelty is proving an effective-medium equivalence: the finite-frequency Hamiltonian is dynamically equivalent to the classical Christoffel Hamiltonian with a conformally rescaled stiffness tensor, multiplying the classical Lagrangian by an effective refractive index. Consequently, the finite-element Eigenray solver requires only local modifications to the ray-velocity kernel while preserving its variational structure, Bliss identities, and Jacobi dynamic equations. A weak-coupling approximation yields first-order path and phase-time corrections, and naturally explains banana-doughnut sensitivity kernels. Tested on a 2D low-velocity lens model with multipathing and a cusp caustic against finite-difference solutions, the framework shows that closing the amplitude via a phase-space (Maslov) integral accurately reproduces finite-difference waveforms across caustics where standard ray theory fails.
本文利用轨迹力学将非均匀各向异性弹性介质中的两点变分本征射线法（Eigenray）扩展至有限频域。核心创新在于证明了等效介质等价性：有限频哈密顿量动态等价于刚度张量共形缩放后的经典Christoffel哈密顿量，其拉格朗日量仅需乘以等效折射率。因此，原有有限元求解器仅需局部修改射线速度核即可保留变分……

t: Extends the finite-element variational Eigenray method to finite frequencies by conformally rescaling the stiffness tensor with a frequency-dependent amplitude-curvature potential, supplemented by a Maslov phase-space integral for caustic-regular amplitude closure.
通过频变振幅势对刚度张量共形缩放将变分Eigenray扩展至有限频，并结合Maslov积分实现焦散区振幅闭合。

Evaluated on a 2D isotropic acoustic model with a circular low-velocity lens (radius 500 m, 1500 m/s in a 2000 m/s background) generating multipathing and a cusp caustic, benchmarked against 8th-order finite-difference synthetics.
采用含圆形低速透镜的二维声波模型产生多路径与尖点焦散，并与8阶有限差分合成记录进行对比基准测试。

At the cusp receiver, Eigenray overestimates amplitude by 12.4x (misfit 12.3), whereas Eigenwave peaks within 3.5% (misfit 0.21, correlation 0.981); across the 201-receiver gather, the Maslov closure achieves a 0.20 median misfit.
尖点处射线法高估振幅12.4倍，本征波误差仅3.5%（相关系数0.981）；全排列Maslov闭合中位失配0.20。

Eigenwave phase accuracy depends on the closure field and is unreliable near off-axis caustics due to ambiguous KMAH bookkeeping; far from caustics, numerical noise in W exceeds finite-frequency corrections.
离轴焦散附近KMAH相位计入规则不明确导致相位不可靠；远离焦散区时势函数数值噪声大于有限频修正。

Establishes an exact dynamical equivalence between finite-frequency trajectory mechanics and classical anisotropic ray theory via a scalar refractive index, enabling finite-frequency ray bending with minimal code changes.
建立了有限频轨迹力学与经典各向异性射线理论的等效介质动态等价性，仅需局部修改速度核即可实现有限频射线弯曲。

kc: Proved that the finite-frequency trajectory-mechanics Hamiltonian is dynamically equivalent to a classical Christoffel Hamiltonian in an effective medium with a conformally rescaled stiffness tensor.

Derived the finite-frequency Euler-Lagrange (kinematic) and Jacobi (dynamic) Eigenwave equations, showing that the existing finite-element Eigenray solver requires only local modifications to the ray-velocity kernel.

Developed a weak-coupling perturbation theory that yields a forced Jacobi equation for path corrections, a path-integral phase-time correction, and a trajectory-mechanics explanation of banana-doughnut kernels.
Formulated a phase-space (Maslov) amplitude closure that regularizes caustic singularities and accurately reproduces finite-difference waveforms across a cusp caustic.
证明了有限频轨迹力学哈密顿量在动力学上等价于刚度张量共形缩放后的等效介质经典Christoffel哈密顿量。
推导了有限频Euler-Lagrange（运动学）和Jacobi（动力学）本征波方程，表明现有有限元Eigenray求解器仅需对射线速度核进行局部修改即可适用。
发展了弱耦合微扰理论，给出了路径修正的受迫Jacobi方程和相时修正的路径积分，并从轨迹力学角度解释了香蕉-甜甜圈灵敏度核。
提出了相空间（Maslov）振幅闭合方法，正则化了焦散奇异性，并在尖点焦散区精确重现了有限差分波形。
me: Variational calculus and finite-element ray-bending with Hermite interpolation for two-point boundary-value trajectories
Trajectory-mechanics polar wavefield decomposition with frequency-dependent amplitude-curvature potential
Conformal stiffness tensor rescaling (effective-medium equivalence) and weak-coupling linearization
Phase-space (Maslov) asymptotic integral and complex-sheared uniform representations for caustic-regular amplitude closure
基于变分微积分与Hermite插值有限元射线弯曲法的两点边值轨迹求解
包含频变振幅曲率势的轨迹力学极坐标波场分解
刚度张量共形缩放（等效介质等价性）与弱耦合线性化
用于焦散区正则化振幅闭合的相空间（Maslov）渐近积分与复剪切一致表示
de: Analytical illustration of effective-medium slowness and ray-velocity surfaces for a 2D tilted transversely isotropic (TTI) medium

2D acoustic numerical experiment featuring a circular low-velocity focusing lens (R = 500 m, v = 1500 m/s in a 2000 m/s background) producing multipathing and a cusp caustic, benchmarked against 8th-order finite-difference simulations
Analytical benchmarks in a 1D Gaussian gradational potential layer and 3D homogeneous medium with Born-scattered banana-doughnut sensitivity kernels
二维倾斜横向各向同性（TTI）介质中等效介质慢度面与射线速度面的解析算例
包含圆形低速聚焦透镜（半径500 m，速度1500 m/s，背景2000 m/s）、产生多路径与尖点焦散的二维声波数值实验，并与8阶有限差分模拟进行基准对比
一维高斯渐变势层中的解析基准测试，以及三维均匀介质中Born散射香蕉-甜甜圈灵敏度核的解析推导
li: Near off-axis caustics and split caustics, the Eigenwave phase correction is sensitive to closure aperture and lacks a simple rule for KMAH index bookkeeping.
Phase errors scale with path length in wavelengths times the average error in the potential W, making the phase sensitive to numerical differentiation, clipping, and smoothing.
Far from caustics (>1.5 Airy lengths), the true finite-frequency correction is smaller than numerical noise in the potential, offering no accuracy gain over classical Eigenrays.
Diffraction-dominated arrivals around sharp sub-wavelength boundaries belong to no ray branch and are not captured by ray-family closures.
Numerical validation is restricted to 2D isotropic acoustic media; 3D automatic mixed-chart selection, anisotropy, shear modes, and mode coupling remain untested numerically.
在离轴焦散和分裂焦散附近，本征波相位修正对闭合孔径敏感，且缺乏简单的KMAH指数计入规则。
相位误差与以波长计的路径长度及势函数W的平均误差成正比，导致相位对数值微分、截断和平滑非常敏感。
远离焦散区（大于1.5倍Airy长度）时，真实的有限频修正小于势函数的数值噪声，相比经典本征射线无精度提升。
亚波长尖锐边界周围由衍射主导的震相不属于任何射线分支，无法被射线族闭合场捕获。
数值验证仅限于二维各向同性声学介质；三维混合坐标图的自动选择、各向异性、剪切波模态及模态耦合尚未进行数值测试。

tm.why: The paper develops a finite-element variational framework for modeling finite-frequency wave trajectories, phases, and amplitudes in heterogeneous anisotropic elastic media.
The theoretical formulation and effective-medium equivalence are derived for general 3D heterogeneous anisotropic elastic media, with explicit specializations to TTI media.
The method extends two-point boundary-value ray tracing to finite frequencies and connects trajectory mechanics directly to banana-doughnut traveltime sensitivity kernels.

ev.notes: Full 72-page arXiv manuscript (including Appendices A-L, all equations, 11 figures, and 4 tables) was read and analyzed directly from the PDF.

sum: This paper presents a neural-network-based framework for the sequential estimation of time-dependent seismic b-values. Because true b-values are unknown in real catalogs, the model (based on bidirectional long short-term memory, BiLSTM) is trained on synthetic catalogs generated by epidemic-type aftershock sequence (ETAS) simulations with prescribed piecewise-linear b-value variations. The model maps earthquake magnitude sequences directly to b-value sequences, achieving lower root-mean-square errors than conventional moving-window maximum-likelihood estimation (MLE). It suppresses spurious short-timescale fluctuations while maintaining adaptability to abrupt changes. When applied to the 2011 Tohoku earthquake sequence, the model successfully captures a gradual pre-mainshock decrease in b-value, offering smoother sequential estimates.
本文提出了一种基于神经网络的地震b值随时间变化顺序估计框架。由于真实地震目录中的真实b值未知，该方法利用流行病型余震序列（ETAS）模拟生成的合成目录进行训练，其中b值被设定为分段线性变化。该模型基于双向长短期记忆网络（BiLSTM），直接将地震震级序列映射为对应的b值序列。相比于传统的滑动窗口极大……

t: A bidirectional long short-term memory (BiLSTM) neural network trained on synthetic ETAS catalogs to map earthquake magnitude sequences directly to time-dependent b-values.
基于双向长短期记忆网络（BiLSTM）的神经网络，在合成ETAS目录上训练，直接将震级序列映射为随时间变化的b值。
Synthetic earthquake catalogs generated by epidemic-type aftershock sequence (ETAS) simulations with prescribed b-value variations, and real catalog data from the 2011 Tohoku earthquake sequence.
通过具有设定b值变化的流行病型余震序列（ETAS）模拟生成的合成地震目录，以及2011年东日本大地震序列的真实目录数据。

The BiLSTM model achieved lower root-mean-square errors than moving-window MLE, suppressed spurious fluctuations, and successfully reconstructed the pre-mainshock b-value decrease for the 2011 Tohoku earthquake.
BiLSTM模型比滑动窗口MLE实现了更低的均方根误差，抑制了虚假波动，并成功重建了2011年东日本大地震前b值的下降趋…
The bidirectional architecture yields retrospective estimates, introducing a trade-off between lag and leakage around abrupt changes when applied in a quasi-real-time manner.
双向架构产生的是回顾性估计，在准实时应用时，在突变附近存在时滞与泄漏之间的权衡。
First application of deep learning (BiLSTM) trained on physics-based ETAS simulations to sequentially estimate b-values without manually specifying a temporal window length.
首次将基于物理ETAS模拟训练的深度学习（BiLSTM）应用于顺序估计b值，无需手动指定时间窗口长度。

kc: Developed a novel deep-learning framework (BiLSTM) to sequentially estimate time-dependent b-values directly from magnitude sequences.
Utilized synthetic catalogs from ETAS simulations with prescribed b-value variations to train the neural network, bypassing the lack of true labels in real data.
Demonstrated that the proposed method avoids the trade-off between temporal stability and adaptability inherent in moving-window MLE without manual parameter tuning.
开发了一种新型深度学习框架（BiLSTM），直接从震级序列中顺序估计随时间变化的b值。
利用具有设定b值变化的ETAS模拟合成目录来训练神经网络，解决了真实数据中缺乏真实标签的问题。
证明了该方法避免了滑动窗口MLE中固有时间稳定性和适应性之间的权衡，且无需手动调节参数。
me: Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) neural network architecture.
Epidemic-Type Aftershock Sequence (ETAS) simulations for generating synthetic training catalogs.
Comparison with conventional moving-window Maximum Likelihood Estimation (MLE).
双向长短期记忆网络（BiLSTM）神经网络架构。
用于生成合成训练目录的流行病型余震序列（ETAS）模拟。
与传统的滑动窗口极大似然估计（MLE）进行对比。
de: Synthetic earthquake catalogs with constant, piecewise-linear, and sinusoidally varying b-values.
Real earthquake catalog data from the 2011 Tohoku earthquake sequence to evaluate pre-mainshock b-value changes.
具有常数、分段线性以及正弦变化的b值的合成地震目录。
来自2011年东日本大地震序列的真实地震目录数据，用于评估主震前的b值变化。
li: The bidirectional architecture is retrospective, introducing a trade-off between lag and leakage when applied in a quasi-real-time manner.
双向架构是回顾性的，在准实时应用时，在突变附近存在时滞与泄漏之间的权衡。

tm.why: The paper proposes a neural-network-based framework using bidirectional long short-term memory (BiLSTM) to estimate time-dependent b-values.
The study focuses on estimating the b-value of the Gutenberg-Richter law from earthquake catalogs and ETAS simulations.

ev.notes: No PDF was available. The analysis is strictly based on the detailed abstract provided in the metadata.

sum: This study presents the largest high-precision 142Nd dataset for a single hotspot, analyzing 29 Hawaiian shield-stage tholeiitic basalts. Complemented by 138Ce and 143Nd data, the results show no significant 142Nd variability (weighted mean 0.48 ± 0.27), remaining indistinguishable from reference materials and global ocean island basalts. This lack of anomaly indicates that the depleted mantle source of these lavas formed later than ~400 Ma after Solar System formation. Consequently, the data do not support the preservation of early-formed, primordial Sm-Nd isotopic heterogeneities in the deep mantle beneath Hawaii, despite the presence of seismically anomalous low-velocity zones. This highlights a discrepancy with other isotopic systems (e.g., 182W, 100Ru) and underscores the complexity of deep mantle reservoir preservation.
本研究提供了夏威夷热点最大规模的高精度142Nd数据集（29个样品，55次分析）。结果显示样品无显著142Nd异常（均值0.48 ± 0.27），与全球洋岛玄武岩一致。这表明其亏损地幔源区形成于太阳系形成约400 Ma之后。尽管该区存在地震低速异常，但新数据未支持深部地幔保留早期原始Sm-Nd同位素……

t: High-precision thermal ionization mass spectrometry (TIMS) combined with multiple chemical purification procedures to measure short-lived and long-lived radiogenic isotope systems.
采用高精度热电离质谱（TIMS）与多种化学纯化流程，测量短寿命和长寿命放射性同位素系统。
55 high-precision 142Nd analyses of 29 shield-stage tholeiitic basalts from the Hawaiian Islands, complemented by 138Ce and 143Nd data.
包含夏威夷群岛29个盾地阶段拉斑玄武岩的55次高精度142Nd分析，及Ce-Nd同位素数据。
Hawaiian basalts show no significant 142Nd variability (weighted mean 0.48 ± 0.27), indicating their depleted mantle source formed later than ~400 Ma after Solar System formation.
样品未见显著142Nd异常，表明其亏损地幔源区形成于太阳系形成约400 Ma之后。
Discrepancies between the lack of 142Nd anomalies and reported variations in 182W, 40K, and 100Ru remain difficult to resolve without identical sample measurements.
缺乏142Nd异常与已报道的182W等系统异常存在不一致，难以在非同一样品上直接对比。
Provides the largest high-precision 142Nd dataset for a single hotspot to test the preservation of early-formed silicate reservoirs in seismically anomalous deep mantle zones.
提供了单一个热点最大规模的高精度142Nd数据集，约束了地震波低速带深部地幔的早期演化。

kc: Presents the largest high-precision 142Nd dataset for a single hotspot (Hawaiian Islands).
Demonstrates that the depleted mantle source of Kea-trend lavas formed later than ~400 Ma after Solar System formation.
Shows that the deep mantle beneath Hawaii lacks large-scale primordial Sm-Nd isotopic heterogeneities, despite seismic low-velocity anomalies.
提供了单一热点（夏威夷群岛）中最大规模的高精度142Nd同位素数据集。
证实了Kea趋势熔岩的亏损地幔源区形成于太阳系形成约400 Ma之后。
表明尽管存在地震波低速异常，夏威夷下方的深部地幔仍缺乏大规模的原始Sm-Nd同位素非均匀性。
me: Thermal ionization mass spectrometry (TIMS) for high-precision 142Nd measurements.
Multiple chemical purification procedures to ensure analytical reproducibility.
Combined isotopic analysis of short-lived (146Sm-142Nd) and long-lived (147Sm-143Nd, 138La-138Ce) isotope systems.
采用高精度热电离质谱（TIMS）进行142Nd同位素测量。
使用多种化学纯化流程以确保分析的重现性。
结合短寿命（146Sm-142Nd）与长寿命（147Sm-143Nd, 138La-138Ce）同位素系统进行综合分析。
de: 55 high-precision 142Nd analyses of 29 shield-stage tholeiitic basalts from the Hawaiian Islands (Loa and Kea trends).
Complementary 138Ce and 143Nd measurements.
Comparison with JNdi-1 reference material and global ocean island basalt averages.
对夏威夷群岛（Loa和Kea趋势）的29个盾地阶段拉斑玄武岩进行了55次高精度142Nd分析。
补充测量了138Ce和143Nd同位素数据。
与JNdi-1标准物质及全球洋岛玄武岩平均值进行了对比。
li: The lack of 142Nd anomalies contrasts with reported variations in 182W, 40K, and 100Ru in some Hawaiian lavas.
Difficult to definitively link isotopic signatures to specific reservoirs without a more comprehensive, multi-system dataset on the exact same samples.
缺乏142Nd异常，这与部分夏威夷熔岩中已报道的182W、40K和100Ru异常存在冲突。
若不对完全相同的样品进行更全面的多系统测量，很难将这些同位素特征与特定源区联系起来。

tm.why: The paper investigates the preservation of early-formed geochemical reservoirs in the deep mantle beneath the Hawaiian hotspot, linking isotopic data to seismically anomalous low-velocity zones.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the provided abstract and public metadata since no PDF was available.

sum: This study investigates local P- and S-wave travel-time characteristics and station-dependent residuals across southern Ghana using data from the Ghana Digital Seismic Network (GHDSN) for 2012–2014. From a deep-learning-generated bulletin of 73 earthquakes recorded at six broadband stations, the authors selected nine well-recorded events with paired P and S arrivals at five or more stations (47 station-level observations). First-order linear regressions of travel time against hypocentral distance yielded effective velocities of 6.51 km/s for P waves (R² = 0.985) and 3.88 km/s for S waves (R² = 0.993), giving a Vp/Vs ratio of ~1.68. Median station residuals ranged from -0.40 to +1.17 s (P) and -1.39 to +1.27 s (S). A within-event station-label permutation test confirmed statistically significant non-random station effects (p = 0.0080 for P, p = 0.0110 for S), though small ΔR² values indicate limited overall variance contribution.
本研究利用加纳数字地震台网（GHDSN）2012–2014年的数据，分析了加纳南部地方震P波和S波走时特征及台站相关残差。作者从6个宽频带台站记录的73次地震目录中，筛选出至少在5个台站有成对P、S波到时的9次地震（共47组观测）。走时与震源距的一阶线性回归得出P波和S波有效速度分别为6.51 km……

t: First-order linear regressions of P and S travel times against 3D hypocentral distance yield effective velocities and residuals, followed by a 1,000-iteration within-event station-label permutation test on explained variance (ΔR²).
对P、S波走时与三维震源距进行一阶线性回归，并通过1000次事件内台站标签置换检验评估解释方差增量（ΔR²）。

Nine local earthquakes (47 paired P+S station observations) recorded across six broadband stations of the Ghana Digital Seismic Network (2012–2014), screened from a 73-event EQTransformer-derived bulletin.
从加纳数字地震台网2012–2014年73个深度学习地震目录中筛选出6个宽频带台站记录的9次地方震（47组P+S观测）。

Effective velocities are 6.51 km/s for P (R²=0.985) and 3.88 km/s for S (R²=0.993). Median station residuals span -0.40 to +1.17 s (P) and -1.39 to +1.27 s (S), with permutation p-values of 0.0080 and 0.0110.
P、S波有效速度分别为6.51和3.88 km/s；台站中位残差分别为-0.40至+1.17 s和-1.39至+1.27…
Small sample size (9 events, 47 observations), uneven ray coverage, and unmodeled 3D structure or location/picking errors prevent interpreting empirical residuals as formal site corrections.
样本量小（9次地震47组观测）、射线分布不均及未建模三维结构和定位误差限制了将残差解释为正式台站校正。
First empirical station-by-station characterization of P and S travel-time residuals and within-event permutation testing for the Ghana Digital Seismic Network dataset.
首次对加纳数字地震台网数据集开展逐台站P、S波走时残差经验表征及事件内置换统计检验。

kc: Derived empirical effective velocities of 6.51 km/s (P-wave) and 3.88 km/s (S-wave), with Vp/Vs ≈ 1.68, for southern Ghana.
Quantified station-dependent travel-time residuals across six broadband stations of the Ghana Digital Seismic Network (GHDSN).

Introduced a within-event station-label permutation test showing that station residual patterns are statistically significant (p = 0.0080 and 0.0110) but account for a small fraction of total travel-time variance.
推导出加纳南部经验有效波速：P波6.51 km/s，S波3.88 km/s，波速比Vp/Vs约为1.68。
量化了加纳数字地震台网（GHDSN）6个宽频带台站的P波与S波走时残差。
引入事件内台站标签置换检验，证明台站残差模式具有统计显著性（p=0.0080和0.0110），但占总走时方差的比例较小。
me: Phase-coverage screening retaining events with paired P and S arrivals at >= 5 stations.
Three-dimensional hypocentral distance calculation from epicentral surface distance and focal depth.
First-order linear regression of P- and S-wave travel times versus hypocentral distance.
Within-event station-label permutation testing (1,000 randomizations) evaluating ΔR² to test non-random station effects.
基于震相覆盖率的事件筛选，保留至少在5个台站具有成对P波和S波到时的地震。
结合震中距和震源深度计算三维震源距。
P波和S波走时相对于震源距的一阶线性回归分析。
事件内台站标签置换检验（1000次随机化），通过评估ΔR²检验非随机台站效应。
de: Reanalysis of the 2012–2014 GHDSN waveform archive and SEISAN earthquake bulletin originally generated via EQTransformer.

Quality-controlled subset of 9 local earthquakes (ML ~3.0–4.0, depths 1.7–78 km, distances 8–308 km) providing 47 paired P+S station observations across 6 stations (AKOS, KLEF, KUKU, MRON, SHAI, WEIJ).
重新分析基于EQTransformer生成的2012–2014年GHDSN波形档案和SEISAN格式地震目录。
经质量控制的9次地方震子集（震级约3.0–4.0，深度1.7–78 km，震源距8–308 km），包含6个台站（AKOS、KLEF、KUKU、MRON、SHAI、WEIJ）的47组配对P+S观测。
li: Small sample size (only 9 earthquakes and 47 P+S observations) and uneven event-station geometry limit spatial path separation.
Simple linear regression against hypocentral distance collapses 3D crustal heterogeneity and ray-path curvature into effective parameters.
Relying on automated deep-learning phase picks and unrelocated hypocenters may introduce origin-time, location, and picking uncertainties into the residuals.
样本量较小（仅9次地震和47组P+S观测）且事件-台站几何分布不均，限制了空间路径效应的分离。
对震源距的简单线性回归将三维地壳非均匀性和射线弯曲简化为有效参数。
依赖深度学习自动震相拾取和未重定位的震源参数，可能会在残差中引入发震时刻、定位和拾取不确定性。

tm.why: The paper re-examines a local earthquake catalog and phase-arrival bulletin from the Ghana Digital Seismic Network to analyze P- and S-wave travel times and station residuals.
The study estimates effective crustal P- and S-wave velocities (6.51 and 3.88 km/s) across southern Ghana within the West African Craton.
It characterizes body-wave travel-time versus distance relationships and station-dependent residuals, laying empirical groundwork for future velocity-location-station inversions.

ev.notes: Full 28-page EarthArXiv preprint PDF used, including all equations, 7 figures, and text sections.

sum: RiptideRemix is an interactive web dashboard developed during the 2025 Ocean Hack Week to synthesize musical compositions from marine acoustic and geophysical datasets. By integrating pre-processed audio clips from sources like Ocean Networks Canada (ONC), SAGE, OrcaSound, and NCEI, the toolbox allows users to manipulate pitch, speed, and repetition in a visual audio mixer. The platform generates waveforms, spectrograms, and whimsical maps representing the sound sources. Beyond its creative utility, RiptideRemix serves an educational purpose by providing detailed descriptions of marine sensors, environments, and seismic wave physics, making complex geophysical data accessible and engaging to the public.
RiptideRemix是2025年海洋黑客周开发的交互式网页工具，利用海洋声学和地球物理数据合成音乐。该工具整合了ONC、SAGE、OrcaSound和NCEI的音频，允许用户在混音器中调整音高和速度，并生成波形与声谱图。项目还包含科普板块，介绍海洋传感器和地震波物理学，以寓教于乐的方式向公众推广……

sum: This study investigates the recent volcanic history and magmatic architecture of the poorly documented southern Manda Hararo rift segment (Gumat Mali and Gablaytu sub-segments) in Central Afar, Ethiopia. By combining high-resolution Pléiades stereo imagery (2 m DSM), medium-resolution satellite data (Landsat-8, Sentinel-2), field volcanology, bulk-rock geochemistry, and in-situ cosmogenic 36Cl surface exposure dating of 14 lava surfaces, the authors reconstruct the timing and style of the latest eruptions. Results demonstrate that volcanic activity occurred between ~3.20 and 1.50 ka at Gablaytu and between ~1.90 and 0.61 ka at Gumat Mali, considerably younger than previously thought (~30 ka). Petrological data show that Gumat Mali eruptions were triggered by mafic recharge and magma hybridization with evolved mush, whereas Gablaytu records progressive differentiation and plagioclase assimilation. The findings document the first late-Holocene phreatomagmatic explosive activity in southern Manda Hararo, informing regional volcanic hazard assessments near Semera.
本研究结合高分辨率Pléiades立体卫星影像、野外火山学考察、全岩主微量元素地球化学分析及14个熔岩表面的原位宇宙成因36Cl暴露测年，重建了埃塞俄比亚阿法尔中部曼达哈拉罗裂谷南段（Gumat Mali和Gablaytu亚段）的最新火山活动历史。结果表明，Gablaytu和Gumat Mali的最……

t: Combines high-resolution Pléiades stereo DSM generation (2 m) and multispectral remote sensing with field volcanology, ICP-OES/ICP-MS bulk-rock geochemistry, and in-situ cosmogenic 36Cl surface exposure dating via AMS.

19 Pléiades stereo pairs (4535 km²), Landsat-8 and Sentinel-2 imagery, 19 basaltic lava samples for major/trace element geochemistry, and 14 lava surface samples for 36Cl exposure dating collected in 2013–2023.
覆盖4535 km²的19对Pléiades立体影像、19个全岩地球化学样品及14个36Cl表面暴露测年熔岩样品。

Cosmogenic 36Cl ages range from 3.15±0.50 to 1.54±0.20 ka at Gablaytu and 1.90±0.29 to 0.61±0.19 ka at Gumat Mali, with MgO between 5.20–7.44 wt% reflecting magma recharge/hybridization at Gumat Mali and plagioclase assimilation at Gablaytu.
Gablaytu和Gumat Mali火山年龄分别为3.15–1.54 ka和1.90–0.61 ka，分别记录了斜长石…
Intrinsic 2σ uncertainties of 36Cl exposure ages overlap across consecutive eruptive stages at Gumat Mali, and older sub-aquatic/subaerial units at Gablaytu lack direct absolute dating.
Gumat Mali各阶段36Cl年龄在2σ误差内重叠，且Gablaytu早期水下/陆相单元缺乏直接绝对测年。

First late-Holocene (<3.2 ka) absolute chronology and documentation of explosive phreatomagmatic volcanism in southern Manda Hararo, identifying two distinct self-consistent rift sub-segments with independent transcrustal plumbing systems.

Provides high-resolution volcanological mapping of Gumat Mali and Gablaytu sub-segments using Pléiades stereo DSMs (2 m resolution) and multispectral imagery.
Identifies distinct transcrustal magmatic processes: mafic recharge and mush hybridization at Gumat Mali versus fractional crystallization and plagioclase assimilation at Gablaytu.
Documents late-Holocene high-energy phreatomagmatic explosive activity at Gumat Mali, highlighting new regional volcanic hazards for the nearby Semera district.
利用宇宙成因36Cl表面暴露测年，首次建立了曼达哈拉罗裂谷南段全新世晚期（~3.20至0.61 ka）的火山活动年代学框架。
结合Pléiades立体数字表面模型（2米分辨率）和多光谱遥感影像，完成了Gumat Mali和Gablaytu亚段的高分辨率火山地质填图。
揭示了两个亚段截然不同的跨地壳岩浆演化过程：Gumat Mali表现为基性岩浆补给与晶粥混合，Gablaytu表现为结晶分异与斜长石同化混染。
首次记录了Gumat Mali全新世晚期的高能射气岩浆爆发活动，为邻近Semera地区的火山灾害评估提供了新的地质约束。

sum: At magma-poor ultraslow-spreading mid-ocean ridges, large-offset detachment faults often alternate polarity in a 'flip-flop' regime. To determine the mechanical controls behind this behavior, this study employs 2-D visco-elasto-plastic thermo-mechanical simulations (using the SiStER code) alongside analytical force-balance and energy-minimization models. By varying frictional (0 to 0.3) and cohesive (15 to 40 MPa) strain weakening across 84 simulations in a 15-km thick axial brittle lithosphere, the authors identify three regimes: distributed minor faults, sequential flip-flop detachments, and persistent runaway detachments. Results demonstrate that the integrated strength contrast (ΔS) between intact lithosphere and weakened faults provides a unifying framework for faulting styles. Flip-flop detachments occur strictly at moderate strength contrasts (ΔS ≈ 0.4–1.1 TN/m), achievable via fault-zone serpentinization, where fault weakening balances flexural resisting forces and footwall thermal thinning triggers antithetic fault takeover without requiring magmatic intrusions.
在贫岩浆超慢速扩张洋中脊，大位移拆离断层常呈现极性交替的“翻转（flip-flop）”模式。本研究结合二维粘弹塑性热力学数值模拟（SiStER代码）与解析力平衡及能量最小化模型，对15公里厚轴部脆性岩石圈进行了84组参数模拟，系统改变摩擦（0–0.3）和内聚力（15–40 MPa）应变弱化程度。研究……

t: 2-D visco-elasto-plastic thermo-mechanical simulations (SiStER code) using finite-difference and particle-in-cell methods, paired with analytical force-balance and energy-minimization models.
采用有限差分与质点网格法的二维粘弹塑性热力学模拟（SiStER），结合力平衡与能量最小化解析模型。
84 numerical simulations exploring friction contrasts (0–0.3) and cohesion contrasts (15–40 MPa) across two lower-lithosphere rheological endmembers in a 15-km thick axial brittle layer.
在15公里厚轴部脆性层中，针对两种下岩石圈流变端元开展了84组改变摩擦和内聚力对比的数值模拟。

Flip-flop detachments emerge at intermediate integrated strength contrasts (ΔS between ~0.4 and 1.1 TN/m), with cycle durations of 700 kyr to 1 Myr, whereas higher contrasts cause runaway detachments.
翻转拆离断层在中等综合强度对比（0.4–1.1 TN/m）下发育，周期为70–100万年；更高对比导致失控断层。
The 2-D models neglect magma emplacement, reaction-dependent weakening, alteration density changes, thermal expansion, lateral buoyancy loads, and 3-D along-axis variations.
二维模型忽略了岩浆侵位、蚀变反应动力学、密度变化、热膨胀及三维沿轴向变化。

Provides the first systematic parametric study unifying frictional and cohesive fault weakening into an integrated strength contrast metric (ΔS) to explain flip-flop detachment mechanics analytically and numerically.
首次系统开展参数研究，将摩擦与内聚力弱化统一为综合强度对比指标（ΔS）以解析翻转断层机制。

Demonstrates that sequential flip-flop detachment faulting emerges specifically at moderate strength contrasts (0.4–1.1 TN/m) without requiring magmatic intrusions.
Formulates an analytical energy-minimization model explaining synchronous horst phases and polarity switches via competition between fault weakening and footwall thermal thinning.
确立了完整岩石圈与弱化断层带之间的综合强度对比（ΔS）作为控制洋中脊断层活动机制的统一指标。
证明了无需岩浆侵入，仅在中等强度对比（0.4–1.1 TN/m）条件下即可产生交替翻转拆离断层。
建立了能量最小化解析模型，通过断层弱化与下盘热减薄之间的竞争解释了双断层同步活动（地垒阶段）及极性转换机制。

Analytical rate of energy dissipation (work minimization) comparison between single-fault and two-fault (antithetic) configurations.

建立解析力平衡模型，对比断层摩擦弱化力与弹塑性弯曲阻力。

de: 84 two-dimensional numerical simulations systematically varying friction contrast (0–0.3) and cohesion contrast (15–40 MPa) across dry olivine and Newtonian lower-lithosphere endmembers.

与西南印度洋脊（SWIR）64°30'E区域的地形、地质及微震观测数据进行了定性与定量对比。

Brittle weakening is parameterized purely as a linear function of plastic strain rather than explicit chemical alteration reactions or fluid availability.
Models neglect rock thermal expansion, alteration-induced density changes, lateral buoyancy contrasts, and 3-D along-axis tectonic effects.

sum: This study investigates present-day microseismicity within the Tsetserleg-Bulnay fault system in Mongolia, which hosted two Mw>8 earthquakes in 1905. Using 16 months of temporary seismic network data, the authors construct a catalog of 8,000 earthquakes (ML ≥ -0.6) to image the 3D geometry of the fault system. The spatial distribution and rate of seismicity suggest that current activity represents long-lasting aftershocks of the 1905 sequence. The seismicity rate aligns with Omori and Gutenberg-Richter predictions. Furthermore, rate-and-state models explain why the slowly slipping Tsetserleg fault exhibits higher microseismicity than the faster-slipping Bulnay fault. This demonstrates that aftershock sequences in slowly deforming continental regions can persist for over a century, providing crucial insights into historical ruptures and long-term fault behavior.
本研究利用16个月临时台网数据构建了蒙古1905年双8级地震断裂带的微震编目。结果表明，当前的微震是1905年地震的超长余震，衰减率符合Omori和G-R定律。速率-状态摩擦模型解释了为何慢划动的鹐鹐尔勒格断裂比快划动的布尔奈断裂微震更活跃，证实了缓慢变形大陆区余震可望持续百年以上。

sum: Prestack seismic inversion often suffers from ill-posedness, parameter coupling, and structural complexity. This paper proposes a Global Structure-Constrained Prestack Inversion (GSCI) framework that represents the 3D spatial and elastic parameter (Vp, Vs, density) model as a 4D tensor. Forward modeling and inversion are formulated via multidimensional matrix multiplication, avoiding the computational bottlenecks of giant Kronecker-product matrices. The method introduces decoupled dimension-wise regularizations: vertical sparse/Gaussian reflection constraints, parameter-domain stabilization using Gardner's empirical velocity-density relationship, and lateral structural constraints. Unlike conventional structure-oriented methods relying on local amplitude-derived structure tensors, GSCI directly integrates interpreted seismic horizons via a Fourier-phase-interpolated layer-flattening matrix and preserves sharp discontinuities using fault-guided indicator tensors. Validated on the 2D Marmousi-2 model, a 3D overthrust synthetic model, and a 3D field dataset with well logs, GSCI significantly enhances density stability, lateral continuity, and fault boundary preservation while maintaining high computational efficiency.

sum: This paper proposes integrating wavelet transform methods directly into modern seismic imaging workflows, such as Least-Squares Migration (LSM) and Full Waveform Inversion (FWI), rather than using them solely for pre- or post-processing. By leveraging the multiscale, localized, and directional properties of wavelets, the authors develop techniques for wavelet-domain gradient conditioning, adaptive Hessian filtering for LSM, and Hessian-based preconditioning for FWI. Crucially, they introduce a wavelet-domain block Hessian inversion strategy for multi-parameter FWI, which successfully decouples parameter sensitivities (cross-talk) without heuristic reparameterization. Synthetic and field tests (using the Atlantis dataset) demonstrate accelerated convergence, reduced cross-talk, and superior image fidelity, establishing the wavelet transform as a powerful, scalable tool for next-generation seismic inversion.

sum: Large Low Velocity Provinces (LLVPs) in Earth's lowermost mantle have been debated as either actively rising superplumes or passive thermochemical piles. While recent seismic tomography reveals tall, plume-shaped LLVP morphologies, this study uses 110 two-dimensional Boussinesq thermochemical convection simulations (via Citcom2D) to test the impact of thermal initial conditions and buoyancy numbers (0.1 to 1.0) on LLVP structure. Unlike traditional thermal equilibrium initial conditions that require buoyancy numbers above 0.7 to form passive piles, warm isothermal initial conditions (e.g., T = 0.8) enable the formation of tall passive piles ('superpiles') at low buoyancy numbers (e.g., B = 0.4). Consequently, there is no single critical buoyancy number separating piles from superplumes; background mantle temperature plays a critical governing role. Thus, plume-shaped LLVPs observed in seismic tomography do not necessarily indicate active superplumes, as they can be explained by passive superpiles lasting hundreds of millions of years.
本研究利用Citcom2D开展了110组二维Boussinesq热化学对流数值模拟，结合7个全球地震层析成像模型的太平洋LLVP剖面对比，探究初始温度条件和浮力数（0.1–1.0）对大型低速省（LLVP）形态的影响。研究发现，不存在单一的临界浮力数；在较热的等温初始条件下（如T=0.8），即使本征密……

t: 2D Cartesian thermochemical convection simulations under the Boussinesq approximation using a modified Citcom code with 1,980,000 tracers, evaluating effective density differences across varying initial temperatures and buoyancy numbers.
采用改进的Citcom代码和约198万示踪粒子，在Boussinesq近似下进行二维热化学对流模拟。

110 primary 2D thermochemical convection models spanning thermal equilibrium and 10 isothermal initial conditions (T = 0.0–1.0) with buoyancy numbers B = 0.1–1.0, plus 7 global tomography models via SubMachine.
110组涵盖不同初始温度和浮力数（0.1–1.0）的对流模型，以及SubMachine中的7个层析成像模型。

Thermal equilibrium initial conditions formed superplumes below B = 0.7 and passive piles above B = 0.7, whereas warm isothermal conditions (e.g., T = 0.8) formed tall passive piles ('superpiles') at much lower buoyancy numbers (B = 0.4).

The models use a simplified 2D Cartesian Boussinesq setup without internal heating, spherical curvature, or distinct compositional/grain-size rheologies between the reservoir and background mantle.

Established through comparison with seven global seismic tomography models that tall, plume-like LLVP geometries can represent passive superpiles rather than solely active superplumes.

sum: This study investigates the shallow magmatic plumbing system (<3 km) of Mt. Etna between January and September 2023 by integrating bulk plume geochemistry (SO2 and HCl fluxes via DOAS and OP-FTIR), volcanic tremor amplitude and 3D source locations, infrasound array detections, and Sentinel-2 SWIR thermal anomalies classified via k-means clustering. From January to mid-May 2023, coupled SO2 and HCl emissions (mean weight ratio ~4.4, matching theoretical bulk degassing of ~4.3), stable tremor beneath Bocca Nuova (BN), low infrasound, and persistent BN1 thermal anomalies indicate steady-state convective magma overturn and shallow (<1 km) magma ponding. From late May to August 2023, diverging SO2-HCl trends, heightened tremor migrating toward the Southeast Crater (SEC), increased infrasound, and shifting thermal anomalies reveal gas-melt decoupling, conduit re-pressurization leading to two lava fountains (21 May and 14 August), and localized shallow magma stagnation causing the 15 July collapse and reactivation of the BN2 pit crater.

t: Integrates DOAS/OP-FTIR plume geochemistry (SO2 and HCl fluxes), 3D grid-search volcanic tremor amplitude-decay localization, 2D brightness-function infrasound array localization, and unsupervised k-means (k=2) clustering of Sentinel-2 SWIR thermal imagery.

Nine months (January–September 2023) of continuous multiparametric monitoring at Mt. Etna using 9 FLAME DOAS scanners, OP-FTIR spectra, 16 broadband seismic stations, 10 infrasound microphones, and 20-m Sentinel-2 Band 12 images.
