Station malfunctions during February–March 2023 caused a ~1-month gap in reliable volcanic tremor source centroid locations and early-2023 infrasound event counts.
Low-energy infrasonic emissions at newly opened vents (e.g., BN2 in July 2023) could not be localized across the network due to insufficient signal detection across multiple stations.
FLAME-DOAS紫外光谱法受限于白天和良好天气，未能捕捉到5月21日（恶劣天气）和8月13–14日（夜间）熔岩喷泉期间的同喷发SO2通量。
2023年2月至3月部分山顶台站故障导致约1个月的火山颤动源定位数据缺失以及2023年初的次声事件计数不可靠。
新开启喷口（如2023年7月的BN2）产生的低能量次声信号无法被足够多的台站检测到，从而限制了其早期空间定位。

tm.why: The paper investigates Mt. Etna's shallow magmatic plumbing system by integrating volcanic tremor, infrasound, plume geochemistry, and satellite thermal imagery.
The study uses STA/LTA detection and 2D/3D grid-search methods to locate volcanic tremor centroids and infrasonic events across summit craters.
An unsupervised non-hierarchical k-means clustering algorithm is applied to Sentinel-2 satellite SWIR imagery to detect volcanic thermal anomalies.

ev.notes: Full 12-page PDF analyzed, including abstract, main text (§1–§5), all 6 figures, and references.

sum: Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) measures differential strain, making full-waveform inversion (FWI) highly vulnerable to localized near-surface scattering that masks deep targets. To overcome this, the authors extend 1-D time-frequency misfits to a 4-D time-frequency-space-wavenumber (TFXK) objective function using a 2-D Gabor transform across the entire DAS array. They derive adjoint sources for phase and normalized envelope misfits for both strain and strain-rate data, resulting in continuous dipole line sources. Tested on 2-D SPECFEM2D synthetic data with strong random shallow heterogeneities and two deep low-velocity anomalies, TFXK nearly doubles deep sensitivity kernel amplitudes at 8–12 Hz compared to 1-D time-frequency (TF) misfits. In L-BFGS inversions, TFXK converges in 140 iterations versus 266 for TF, reducing final model error by 18% (and 14% with correlated noise). Theoretical extensions for curved fibres using arc-length parametrization, Local Polynomial Fourier Transforms, and 3-D vectorial wavenumbers are also derived.
针对分布式声学传感（DAS）差分应变测量易受浅层局部散射干扰、难以反演深部结构的问题，本文利用二维Gabor变换提出了四维时间-频率-空间-波数（TFXK）目标函数，并推导了相位和包络失配的伴随源。在含强浅层随机非均匀体的二维SPECFEM2D合成数据测试中，TFXK利用空间相干性平滑了目标函数，在……

t: Extends 1-D time-frequency misfits to 4-D time-frequency-space-wavenumber (TFXK) phase and normalized envelope misfits via a 2-D Gabor transform over the full DAS strain field, deriving corresponding dipole line-source adjoint sources.
对DAS应变场应用二维Gabor变换，构建四维TFXK相位和归一化包络失配函数，并推导偶极线源伴随源。

2-D SPECFEM2D synthetic strain seismograms from 20 moment-tensor sources recorded on a 14.4-km straight surface DAS fibre (5 m spacing, 10 m gauge length) above three random shallow scattering layers and two deep anomalies.
含三层浅部随机散射和两个深部异常的二维模型，由14.4 km地表直光缆记录20个震源的SPECFEM2D合成数据。
TFXK nearly doubles smoothed kernel amplitudes at deep anomalies (8 and 12 Hz) compared to TF misfits, and converges in 140 vs 266 iterations with 18% lower final model error (14% with noise).
在8和12 Hz下深部核振幅提高近一倍；反演以140次迭代收敛（TF需266次），最终模型误差降低18%。
Computational and memory costs scale with the fourth power of frequency (requiring 400 GB at 12 Hz), and tests are limited to 2-D synthetic straight-fibre models with known sources.
计算和内存随频率四次方增长（12 Hz需400 GB），且仅在震源已知的二维直光缆合成数据上验证。

First 4-D spatiotemporal-spectral FWI objective function for DAS that enforces spatial coherence across channels to suppress near-surface scattering, alongside analytical extensions to curved fibre trajectories.
首次提出利用DAS空间相干性抑制浅层散射的四维TFXK反演目标函数，并给出弯曲光缆的理论扩展。

kc: Formulated a 4-D time-frequency-space-wavenumber (TFXK) phase and normalized envelope misfit function using a 2-D Gabor transform for DAS data.
Derived corresponding dipole line-source adjoint sources for strain and strain-rate measurements, with an efficient gauge-length shift-and-subtract numerical implementation.
Demonstrated via 2-D synthetic FWI that TFXK suppresses shallow scattering, nearly doubles deep kernel sensitivity at 8–12 Hz, and reduces model error by 14–18% in fewer iterations.
Developed three theoretical extensions for curved optical fibres: arc-length parametrization, 5-D Local Polynomial Fourier Transform (LPFT), and 6-D full vectorial wavenumber transform.
利用二维Gabor变换，为DAS数据构建了四维时间-频率-空间-波数（TFXK）相位和归一化包络失配函数。
推导了应变和应变率测量的偶极线源伴随源解析式，并提出了基于标距平移相减的高效数值实现策略。
通过二维合成全波形反演证明TFXK能有效抑制浅层散射，在8–12 Hz下使深部敏感度核振幅翻倍，减少迭代次数并将模型误差降低14–18%。
提出了三种适应弯曲光缆几何形态的理论扩展方案：弧长参数化、五维局部多项式傅里叶变换（LPFT）和六维全矢量波数变换。
me: 2-D Gabor transform applied across the spatiotemporal DAS strain/strain-rate wavefield to compute 4-D TFXK phase and normalized envelope misfits.
Adjoint-state method and representation theorem to derive dipole line-source adjoint sources accounting for finite gauge length.
2-D spectral-element wave propagation (SPECFEM2D) coupled with L-BFGS multi-scale optimization across 0.9–4 Hz, 0.9–6 Hz, and 0.9–8 Hz bands.
Stationary phase approximation and Radon-Nikodym derivatives to ensure isometric energy preservation for curved-fibre LPFT and 3-D wavenumber transforms.
对时空DAS应变/应变率波场应用二维Gabor变换，计算四维TFXK相位与归一化包络失配函数。
利用伴随状态法和表示定理，推导考虑有限标距（GL）效应的偶极线源伴随源。
结合二维谱元法波场模拟（SPECFEM2D）与L-BFGS算法，在0.9–4 Hz、0.9–6 Hz和0.9–8 Hz频带进行多尺度反演。
应用稳相近似与Radon-Nikodym导数修正积分测度，保证弯曲光缆LPFT及三维波数变换的等距能量守恒。
de: Exemplary field microseismic event from the downhole HFTS dataset (0.5 ms temporal sampling, 4 m spatial sampling) illustrating continuous wavefield sampling.
2-D synthetic elastic model (15 km wide by 5 km deep) containing three shallow random scattering layers and two deep 1-km-radius low-velocity/low-density anomalies.
Synthetic dataset generated using 20 moment-tensor point sources (at 2, 3, and 4 km depths) recorded on a 14.4 km surface straight DAS fibre (5 m channel spacing, 10 m gauge length).
Sensitivity kernel comparisons (up to 12 Hz) and L-BFGS FWI convergence tests (up to 8 Hz) comparing L2, 1-D TF, and 4-D TFXK misfits under noise-free and correlated-noise conditions.
展示井下HFTS数据集的微地震实测事件（0.5 ms时间采样，4 m空间采样），说明时空连续波场采样特性。
构建15 km宽、5 km深的二维合成弹性模型，包含三层浅部随机散射层和两个深部1 km半径的低速/低密度异常体。
使用分布在2、3、4 km深度的20个矩张量点源，在14.4 km长的地表直光缆（5 m道间距、10 m标距）上生成合成应变数据。
在无噪和时空相关噪声条件下，开展最高12 Hz的敏感度核对比及最高8 Hz的L2、一维TF和四维TFXK全波形反演收敛测试。
li: High computational and memory cost scaling with the fourth power of frequency (400 GB RAM at 12 Hz), and fifth/sixth power for LPFT and full-k curved fibre extensions.
Numerical validation is restricted to 2-D synthetic examples with a straight surface fibre and perfectly known seismic source parameters.
Theoretical extensions for curved fibres (arc-length, LPFT, full vectorial wavenumber) are derived mathematically but not tested numerically.
计算和内存开销巨大，随频率呈四次方增长（12 Hz时需400 GB内存），弯曲光缆扩展则呈五次或六次方增长。
数值验证仅限于二维合成数据和地表直光缆，且假设震源参数完全已知。
针对弯曲光缆的三种理论扩展方案仅给出了数学推导，尚未进行数值实验验证。

tm.why: The paper develops a 4-D time-frequency-space-wavenumber (TFXK) objective function and derives its corresponding adjoint sources for full-waveform inversion.
The misfit function specifically leverages the dense spatial sampling of DAS strain and strain-rate measurements and addresses curved fibre geometries.
The study formulates new spatiotemporal objective functions, derives adjoint operators, and establishes energy-preserving isometric transforms using Radon-Nikodym derivatives.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 51-page manuscript PDF, including mathematical derivations in §2 and §6, numerical experiments and figures in §3–§5, and Appendices A and B.

sum: Rapid hypocenter determination using 3D velocity models in subduction zones is computationally demanding. Extending HypoNet Nankai, this study presents HypoNet Nankai PS to incorporate both P- and S-wave travel times in the Nankai Trough. The authors construct a 3D S-wave velocity model from an existing P-wave model using empirical relations for marine sediments and crust. Because low shallow S-wave velocities (down to 0.2 km/s) create steep travel-time gradients, the original PINN training strategy failed. The authors revise the training by adopting full-3D source/collocation sampling with random-distance weighting, the Deeper-PINN architecture, and the second-order SOAP optimizer without domain decomposition. Benchmark tests against the fast marching method (FMM) show travel-time RMSDs of 0.1–0.3 s for S-waves and <0.12 s for P-waves, compressing the total model size to 63 MB. Applied to 223 DONET-recorded earthquakes, the system rapidly locates events (<1 s on GPU) and significantly reduces posterior uncertainties compared to P-only inversions.
本研究提出了HypoNet Nankai PS，将南海海槽基于物理信息神经网络（PINN）的三维震源定位框架扩展至同时支持P波和S波走时。作者首先利用经验转换关系从现有P波模型构建了三维S波速度模型。针对浅部低速海洋沉积物导致的陡峭S波走时梯度，研究改进了PINN训练策略：采用全三维域随机距离采样、……

t: Revises PINN eikonal solver training using full-3D source/collocation random-distance sampling, the Deeper-PINN architecture (30 shortcut blocks), and the second-order SOAP optimizer, coupled with GPU-accelerated MAP hypocenter inversion.
结合全三维随机距离采样、Deeper-PINN架构和二阶SOAP优化器训练PINN求解程函方程，并用GPU加速MAP定位…
Uses a 900×300×60 km 3D P- and empirically derived S-wave velocity model (~50 million points), tested on 3,313 synthetic events across DONET/N-net and 223 real earthquakes recorded by DONET.
采用南海海槽三维P波及经验转换S波速度模型，在3313个合成震源和223次DONET实际地震上进行测试。

Achieves travel-time RMSDs of 0.1–0.3 s for S-waves and <0.12 s for P-waves against FMM, <1 s GPU inversion per event, 63 MB total model size, and reduces 95th-percentile horizontal uncertainty from 26 km to 5 km.
P波和S波走时均方根误差分别<0.12 s和0.1–0.3 s，模型共63 MB，单次定位<1 s，水平不确定性从26 …
The 3D S-wave velocity structure relies on empirical conversion from P-wave velocities rather than direct seismic observations, and practical applications may still require station corrections.
三维S波速度模型由P波经验转换所得，缺乏直接地震观测约束，且未包含台站校正。
Extends PINN-based 3D subduction-zone hypocenter location to S-waves with steep shallow sediment gradients using a single compact global Deeper-PINN per wave type without domain decomposition.
克服浅部低速沉积物大梯度难题，无需区域分解即可利用单一全局PINN实现三维P波与S波快速震源定位。

kc: Constructed a 3D S-wave velocity model for the offshore Nankai Trough (900 km × 300 km × 60 km) from the N2018 P-wave model using empirical relations with a 0.2 km/s minimum threshold.

Revised the PINN eikonal solver training with full-3D random-distance sampling, Deeper-PINN (30 shortcut blocks), and the second-order SOAP optimizer, achieving 0.1–0.3 s S-wave and <0.12 s P-wave RMSD against FMM.
Eliminated domain decomposition to produce a compact 63 MB total model size (versus 500 MB previously and ~160 GB for FMM tables) with sub-second GPU-accelerated MAP hypocenter inversion.

Relocated 223 earthquakes recorded by DONET off the Kii Peninsula, showing that S-wave inclusion reduces the 95th percentile of horizontal uncertainty from 26 km to 5 km and places seaward events 18.6 km shallower on average than the JMA catalog.
基于N2018 P波模型和经验转换关系，构建了南海海槽外海（900 km × 300 km × 60 km）的三维S波速度模型（设定0.2 km/s速度下限）。
引入全三维随机距离采样、Deeper-PINN架构（30个残差块）和二阶SOAP优化器改进PINN训练，与FMM相比，S波和P波走时均方根误差分别降至0.1–0.3 s和0.12 s以内。
无需区域分解即可实现全局高精度走时推理，模型总大小仅为63 MB（原版为500 MB，传统FMM走时表约160 GB），结合GPU加速实现亚秒级MAP震源定位。
重定位了纪伊半岛外海DONET记录的223次地震，证实加入S波可将水平后验标准差的95%分位数从26 km降至5 km，且外海震源深度比JMA目录平均浅18.6 km。
me: Derived a 3D S-wave velocity structure using Hamilton (1979) relations for marine sediments (0–500 m below seafloor) and Brocher (2005) relations for deeper crust, capped at a minimum Vs of 0.2 km/s.

Trained a single global Deeper-PINN (width 256, 30 shortcut blocks, random Fourier feature embedding) per wave type to solve the 3D eikonal equation with hard source constraints and travel-time reciprocity.
Implemented full-3D source and collocation point sampling with a random-distance strategy and trained using the second-order SOAP optimizer on 8 NVIDIA A100 GPUs.

Estimated hypocenters via a GPU-accelerated Maximum A Posteriori (MAP) method marginalized over origin time, solved with L-BFGS from three initial depths (7.7, 30.5, 53.3 km) and Laplace approximation for uncertainty.
对海底以下0–500 m海洋沉积物采用Hamilton (1979)关系、对深部地壳采用Brocher (2005)关系推导三维S波速度结构，并设定0.2 km/s的最小横波速度阈值。
针对P波和S波分别训练单一全局Deeper-PINN网络（宽度256，30个快捷连接块，随机傅里叶特征嵌入），结合硬震源约束和走时互易性求解三维程函方程。
采用全三维震源与配点随机距离采样策略，并使用二阶SOAP优化器在8块NVIDIA A100 GPU上进行训练。
采用GPU加速的最大后验概率（MAP）方法（对发震时刻边缘化），从7.7、30.5和53.3 km三个初始深度使用L-BFGS求解震源位置，并通过拉普拉斯近似评估不确定性。
de: Downsampled the N2018 3D velocity model (900 km × 300 km × 60 km) to ~50 million points in regions with vertical velocity gradients < 0.1 s⁻¹, incorporating GEBCO bathymetry and EGM2008 geoid.
Benchmarked forward travel-time predictions against the fast marching method (FMM) across 20 random 3D sources (15 validation, 5 test) on a 1 km surface receiver grid.
Conducted synthetic hypocenter recovery tests for 3,313 grid sources across 5 depths (-10 to -50 km) using 51 DONET and 36 N-net seafloor stations with (0.1 s)² Gaussian noise.

Applied the system to P- and S-wave arrival times from 223 natural earthquakes (Sept 2020 – Dec 2023) recorded at ≥6 DONET stations off the Kii Peninsula, comparing against the JMA catalog and P-only inversions.
将N2018三维速度模型（900 km × 300 km × 60 km）在垂向速度梯度小于0.1 s⁻¹的区域降采样至约5000万个点，并融合GEBCO水深和EGM2008大地水准面数据。
在1 km间距的地表虚拟台网网格上，利用20个随机三维震源（15个验证集，5个测试集）将PINN正演走时与快进法（FMM）进行基准对比。
利用51个DONET台站和36个N-net海底台站，对5个深度（-10至-50 km）共3313个网格合成震源添加(0.1 s)²高斯噪声进行震源恢复测试。
将系统应用于2020年9月至2023年12月纪伊半岛外海至少6个DONET台站记录的223次天然地震的P波和S波到时数据，并与JMA目录及仅用P波的反演结果进行对比。
li: The 3D S-wave velocity model is derived empirically from P-wave velocities rather than directly constrained by S-wave seismic observations or tomography.
Hypocenter location errors and uncertainties remain large outside the seafloor station coverage (large station distances and azimuthal gaps > 200°–300°).
Station corrections were not included in the real-data demonstration, although combining 3D PINN models with station corrections may be preferable in practice.
三维S波速度模型是通过P波速度的经验转换关系推导的，并未直接受S波实际地震观测或层析成像约束。
在海底台网覆盖范围之外（台站距离大且方位角间隙大于200°–300°），震源定位误差和不确定性依然较大。
实际数据应用中未包含台站校正，而在实际业务应用中将三维PINN模型与台站校正相结合可能效果更佳。

tm.why: The paper develops a physics-informed neural network (Deeper-PINN) trained with the SOAP optimizer to solve the 3D eikonal equation for P- and S-wave travel times.
The core objective is rapid hypocenter determination and uncertainty estimation in the Nankai Trough subduction zone using P- and S-wave arrival times.
Hypocenter locations and uncertainties are determined via a maximum a posteriori (MAP) formulation marginalized over origin time with Laplace approximation.

ev.notes: Full 34-page preprint PDF analyzed, including all sections, equations, Table 1, and Figures 1–10.

sum: To investigate escalating hydraulic fracturing (HF)-induced seismicity in the Karnes Trough Fault Zone (Eagle Ford Shale, Texas), including the 2023 M4.0 and 2025 M4.7 earthquakes, the authors developed TM2DD—an open-source workflow integrating multistation template matching, automated noise-decay correlation thresholds, cross-correlation phase pick propagation, and hypoDD double-difference relocation. Applied to ~5 years of continuous TexNet waveforms (2020–2025), TM2DD expands the catalog 17.5-fold from 359 templates to 6,280 events (Mc = 0.75, b = 0.84). Relocations and RANSAC plane fitting reveal that the 2023 M4.0 and 2025 M4.7 sequences ruptured adjacent, connected segments of the same NE-SW striking fault system separated by a ~20° dip change (listric geometry). All four major sequences correlate with active HF wells within 3.5 km. Notably, the shallower 2023 M4.0 (2.4 km) exhibited swarm-like behavior, whereas the deeper 2025 M4.7 (6.4 km) displayed mainshock-aftershock characteristics, highlighting propagating hazard along connected faults.
针对德州Eagle Ford页岩区Karnes槽断裂带日益增强的水力压裂诱发地震（含2023年M4.0和2025年M4.7事件），本研究开发了TM2DD工作流，集成了多台模板匹配、自动噪声衰减相关阈值、互相关震相传播及hypoDD双差重定位。基于约5年的TexNet连续波形，该流程将目录扩充了17.……

t: TM2DD integrates 3-station template matching, automated noise-decay correlation thresholds, two-pass waveform cross-correlation pick propagation, elocate initial location, and iterative hypoDD double-difference relocation, followed by RANSAC plane fitting.
集成三台站模板匹配、自动噪声衰减阈值、互相关震相修正与传播、elocate初步定位、hypoDD双差重定位及RANSAC…
Continuous seismograms (Jan 2020–Apr 2025) from 10 TexNet stations (~25 km spacing) in the Karnes Trough Fault Zone, 359 TexNet template events, and hydraulic fracturing well data from the Texas RRC.
2020年1月至2025年4月Karnes槽断裂带10个TexNet台站连续波形、359个模板事件及德州RRC水力压裂井…

Expanded the catalog 17.5-fold (359 to 6,280 events, Mc=0.75, b=0.84). Relocations and RANSAC fits show the 2023 M4.0 (2.4 km, dip 60.36°) and 2025 M4.7 (6.4 km, dip 38.10°) ruptured connected segments within 3.5 km of active HF wells.
Sparse station spacing (~25 km) poorly constrains focal depths, and combining all templates destabilized hypoDD, requiring iterative subsetting and separate relocations of the M4+ sequences.
台站稀疏（~25 km）导致深度约束差；全模板联合重定位会失稳，需对序列分组独立重定位。
First end-to-end template-matching to double-difference relocation analysis in the Eagle Ford Shale, revealing connected listric fault reactivation and depth-dependent rupture behavior.
首次在Eagle Ford实施模板匹配与双差联合重定位，揭示铲式断层连通激活及随深度变化的破裂模式。

kc: Developed TM2DD, an open-source end-to-end pipeline linking multistation template matching, automated per-template correlation thresholding, cross-correlation pick refinement, and hypoDD relocation.
Expanded the TexNet catalog in the Karnes Trough Fault Zone by 17.5-fold (from 359 to 6,280 events between 2020 and 2025), lowering Mc to 0.75.
Demonstrated via RANSAC plane fitting that the 2023 M4.0 (dip ~60°) and 2025 M4.7 (dip ~38°) sequences ruptured adjacent, connected segments of a listric or warped fault system.
Showed a behavioral transition from shallow (2.4 km) swarm-like seismicity in 2023 to deep (6.4 km) mainshock-aftershock rupture in 2025, both triggered by HF wells within 3.5 km.
开发了开源端到端工作流TM2DD，集成了多台模板匹配、自动单模板相关阈值确定、互相关震相修正及hypoDD双差重定位。
将Karnes槽断裂带的TexNet地震目录扩充了17.5倍（2020-2025年间从359个增至6280个事件），完备震级降至0.75。
通过RANSAC平面拟合证明2023年M4.0（倾角~60°）与2025年M4.7（倾角~38°）序列破裂了同一铲式或弯曲断层系统的相邻连通段落。
揭示了从2023年浅部（2.4 km）震群型活动向2025年深部（6.4 km）主震-余震型破裂的转变，且均由3.5 km内的水力压裂井触发。
me: Multistation template matching using 3 nearest 3-component broadband TexNet stations (20 s windows, 3–15 Hz bandpass filter).
Automated per-template correlation threshold selection by fitting the logarithmic decay of random noise matches.
Manual correction of TexNet template picks followed by two-pass waveform cross-correlation to propagate and refine P and S arrival times.
Preliminary absolute location via elocate (1-D local velocity model) followed by iterative multi-template group (MTG) double-difference relocation in hypoDD.
RANSAC regression and GMT surface interpolation to suppress vertical scatter and reconstruct 3-D fault plane geometry.
利用最近的3个三分量宽频带TexNet台站进行多台模板匹配（20秒时窗，3–15 Hz带通滤波）。
通过拟合随机噪声匹配数的对数衰减曲线，自动确定每个模板的相关系数阈值。

sum: This study quantifies the hillslope displacement thresholds required to transition a rock mass from metastable to catastrophic failure (rock avalanche) during earthquakes. Using remote sensing measurements from six coseismic landslides in closely-jointed greywacke, the authors estimate normalized translational slope displacements (TSDs). They find that transitioning to the rock avalanche stage requires TSDs exceeding 5%, varying with hillslope angle. To generalize these findings, they propose the 'translational slope deformation index' (TSDI), which incorporates the translational angle and normalized displacement. This empirical tool bridges analytical slope displacement estimates with the probability of highly hazardous, mobile rock avalanches, improving coseismic landslide hazard assessments.
本研究定量评估了地震期间岩体从亚稳态向灾难性崩塌（岩崩）过渡所需的边坡位移阈值。利用六个节理密集灰砂岩地震滑坡的遥感位移测量数据，作者估算了归一化平移边坡位移（TSD）。结果表明，过渡到岩崩阶段需要大于5%的TSD，且该阈值随边坡角而变化。为此，他们提出了“平移边坡变形指数”（TSDI），该指数是平……

t: Empirical formulation of the Translational Slope Deformation Index (TSDI) based on remote sensing displacement measurements and normalized translational slope displacements.
基于遥感位移测量和归一化平移边坡位移，构建平移边坡变形指数（TSDI）经验公式。
Remote sensing displacement measurements and derived translational slope displacements from six coseismic landslides in closely-jointed greywacke.
来自六个节理密集灰砂岩地震滑坡的遥感位移测量及推导的平移边坡位移数据。
Transitioning from metastable to rock avalanche failure requires normalized translational slope displacements (TSDs) greater than 5%, varying with hillslope angle.
岩体向岩崩过渡需要大于5%的归一化平移边坡位移（TSD），具体取决于边坡角。
The empirical index and thresholds are derived from a small sample size of six landslides in a single lithology (greywacke).

Proposes the TSDI to directly link analytical slope displacement estimates to the likelihood of highly hazardous, mobile rock avalanches.

Developed the Translational Slope Deformation Index (TSDI) as a function of translational angle and normalized displacement.

sum: This paper introduces Coseis-Diff, a novel error-correction model for single-frame coseismic InSAR interferograms based on a residual denoising diffusion framework with a diffusion transformer backbone. By leveraging global self-attention, the model overcomes the limited receptive fields of traditional CNNs, enabling unified correction of multi-scale errors (such as atmospheric delays, orbital errors, and decorrelation noise) without requiring external auxiliary data or time-series archives during inference. Evaluated on physics-based synthetic datasets and real-world earthquakes (Mw 5.7–7.05), Coseis-Diff successfully separates spatially correlated artifacts and recovers high-fidelity deformation signals. The results show excellent agreement with independent Okada dislocation models and GNSS displacements, offering a rapid, high-precision tool for emergency response and earthquake source inversion in data-scarce regions.
本文提出Coseis-Diff，一种基于去噪扩散Transformer的单幅同震InSAR误差校正模型。该模型利用全局自注意力机制，在推理时无需外部辅助数据，即可统一校正大气延迟、轨道误差和噪声。在合成与真实地震（Mw 5.7–7.05）数据中的应用表明，该模型能有效分离伪影并恢复高保真形变，与Ok……

t: A residual denoising diffusion framework with a diffusion transformer backbone utilizing global self-attention to correct multi-scale errors in single-frame InSAR.

Physics-based synthetic datasets and real-world earthquake interferograms (Mw 5.7–7.05), validated against independent Okada dislocation models and GNSS displacements.

Coseis-Diff successfully separates spatially correlated artifacts, recovers high-fidelity deformation signals in low-coherence zones, and achieves closer agreement with GNSS and Okada models than raw interferograms.
Coseis-Diff成功分离了空间相关伪影，恢复了低相干区的高保真形变信号，且比原始干涉图更符合GNSS和Okada模…

First application of a data-independent diffusion transformer for single-frame InSAR error correction, eliminating the need for external auxiliary data or time-series archives.

sum: This paper introduces SEQNet, a deep-learning seismic waveform denoising model that incorporates multiscale feature attention (MFA) and global feature aggregation (GFA) into a phase-sensitive time-frequency mask-reconstruction framework. Trained and tested on paired event-noise waveforms from the INSTANCE and STEAD datasets, SEQNet's architectural modifications are systematically evaluated. Ablation experiments show that MFA is the primary contributor to performance improvements. Compared to DeepDenoiser, SEQNet achieves superior reference-based waveform fidelity, whereas DeepDenoiser excels in event-to-pre-event contrast. A continuous data test on Lushan aftershocks demonstrates its practical utility for downstream phase picking. The study highlights the importance of distinguishing waveform fidelity from contrast enhancement in denoising evaluations.
本文提出SEQNet，一种将多尺度特征注意力（MFA）和全局特征聚合（GFA）融入时频掩膜重建框架的深度学习地震波形去噪模型。利用INSTANCE和STEAD数据集的配对波形进行训练与消融实验，结果表明MFA是提升性能的核心模块。相比于DeepDenoiser，SEQNet在波形保真度上表现更优，而……

t: A phase-sensitive time-frequency mask-reconstruction network integrating multiscale feature attention and global feature aggregation.
融合了多尺度特征注意力和全局特征聚合的相敏时频掩膜重建网络。
Paired event-noise waveforms from INSTANCE and STEAD datasets, and continuous data from the Lushan aftershock sequence.
来自INSTANCE和STEAD数据集的配对波形，以及芦山余震序列的连续地震数据。
SEQNet achieves superior waveform fidelity compared to DeepDenoiser, while MFA is identified as the primary driver of architectural improvement.
相比于DeepDenoiser，SEQNet实现了更优的波形保真度，且MFA被证实是架构改进的核心驱动力。
GFA shows limited and metric-dependent improvements, and there is a trade-off between waveform fidelity and contrast enhancement.
GFA的提升有限且依赖于指标，且波形保真度与对比度增强之间存在权衡。
Introduces MFA and GFA to isolate architectural contributions in seismic denoising, distinguishing waveform fidelity from contrast enhancement.
引入MFA和GFA以隔离地震去噪中的架构贡献，并区分了波形保真度与对比度增强。

Demonstrated through ablation studies that multiscale feature attention (MFA) is the most critical architectural component.
Revealed a trade-off between reference-based waveform fidelity (favored by SEQNet) and event-to-pre-event contrast enhancement (favored by DeepDenoiser).

sum: Full waveform inversion (FWI) parameterized by implicit neural representations (IFWI) with multiresolution hash encoding improves convergence and continuity but still suffers from spurious high-frequency artifacts and geological implausibility under limited illumination. This paper introduces G2IFWI, a gradient-coupled regularization framework that integrates a pretrained denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM) and optional borehole well-log guidance into hash-encoded IFWI. Using the Regularization by Denoising (RED) formulation, the residual between the current velocity estimate and a well-guided reverse-diffusion sample defines a prior score gradient. This prior gradient is fused with the adjoint-state data-misfit gradient and backpropagated directly to update the hash tables and multilayer perceptron parameters. Evaluated on the synthetic 2D Overthrust and BP 2004 salt models and the short-offset 2D Viking Graben marine field dataset, G2IFWI suppresses high-frequency artifacts, resolves null-space ambiguities without degrading waveform fit, and improves deep structural continuity and local well-tie accuracy.
本研究提出G2IFWI框架，将预训练去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM）与测井引导结合到基于多分辨率哈希编码的隐式全波形反演（IFWI）中。方法利用去噪正则化（RED）理论，将当前速度模型与受测井约束的逆扩散采样结果之差作为先验梯度，与伴随状态法计算的波形残差梯度融合，共同反向传播更新神经网络参数。在二维O……

t: G2IFWI parameterizes velocity with a multiresolution hash-encoded MLP and updates network parameters by backpropagating the sum of the adjoint-state waveform misfit gradient and a RED-formulated prior gradient from well-guided reverse diffusion.
采用多分辨率哈希编码MLP表征速度，融合伴随波形残差梯度与受测井引导的RED扩散先验梯度更新网络参数。

The diffusion prior is trained on 40,000 procedural 128x128 velocity crops, and G2IFWI is evaluated on the 2D Overthrust model, 2D BP 2004 salt benchmark, and 2D Viking marine field dataset with two wells.
先验在4万个合成切片上训练，并在Overthrust、BP 2004盐丘及含两口井的Viking实测数据上评估。

G2IFWI lowers RMSE from 423.73 to 310.12 (SSIM 0.67 to 0.73) on Overthrust and from 237 to 210 (SSIM 0.85 to 0.90) on BP 2004, while improving reflector continuity and sonic log alignment on Viking field data.
Overthrust的RMSE从423.73降至310.12，BP模型从237降至210，实测数据同相轴连续性及测井吻合…
The diffusion prior carries mainly high-wavenumber structural components and acts only as a late-stage regularizer, meaning it cannot supply low-wavenumber updates to solve cycle skipping.
扩散先验主要提供晚期高波数构造约束，无法提供低波数背景更新以解决周波跳跃。

Rather than plug-and-play pixel-domain denoising, G2IFWI couples the physics-driven misfit gradient and well-guided diffusion score gradient to directly regularize neural network parameters in multiresolution hash-encoded IFWI.
摒弃即插即用像素域去噪，通过梯度级耦合使受测井引导的扩散先验直接正则化隐式网络参数。

kc: Proposes G2IFWI, integrating a pretrained diffusion prior and optional well-log guidance into multiresolution hash-encoded implicit FWI.
Formulates a RED-based gradient-level coupling that backpropagates combined physics-misfit and diffusion-score gradients directly into neural network parameters.
Demonstrates significant artifact suppression, null-space resolution, and improved structural continuity on Overthrust, out-of-distribution BP 2004 salt, and Viking marine field datasets.
提出G2IFWI框架，将预训练扩散先验和可选测井引导集成到多分辨率哈希编码隐式FWI中。
建立基于RED的梯度级耦合机制，将物理数据残差梯度与扩散先验梯度融合并直接反向传播至神经网络参数。
在Overthrust、分布外BP 2004盐丘模型和Viking海上实测数据上验证了伪影压制、零空间消歧及深部构造连续性提升。
me: Multiresolution spatial hash encoding combined with a SIREN multilayer perceptron (MLP) to parameterize continuous 2D velocity fields.
Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model (DDPM) with a U-Net backbone trained on 40,000 procedurally generated 2D geological velocity crops.
Regularization by Denoising (RED) gradient coupling that fuses adjoint-state waveform misfit gradients with well-guided reverse-diffusion residuals.
采用多分辨率空间哈希编码结合SIREN多层感知机（MLP）参数化连续二维速度场。
基于U-Net架构的去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM），在40,000个程序化生成的二维地质速度切片上进行训练。
利用去噪正则化（RED）梯度耦合，将伴随状态波形残差梯度与受测井引导的逆扩散残差梯度融合。
de: Synthetic 2D Overthrust model (400 x 94 grid, 8 Hz Ricker wavelet), including sensitivity sweeps on weight lambda, SNR down to -5 dB, degraded initial models, and missing low frequencies (<4 Hz).
Synthetic 2D BP 2004 salt model (752 x 272 grid, multiscale 2–8 Hz) serving as an out-of-distribution test for the sedimentary-trained diffusion prior.
2D Mobil AVO Viking Graben Line 12 marine field dataset (28.5 x 4.0 km, 1001 shots, 3 km max offset, 2–20 Hz multiscale inversion) with two sonic well logs.
合成二维Overthrust模型（400×94网格，8 Hz雷克子波），包含权重λ敏感性、低至-5 dB信噪比、退化初始模型和缺失4 Hz以下低频的鲁棒性测试。
合成二维BP 2004盐丘模型（752×272网格，2–8 Hz多尺度反演），作为沉积层训练扩散先验的分布外测试。
二维Mobil AVO Viking Graben Line 12海上实测数据集（28.5×4.0 km，1001炮，最大偏移距3 km，2–20 Hz多尺度反演）及两口声波测井数据。
li: The diffusion prior acts as a late-stage high-wavenumber structural regularizer and does not provide low-wavenumber background updates to mitigate cycle skipping.
Performance gain is milder when subsurface geology (e.g., massive salt bodies in BP 2004) is out-of-distribution relative to the procedural training dataset.
Current implementation is restricted to 2D isotropic acoustic FWI, requiring well-log guidance to compensate for anisotropy-induced depth misties in field data.
扩散先验仅作为后期高波数构造正则化器，无法提供低波数背景更新以克服周波跳跃。
当地下地质构造（如BP 2004中的巨厚盐丘）超出训练集分布时，精度提升幅度有限。
当前实现仅限于二维各向同性声波FWI，实测数据中由各向异性引起的深度误差需依赖测井引导校正。

tm.why: The paper develops a new regularization framework for acoustic full-waveform inversion using adjoint-state gradients.
It combines implicit neural representations (multiresolution hash encoding + SIREN MLP) with denoising diffusion probabilistic models.
It formulates a Regularization by Denoising (RED) variational coupling between physics-driven gradients and learned diffusion score gradients.

sum: This paper introduces the AI-Ready Downhole Microseismic Benchmark Database (AMBER), a curated dataset designed to overcome the lack of public training data for downhole microseismic AI applications. AMBER compiles waveforms from 10 downhole microseismic datasets, comprising over 4,000 events with more than 150,000 manually verified P- and S-wave arrival picks, alongside over 10,000 noise samples. Provided with Python tools for data ingestion and augmentation, AMBER serves as a standardized benchmark to stimulate and evaluate machine learning models for subsurface industrial monitoring, such as geothermal stimulation, carbon storage, and hydraulic fracturing.
本文介绍了面向人工智能的井下微地震基准数据库（AMBER）。针对井下微地震AI处理缺乏公开训练数据的瓶颈，研究团队整合了10个井下微地震数据集，构建了包含4000多个事件、超15万个经人工验证的P波和S波到时拾取以及超1万个噪声样本的数据库。AMBER提供了用于数据读取和增强的Python工具，旨在……

t: Curation, manual verification, and standardization of 10 downhole microseismic datasets into an AI-ready format with Python ingestion tools.

sum: Quantifying the onset of shear localization before earthquakes using routine seismic catalogs remains challenging. This study derives governing equations from nonlocal continuum damage rheology for the spatial mean and variance of the inelastic strain-rate field during fault preparation. As damage accumulates, the mean strain rate increases monotonically due to viscosity reduction, whereas the spatial variance passes through a transient minimum as coalescing damage clusters reduce the production of new stress heterogeneity. This variance minimum precedes peak strain rate, distinguishing coherent localization from distributed acceleration. The authors map these statistical moments to two catalog-based proxies: seismic strain dynamics (SSD) and the seismic regularity coefficient (dc). Cross-scale validation across Westerly granite stick-slip experiments, 3D dynamic rupture simulations, induced seismicity (Pertusillo Lake and The Geysers), and the 2025 Mw 7.7 Myanmar earthquake confirms the predicted SSD–dc trajectory, offering a physically grounded diagnostic of fault mechanical state.
本研究从非局域连续损伤本构律推导出断层孕育期非弹性应变率场空间均值与方差的演化方程。随损伤累积，均值因黏度降低而单调增加，空间方差则因损伤簇合并減少新应力非均质性产生而经历瞬态极小值，且方差极小值先于均值峰值。作者将这两个矩映射为常规地震目录指标：地震应变动力学（SSD）和地震规则性系数（dc）。跨……

t: Derives spatial mean and variance equations for inelastic strain rate from nonlocal continuum damage rheology, mapping them to catalog observables SSD and dc computed in sliding event-count windows with temporal permutation significance tests.
从非局域连续损伤流变学推导非弹性应变率均值与方差方程，映射为滑动窗口计算的目录指标SSD和dc。

Evaluates four system types across eight orders of magnitude: Westerly granite stick-slip AE catalogs, 3D dynamic rupture simulations in multiscale fracture networks, Pertusillo Lake and The Geysers induced seismicity, and the 2025 Mw 7.7 Myanmar earthquake.
跨越8个尺度评估四类系统：花岗岩黏滑声发射、三维动力破裂模拟、水库与地热诱发地震及缅甸7.7级地震。

Observed dc minima precede peak SSD and mainshocks with statistically significant depth (p_depth < 0.001 in laboratory samples, p_depth < 0.05 in Pertusillo Lake, The Geysers, and Myanmar Mw 7.7), whereas distributed swarm cascades show non-significance.
实验室(p<0.001)、诱发及缅甸地震(p<0.05)的dc极小值显著深于随机替代目录，震群级联则不显著。

The framework is less diagnostic in swarm-dominated, strongly triggered, or sparse catalogs, and dc minima represent a necessary condition for localization rather than a sufficient condition or universal time-to-failure predictor.
在震群主导、强触发或稀疏目录中诊断力下降，且局部化不定义普适的破裂剩余时间。

Demonstrates mechanically why rate-only seismic precursors fail by proving that a spatial strain-rate variance minimum must precede peak strain-rate acceleration during coherent shear localization, directly linking continuum damage equations to catalog metrics.
从力学上证明相干局部化中应变率方差极小值先于均值峰值，解释了纯速率前兆失效的原因。

kc: Derived governing equations from nonlocal continuum damage rheology showing that inelastic strain-rate spatial variance passes through a minimum prior to the mean strain-rate maximum during shear localization.

Established a physically grounded mapping between inelastic strain-rate statistical moments and two routine catalog observables: seismic strain dynamics (SSD) and the seismic regularity coefficient (dc).

Validated the predicted SSD–dc trajectory across eight orders of magnitude in spatial scale, encompassing laboratory acoustic emissions, 3D dynamic rupture simulations, anthropogenic seismicity, and tectonic earthquakes.
从非局域连续损伤流变学推导出控制方程，证明剪切局部化期间非弹性应变率空间方差在平均应变率达到最大值之前经历极小值。
建立了非弹性应变率统计矩与两个常规地震目录可观测量（地震应变动力学SSD和地震规则性系数dc）之间的物理映射关系。
在跨越8个空间数量级的系统中验证了预测的SSD–dc轨迹，涵盖实验室声发射、三维动力破裂模拟、诱发地震和构造地震。
me: Moment-based analytical reduction of nonlocal continuum damage rheology using first-order perturbation expansions and Fourier-space spectral stress relaxation equations.
Sliding event-count window calculation of catalog proxies SSD (subcritical crack growth scaling) and dc (mean pairwise Euclidean distance in normalized equivalent-dimension space).
Temporal Monte Carlo permutation testing (1000 surrogates permuting interevent times) to evaluate the statistical significance of pre-mainshock dc minimum depth and lead time.
利用一阶微扰展开和傅里叶空间谱应力弛豫方程，对非局域连续损伤流变学进行基于统计矩的解析约化。
采用滑动事件数窗口计算目录代理指标SSD（亚临界裂纹扩展标度）和dc（归一化等效维度空间中的平均成对欧氏距离）。
应用时间蒙特卡洛置换检验（打乱事件间隔生成1000个替代目录）评估主震前dc极小值深度和提前时间的统计显著性。
de: Laboratory acoustic emission catalogs (>10^4 events per run, MAE >= 2.5) from triaxial stick-slip experiments on intact and thermally damaged Westerly granite under varying pore pressures (Wgn19, Wgn20, Wgn21, Wgn24).
Synthetic seismic catalogs from high-resolution 3D dynamic-rupture simulations in multiscale fracture networks across four rupture cascade styles.
Field seismic catalogs from water reservoir impoundment at Pertusillo Lake (Italy), geothermal fluid injection at The Geysers (USA), and the 2025 Mw 7.7 Sagaing Fault earthquake (Myanmar).
不同孔隙压力下完整和热损伤Westerly花岗岩三轴黏滑实验的高分辨率实验室声发射目录（每次实验>10^4个事件，MAE >= 2.5；样本Wgn19、Wgn20、Wgn21、Wgn24）。
多尺度裂缝网络中涵盖四种破裂级联模式的高分辨率三维动力破裂模拟合成地震目录。
意大利Pertusillo湖水库蓄水诱发地震、美国The Geysers地热注水诱发地震以及2025年缅甸实皆断裂Mw 7.7地震的野外观测地震目录。
li: Diagnostic precision degrades in swarm-dominated or strongly triggered sequences where clustering reflects transient external forcing rather than progressive mechanical localization.
In sparse catalogs or highly segmented fault systems with competing deformation zones, inter-zone stress transfer sustains variance and produces shallower or statistically non-significant dc minima.
Laboratory evaluation includes only one representative sample per experimental condition, preventing unique separation of pore pressure and thermal damage effects from sample-specific variability.
在震群主导或强触发序列中，由于丛集反映瞬态外部强迫而非渐进力学局部化，该框架的诊断精度会下降。

实验室分析中每种实验条件仅包含一个代表性样本，无法将孔隙压力和热损伤效应与样本自身的变异性完全分离。

Investigates earthquake preparation processes, rupture nucleation, and validates predictions using 3D dynamic rupture simulations and tectonic earthquakes.

sum: Long-term earthquake forecasts estimate segment rupture probabilities over decades but do not specify where a rupture will initiate. Because the Gutenberg–Richter b-value decreases with increasing differential stress, it serves as a crustal stress meter. Following the 2016 M7.3 Kumamoto sequence, b-values rose along ruptured segments of the Futagawa and Hinagu fault zones (FZs) but dropped in the unruptured central Hinagu FZ. In 2019, the authors published an advance identification of this low-b-value volume as the most likely initiation site for a future rupture. On 28 July 2026, an M7.1 earthquake initiated at 16 km depth inside this low-b-value zone (b = 0.6–0.7), and preliminary geodetic (GSI) and seismic (NIED) slip inversions confirm >1.2 m slip across the identified patch. The rupture arrested at a persistent low-b-value fault bend and imparted +0.9–1.7 bar Coulomb stress onto Yatsushiro Sea faults, highlighting the next likely nucleation zone.
长期地震预测通常无法指出破裂起始点。本研究利用b值作为地壳应力计，基于日本气象厅2000–2026年逾30万次地震目录，采用全震级范围（EMR）方法绘制了日奈久断层带的b值时空分布，并结合GSI与NIED断层滑动模型计算了库仑应力变化。结果表明，2026年7月M7.1熊本地震震源（16 km深）正好……

t: The authors estimate Gutenberg-Richter b-values using the Entire-Magnitude-Range (EMR) maximum-likelihood method within 5-km radius cylindrical volumes on map and cross-sectional grids, and compute static Coulomb failure stress changes from geodetic and seismic slip models.
采用全震级范围（EMR）法在5 km半径圆柱体内计算平面与剖面b值，并基于GSI和NIED断层滑动模型计算静态库仑应力变…

Over 300,000 crustal earthquakes (M ≥ 0, depth ≤ 25 km) from the JMA catalogue (2000–2026) along the Futagawa and Hinagu fault zones, supplemented by preliminary GSI (GNSS/SAR) and NIED (strong-motion waveform) slip inversions.
2000–2026年日本气象厅目录中30余万次浅源地震（M≥0，深度≤25 km），以及GSI大地测量和NIED强震波形…

The 2026 M7.1 Kumamoto earthquake nucleated at 16 km depth within the pre-identified low-b-value zone (b = 0.6–0.7), ruptured across it with >1.2 m slip, stopped at a persistent low-b fault bend, and imparted +0.9–1.7 bar Coulomb stress to Yatsushiro Sea faults.
2026年M7.1震源（16 km深）位于预先识别的低b值区（0.6–0.7）内且滑动超1.2 m，破裂止于断层弯曲处并…
b-value mapping identifies where a rupture is likely to initiate but provides no information on rupture timing; furthermore, sparse seismicity in the Yatsushiro Sea prevents b-value estimation there.
b值仅能指示破裂起始位置而无法预测发震时间；此外八代海地震稀疏无法直接计算b值。
First prospective, published-in-advance identification of the specific initiation site of a large earthquake (2026 M7.1 Kumamoto) validated by subsequent rupture nucleation and slip distributions.
首次在事前公开文献中成功指明大地震（2026年熊本M7.1地震）的破裂起始位置。

kc: Demonstrated the first prospective, published identification of the initiation point of a large earthquake (2026 M7.1 Kumamoto) using b-value stress mapping.

Showed via 2D cross-sectional b-value imaging and source slip models (GSI and NIED) that the 16 km deep M7.1 hypocentre nucleated inside the low-b-value volume (b = 0.6–0.7) and experienced >1.2 m slip.

Identified a persistent low-b-value zone at a fault bend (-20 km along strike) where the 2026 rupture stopped and demonstrated positive Coulomb stress transfer (up to 0.9–1.7 bar) onto southern Hinagu FZ faults in the Yatsushiro Sea.
利用b值应力成像，首次在公开出版物中事前成功预测了大地震（2026年M7.1熊本地震）的破裂起始位置。
通过剖面b值成像及GSI和NIED初步滑动模型，证实16 km深的M7.1震源位于低b值（0.6–0.7）体积内，且大滑动区（>1.2 m）穿过该预测区。
发现2026年破裂终止于一处自2000年以来持续低b值的断层弯曲处，并计算出八代海断层产生了高达0.9–1.7 bar的正库仑应力变化，指出了下一次破裂最可能起始的位置。
me: Entire-magnitude-range (EMR) maximum-likelihood b-value and completeness magnitude (Mc) estimation with 1,000-iteration bootstrap uncertainty quantification in ZMAP.
Spatial and vertical cross-sectional b-value gridding using cylindrical sampling volumes (r = 5 km, minimum 50 events above Mc) and Utsu's AIC test (ΔAIC) for temporal b-value changes.

Static Coulomb failure stress change (ΔCFS) modeling in an elastic half-space using Coulomb 3.4 based on reconstructed GSI (GNSS/SAR) and NIED (strong-motion S-wave inversion) finite-fault slip models.
在ZMAP中使用全震级范围（EMR）最大似然法联合估计完备震级Mc与b值，并通过1000次自助法（Bootstrapping）评估不确定性。
采用半径r = 5 km圆柱体采样（Mc以上至少50个事件）构建平面与垂直剖面b值网格，并应用宇津ΔAIC检验评估不同时期b值变化的显著性。
重构GSI（基于GNSS/SAR）和NIED（基于强震S波波形反演）的有限断层滑动分布模型，利用Coulomb 3.4计算弹性半空间静态库仑破裂应力变化（ΔCFS）。
de: JMA unified earthquake catalogue from 1 January 2000 to 6 September 2026 (>3×10^5 earthquakes with M ≥ 0 and depth ≤ 25 km in the Futagawa–Hinagu fault region).
NIED preliminary finite-fault slip model inverted from S-wave velocity records (0.08–0.8 Hz) at 15 K-NET, KiK-net, and F-net stations.
GSI preliminary two-segment (F1, F2) fault slip model derived from GNSS (21 Jul to 2 Aug 2026) and SAR surface displacement observations.
日本气象厅（JMA）2000年1月1日至2026年9月6日地震目录（布田川-日奈久断层带研究区内深度≤25 km、M≥0的超过30万次地震）。
防灾科学技术研究所（NIED）利用15个K-NET、KiK-net和F-net台站的三分量S波速度记录（0.08–0.8 Hz）反演的初步震源滑动模型。

li: The b-value method identifies the spatial location of high stress where a rupture is likely to begin, but provides no prediction of the occurrence time.
Calculated Coulomb stress changes on and very near the slipped fault planes depend on unresolved details of preliminary slip models and cannot be reliably interpreted.
Sparse background seismicity in the Yatsushiro Sea prevents direct estimation of b-values along the southwesternmost offshore segments of the Hinagu FZ.
b值方法只能识别未来破裂最可能起始的高应力空间位置，无法预测发震时间。
断层面内部及紧邻区域的库仑应力变化计算结果受初步滑动模型未分辨细节的影响，可靠性不足。

tm.why: The paper investigates the rupture initiation location, slip distribution, and termination at a fault bend of the 2026 M7.1 Kumamoto earthquake.
The study uses b-values as a crustal differential stress meter and computes static Coulomb failure stress transfer across fault segments and bends.
The authors evaluate prospective forecasting of earthquake nucleation sites and assess elevated rupture probabilities on adjacent fault segments in the Yatsushiro Sea.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 38-page arXiv PDF manuscript including main text, Methods, 5 main figures, and 2 supplementary figures.

sum: This paper introduces a simple, low-cost tool that evaluates near-field tsunami evacuation feasibility by combining mobile-app GPS tracks from drills with simulated tsunami inundation. Applied as a proof of concept in Viña del Mar, Chile, the study analyzed 119 GPS trajectories under three departure times (0, 8, and 12 minutes post-earthquake). Results show that evacuation success drops drastically from 100 feasible trajectories at 0 minutes to only 3 at 12 minutes. The novelty lies in using real citizen-science GPS data from drills overlaid on dynamic inundation models to produce intuitive, time-dependent evacuation visualizations, offering an accessible alternative to data-intensive and expensive evacuation modeling for resource-limited communities.
本文提出一种低成本工具，将手机记录的演练GPS轨迹与海啸淹没模拟结合，评估近场海啸疏散可行性。在智利的应用表明，疏散成功率随延迟出发急剧下降，从0分钟的100条可行降至12分钟的3条。该方法创新地将真实演练数据与动态淹没模型叠加生成直观视频，为资源有限社区提供易推广的防灾评估与宣传工具。

结合手机记录的演练GPS轨迹与海啸淹没模拟，评估时间相关疏散可行性的低成本工具。

Evacuation feasibility dropped drastically with departure delay: 100 of 119 trajectories were feasible at 0 min delay, 49 at 8 min, and only 3 at 12 min.

sum: This paper presents a low-frequency structure-guided 3D conditional diffusion method for reconstructing missing seismic data, particularly consecutively missing traces. The method first extracts and completes stable low-frequency components from incomplete 3D seismic volumes using 3D structure-tensor dip estimation and event-oriented interpolation. This completed low-frequency volume serves as a structural constraint for a 3D conditional diffusion process. A 3D U-Net denoiser, enhanced by an optional lightweight 3D attention module, progressively restores mid- and high-frequency reflection details during reverse sampling. Tested on SEG C3 synthetic data and field datasets, the method effectively recovers complex 3D wavefield structures and improves lateral coherence compared to conventional and standard deep-learning interpolation methods.
本文提出一种低频结构引导的三维条件扩散方法，用于重建连续缺失的地震数据。该方法先通过结构张量倾角估计和插值补全低频成分作为结构约束，再利用结合注意力机制的3D U-Net在扩散反向采样中恢复中高频细节。在SEG C3等数据集上的测试表明，该方法能有效恢复复杂三维波场并提高横向连续性。

t: A 3D conditional diffusion model constrained by a completed low-frequency structural volume, using a 3D U-Net with an optional lightweight 3D attention module for reverse sampling.
一种由补全的低频结构体约束的三维条件扩散模型，在反向采样中使用带注意力机制的3D U-Net。
Tested on the SEG C3 synthetic 3D seismic dataset and field seismic data with consecutively missing traces.
在SEG C3合成三维地震数据集以及具有连续缺失道的实际地震数据上进行了测试。
Successfully reconstructed complex 3D wavefields and improved lateral coherence of reflection events, outperforming conventional interpolation and 2D deep-learning methods.
成功重建了复杂的三维波场并提高了反射同相轴的横向连续性，优于传统插值和二维深度学习方法。
The method suffers from high training and sampling costs inherent to 3D diffusion models, and relies on stable low-frequency extraction.
该方法存在三维扩散模型固有的高训练和采样成本，且依赖于稳定的低频提取。
Introduces low-frequency structure as a prior constraint in a 3D conditional diffusion framework to guide the recovery of mid- and high-frequency seismic details.
在三维条件扩散框架中引入低频结构作为先验约束，以引导中高频地震细节的恢复。

kc: Proposed a low-frequency structure-guided 3D conditional diffusion model for seismic data reconstruction.
Developed a workflow combining 3D structure-tensor dip estimation and event-oriented interpolation to build stable low-frequency structural constraints.
Integrated a lightweight 3D attention module into a 3D U-Net denoiser to capture spatial correlations along time, inline, and crossline directions.
提出了一种用于地震数据重建的低频结构引导三维条件扩散模型。
开发了结合三维结构张量倾角估计和面向同相轴插值的流程，以构建稳定的低频结构约束。
在3D U-Net去噪器中集成了轻量级三维注意力模块，以捕获沿时间、测线和联络线方向的空间相关性。
me: 3D structure-tensor dip estimation and event-oriented low-frequency interpolation.
Reliability-weighted fusion for low-frequency volume completion.
3D conditional diffusion process with a 3D U-Net denoiser and lightweight 3D attention.
三维结构张量倾角估计与面向同相轴的低频插值。
用于低频数据体补全的可信度加权融合。
结合3D U-Net去噪器和轻量级三维注意力机制的三维条件扩散过程。
de: Synthetic tests using the SEG C3 3D synthetic seismic dataset with consecutively missing traces.
Controlled tests on field seismic datasets to evaluate reconstruction performance under complex conditions.
使用存在连续缺失道的SEG C3三维合成地震数据集进行合成测试。
在实际地震数据集上进行对照测试，以评估复杂条件下的重建性能。
li: High computational cost associated with 3D diffusion models and reverse sampling chains.
Dependence on the quality of the initial low-frequency structure extraction.
三维扩散模型和反向采样链带来的高计算成本。
依赖于初始低频结构提取的质量。

tm.why: The paper proposes a 3D conditional diffusion method, which is a deep learning generative model, for reconstructing missing seismic data.
Seismic data reconstruction is formulated as an inverse problem solved via conditional diffusion processes.
