sum: Generalizing deep learning models to classify local earthquakes and explosions across unseen regions remains challenging. This study advances multilocality source discrimination by developing a two-branch convolutional neural network (CNN) that combines 2D continuous wavelet transform scalograms with 1D P- and S-wave arrival probability time series generated by PhaseNet. Using 16 local datasets containing earthquakes and single-fired borehole explosions within 300 km, the authors optimize network architectures with Optuna and evaluate data-balancing and quality-control criteria. The two-branch model reduces trainable parameters by over 50% (2.4M vs. 5.7M) and converges faster than a conventional one-branch scalogram-only CNN. It achieves 95.7% in-distribution balanced accuracy and increases average out-of-distribution accuracy across 16 held-out localities from 84.4% to 87.6%, outperforming uncalibrated P/S amplitude ratios by 14%. Leveraging phase pick probabilities—a standard byproduct of modern catalog workflows—provides an effective, analyst-free scientific prior for generalizing event classification to new regions.
本研究提出了一种双分支卷积神经网络（CNN），结合三维连续小波变换时频尺度图（2D）与PhaseNet输出的P、S波到时概率时间序列（1D），以提高地方天然地震与浅孔单发爆破分类的跨区域泛化能力。利用全球16个地区的同台地震与爆破波形数据（震中距<300 km），通过Optuna进行了超参数优化及数……

t: An Optuna-optimized two-branch CNN fuses 2D convolutional features from three-component Morlet wavelet scalograms (2–18 Hz) with 1D convolutional features from PhaseNet P- and S-wave pick probability time series.
采用Optuna优化的双分支CNN，融合三分量小波尺度图（2D）与PhaseNet震相拾取概率序列（1D）。

The database comprises 16 local datasets worldwide containing 8,999 shallow single-fired borehole explosion and 25,353 earthquake (M 0.5–4) three-component records within 300 km, balanced via pre-event noise augmentation.
全球16个地区震中距300 km内的8999条单发浅孔爆破与25353条地方震三分量波形数据。

The two-branch model cuts parameters by over 50% (2.41M vs. 5.68M), reaches 95.7% in-distribution accuracy, increases mean N-1 out-of-distribution accuracy from 84.4% to 87.6%, and beats P/S ratios by 14%.
双分支模型参数减半，分布内准确率达95.7%，跨区域外推准确率从84.4%升至87.6%，领先P/S比14%。

Training explosions only include single-fired borehole chemical shots rather than complex mine excavation blasts, and misclassifications concentrate at low SNRs and 20–100 km source-receiver distances.
仅限单发浅孔爆破，未含复杂矿山爆破；低信噪比及20–100 km距离误分率较高。

First integration of pre-trained PhaseNet pick probability time series alongside wavelet scalograms in a hyperparameter-optimized two-branch CNN for analyst-free, generalizable multilocality explosion-earthquake discrimination.
首次将预训练震相拾取概率序列与时频尺度图在优化双分支CNN中结合，提升跨区免人工分类泛化性。

kc: Designed an Optuna-optimized two-branch CNN combining 2D wavelet scalograms and 1D PhaseNet P/S pick probabilities, cutting trainable parameters by over 50% compared to a one-branch baseline.

Expanded the local earthquake and single-fired borehole explosion benchmark database from 8 to 16 diverse geologic localities worldwide (8,999 explosion and 25,353 earthquake records prior to augmentation).

Demonstrated that incorporating PhaseNet pick probabilities as both a quality-control filter (Pprob > 0.1) and an input feature boosts out-of-distribution (N-1) balanced accuracy from 84.4% to 87.6%, outperforming P/S amplitude ratios by ~14%.
设计并经Optuna优化了结合2D小波尺度图与1D PhaseNet震相拾取概率的双分支CNN，相比单分支基线模型减少了超过50%的可训练参数。
将地方天然地震与单发浅孔化学爆破基准数据库从8个扩展至全球16个不同地质背景区域（含8,999条爆破和25,353条地震记录）。
证明将PhaseNet拾取概率同时作为质控条件（Pprob > 0.1）和输入特征，可将跨区域（N-1）外推测试平均平衡准确率从84.4%提升至87.6%，领先P/S振幅比方法约14%。
me: Two-branch CNN architecture combining a 2D CNN branch for three-component Morlet CWT scalograms (2–18 Hz, 3x50x400) and a 1D CNN branch for PhaseNet P and S pick probability series (1–18 Hz, 2x4000).

Automated hyperparameter optimization over network depth, channels, kernel size, stride, dilation, fully connected units, dropout, and learning rate using Optuna's Tree-structured Parzen Estimator (TPE).
Comparison of two pre-event noise data augmentation/balancing schemes ('raw data weighting' vs. 'equal-1000 weighting') and automated quality control using P-wave SNR > 2 and PhaseNet Pprob > 0.1.
构建双分支CNN架构：2D卷积分支处理三分量Morlet连续小波变换尺度图（2–18 Hz，维度3×50×400），1D卷积分支处理PhaseNet输出的P、S波拾取概率序列（1–18 Hz，维度2×4000）。
利用Optuna的树结构Parzen估计器（TPE）对网络深度、通道数、卷积核大小、步长、膨胀率、全连接层神经元数、Dropout率和学习率进行自动超参数寻优。
对比了两种基于事件前噪声的数据增强平衡策略（“原始数据权重”与“等量1000权重”），并结合P波信噪比（SNR > 2）与PhaseNet拾取概率（Pprob > 0.1）进行自动质量控制。
de: Three-component seismic waveforms (resampled to 40 Hz, rotated to ZRT, <300 km distance) from 16 localities across North America, Iberia, Morocco, Tibet, and the Middle East, formatted in ASDF.
In-distribution evaluation via 50 bootstrap resamplings of 70/15/15 random train/validation/test splits across all 16 datasets.
Out-of-distribution (N-1) generalization tests where the model is trained on 15 localities and tested on the 16th held-out locality, benchmarked against uncalibrated 6–18 Hz P/S amplitude ratios.
汇编北美、伊比利亚、摩洛哥、青藏高原和中东共16个地区的三分量波形数据（重采样至40 Hz，旋转至ZRT分量，震中距<300 km），统一存为ASDF格式。
分布内测试实验：在全部16个数据集上采用70%/15%/15%随机划分训练/验证/测试集，并进行50次自助法（bootstrap）重采样统计评估。
分布外（N-1）泛化测试：轮流在15个地区上训练并在留出的第16个未见地区上测试，与未作局地校正的6–18 Hz频段P/S振幅比分类器进行对比。
li: Training explosions are restricted to single-fired shallow borehole chemical explosions, which do not capture complex ripple-fired mine excavation blasts or mining-induced collapse events.
Classification accuracy degrades significantly at low signal-to-noise ratios (SNR near 2) and within the 20–100 km distance range where local wavefield scattering is strong.
Source-receiver distance is not currently included as an explicit input feature to help the network account for distance-dependent attenuation and waveform changes.
训练集中爆破样本仅限于单发浅孔化学爆破，未涵盖复杂的延时起爆矿山开挖爆破或采矿诱发塌陷事件。
分类准确率在低信噪比（SNR接近2）以及受局地波场散射影响强烈的20–100 km震中距范围内明显下降。
模型目前未将震中距作为显式输入特征来辅助神经网络学习随距离变化的波形衰减特征。

tm.why: The paper develops and optimizes a two-branch convolutional neural network combining seismic scalograms and PhaseNet pick probabilities to classify earthquakes and explosions.
The study focuses on automated event type discrimination (local earthquakes vs. shallow borehole explosions) using phase pick probabilities from event detection workflows.

ev.notes: Full 15-page PDF from Seismological Research Letters used, including all text, 7 figures, and 2 tables.

sum: Existing scalar definitions of geodetic shear strain rate, total strain rate, and deformation style inconsistently mix dilatation and shear because they rely on principal eigenvalues. Motivated by fault kinematics, this study introduces an internally consistent set of scalar measures based on kinematic mode decomposition along zero-length-change (ZLC) orientations. The strike-slip strain rate is defined as twice the geometric mean of opposite-sign principal strain rates, the total strain rate is the explicit linear sum of strike-slip and absolute dilatation rates, and the deformation style represents the fractional dilatational contribution. Extending this partitioning to seismic hazard yields a split moment rate assuming independent strike-slip and Andersonian dip-slip fault populations. Applied to a geodetic strain rate model of the southwestern United States, the split moment rate exceeds the traditional Savage-Simpson minimum moment rate by 20% regionally and by 34% across mixed-strain zones covering 53% of the area.
现有大地测量应变率标量依赖主特征值，无法有效分离膨胀与剪切变形。本研究基于零长度变化（ZLC）方向上的断层运动学模态分解，提出了一套自洽的新标量定义：走滑应变率定义为异号主应变率几何平均的两倍，总应变率为走滑与绝对膨胀应变率的显式线性加和，变形类型参数表示膨胀贡献分数。进一步假设走滑和倾滑断层独立释……

t: Decomposes the 2D horizontal strain rate tensor along zero-length-change fault orientations into an additive strike-slip shear rate and normal dilatation rate, converting them into partitioned strike-slip and dip-slip seismic moment rates.
沿零长度变化断层方向将水平应变率张量分解为可加的走滑剪切率与正膨胀率，并转换为分裂地震矩率。
Evaluated using five synthetic 100x100 km kinematic test cases and applied to the Kreemer & Young (2022) GNSS geodetic strain rate model across the southwestern United States (124-111°W, 32.5-42°N).
采用5个合成运动学算例，并应用于覆盖美国西南部的Kreemer & Young (2022)大地测量应变率模型。

In the southwestern U.S., the partitioned moment rate exceeds the minimum moment rate by 20% overall and by 34% across intermediate mixed-strain areas (53% of the region), reaching up to 37% theoretically.
在美西南地区，分裂矩率总体比最小矩率高20%，在占面积53%的混合应变区高34%（理论最高37%）。

The moment rate formulation assumes full seismic coupling and idealized zero-length-change and Andersonian fault orientations, without accounting for aseismic creep, oblique slip, or inherited misoriented faults.
假设完全地震耦合及理想ZLC与Anderson断层产状，未考虑非震蠕滑、斜滑或继承性偏斜断层。
Provides the first additive scalar strain rate and moment rate definitions that cleanly partition strike-slip shear and dilatation without cross-contamination from eigenvalue-based quadratic norms.
首次提出满足可加性的应变率与矩率标量，消除了传统特征值定义中剪切与膨胀的相互混叠。

kc: Derived a coordinate-invariant strike-slip strain rate scalar from shear resolved along zero-length-change (ZLC) fault orientations.
Defined an additive total strain rate as the explicit sum of strike-slip and absolute dilatation rates, which exceeds the Frobenius norm by up to a factor of sqrt(3).
Introduced a linear deformation style parameter that cleanly quantifies the fractional dilatational contribution in mixed-strain regimes and separates uniaxial from biaxial strain.
Formulated a partitioned geodetic moment rate (M_split) for independent strike-slip and Andersonian dip-slip faults, exceeding minimum moment estimates by up to 37% in mixed-faulting settings.
Demonstrated across the southwestern U.S. that M_split increases regional moment rate estimates by 20% overall and 34% in intermediate mixed-style zones compared to minimum moment.
基于零长度变化（ZLC）断层方向上的分解剪切，推导出坐标不变的走滑应变率标量。
将总应变率定义为走滑应变率与绝对膨胀率的显式加和，满足可加性且最高可达Frobenius范数的√3倍。
引入线性变形类型参数，清晰量化混合应变区的膨胀贡献比例，并区分单轴与双轴应变。
构建了由独立走滑和Anderson倾滑断层释放应变的分裂地震矩率（M_split），在混合断层环境中比最小矩率高出至多37%。
在美国西南部的应用表明，与最小矩率相比，M_split使区域总矩率估计提高20%，在中间混合变形区提高34%。
me: Kinematic mode decomposition of the 2D horizontal infinitesimal strain rate tensor in a reference frame aligned with zero-length-change (ZLC) orientations.
Geometric derivation of ZLC orientations and resolved fault shear using the Mohr circle for strain rate.
Kostrov tensor conversion with separate geometric dip corrections applied exclusively to the dilatational dip-slip fault component.
First-order analytical error propagation for the new strain and moment rate scalars in terms of both tensor components and principal eigenvalues.
在对齐零长度变化（ZLC）方向的参考系中，对二维水平无穷小应变率张量进行运动学模态分解。
利用应变率莫尔圆几何推导ZLC方向及断层分解剪切应变率。
基于Kostrov张量关系转换地震矩率，并仅对膨胀倾滑断层分量施加几何倾角校正。
以张量分量和主特征值两种形式，推导新应变率和矩率标量的一阶解析误差传播公式。
de: Five synthetic 100x100 km block velocity boundary condition test cases (uniaxial extension, simple shear, two mixed-strain combinations, and equal biaxial extension).
Application to the published GNSS-derived horizontal geodetic strain rate model of Kreemer & Young (2022) covering the southwestern United States (124-111°W, 32.5-42°N).
五个100×100 km合成块体速度边界条件测试算例（单轴伸展、简单剪切、两种混合应变组合及等双轴伸展）。
应用于Kreemer & Young (2022)发表的覆盖美国西南部（124-111°W，32.5-42°N）的GNSS水平大地测量应变率模型。
li: The moment rate conversion assumes full seismic coupling (no fault creep, slow slip, or aseismic distributed deformation) and lacks testing against observed earthquake catalogs.
The partitioned moment rate assumes specific fault orientations (ZLC strikes and Andersonian dips), whereas real inherited faults may deviate or accommodate strain via oblique slip.
First-order analytical uncertainty expressions diverge and become singular near the boundary between opposite-sign and same-sign strain regimes.
矩率转换假设完全地震耦合（忽略断层蠕滑、慢滑移或非震分布式变形），且未与观测地震目录进行检验对比。
分裂矩率假设了特定的断层产状（ZLC走向和Anderson倾角），而实际继承性断层可能偏离该方向或发生斜滑。
一阶解析不确定度表达式在异号与同号主应变机制边界附近会发散并出现奇异性。

tm.why: The paper develops scalar measures of horizontal geodetic strain rate tensors to characterize crustal deformation and tectonic kinematics across the southwestern United States.
The study focuses on converting geodetic strain rate tensors into expected seismic moment rates, which are essential for earthquake rate forecasting and seismic hazard assessment.

The proposed strain rate decomposition and moment rate definitions are directly derived from fault kinematics, zero-length-change orientations, and slip partitioning between strike-slip and dip-slip fault systems.

ev.notes: Full 44-page EarthArXiv preprint PDF (including main text, 6 tables, 6 figures, and Appendices A-D) was analyzed directly.

sum: This study investigates the crustal and lithospheric structure of Bangladesh using 3D gravity inversion constrained by seismic Moho depths, alongside 3D flexural backstripping. The results show Moho depths of 22–32 km and crustal thicknesses under 22 km in the Bengal Basin. The lithospheric structure reveals depth-dependent extension, with lithospheric thinning preceding crustal thinning in the north, while occurring synchronously in the south. The study identifies 5–8 km of magmatic underplating beneath the volcanic rifted margin. Flexural backstripping indicates 5–7 km of thermal subsidence in the Bengal Basin and tectonic uplift of the Shillong Plateau (~1 km from plume magmatism and sediment loading, with the rest from Cenozoic shortening). This provides a comprehensive geodynamic model for the region's evolution.
本研究利用地震莫霍面深度约束的3D重力反演和3D挠曲回剥分析，探讨了孟加拉国地壳与岩石圈结构。结果显示孟加拉湾盆地莫霍面深22-32公里，地壳厚度小于22公里。岩石圈结构呈现深度相关延伸：北部岩石圈减薄早于地壳减薄，南部则同步发生。研究证实火山裂谷边缘存在5-8公里的岩浆底侵。回剥分析表明，盆地热沉……

t: 3D gravity inversion constrained by seismically-derived Moho depths combined with 3D flexural backstripping analysis.
结合地震约束莫霍面深度的三维重力反演与三维挠曲回剥分析方法。
Gravity anomaly data, sedimentary thickness maps (up to 20 km), and sparse seismically-derived Moho depth constraints.
重力异常数据、高达20公里的沉积厚度图以及稀疏的地震约束莫霍面深度。
Moho depth varies from 22 to 32 km, with 5-8 km of magmatic underplating and ~1 km of sediment-loading-induced uplift at Shillong Plateau.
莫霍面深22-32公里，存在5-8公里岩浆底侵，沉积负载导致希隆高原约1公里隆升。
Relies on sparse seismic constraints for gravity inversion and indirect estimation of magmatic underplating.
重力反演依赖稀疏的地震约束，且岩浆底侵厚度为间接估算。
First regional 3D lithospheric model showing depth-dependent extension and quantifying flexural response to massive sediment loading in Bangladesh.
首次提出揭示深度相关延伸并定量化巨量沉积负载挠曲响应的区域三维岩石圈模型。

kc: Mapped the regional-scale 3D Moho topography and crustal thickness across Bangladesh using gravity inversion.
Identified depth-dependent lithospheric extension, showing asynchronous thinning in the north and synchronous thinning in the south.
Quantified the contribution of sediment loading, plume magmatism, and tectonic thrusting to the uplift of the Shillong Plateau.
利用重力反演绘制了孟加拉国区域尺度的三维莫霍面地形和地壳厚度图。
识别出深度相关的岩石圈延伸，表现为北部非同步减薄和南部同步减薄。
定量评估了沉积负载、地幔柱岩浆作用和构造逆冲对希隆高原隆升的贡献。
me: 3D gravity inversion constrained by seismically-derived Moho depths.
3D flexural backstripping analysis to model thermal subsidence and tectonic uplift.
Tectonic subsidence analysis to estimate stretching factors and magmatic underplating.
受地震约束的莫霍面深度三维重力反演。
用于模拟热沉降和构造隆升的三维挠曲回剥分析。
用于估算拉张系数和岩浆底侵的构造沉降分析。
de: Gravity anomaly data across Bangladesh and adjacent regions.
Seismically-derived Moho depth constraints from sparse broadband stations.
Sedimentary thickness data (up to 20 km of deposits) and stratigraphic records for backstripping.
覆盖孟加拉国及邻区的重力异常数据。
来自稀疏宽频带台站的地震约束莫霍面深度数据。
用于回剥分析的沉积物厚度数据（高达20公里的沉积物）和地层记录。
li: The gravity inversion relies heavily on sparse seismic constraints, which may introduce local uncertainties.
Resolution of the magmatic underplating thickness is indirect, based on gravity modeling and stretching factors.
重力反演高度依赖稀疏的地震约束，这可能会引入局部不确定性。
岩浆底侵厚度的分辨率是间接的，基于重力建模和拉张系数估算。

tm.why: The paper investigates the crustal and lithospheric structure, Moho topography, and geodynamics of Bangladesh and the Shillong Plateau.

ev.notes: The analysis is based entirely on the provided abstract and Crossref metadata as no PDF was available.

sum: Parametric earthquake insurance in Japan increasingly uses the JMA seismic intensity scale (IJMA / Shindo) as a payout trigger, yet most earthquake risk models output Peak Ground Acceleration (PGA) and spectral accelerations (Sa(T)) rather than IJMA directly. This study develops empirical parameterisations of IJMA across all 511 combinations of Mw, hypocentral distance, PGA, and Sa(T) at six periods (0.2–3.0 s) for both geometric mean and RotD50 orientations. Using weighted ridge regression to handle multicollinearity and class imbalance on 21,354 high-quality strong-motion recordings from 112 Japanese earthquakes (1997–2025), the authors identify a parsimonious three-parameter model combining PGA, Sa(0.3 s), and Sa(1.0 s). Out-of-sample testing on 256 NGA-Subduction recordings and application to a synthetic Japanese insurance portfolio show that the new model reduces wRMSE (0.1963 vs. 0.4769) and aggregate insured loss overestimation (9% vs. 33%) compared to established conversions, significantly lowering basis risk.
日本参数地震保险广泛采用气象厅震度（IJMA/Shindo）作为赔付触发指标，但多数地震风险模型仅输出峰值地面加速度（PGA）和谱加速度（Sa）。本研究利用1997至2025年间112次日本地震的21,354条高质量强震记录，采用加权岭回归方法测试了矩震级、震源距、PGA及6个周期Sa（0.2–3.……

t: Weighted ridge regression applied to log-transformed PGA, spectral accelerations, hypocentral distance, and Mw across 511 variable combinations, tuned via five-fold cross-validation to minimize weighted RMSE while mitigating multicollinearity.
对PGA、谱加速度、震源距和震级的511种组合进行加权岭回归，通过五折交叉验证最小化wRMSE并消除共线性。

21,354 high-quality three-component surface strong-motion recordings from KiK-net and K-Net across 112 Japanese earthquakes (Mw >= 5.0, max IJMA >= 5.0) from 1997 to 2025, plus 256 non-Japanese NGA-Subduction records.
1997–2025年112次日本地震的21,354条KiK-net和K-Net高质量记录，及256条NGA-Sub非日本…

The three-variable RotD50 model (PGA, Sa(0.3 s), Sa(1.0 s)) achieves wRMSE of 0.1633 in-sample, 0.1963 out-of-sample (vs. 0.4769 for KY02), and lowers synthetic portfolio aggregate loss overestimation from 33% to 9%.
三参数RotD50模型样本内wRMSE为0.1633，样本外为0.1963（优于前人的0.4769），总损失高估由33%…

Residual misfit increases slightly at stiffer sites (Vs30 >= 600 m/s) because PGA and Sa(1.0 s) alone do not capture the complete high-frequency site response, and extreme events like Tohoku-Oki are overestimated.
在Vs30>=600m/s硬场地残差略增，且对2011年东北冲等极端大震存在一定程度的高估。

First comprehensive suite of IJMA conversions using exclusively standard earthquake risk model outputs (PGA and multi-period Sa in GM/RotD50) calibrated on modern post-1997 Japanese strong-motion records.
首次直接利用风险模型标准输出（GM/RotD50的PGA与多周期Sa）基于现代日本强震数据建立IJMA转换关系。

kc: Evaluated 1,022 candidate empirical models (511 variable combinations across GM and RotD50 orientations) relating standard risk-model ground motion outputs to JMA instrumental intensity (IJMA).
Proposed a parsimonious three-parameter model using PGA, Sa(0.3 s), and Sa(1.0 s) that achieves a weighted RMSE of ~0.163–0.164 and captures both high- and low-frequency site amplification effects.

Demonstrated on out-of-sample NGA-Subduction data and a 29-year synthetic Japanese insurance portfolio that the new parameterisation reduces aggregate loss bias from 33% to 9% compared to Karim & Yamazaki (2002).
评估了1,022个候选经验回归模型（涵盖GM和RotD50分量方向的511种变量组合），建立地震风险模型输出参数与JMA仪器震度（IJMA）的转换关系。
提出了结合PGA、Sa(0.3 s)和Sa(1.0 s)的三参数简约模型，加权均方根误差达0.163–0.164，兼顾了高频与低频场地放大效应。
通过NGA-Sub样本外数据和29年日本合成保险投资组合验证，新模型将总赔付偏差从前人模型的33%降至9%，显著降低基差风险。
me: Frequency-domain bandpass filtering (low-cut, high-cut, and periodic filters) and root-sum-square time-domain combination to compute exact JMA instrumental intensity (IJMA).
Inverse-frequency and linear-ramp sample weighting to prioritize damaging ground motions (IJMA >= 4.5) during regression fitting.
Standardized ridge regression (L2 penalty tuned via 5-fold cross-validation over lambda from 0.1 to 1000) to mitigate multicollinearity among PGA and spectral acceleration periods.
利用频域带通滤波（低截、高截和周期滤波器）及时域平方和开方合成计算精确的JMA仪器震度（IJMA）。
采用逆频率与线性斜坡样本加权策略，在回归拟合中重点优化致灾强地面运动（IJMA >= 4.5）。
采用标准化岭回归（通过五折交叉验证在0.1至1000间优选L2正则化参数λ），克服PGA与不同周期谱加速度间的多重共线性。
de: 21,354 high-quality surface strong-motion recordings from K-Net and KiK-net across 112 Japanese earthquakes (Mw >= 5.0, max IJMA >= 5.0) between January 1997 and December 2025.
Out-of-sample validation dataset of 256 non-Japanese recordings from the NGA-Subduction database (hypocentral depth <= 30 km, PGARotD50 >= 0.1 g).

Synthetic parametric insurance portfolio of Japanese healthcare facilities and power plants (uniform 10 billion JPY limit per asset within 20 km of a station) tested against 1997–2025 historical seismicity.
1997年1月至2025年12月间112次日本地震（Mw >= 5.0且至少一台站IJMA >= 5.0）的21,354条K-Net和KiK-net高质量地表强震记录。
NGA-Subduction数据库中256条非日本强震记录（震源深度 <= 30 km，PGARotD50 >= 0.1 g）作为样本外验证集。
由日本医疗设施和发电厂组成的合成参数保险投资组合（距台站20 km内每个资产保额统一设为100亿日元），利用1997–2025年历史地震进行回测。
li: Residual misfits slightly increase at stiff-soil sites with Vs30 >= 600 m/s because PGA, Sa(0.3 s), and Sa(1.0 s) alone do not fully capture the complete site amplification response.
Both the proposed model and prior models systematically overestimate IJMA and insured losses for the extreme Mw 9.0 2011 Tohoku-Oki earthquake.
The synthetic portfolio assumes uniform asset values and vulnerabilities and assigns station shaking up to 20 km away, leaving spatial and structural basis risk unmodeled.
在Vs30 >= 600 m/s的硬土/基岩场地残差略有增大，因为仅靠PGA、Sa(0.3 s)和Sa(1.0 s)难以完全刻画全部场地响应。
对于2011年Mw 9.0东北冲特大地震，本研究模型与前人模型均系统性高估了IJMA和保险损失。
合成投资组合假设所有资产价值与脆弱性相同，并直接采用20 km内最近台站震度，未量化台站距离与建筑结构差异带来的基差风险。

tm.why: The paper develops empirical conversion relationships between strong ground motion intensity measures (PGA, spectral acceleration) and the JMA seismic intensity scale (Shindo) to improve parametric earthquake insurance pricing and hazard assessment.

ev.notes: Full 13-page PDF read and analyzed, including equations, tables, figures, and section text.

sum: Passive imaging of the oceanic Moho using ocean-bottom seismographs (OBS) via receiver functions is often hindered by instrument tilt, azimuthal misalignment, and water-column reverberations. This study introduces a teleseismic P-wave coda autocorrelation workflow applied to OBS hydrophone recordings, which record scalar pressure and avoid P-to-S conversions. Analyzing 22 long-period and 24 short-period OBS stations from the NoMelt experiment in the central Pacific, the authors extract clear Moho reflections (PmP) and water-column multiples (PwP, PwwP). They find an average oceanic-crust two-way travel time (TwTT) of ~2.56 s (ranging from 2.26 to 2.96 s), resolving fine-scale lateral variations absent in global models like ECM1. Because 2.56 s corresponds to an unexpectedly thick ~8.32 km crust, synthetic modeling of gradational velocity interfaces demonstrates that a crust-mantle transition zone delays the PmP peak, providing a physical explanation for the longer observed travel times.
受海底地震仪（OBS）倾斜、方位角偏差及水层多次波影响，传统接收函数难以清晰成像大洋莫霍面。本文提出将远震P波尾波自相关方法应用于OBS水听器记录，利用流体不传播S波的特性简化了反射P波的提取与解释。通过对太平洋NoMelt实验中22个长周期和24个短周期台站数据进行频谱白化与叠加，成功提取出莫霍面……

t: Teleseismic P-wave records from OBS hydrophones (-10 to 45 s around P arrival) are spectrally whitened, filtered at 0.5–2.0 Hz, autocorrelated, corrected for moveout, and linearly stacked to retrieve vertical P-wave reflection responses.
对OBS水听器远震P波尾波进行频谱白化、0.5–2.0 Hz滤波、自相关、动校正及线性叠加，提取P波反射响应。

Teleseismic hydrophone recordings from 22 broadband long-period (~1-year) and 24 short-period (~25-day) OBS stations deployed across a 600 × 400 km array in the deep Pacific during the 2011–2012 NoMelt experiment.
2011–2012年太平洋NoMelt实验22个长周期和24个短周期OBS台站的远震水听器记录。

Stacked autocorrelograms identify clear Moho reflections with oceanic-crust two-way travel times ranging from 2.26 to 2.96 s (average ~2.56 s, or ~8.32 km thickness), suggesting a gradational crust-mantle transition zone.
测得大洋地壳双程走时为2.26–2.96秒（平均2.56秒，视厚度约8.32 km），指示存在壳幔过渡带。
The method struggles in shallow water (~1,500 ± 500 m) where water multiples overlap with PmP, in thick sediments with strong PsP interference, and over steeply dipping Moho interfaces.
在约1500米浅水区受水层多次波重叠干扰，且难以适用于厚沉积层或强倾斜莫霍面区域。
First application of teleseismic P-wave coda autocorrelation to OBS hydrophone recordings to image the oceanic Moho, avoiding three-component coupling, tilt, and shear-wave conversion issues.
首次将远震P波尾波自相关应用于OBS水听器数据以成像大洋莫霍面，克服三分量倾角与耦合难题。

kc: Developed and validated a teleseismic P-wave coda autocorrelation workflow tailored for OBS hydrophone data, bypassing three-component tilt and orientation issues.
Determined an average oceanic-crust P-wave two-way travel time of ~2.56 s across 22 long-period and 24 short-period OBS stations in the NoMelt region.
Demonstrated via synthetic waveform modeling that a gradational crust-mantle transition zone delays the PmP autocorrelation phase, explaining the larger-than-expected apparent crustal thickness.
开发并验证了适用于OBS水听器数据的远震P波尾波自相关流程，避开了三分量地震计的倾斜与方位偏差问题。
利用NoMelt实验22个长周期和24个短周期OBS台站，测得大洋地壳平均双程走时约为2.56秒。
通过合成波形模拟证明渐变的壳幔过渡带会延迟PmP自相关相位，合理解释了观测到的偏大地壳视厚度。
me: Teleseismic P-wave coda autocorrelation of scalar pressure recordings from OBS hydrophones (-10 s to +45 s around theoretical P arrival).
Data preprocessing including instrument response removal, SNR screening, spectral whitening, 0.5–2.0 Hz bandpass filtering, moveout correction, one-sided Hanning tapering, and linear stacking.
1-D synthetic P-wave coda autocorrelation modeling comparing sharp Moho interfaces against gradational crust-mantle transition zones (0–2.0 km thick).
对OBS水听器标量压力记录（理论P波到时前10秒至后45秒）进行远震P波尾波自相关分析。
数据预处理包括去除仪器响应、信噪比筛选、频谱白化、0.5–2.0 Hz带通滤波、动校正、单边汉宁窗削趾及线性叠加。
开展一维合成P波尾波自相关正演模拟，对比尖锐莫霍面与不同厚度（0–2.0 km）渐变壳幔过渡带的响应差异。
de: Hydrophone recordings of teleseismic events from 22 broadband long-period (~1-year deployment) and 24 short-period (~25-day deployment) OBS stations in the 2011–2012 NoMelt experiment (55–75 Ma Pacific lithosphere).
Bathymetric data from GEBCO 2024 and crustal thickness reference from Earth Crustal Model 1 (ECM1).
2011–2012年太平洋NoMelt实验（55–75 Ma岩石圈）中22个宽频带长周期（约1年）和24个短周期（约25天）OBS台站的远震水听器记录。
GEBCO 2024水深地形数据以及地球地壳模型1（ECM1）全球参考模型数据。
li: In shallow water (~1,500 ± 500 m, TwTT 1.3–2.6 s), water-column reverberations overlap with and distort the Moho reflection.
Thin sediment layers (~200 m in NoMelt, TwTT < 0.3 s) cannot be resolved due to low dominant frequencies, whereas thick sediments generate interfering PsP phases.
Strongly dipping interfaces (e.g., in steep subduction zones) introduce significant errors into two-way travel time estimates.
在浅水区（水深约1500±500米，双程走时1.3–2.6秒），水层多次波会与莫霍面反射重叠并造成干扰。
受自相关波形低主频限制无法分辨薄沉积层（<0.3秒），而在厚沉积区则会产生干扰性的沉积基底反射相（PsP）。
在强倾斜界面区域（如陡峭俯冲带），近垂直入射平面波假设会导致双程走时估计产生显著误差。

tm.why: The study focuses on imaging the oceanic Moho discontinuity and inferring a crust-mantle transition zone beneath the NoMelt experiment array.
The authors apply seismic interferometry via teleseismic P-wave coda autocorrelation to extract vertical P-wave reflection responses from a single station.
The methodology specifically leverages ocean-bottom seismograph (OBS) hydrophone recordings to overcome instrument tilt, azimuthal misalignment, and poor seafloor coupling.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 11-page Geophysical Research Letters PDF, including all 4 figures, equations, and sections.

sum: This paper presents a lightweight convolutional neural network (CNN) to extract formation shear-wave velocity from quadrupole acoustic logging-while-drilling (LWD) array waveforms. Instead of traditional slowness-time coherence (STC) processing, which is computationally heavy and prone to noise, the proposed CNN directly regresses the inter-receiver moveout. Evaluated on a synthetic dataset, the model achieves a median relative velocity error of 2.51% ± 0.16%. It operates 25 times faster than vectorized STC and has a compact size of 266 KB, making it highly suitable for real-time downhole edge deployment. The study also explores the limits of supervised regression using STC-labeled logs, highlighting the risk of near-neighbor data leakage in random splitting.
本文提出一种轻量级CNN，直接从随钻四极子声波测井阵列波形中回归接收器间时差，以提取剪切波速度。在合成数据集上，该模型实现了2.51%的平均相对速度误差。模型大小仅266 KB，运行速度比传统STC方法快25倍，适合井下实时边缘部署。研究还通过深度阻断交叉验证揭示了传统随机划分中的数据泄漏风险。

t: Lightweight CNN-based moveout regression directly from array waveforms to bypass traditional grid-search STC.
基于轻量级CNN的波形时差直接回归方法，避免了传统的慢度-时间相关网格搜索。
Synthetic quadrupole acoustic logging-while-drilling (LWD) array waveforms and a field-measured STC log.
合成四极子随钻声波测井阵列波形数据集以及实测STC测井曲线。
Median relative velocity error of 2.51% ± 0.16% on synthetic data, 25x faster than vectorized STC, and a 266 KB model size.
在合成数据上实现2.51%的平均相对速度误差，速度比STC快25倍，模型仅266 KB。
Performance drops significantly (correlation r drops from 0.72 to 0.20) under depth-blocked cross-validation.
深度阻断交叉验证下相关系数降至0.20，跨深度泛化能力有限。
Direct regression of moveout using a lightweight CNN for real-time downhole LWD edge deployment, bypassing STC search.
提出直接回归时差的轻量级CNN，适用于井下边缘计算实时速度提取。

kc: Developed a lightweight CNN for direct moveout regression from quadrupole LWD waveforms, bypassing traditional grid-search STC.
Achieved a 25x speedup compared to vectorized STC, with a model size of only 266 KB suitable for downhole edge deployment.
Demonstrated the impact of near-neighbor data leakage in random splitting for logging data using depth-blocked cross-validation.
开发了一种轻量级CNN，直接从四极子随钻声波测井波形中回归时差，避开了传统的网格搜索STC方法。
与向量化STC相比，实现了25倍的加速，模型大小仅为266 KB，适合井下边缘部署。
通过深度阻断交叉验证，展示了测井数据在随机划分中邻近数据泄漏的影响。
me: Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) for direct moveout regression.
Slowness-time coherence (STC) processing as a baseline.
Depth-blocked cross-validation to evaluate spatial generalization and data leakage.
用于直接时差回归的卷积神经网络（CNN）。
作为基准对比的慢度-时间相关（STC）处理方法。
用于评估空间泛化能力和数据泄漏的深度阻断交叉验证。
de: Synthetic quadrupole acoustic logging-while-drilling (LWD) array waveform dataset.
Field-measured STC log used as labels for control experiments under different splitting strategies.
合成四极子随钻声波测井（LWD）阵列波形数据集。
在不同划分策略的对照实验中，用作标签的实测STC测井曲线。
li: The model's generalization drops significantly (correlation r drops to 0.20) when spatial correlation is blocked, indicating high sensitivity to out-of-distribution depth intervals.
当阻断空间相关性时，模型的泛化能力显著下降（相关系数降至0.20），表明其对分布外深度区间高度敏感。

tm.why: The paper proposes a lightweight convolutional neural network (CNN) to regress moveout directly from acoustic logging waveforms.
The study addresses the extraction of shear-wave velocity from wavefields, comparing the CNN approach to traditional slowness-time coherence (STC) inversion.

ev.notes: Analyzed based on the detailed abstract and metadata from OpenAlex and Crossref since no PDF was available.

sum: This study investigates regional variations in crustal seismic velocity susceptibility to earthquake shaking along the Alaska subduction zone. Using single-station coda-wave interferometry on continuous broadband ambient noise (±100 days) across three frequency bands (0.5–1, 1–2, and 2–4 Hz), the authors consistently analyze 14 Mw 6.8–8.2 Alaskan earthquakes. For sites experiencing peak ground velocities (PGV) > 0.65 cm/s and stable pre-event baselines, ~36–40% show significant coseismic dv/v drops, with a moderate negative correlation (~-0.3 to -0.47 Spearman) between dv/v and PGV. While Cook Inlet basin stations show large absolute dv/v drops due to amplified PGV, sites in the highest susceptibility decile (dv/v normalized by PGV) all occur near active volcanoes (Akutan, Makushin, Shishaldin, Pavlof, Katmai, Augustine). Frequency dependence and Rayleigh wave sensitivity kernels constrain changes to the uppermost 500 m, highlighting the role of shallow hydrothermal systems and poorly consolidated volcanic deposits.
本研究利用单台背景噪声尾波干涉方法，在0.5–1、1–2和2–4 Hz三个频段内一致分析了阿拉斯加俯冲带14次Mw 6.8–8.2级地震前后各100天的连续宽频带地震数据，探究地壳相对波速变化（dv/v）对地震动敏感性的区域差异。结果显示，约40%的台站在峰值地面速度（PGV）较大时出现显著同震波速……

t: Single-station coda-wave interferometry using the stretching method in SeisMIC across 6 component pairs and 3 octave frequency bands (0.5–4 Hz), fitted with a step drop, exponential recovery, and linear trend.
使用SeisMIC拉伸法对6个分量对和3个频段（0.5–4 Hz）进行单台尾波干涉，拟合阶跃下降与指数恢复模型。
Continuous broadband seismic data within ±100 days of 14 Mw 6.8–8.2 Alaskan earthquakes (2002–2025) from stations within 300–600 km, yielding 504 station-event time series paired with ShakeMap PGV.
14次Mw 6.8–8.2级阿拉斯加地震前后各100天的宽频带数据，共504条时间序列，结合ShakeMap PGV分析…

Only 36% of favorable station-event pairs show significant dv/v drops. Drops increase with frequency (mean -0.545% at 2–4 Hz), correlate moderately with PGV, and exhibit highest susceptibility near active volcanoes at <500 m depth.
36%的台站-事件对出现显著波速下降，幅度随频率增加，与PGV中等相关，最高敏感区位于活火山浅表500米内。

PGV values rely on ShakeMap estimates which may underestimate ground motion, seismic networks are spatially biased toward volcanoes, and depth kernels assume Rayleigh-wave dominance in the early coda.
PGV依赖ShakeMap可能低估震动，台网分布偏向火山区，且深度核假设早期尾波由瑞利波主导。

First large-scale, uniformly processed multi-earthquake analysis of coseismic dv/v susceptibility across the Alaska subduction zone, distinguishing PGV amplification in basins from genuinely elevated shallow volcanic susceptibility.
首次对阿拉斯加俯冲带多震例同震dv/v进行统一处理，区分了盆地PGV放大与火山浅部真实高敏感性。

kc: Consistently analyzed 504 single-station dv/v time series across 14 Mw 6.8–8.2 Alaskan earthquakes in three octave frequency bands.
Demonstrated that only ~36–40% of stations under favorable shaking and baseline stability conditions exhibit significant coseismic dv/v drops.
Identified that the highest dv/v susceptibility sites (normalized by PGV) are exclusively located near active arc volcanoes, whereas forearc basin sites have large drops driven by high PGV.
Constrained the dominant depth of coseismic dv/v changes to the uppermost <500 m using frequency dependence and Rayleigh-wave sensitivity kernels.
在三个倍频程频段内，对14次Mw 6.8–8.2级阿拉斯加地震的504条单台dv/v时间序列进行了一致性分析。
证明在有利的地震动和震前基线稳定性条件下，仅有约36–40%的台站表现出显著的同震dv/v下降。
发现归一化PGV后dv/v敏感性最高的台站全部位于活火山弧附近，而弧前盆地台站的大幅下降则源于高PGV放大。
结合频率依赖性与瑞利波敏感度核，将同震dv/v变化的主导深度约束在最浅表500米以内。
me: Single-station ambient noise cross-correlation across six component pairs (EE, NN, ZZ, EN, EZ, NZ) with one-bit normalization in 0.5–1, 1–2, and 2–4 Hz bands.
Coda-wave interferometry via the stretching method (up to ±3%) using the SeisMIC software package on 24-hr stacked noise correlation functions.
Parametric curve fitting of dv/v time series using a step function drop, exponential post-seismic recovery, and linear background trend optimized via the Nelder-Mead algorithm.
1-D Rayleigh-wave depth sensitivity kernel modeling using PREM and generic near-surface rock/volcanic velocity profiles.
对六个分量对（EE、NN、ZZ、EN、EZ、NZ）进行单台背景噪声互相关，采用1比特归一化并在0.5–1、1–2和2–4 Hz频段内分析。
使用SeisMIC软件包，对24小时叠加的噪声互相关函数应用拉伸法（±3%以内）进行尾波干涉测量。
结合阶跃下降、指数震后恢复和线性背景趋势模型，利用Nelder-Mead算法拟合dv/v时间序列。
基于PREM和典型近地表岩石/火山速度模型计算一维瑞利波深度敏感度核。
de: Continuous broadband seismic records spanning ±100 days around 14 Mw 6.8–8.2 Alaskan earthquakes (2002–2025) from networks AK, AV, TA, and others (within 300–600 km of epicenters).

提取USGS ShakeMap的峰值地面速度（PGV）估值，用于量化局部震动强度并对dv/v下降进行归一化。

The highest dv/v susceptibility sites are located near active Alaskan volcanoes and are linked to shallow hydrothermal systems, volcanic deposits, and seasonal freeze-thaw/snow loading effects.
The paper systematically relates coseismic crustal velocity drops to earthquake shaking strength quantified by peak ground velocity (PGV).

sum: Subsurface flow systems often exhibit hierarchical geological uncertainty involving both high-level metaparameters and high-dimensional cell-by-cell property fields. This paper develops an adaptive tempered sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) method for joint Bayesian inference of metaparameters and Gaussian latent variables under noncentered geological parameterizations (PCA and 3D latent diffusion models). Deep learning flow surrogates (recurrent transformer U-Net and convolutional-recurrent networks) replace expensive numerical simulations, with correlated surrogate errors explicitly incorporated into the likelihood. The method is also extended to successive (multistage) data assimilation by updating existing posterior particles via conditional likelihood tempering. Tested on 3D faulted carbon storage and channelized oil-water reservoir systems, SMC closely reproduces reference Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) posterior distributions and flow forecasts while achieving 2.5–7.0x speedups on a single GPU and 11.7–32.0x speedups across five GPUs, alongside major efficiency gains in successive assimilation.
针对地下渗流系统的分层地质不确定性，本文提出了一种自适应退火序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC）方法，在非中心化地质参数化（PCA与3D潜扩散模型）下联合反演地质超参数与高维高斯潜变量。研究采用深度学习渗流代理模型替代高成本数值模拟，并在似然函数中显式计入代理误差相关性；进一步将该框架扩展至多阶段序贯数据同化。在……

t: Adaptive tempered sequential Monte Carlo transports particles from a noncentered joint prior to the hierarchical posterior via ESS-based likelihood tempering, systematic resampling, and blockwise pCN/random-walk MCMC mutation using deep learning surrogates.

Evaluated on two 3D synthetic systems: a 333,684-cell faulted CO2 storage model (5000 GEOS runs, PCA parameterization) and a 524,288-cell channelized oil-water model (9000 tNavigator runs, 3D-LDM parameterization).

SMC closely matches reference MCMC posteriors across four synthetic test cases while reducing function evaluations and achieving 2.5–7.0x single-GPU speedups and 11.7–32.0x five-GPU speedups.

在三维断层碳封存和河道化油水系统中验证了该方法与参考MCMC的一致性，实现单GPU 2.5–7.0倍、多GPU 11.7–32.0倍加速。
me: Noncentered hierarchical parameterization decoupling metaparameters from standard Gaussian latent variables (PCA and 3D-LDM).
Adaptive likelihood tempering governed by importance-weight effective sample size (ESS) criteria, systematic resampling, and blockwise MCMC mutation.
Blockwise Metropolis-within-Gibbs mutation using preconditioned Crank-Nicolson (pCN) proposals for latent variables and Gaussian random-walk proposals for metaparameters.
Deep learning surrogate forward modeling (recurrent transformer U-Net for 3D CO2 plumes/pressure; 3D residual CNN-Transformer-GRU for well rates) with empirical error covariance.
非中心化分层地质参数化，将地质超参数与标准高斯潜变量（PCA和3D-LDM）在先验下解耦。

sum: This paper presents the design and unshielded validation of a three-axis vector optically pumped magnetometer (OPM) optimized for long-term stability in geomagnetic monitoring. Utilizing a buffer-gas-free rubidium vapor cell, a VCSEL, and direct absorption spectroscopy (DAS) for active frequency stabilization, the system overcomes thermal wavelength drift and wall-collision relaxation without complex sub-Doppler optics. Tested in an unshielded laboratory in Okayama, the OPM successfully tracked horizontal geomagnetic variations and resolved regional Parkinson induction vectors (reflecting the geomagnetic coast effect) despite DC railway interference. It achieves an intrinsic white noise floor of 10-20 pT above 1 Hz and a bias instability of 0.1 nT at 100-200 s. This work demonstrates a low-cost, high-stability OPM platform suitable for unshielded geophysical surveys.
本文研发了一种用于无屏蔽地磁监测的长期稳定三轴矢量光泵磁力仪。系统采用无缓冲气体铷气室，利用直接吸收光谱频率锁定克服激光漂移。在冈山无屏蔽环境下的测试表明，该仪器能准确追踪地磁变化并解析出反映区域电导率对比的帕金森感应矢量，白噪声达10-20 pT，为地球物理调查提供了低成本、高稳定的磁测平台。

sum: This study investigates the dynamic rupture process of the 1975 Ms 7.3 Haicheng earthquake using a grid-search-based spontaneous rupture simulation workflow. Constrained by magnitude and seismic intensity data, the authors perform 288 simulations using the boundary integral equation method (BIEM). The preferred model shows that the rupture involved three segments: the eastern and western Dayanghe faults and the conjugate Ximuhe fault. Nucleating on the eastern Dayanghe segment, the rupture propagated northwestward for ~11 seconds, yielding a Mw ~6.85 event with a maximum slip of ~2.5 m. Crucially, the simulation suggests that fluids likely facilitated rupture on the otherwise stable conjugate Ximuhe fault by weakening its frictional strength. This physics-based model provides a framework for reconstructing historical earthquake rupture processes.

sum: This paper reviews the achievements, current capabilities, and future directions of solid-Earth geophysics and geodesy in Antarctica. It highlights how GNSS and seismic networks, alongside airborne and satellite geophysics, have advanced our understanding of solid-Earth processes and their feedbacks with the Antarctic Ice Sheet (AIS). Key challenges include modeling realistic mantle rheology with lateral inhomogeneities and transient relaxation, and developing coupled ice-sheet/gravity-rotation-deformation models. The review outlines a multidisciplinary vision for future observations and modeling to improve projections of Antarctica's ice-mass and sea-level contributions.
本文综述了南极固体地球物理与大地测量学的进展、观测能力及未来方向。文章重点介绍了GNSS和地震网络在理解固体地球过程及其与冰盖相互作用中的应用。指出核心挑战在于构建包含横向非均匀性和瞬态松弛的真实地幔流变学模型，以及开发耦合的冰盖-重力-自转-形变模型，并提出了多学科联合观测与模拟的未来愿景。

sum: This study utilizes data-assimilation-based numerical simulations to investigate the origin and evolutionary trajectory of the New England Seamounts chain. The authors propose that the New England chain, Corner Seamounts, Great Meteor Seamounts, and Azores archipelago were all generated by a single source: the Azores plume. The simulation results indicate that the plume underwent a two-stage motion history. Crucially, the spatiotemporal distribution and geometry of these hotspot tracks are predominantly controlled by subduction-induced sublithospheric mantle flow, rather than plume-plate interactions. Plume-plate interactions instead primarily influence the continuity of this trans-plate hotspot system. These findings provide a novel reinterpretation of hotspot-track formation and offer critical constraints on mantle flow reorganization across multiple tectonic plates.
本研究采用数据同化数值模拟探讨新英格兰海山链的起源。结果表明，新英格兰海山、转角海山、大流星海山及亚速尔群岛均源于单一的亚速尔地幔柱。该地幔柱经历了两阶段运动，且俯冲诱导的岩石圈下地幔流主导了海山时空分布与轨迹几何，其影响超越了地幔柱-板块相互作用。该研究为跨板块热点轨迹形成提供了全新动力学解释。

t: Data-assimilation-based numerical geodynamic simulations of mantle flow and plume-plate interactions.

sum: This study investigates the crustal structure of the Jammu-Kashmir-Kishtwar Himalaya, located within the major Kashmir seismic gap (last great earthquake in 1555). Using teleseismic waveforms from 1,353 earthquakes recorded at 12 broadband stations (JAKSNET), the authors perform P-wave receiver function H-Vp/Vs stacking, Common Conversion Point (CCP) stacking, and joint inversion with Rayleigh-wave group-velocity dispersion (5–70 s). Results reveal a predominantly felsic crust (average Vs of 3.43±0.03 km/s, Vp/Vs of 1.74±0.03). The underthrusting Indian crust maintains a ~40 km thickness, with the Moho deepening northeastward at 2–3° from ~46–48 km beneath the Sub-Himalaya to ~54 km beneath the Kishtwar Window. The Main Himalayan Thrust (MHT) appears as a 2–6 km thick low-velocity layer deepening from 8–10 km to 18–20 km, featuring a 13–17° mid-crustal ramp beneath the Higher Himalaya where microseismicity marks the locked-to-creep transition.
本研究利用12个宽频带台站（JAKSNET）记录的1353个远震事件，结合P波接收函数H-Vp/Vs叠加、共转换点（CCP）叠加及与瑞利波群速度频散（5–70 s）的联合反演，揭示了克什米尔地震空区东段（查谟-克什米尔-基什特瓦尔喜马拉雅）的地壳结构。结果表明该区主要为长英质地壳（平均Vs为3.43……

t: The authors combine P-wave receiver function H-Vp/Vs stacking, depth-migrated Common Conversion Point (CCP) stacking, and linearized least-squares joint inversion of receiver functions and fundamental-mode Rayleigh-wave group-velocity dispersion curves.
结合P波接收函数H-Vp/Vs叠加、深度偏移CCP叠加，以及接收函数与瑞利波群速度频散的最小二乘联合反演。

Teleseismic P-wave recordings from 1,353 earthquakes (Mw > 5, 30°–90° distance) recorded between July 2013 and June 2019 across 12 broadband stations, augmented with 5–70 s Rayleigh-wave group velocity dispersion data.
12个宽频带台站记录的1353个远震P波波形（Mw>5，震中距30°–90°），结合5–70 s瑞利波群速度频散数据。

The crust is felsic (average Vs = 3.43±0.03 km/s, Vp/Vs = 1.74±0.03). The Moho dips 2–3° from ~46–48 km to ~54 km, and the MHT low-velocity layer deepens from 8–10 km to 18–20 km across a 13–17° ramp.

Due to uneven backazimuthal coverage of teleseismic events, modeling dipping or anisotropic structures and quantitatively estimating splay fault dips above the MHT are beyond the study's scope.
受限于远震反方位角覆盖不均，无法定量反演倾斜界面、各向异性结构及MHT上方分支断层倾角。
Provides the first broadband receiver-function and dispersion-derived 2D CCP and Vs crustal profile across the poorly constrained Jammu-Kishtwar segment of the Kashmir seismic gap.
首次利用宽频带台阵给出克什米尔地震空区查谟-基什特瓦尔段的高分辨率CCP图像和地壳Vs结构模型。

kc: First high-resolution 2D CCP receiver function image and 1D shear-wave velocity profile across the Jammu-Kishtwar segment of the Kashmir seismic gap.

Identification of the Main Himalayan Thrust (MHT) as a 2–6 km thick low-velocity zone with a flat-ramp-flat geometry, dipping 2–3° in the foreland and steepening to 13–17° beneath the Higher Himalaya.
Constraint on bulk crustal composition as predominantly felsic (average Vp/Vs = 1.74 ± 0.03, average Vs = 3.43 ± 0.03 km/s) with an underthrusting Indian crust of ~40 km uniform thickness.
Correlation of crustal structure with relocated seismicity and geodetic locking, estimating a ~100 km frictionally locked down-dip width capable of a maximum Mw ~8.4 earthquake across the 250 km gap.
首次给出了横跨克什米尔地震空区查谟-基什特瓦尔段的高分辨率二维CCP接收函数图像和一维剪切波速度剖面。
识别出主喜马拉雅逆冲断层（MHT）为2–6 km厚的低速带，呈断坪-断坡-断坪几何形态，前陆倾角2–3°，高喜马拉雅下方变陡至13–17°。
约束该区地壳整体为长英质成分（平均Vp/Vs = 1.74 ± 0.03，平均Vs = 3.43 ± 0.03 km/s），俯冲印度地壳厚度均匀（约40 km）。
将地壳结构与重定位地震活动及大地测量闭锁关联，估计MHT摩擦闭锁倾向宽度约100 km，在整个250 km空区可能产生最大Mw ~8.4地震。

Crustal thickness (H) and Vp/Vs grid-search stacking (Zhu & Kanamori 2000) with bootstrap uncertainty estimation.
Depth-migrated Common Conversion Point (CCP) stacking along a ~160 km profile using a modified IASP91 velocity model.
Linearized least-squares joint inversion (JOINT96) of clustered receiver functions and interpolated Rayleigh-wave group velocity dispersion curves (5–70 s).

de: Continuous waveform recordings at 100 Hz from 12 broadband stations of the JAKSNET array across Sub-, Lesser, and Higher Himalaya to the Kishtwar Window.
1,353 teleseismic earthquakes (Mw > 5.0, epicentral distance 30°–90°) recorded between July 2013 and June 2019.
Fundamental-mode Rayleigh wave group-velocity dispersion maps (5–70 s period) from Gilligan & Priestley (2018).
Forward modeling perturbation tests for LVL, HVL, and Moho depth (±5 km) plus 50-run bootstrap resampling tests.
跨越亚喜马拉雅、低喜马拉雅、高喜马拉雅至基什特瓦尔构造窗的12个JAKSNET宽频带台站100 Hz连续波形记录。

li: Non-uniform backazimuthal coverage of teleseismic events prevents quantitative modeling of dipping interfaces and crustal anisotropy.
Gaps in shallow CCP ray coverage limit the continuity of imaged splay faults above the Main Himalayan Thrust.

接收函数的频率成分（约1.2 Hz）将垂向结构分辨率限制在约1.5–2.0 km。

tm.why: The core analysis uses P-wave receiver-function CCP stacking, H-Vp/Vs stacking, and joint inversion with surface-wave dispersion to image the Moho and Main Himalayan Thrust.
The paper determines the crustal velocity architecture, Moho depth variations, and underthrusting Indian crust geometry across the Jammu-Kashmir-Kishtwar Himalaya.
The study images the flat-ramp-flat geometry of the Main Himalayan Thrust and links it to the transition from frictional locking to creep and active duplexing.

sum: This book chapter or section by Andreas Fichtner explores the theoretical foundations of potential field extrapolation in geophysics. It covers the mathematical formulation of upward and downward continuation of gravity and magnetic fields, highlighting the inherent ill-posedness of downward extrapolation and discussing methods to stabilize these inverse problems. The work serves as a pedagogical and methodological reference for computational geophysicists working on potential field data processing and inversion.
安德烈亚斯·菲希特纳（Andreas Fichtner）撰写的这一书章探讨了地球物理位场外推的理论基础。它涵盖了重力和磁场向上和向下延拓的数学公式，强调了向下延拓固有的病态性，并讨论了稳定这些反演问题的方法。该工作为处理位场数据和反演的计算地球物理学家提供了教学和方法论参考。

sum: This paper proposes a deterministic continuous-medium framework of rotational shear fission to explain the origin of the Earth-Moon system, challenging the canonical giant impact hypothesis. By modeling the coupled evolution of external gradient-induced shear torques and internal mass redistribution, the author shows that smooth rotational fission occurs when centrifugal stress exceeds viscous yield strength. This model quantitatively explains lunar volatile depletion, isotopic enrichment (heavy K and Zn), and the crustal dichotomy without requiring a global magma ocean. Crucially, it predicts a massive, unequilibrated lunar core, offering a falsifiable test for future lunar seismology.
本文提出了一种确定性的连续介质自转剪切分裂框架，用以解释地月系统的起源，挑战了传统的巨型撞击假说。通过模拟外部梯度诱导的剪切力矩与内部质量重新分布的耦合演化，作者指出当离心应力超过粘性屈服强度时，会发生平滑的自转分裂。该模型在无需全球岩浆洋的前提下，定量解释了月球挥发分流失、重同位素富集及地壳二分性……

t: Continuous-medium fluid dynamics modeling of rotational shear instability driven by internal rotational shear and centrifugal stress.
基于内部自转剪切和离心应力驱动的自转剪切不稳定性连续介质流体动力学模拟。
Theoretical model parameters and observed lunar isotopic enrichment data (potassium and zinc) used for validation.
用于验证的理论模型参数以及观测到的月球同位素富集数据（钾和锌）。
Quantitatively explains heavy potassium and zinc isotopic enrichment and predicts a massive, unequilibrated lunar core.
定量解释了重钾和锌同位素的富集，并预测了一个巨大的、未平衡的月球核心。
The model's predictions depend on simplified viscous yield strength assumptions and await future lunar seismic verification.
该模型的预测依赖于简化的粘性屈服强度假设，并有待未来的月球地震验证。
Replaces the stochastic giant impact hypothesis with a deterministic rotational shear fission mechanism.
用确定性的自转剪切分裂机制取代了随机的巨型撞击假说。

kc: Introduces a deterministic rotational shear fission model for Earth-Moon formation as an alternative to the stochastic giant impact hypothesis.
Explains lunar volatile depletion and isotopic enrichment through mass-dependent dissipation in a low-density vacuum.
Predicts a massive, unequilibrated lunar core, providing a concrete falsifiable hypothesis for future lunar seismic exploration.
引入了地月形成的确定性自转剪切分裂模型，作为随机巨型撞击假说的替代方案。
通过低密度真空中的质量相关耗散，解释了月球挥发分的流失和同位素富集。
预测了一个巨大的、未平衡的月球核心，为未来的月球地震探测提供了具体的、可证伪的假设。

The study models planetary differentiation, rotational shear instability, and the origin of the lunar crustal dichotomy.

sum: This study investigates the fate of subducted Bengal Basin sediments in the Burma subduction zone by constructing a 3D shear-wave velocity model down to 100 km depth. The authors combine Rayleigh-wave phase (7–50 s) and group (7–100 s) velocity dispersion curves extracted from ambient noise empirical Green's functions and 100 regional earthquakes recorded at 90 stations, alongside previously published dispersion curves, using direct surface-wave tomography. The model reveals a prominent low-velocity zone (Vs <= 4.0 km/s) at 60–90 km depth extending ~400 km laterally from the Wuntho-Popa arc beneath the Shan Plateau, overlain by thinned mantle lithosphere (<10 km beneath Tengchong). Because Vs is too low for normal asthenosphere, the authors novelly interpret this anomaly as subducted sediments that detached from the Indian slab and intruded subhorizontally beneath the overriding lithosphere, generating 6%–10% partial melt/fluids that support surface uplift and feed intraplate magmatism at Tengchong.
本研究利用90个台站的背景噪声互相关经验格林函数和100个区域地震波形，提取7–100秒瑞利波相速度与群速度频散曲线，采用面波直接反演法构建了缅甸俯冲带及邻区100公里以浅的三维剪切波速度模型。结果显示弧后掸邦高原下方60–90公里深度存在横向延伸约400公里的显著低速异常（Vs≤4.0 km/s）……

t: Direct 3D shear-wave velocity inversion of path-specific Rayleigh-wave phase (7–50 s) and group (7–100 s) dispersion curves using frequency-dependent curved ray tracing without intermediate 2D maps, after polynomial correction of noise-earthquake bias.
对背景噪声与地震频散偏差进行多项式校正后，采用基于频率相关射线追踪的面波直接反演法直接反演三维Vs模型。

Nearly 3 years of vertical-component ambient noise and 100 regional earthquakes recorded at 90 broadband stations in Myanmar and surrounding regions, combined with prior dispersion curves to yield 2,240 phase and 5,187 group velocity curves.
缅甸及邻区90个宽频带台站近3年背景噪声和100个区域地震，结合前人数据共2240条相速度和5187条群速度曲线。

Revealed a widespread ~400-km-wide low-velocity zone (Vs < 4.0 km/s, down to 3.8 km/s) at 60–90 km depth beneath the Shan Plateau, overlain by high-velocity lithosphere (Vs up to 4.4 km/s) thinning to <10 km beneath Tengchong.
发现掸邦高原下60–90 km处宽约400 km的低速带（Vs<4.0 km/s），其上覆岩石圈在腾冲下方减薄至不足10…
Resolution drops below ~50 km depth (resolving 2° x 2° but not 1.5° x 1.5° checkers), regularization underestimates LVZ amplitude, and model reliability is limited to 100 km depth.
50 km以深分辨率降至2°×2°，正则化低估了低速异常幅值，且有效解释深度限于100 km内。

First geophysical imaging demonstrating that subducted Bengal Basin sediments detach from the Indian slab and intrude ~400 km horizontally beneath the overriding lithosphere, driving backarc thinning and Tengchong intraplate volcanism.
首次通过地球物理成像揭示孟加拉盆地俯冲沉积物从板片拆离并水平注入弧后岩石圈下400 km，诱发腾冲火山活动。

kc: Constructed a 3D Vs model of the crust and upper mantle down to 100 km beneath northern/central Myanmar and adjacent regions using direct surface-wave inversion.
Identified and corrected a ~0.2 km/s period-dependent traveltime bias between ambient noise and earthquake group velocity measurements at 17–50 s periods.
Imaged a 400-km-wide upper-mantle low-velocity zone (Vs <= 4.0 km/s) at 60–90 km depth beneath the Shan Plateau, indicating 6%–10% melt/fluid fraction.
Proposed a geophysical model of sediment subduction, diapirism beneath the arc, and horizontal detachment/injection beneath the backarc lithosphere driving Tengchong volcanism.
利用面波直接反演方法，构建了缅甸中北部及邻区100公里深度以内的地壳和上地幔三维剪切波速度模型。
发现并校正了17–50秒周期内背景噪声与天然地震群速度测量之间约0.2 km/s的周期依赖性走时偏差。
揭示了掸邦高原下方60–90公里深度处宽约400公里的上地幔低速带（Vs≤4.0 km/s），指示存在6%–10%的部分熔融或流体。
提出了俯冲沉积物在弧下发生底辟并在弧后拆离、水平注入上覆岩石圈底部，进而驱动腾冲板内火山活动的地球物理模型。
me: Phase cross-correlation and frequency-domain normalization of 3-year vertical-component ambient noise data to extract empirical Green's functions (EGFs).
Automatic frequency-time analysis (AFTAN) to measure Rayleigh-wave phase (7–50 s) and group (7–100 s) velocity dispersion curves.
Empirical polynomial bias correction between ambient-noise and earthquake dispersion measurements using 277 nearly overlapping ray paths.
Direct 3D shear-wave velocity inversion with frequency-dependent ray tracing (Fang et al., 2015), validated via bootstrap resampling and checkerboard/restoration tests.
对近3年垂直分量背景噪声数据进行频域归一化和相位互相关，提取经验格林函数（EGFs）。
采用自动频时分析（AFTAN）测量瑞利波相速度（7–50秒）和群速度（7–100秒）频散曲线。
利用277条近似重合射线路径，通过三次多项式拟合消除背景噪声与地震频散测量之间的系统偏差。
基于频率相关射线追踪开展三维剪切波速度直接反演（Fang et al., 2015），并通过自助法重采样和检测板/异常体恢复测试评估可靠性。
de: Almost 3 years of continuous vertical-component seismic data and 100 regional earthquakes (M >= 5.0, depth <= 100 km) recorded by 90 stations across Myanmar and surrounding areas (MySCOLAR, BIMA, MM, CSN, etc.).
Combined dataset of 2,240 phase velocity and 5,187 group velocity dispersion curves (including dispersion curves from Bai et al., 2021).
缅甸及邻区90个地震台站（含MySCOLAR、BIMA、MM、CSN等台网）记录的近3年连续垂直分量背景噪声数据及100个区域地震（M≥5.0，深度≤100公里）。
融合前人数据（Bai et al., 2021）后共计2,240条相速度频散曲线和5,187条群速度频散曲线。
li: Horizontal resolution degrades at depths exceeding ~50 km, where 1.5° x 1.5° checkerboards are poorly resolved compared to 2° x 2° grids.
Amplitude of the deep low-velocity anomaly is underestimated in tomographic inversions due to regularization damping, and model interpretability is restricted to the top 100 km.
深度超过约50公里后水平分辨率下降，仅能较好恢复2°×2°网格而难以分辨1.5°×1.5°网格。
受正则化平滑影响，深部低速异常的幅值被低估，且模型的有效解释深度仅限于100公里以浅。

tm.why: The paper resolves the 3D shear-wave velocity structure of the crust and upper mantle using direct inversion of Rayleigh-wave phase and group velocity dispersion curves.
Empirical Green's functions from ambient noise cross-correlations across 90 stations are combined with regional earthquake data to extract surface wave dispersion.
The study investigates sediment subduction, detachment, horizontal injection beneath the overriding lithosphere, and intraplate volcanism in the Burma subduction zone.
